verses.sa:
श्रीसूत उवाच
ॐ पराशरं मुनिवरं कृतपौर्वाह्णिकक्रियम् ।
मैत्रेयः परिपप्रच्छ प्रणिपत्याभिवाद्य च ॥
verses.rom:
shrisuta uvacha
om parasharam munivaram kritapaurvahnikakriyam |
maitreyah paripaprachchha pranipatyabhivadya cha ||

verses.sa:
त्वत्तो हि वेदाध्ययनमधीतमखिलं गुरो ।
धर्मशास्त्राणि सर्वाणि तथांगनि यथाक्रमम् ॥
verses.rom:
tvatto hi vedadhyayanamadhitamakhilam guro |
dharmashastrani sarvani tathamgani yathakramam ||

verses.sa:
त्वत्प्रसादान्मुनिश्रेष्ठ मानन्ये नाकृतश्रमम् ।
वक्ष्यन्ति सर्वशास्त्रेषु प्रायशो येऽपि विद्विषः ॥
verses.rom:
tvatprasadanmunishreshtha mananye nakritashramam |
vakshyanti sarvashastreshu prayasho ye'pi vidvishah ||

verses.sa:
सोऽहमिच्छामि धर्मज्ञ श्रोतुं त्वत्तो यथा जगत् ।
बभूव भूयश्च​ यथा महाभाग भविष्यति ॥
verses.rom:
so'hamichchhami dharmajna shrotum tvatto yatha jagat |
babhuva bhuyashcha​ yatha mahabhaga bhavishyati ||

verses.sa:
यन्मयं च जगद्ब्रह्मन्यतश्चैतच्चराचरम् ।
लीनमासीद्यथा यत्र लयमेष्यति यत्र च ॥
verses.rom:
yanmayam cha jagadbrahmanyatashchaitachcharacharam |
linamasidyatha yatra layameshyati yatra cha ||

verses.sa:
यत्प्रमाणानि भूतानि देवादीनां च सम्भवम् ।
समुद्रपर्वतानां च संस्थानं च यथा भुवः ॥
verses.rom:
yatpramanani bhutani devadinam cha sambhavam |
samudraparvatanam cha samsthanam cha yatha bhuvah ||

verses.sa:
सूर्यादीनां च संस्थानं प्रमाणं मुनिसत्तम ।
देवादीनां तथा वंशान्मनून्मन्वन्तराणि च ॥
verses.rom:
suryadinam cha samsthanam pramanam munisattama |
devadinam tatha vamshanmanunmanvantarani cha ||

verses.sa:
कल्पान् कल्पविभागांश्च चातुर्युगविकल्पितान् ।
कल्पान्तस्य स्वरूपं च युगधर्माश्च कृत्स्नशः ॥
verses.rom:
kalpan kalpavibhagamshcha chaturyugavikalpitan |
kalpantasya svarupam cha yugadharmashcha kritsnashah ||

verses.sa:
देवर्षिपार्थिवानां च चरितं यन्महामुने ।
वेदशाखाप्रणयनं यथावद्व्‌यासकर्तृकम् ॥
verses.rom:
devarshiparthivanam cha charitam yanmahamune |
vedashakhapranayanam yathavadvyasakartrikam ||

verses.sa:
धर्माश्च ब्राह्मणादीनां तथा चाश्रमवासिनाम् ।
श्रोतुमिच्छाम्यहं सर्वं त्वृत्तो वासिष्ठनन्दन ॥
verses.rom:
dharmashcha brahmanadinam tatha chashramavasinam |
shrotumichchhamyaham sarvam tvritto vasishthanandana ||

verses.sa:
ब्रह्मन्प्रसादप्रवणं कुरुष्व मयि मानसम् ।
येनाहमेतज्जानीयां त्वत्प्रसादान्महामुने ॥
verses.rom:
brahmanprasadapravanam kurushva mayi manasam |
yenahametajjaniyam tvatprasadanmahamune ||

verses.sa:
श्रीपराशर उवाच
साधु मैत्रेय धर्मज्ञ स्मारितोऽस्मि पुरातनम् ।
पितुः पिता मे भगवान् वसिष्ठो यदुवाच ह ॥
verses.rom:
shriparashara uvacha
sadhu maitreya dharmajna smarito'smi puratanam |
pituh pita me bhagavan vasishtho yaduvacha ha ||

verses.sa:
विश्वामित्रप्रयुक्तेन रक्षसा भक्षितः पुरा ।
श्रुतस्तातस्ततः क्रोधो मैत्रेयाभून्ममातुलः ॥
verses.rom:
vishvamitraprayuktena rakshasa bhakshitah pura |
shrutastatastatah krodho maitreyabhunmamatulah ||

verses.sa:
ततोऽहं रक्षसां सत्रं विनाशाय समारभम् ।
भस्मीभूताश्च शतशस्तस्मिन्सत्रे निशाचराः ॥
verses.rom:
tato'ham rakshasam satram vinashaya samarabham |
bhasmibhutashcha shatashastasminsatre nishacharah ||

verses.sa:
ततः सड्‌क्षीयमाणेषु तेषु रक्षस्स्वशेषतः ।
मामुवाच महाभागो वसिष्ठो मत्पितामहः ॥
verses.rom:
tatah sadkshiyamaneshu teshu rakshassvasheshatah |
mamuvacha mahabhago vasishtho matpitamahah ||

verses.sa:
अलमत्यन्तकोपेन तात मन्युमिमं जहि ।
राक्षसा नापराध्यन्ति पितुस्ते विहितं हि तत् ॥
verses.rom:
alamatyantakopena tata manyumimam jahi |
rakshasa naparadhyanti pituste vihitam hi tat ||

verses.sa:
मूढानामेव भवति क्रोधो ज्ञानवतां कृतः ।
हन्यते तात कः केन यतः स्वकृतभुक्पुमान् ॥
verses.rom:
mudhanameva bhavati krodho jnanavatam kritah |
hanyate tata kah kena yatah svakritabhukpuman ||

verses.sa:
सत्र्चितस्यापि महता वत्स क्लेशेन मानवैः ।
यशसस्तपसश्र्चैव क्रोधो नाशकरः परः ॥
verses.rom:
satrchitasyapi mahata vatsa kleshena manavaih |
yashasastapasashrchaiva krodho nashakarah parah ||

verses.sa:
स्वर्गापवर्गव्यासेधकारणं परमर्षयः ।
वर्जयन्ति सदा क्रोधं तात मा तद्वशो भव ॥
verses.rom:
svargapavargavyasedhakaranam paramarshayah |
varjayanti sada krodham tata ma tadvasho bhava ||

verses.sa:
अलं निशाचरैर्दग्धैदीनैरनपकारिभिः ।
सत्रं ते विरमत्वेतत्क्षमासारा हि साधवः ॥
verses.rom:
alam nishacharairdagdhaidinairanapakaribhih |
satram te viramatvetatkshamasara hi sadhavah ||

verses.sa:
एवं तातेन तेनाहमनुनीतो महात्मना ।
उपसंहृतवान्सत्रं सद्यस्तद्वाक्यगौरवात् ॥
verses.rom:
evam tatena tenahamanunito mahatmana |
upasamhritavansatram sadyastadvakyagauravat ||

verses.sa:
ततः प्रीतः स भगवान्वसिष्ठो मुनिसत्तमः ।
सम्प्राप्तश्च तदा तत्र पुलस्त्यो ब्रह्मणः सुतः ॥
verses.rom:
tatah pritah sa bhagavanvasishtho munisattamah |
sampraptashcha tada tatra pulastyo brahmanah sutah ||

verses.sa:
पितामहेन दत्तार्घ्यः कृतासनपरिग्रहः ।
मामुवाच महाभागो मैत्रेय पुलहाग्रजः ॥
verses.rom:
pitamahena dattarghyah kritasanaparigrahah |
mamuvacha mahabhago maitreya pulahagrajah ||

verses.sa:
वैरे महति यद्दाक्याद्‌गुरोरद्याश्रिता क्षमा ।
त्वया तस्मात्समस्तानि भवात्र्च्छास्त्राणि वेत्स्यति ॥
verses.rom:
vaire mahati yaddakyadguroradyashrita kshama |
tvaya tasmatsamastani bhavatrchchhastrani vetsyati ||

verses.sa:
सन्ततेर्न ममोच्छेदः क्रुद्धेनापि यतः कृतः ।
त्वया तस्मान्महाभाग ददाम्यन्यं महावरम् ॥
verses.rom:
santaterna mamochchhedah kruddhenapi yatah kritah |
tvaya tasmanmahabhaga dadamyanyam mahavaram ||

verses.sa:
पुराणसंहिताकर्ता भवान्वत्स भविष्यति ।
देवतापारमार्थ्यं च यथावद्वेत्स्यते भवान् ॥
verses.rom:
puranasamhitakarta bhavanvatsa bhavishyati |
devataparamarthyam cha yathavadvetsyate bhavan ||

verses.sa:
प्रवृत्ते च निवृत्ते च कर्मण्यस्तमला मतिः ।
मत्प्रसादादसन्दिग्धा तव वत्स भविष्यति ॥
verses.rom:
pravritte cha nivritte cha karmanyastamala matih |
matprasadadasandigdha tava vatsa bhavishyati ||

verses.sa:
ततश्च प्राह भगवान्वसिष्ठो मे पितामहः ।
पुलस्त्येन यदुक्तं ते सर्वमेतद्भविष्यति ॥
verses.rom:
tatashcha praha bhagavanvasishtho me pitamahah |
pulastyena yaduktam te sarvametadbhavishyati ||

verses.sa:
इति पूर्वं वसिष्ठेन पुलस्त्येन च धीमता ।
यदुक्तं तत्स्मृतिं याति त्वत्प्रश्नादखिलं मम ॥
verses.rom:
iti purvam vasishthena pulastyena cha dhimata |
yaduktam tatsmritim yati tvatprashnadakhilam mama ||

verses.sa:
सोऽहं वदाम्यशेषं ते मैत्रेय परिपृच्छते ।
पुराणसंहितां सम्यक् तां निबोध यथातथम् ॥
verses.rom:
so'ham vadamyashesham te maitreya pariprichchhate |
puranasamhitam samyak tam nibodha yathatatham ||

verses.sa:
विष्णोः सकाशादुद्भूतं जगत्तत्रैव च स्थितम् ।
स्थितिसंयमकर्ताऽसौ जगतोऽस्य जगच्च सः ॥
verses.rom:
vishnoh sakashadudbhutam jagattatraiva cha sthitam |
sthitisamyamakarta'sau jagato'sya jagachcha sah ||

prose.en:
Om! Salutation unto Vāsudeva! O Pundarikāsha, victory unto thee! I bow unto thee, O origin of the universe! O Hrishikesha, O great Purusha, O thou the first born! That Vishnu, who is eternal, indecayable one, who is Brahmā, the Isvara and the Purusha,—who causeth the creation, the sustentation and the dissolution (of the world) consequent on the qualities being agitated,—and from whom hath sprung the cosmos with Pradhāna, Buddhi, etc.;—may he confer on us excellent understanding wealth and emancipation! Bowing down unto Vishnu, lord of the universe, and saluting Brahmā and the rest, and paying reverence unto my preceptor, I will rehearse the Purāna that is equal to the Vedas. Saluting and paying homage unto that best of ascetics, Parāçara—son unto Vasistha's son—versed in annals and the Purānas, accomplished in the Vedas and the branches thereof, and learned in the mysteries of the scriptures,—who had finished his first daily devotions.—Maitreya asked him, saying,—"O preceptor, I have one by one studied near thee all the scriptures as well as the Vedas and their branches. It is owing to thy grace that, O foremost of ascetics, almost all of those that are even our enemies, confess that I have studied all the branches of knowledge. O thou cognisant of righteousness, I am desirous of hearing from thee how this universe came into being, and how, O virtuous one, it shall be in the future; in what, O Brāhmana, the cosmos consists; wherefrom sprang this system of mobile and immobile objects; where it lay at first and where it shall dissolve itself; as to the objects that have manifested themselves; the genesis of the gods; the establishment of seas and mountains and the earth, and that of the sun, etc. and the dimensions thereof; the genealogies of the deities,—all about the Manus, and the Manwantaras, and Kalpas and Vikalpas of Kalpas composed of the fourfold division into Yugas; the character of the close of Kalpas; and the entire tendencies of the Yugas; and, O mighty ascetic, the history of Devarshis and monarchs; the proper division by Vyāsa of the Vedas into different parts; and the morality concerning Brāhmanas and others, as well as that of householders. O son of Vasishtha, I wish to hear all this related by thee. O Brahmana, incline thy mind favourably unto me, so that, O mighty anchoret, I may know all this through thy grace".

Pāraçara said,—"Excellent well; O Maitreya, O thou that art conversant with righteousness. Thou bringest into my recollection what of old my grandsire, the reverend Vasishtha, had said of old. When I heard that my sire had been devoured by the Rākshasa sent by Vicwāmitra, I was wrought up with an exceeding rage. Then I set about disturbing the sacrifice of the Rakshas; and in that sacrifice reduced to ashes night-rangers by hundreds. On the Rakshas undergoing extermination, the eminently pious Vasishtha, my grandfather, said unto me,—'Do not indulge in excessive wrath, O child, control this passion of thine. Albeit the Rākshasas did thus unto thy sire, yet have they not transgressed. This ire springeth up in fools; but where is the anger of the wise? Who, my child, destroyeth whom? Persons but reap their acts. O child, anger heweth away the great and immense asceticism and fame acquired with extreme toil by men. The prime saints ever banish anger, which retardeth heaven and emancipation. Therefore, my child, do not thou come under its sway. No need of burning the night-rangers, who have not wronged. Stop this sacrifice of thine. Pious people are composed of forgiveness.' Thus exhorted by my high-souled grandsire, I, for the sake of the dignity of his speech, stopped the sacrifice. Thereat, that foremost of ascetics, the reverend Vasishtha was gratified. And it came to pass that there appeared then Pulastya, son unto Brahmā. And when my grandfather had offered him arghya, when he had taken his seat, O Maitreya, the exceedingly righteous elder brother of Pulaha addressed me, saying,—'As, albeit a mighty enmity existeth (between thyself and the Rākshasas), thou hast resorted to forgiveness at the words of thy superior, thou shall master all the branches of knowledge. And as, although highly enraged, thou hast not cut off my sons, I, O pious one, shall confer on thee a mighty boon. Thou shalt be the author of the Purāna and Samhita, and thou shalt attain a consummate knowledge of the celestials. And through my grace, O child, thy intelligence shall be clear and unobstructed as concerns the Present and the Past.' Then my grandsire, the reverend Vasishtha, said,—'What Pulastya hath uttered to thee, must be so.' At thy question I remember me in full of all that formerly had been said unto me by Vasishtha and the intelligent Pulastya. And, O Maitreya, as thou hast asked me, I shall at length relate unto thee adequately the Purāna Samhitā.—Do thou understand that properly. This universe hath sprung from Vishnu,—and in Him it is established. He is the cause of the creation, maintenance and destruction thereof, and He is the universe".

verses.sa:
श्रीपराशर उवाच
अविकाराय शुद्धाय नित्याय परमात्मने ।
सदैकरूपरूपाय विष्णवे सर्वजिष्णवे ॥
verses.rom:
shriparashara uvacha
avikaraya shuddhaya nityaya paramatmane |
sadaikaruparupaya vishnave sarvajishnave ||

verses.sa:
नमो हिरण्यगर्भाय हरये शंकराय च ।
वासुदेवाय ताराय सर्गस्थित्यन्तकारिणे ॥
verses.rom:
namo hiranyagarbhaya haraye shamkaraya cha |
vasudevaya taraya sargasthityantakarine ||

verses.sa:
एकानेकस्वरूपाय स्थूलसूक्ष्मात्मने नमः ।
अव्यक्तव्यक्तरूपाय विष्णवे मुक्तिहेतवे ॥
verses.rom:
ekanekasvarupaya sthulasukshmatmane namah |
avyaktavyaktarupaya vishnave muktihetave ||

verses.sa:
सर्गस्थितिविनाशानां जगतो यो जगन्मयः ।
मूलभूतो नमस्तस्मै विष्णवे परमात्मने ॥
verses.rom:
sargasthitivinashanam jagato yo jaganmayah |
mulabhuto namastasmai vishnave paramatmane ||

verses.sa:
आधारभूतं विश्वस्याप्यणीयांसमयीयसाम् ।
प्रणम्य सर्वभूतस्थमच्युतं पुरुषोत्तमम् ॥
verses.rom:
adharabhutam vishvasyapyaniyamsamayiyasam |
pranamya sarvabhutasthamachyutam purushottamam ||

verses.sa:
ज्ञानस्वरूपमत्यन्तनिर्मलं परमार्थतः ।
तमेवार्थस्वरूपेण भ्रान्तिदर्शनतः स्थितम् ॥
verses.rom:
jnanasvarupamatyantanirmalam paramarthatah |
tamevarthasvarupena bhrantidarshanatah sthitam ||

verses.sa:
विष्णुं ग्रसिष्णुं विश्वस्य स्थितौ सर्गे तथा प्रभुम् ।
प्रणम्य जगतामीशमजमक्षयमव्ययम् ॥
verses.rom:
vishnum grasishnum vishvasya sthitau sarge tatha prabhum |
pranamya jagatamishamajamakshayamavyayam ||

verses.sa:
कथयामि यथापूर्व दक्षाद्यैर्मुनिसत्तमैः ।
पृष्ट प्रोवाच भगवानब्जयोनिः पितामहः ॥
verses.rom:
kathayami yathapurva dakshadyairmunisattamaih |
prishta provacha bhagavanabjayonih pitamahah ||

verses.sa:
तैश्चौक्तं पुरुकुत्साय भूभुजे निर्मदातटे ।
सारस्वताय तेनापि मह्मं सारस्वतेन च ॥
verses.rom:
taishchauktam purukutsaya bhubhuje nirmadatate |
sarasvataya tenapi mahmam sarasvatena cha ||

verses.sa:
परः पराणां परमः परमात्मात्मसंस्थितः ।
रूपवर्णादिनिर्देशविशेषणविवर्जितः ॥
verses.rom:
parah paranam paramah paramatmatmasamsthitah |
rupavarnadinirdeshavisheshanavivarjitah ||

verses.sa:
अपक्षयविनाशाभ्यां परिणामर्धिजन्मभिः ।
वर्जितः शक्यते वक्तुंयः सदास्तीति केवलम् ॥
verses.rom:
apakshayavinashabhyam parinamardhijanmabhih |
varjitah shakyate vaktumyah sadastiti kevalam ||

verses.sa:
सर्वत्रासौ समस्तं च वसत्यत्रेति वै यतः ।
ततः स वासुदेवेति विद्वद्भिः परिपठ्यते ॥
verses.rom:
sarvatrasau samastam cha vasatyatreti vai yatah |
tatah sa vasudeveti vidvadbhih paripathyate ||

verses.sa:
तद्‌ब्रह्म परंमं नित्यमजमक्षयमव्ययम् ।
एकस्वरूपं तु सदा हेयाभावाच्च निर्मलम् ॥
verses.rom:
tadbrahma parammam nityamajamakshayamavyayam |
ekasvarupam tu sada heyabhavachcha nirmalam ||

verses.sa:
तदेव सर्वमेवैतद्‌व्यक्ताव्यक्तस्वरूपवत् ।
तथा पुरुषरूपेण कालरूपेण च स्थितम् ॥
verses.rom:
tadeva sarvamevaitadvyaktavyaktasvarupavat |
tatha purusharupena kalarupena cha sthitam ||

verses.sa:
परस्य ब्रह्मणो रूपं पुरुषः प्रथमं द्विज ।
व्यक्ताव्यक्ते तथैवान्ये रूपे कालस्तथा परम् ॥
verses.rom:
parasya brahmano rupam purushah prathamam dvija |
vyaktavyakte tathaivanye rupe kalastatha param ||

verses.sa:
प्रधानपुरुषव्यक्तकालानां परमं हि यत् ।
पश्यन्ति सूरयः शुद्धं तद्विष्णोः परमं पदम् ॥
verses.rom:
pradhanapurushavyaktakalanam paramam hi yat |
pashyanti surayah shuddham tadvishnoh paramam padam ||

verses.sa:
प्रधानपुरुषव्यक्तकालास्तु प्रविभागशः ।
रूपाणि स्थितिसर्गान्तव्यक्तिसद्भावहेतवः ॥
verses.rom:
pradhanapurushavyaktakalastu pravibhagashah |
rupani sthitisargantavyaktisadbhavahetavah ||

verses.sa:
व्यक्तं विष्णुस्तथाव्यक्तं पुरुषः काल एव च ।
क्रीडतो बालकस्येव चेष्टां तस्य निशामय ॥
verses.rom:
vyaktam vishnustathavyaktam purushah kala eva cha |
kridato balakasyeva cheshtam tasya nishamaya ||

verses.sa:
अव्यक्तं कारणं यत्तत्प्रधानमृषिसत्तमैः ।
प्रोच्यते प्रकृतिः सूक्ष्मा नित्यं सदसदात्मकम् ॥
verses.rom:
avyaktam karanam yattatpradhanamrishisattamaih |
prochyate prakritih sukshma nityam sadasadatmakam ||

verses.sa:
अक्षय्यं नान्यदाधारममेयमजरं ध्रुवम् ।
शब्दस्पर्शविहीनं तद्रूपादिभिरसंहितम् ॥
verses.rom:
akshayyam nanyadadharamameyamajaram dhruvam |
shabdasparshavihinam tadrupadibhirasamhitam ||

verses.sa:
त्रिगुणं तज्जगद्योनिरनादिप्रभवाप्ययम् ।
तेनाग्रे सर्वमेवासीद्व्‌यांत्पं वै प्रलयादनु ॥
verses.rom:
trigunam tajjagadyoniranadiprabhavapyayam |
tenagre sarvamevasidvyamtpam vai pralayadanu ||

verses.sa:
वेदवादविदो विद्दन्नियता ब्रह्मवादिनः ।
पठन्ति चैतमेवार्थ प्रधानप्रतिपादकम् ॥
verses.rom:
vedavadavido viddanniyata brahmavadinah |
pathanti chaitamevartha pradhanapratipadakam ||

verses.sa:
नाहो न रात्रिर्न नभो न भूमि- र्नासीत्ममोज्योतिरभूच्च नान्यत् ।
श्रोत्रादिबुद्धयानुपलभ्यमेकं प्राधानिकं ब्रह्म पुमांस्तदासीत् ॥
verses.rom:
naho na ratrirna nabho na bhumi- rnasitmamojyotirabhuchcha nanyat |
shrotradibuddhayanupalabhyamekam pradhanikam brahma pumamstadasit ||

verses.sa:
विष्णोः स्वरूपात्प​रतो हि ते द्वे रूपे प्रधानं पुरुषश्च विप्र ।
तस्यैव तेऽन्येन धूते वियुक्ते रूपांन्तरं तद्‌द्विज कालसंज्ञम् ॥
verses.rom:
vishnoh svarupatpa​rato hi te dve rupe pradhanam purushashcha vipra |
tasyaiva te'nyena dhute viyukte rupamntaram taddvija kalasamjnam ||

verses.sa:
प्रकृतौ संस्थितं व्यक्तमतीतप्रलये तु यत् ।
तस्मात्प्राकृतसंज्ञोऽयमुच्यते प्रतिसत्र्चरः ॥
verses.rom:
prakritau samsthitam vyaktamatitapralaye tu yat |
tasmatprakritasamjno'yamuchyate pratisatrcharah ||

verses.sa:
अनादिर्भगवान्कालो नान्तोऽस्य द्विज विद्यते ।
अव्युच्छिन्नास्ततस्त्वेते सर्गस्थित्यन्तसंयमाः ॥
verses.rom:
anadirbhagavankalo nanto'sya dvija vidyate |
avyuchchhinnastatastvete sargasthityantasamyamah ||

verses.sa:
गुणसाम्ये ततस्तस्मिन्पृथक्पूंसि व्यवस्थिते ।
कालस्वरूपं तद्विष्णोर्मैत्रेय परिवर्त्तते ॥
verses.rom:
gunasamye tatastasminprithakpumsi vyavasthite |
kalasvarupam tadvishnormaitreya parivarttate ||

verses.sa:
ततस्तु तप्तरं ब्रह्मं परमात्मा जगन्मयः ।
सर्वगः सर्वभूतेशः सर्वात्मा परमेश्वरः ॥
verses.rom:
tatastu taptaram brahmam paramatma jaganmayah |
sarvagah sarvabhuteshah sarvatma parameshvarah ||

verses.sa:
प्रधानपुरुषौ चापि प्रविश्यात्मेच्छया हरिः ।
क्षोभयामास सम्प्राप्ते सर्गकाले व्ययाव्ययौ ॥
verses.rom:
pradhanapurushau chapi pravishyatmechchhaya harih |
kshobhayamasa samprapte sargakale vyayavyayau ||

verses.sa:
यथा सन्निधिमात्रेण गन्धः क्षोभाय जायते ।
मनसो नोपकर्तृत्वात्तथाऽसौ परमेश्वरः ॥
verses.rom:
yatha sannidhimatrena gandhah kshobhaya jayate |
manaso nopakartritvattatha'sau parameshvarah ||

verses.sa:
स एव क्षोभको ब्रह्मन् क्षोभ्यश्र्च पुरुषोत्तमः ।
स संकोचविकासाभ्यां प्रधानत्वेऽपिच स्थितः ॥
verses.rom:
sa eva kshobhako brahman kshobhyashrcha purushottamah |
sa samkochavikasabhyam pradhanatve'picha sthitah ||

verses.sa:
विकासाणुस्वरूपैश्च ब्रह्मरूपादिभिस्तथा ।
व्यक्तस्वरूपश्च तथा विष्णुः सर्वेश्वरेश्वरः ॥
verses.rom:
vikasanusvarupaishcha brahmarupadibhistatha |
vyaktasvarupashcha tatha vishnuh sarveshvareshvarah ||

verses.sa:
गुणसाम्यात्ततस्तस्मात्क्षेत्रज्ञाधिष्ठितान्मुने ।
गुणव्यत्र्जनसम्भूतिः सर्गकाले द्विजोत्तम ॥
verses.rom:
gunasamyattatastasmatkshetrajnadhishthitanmune |
gunavyatrjanasambhutih sargakale dvijottama ||

verses.sa:
प्रधानतत्त्वमुद्भतं महान्तं तत्समावृणोत् ।
सात्विको राजसश्चैव तामसश्च त्रिधा महान् ॥
verses.rom:
pradhanatattvamudbhatam mahantam tatsamavrinot |
satviko rajasashchaiva tamasashcha tridha mahan ||

verses.sa:
प्रधानतत्वेन समं त्वचा बीजमिवावृतम् ।
वैकारिकस्तैजसश्च भूतादिश्चैव तामस्वः ॥
verses.rom:
pradhanatatvena samam tvacha bijamivavritam |
vaikarikastaijasashcha bhutadishchaiva tamasvah ||

verses.sa:
त्रिविधोऽयमहंकारो महत्तत्त्वादजायत ।
भूतेन्द्रियाणां हेतुस्स त्रिगुणत्वान्महामुने ।
यथा प्रधानेन महान्महता स तथावृतः ॥
verses.rom:
trividho'yamahamkaro mahattattvadajayata |
bhutendriyanam hetussa trigunatvanmahamune |
yatha pradhanena mahanmahata sa tathavritah ||

verses.sa:
भूतादिस्तु विकुर्वाणः शब्दतन्मात्रकं ततः ।
ससर्ज शब्दतन्मात्रादाकाशं शब्दलक्षणम् ॥
verses.rom:
bhutadistu vikurvanah shabdatanmatrakam tatah |
sasarja shabdatanmatradakasham shabdalakshanam ||

verses.sa:
शब्दमात्रं तथाकाशं भूतादिः स समावृणोत् ।
आकाशस्तु विकुर्वाणः स्पर्शमात्रं ससर्ज ह ॥
verses.rom:
shabdamatram tathakasham bhutadih sa samavrinot |
akashastu vikurvanah sparshamatram sasarja ha ||

verses.sa:
बलवानभवद्वायुस्तस्य स्पर्शो गुणो मतः ।
आकाशं शब्दमात्रं तु स्पर्शमात्रं समावृणोत् ॥
verses.rom:
balavanabhavadvayustasya sparsho guno matah |
akasham shabdamatram tu sparshamatram samavrinot ||

verses.sa:
ततो वायुर्विकुर्णाणो रूपमात्रं ससर्ज ह ।
ज्योतिरुत्पद्यते वायोस्तद्रूपगुणमुच्यते ॥
verses.rom:
tato vayurvikurnano rupamatram sasarja ha |
jyotirutpadyate vayostadrupagunamuchyate ||

verses.sa:
स्पर्शमात्रं तु वै वायू रूपमात्रं समावृणोत् ।
ज्योतिश्चापि विकृर्वाणं रसमात्रं ससर्ज ह ॥
verses.rom:
sparshamatram tu vai vayu rupamatram samavrinot |
jyotishchapi vikrirvanam rasamatram sasarja ha ||

verses.sa:
सम्भवन्ति ततोऽम्भांसि रसाधाराणि तानि च र।
रसमात्राणि चाम्भांसि रूपमात्रं समावृणोत् ॥
verses.rom:
sambhavanti tato'mbhamsi rasadharani tani cha ra|
rasamatrani chambhamsi rupamatram samavrinot ||

verses.sa:
विकुर्वाणानि चाम्भांसि गन्धमात्रं ससर्जिरे ।
संघातो जायते तस्मात्तस्य गन्धो गुणो मतः ॥
verses.rom:
vikurvanani chambhamsi gandhamatram sasarjire |
samghato jayate tasmattasya gandho guno matah ||

verses.sa: तस्मिंस्तस्मिंस्तु तन्मात्रं तेन तन्मात्रता स्मृता ॥
verses.rom: tasmimstasmimstu tanmatram tena tanmatrata smrita ||

verses.sa: तन्मात्राण्यविशेषाणि अविशेषास्ततो हि ते ॥
verses.rom: tanmatranyavisheshani avisheshastato hi te ||

verses.sa:
न शान्ता नापि घोरास्ते न मूढाश्चाविशेषिणः ।
भूततन्मात्रसर्गोऽयमहकांरात्तु तामसात् ॥
verses.rom:
na shanta napi ghoraste na mudhashchavisheshinah |
bhutatanmatrasargo'yamahakamrattu tamasat ||

verses.sa:
तैजसानीन्द्रीयाण्याहूर्देवा वैकारिका दश ।
एकादशं मनश्चात्र देवा वैकारिकाः स्मृताः ॥
verses.rom:
taijasanindriyanyahurdeva vaikarika dasha |
ekadasham manashchatra deva vaikarikah smritah ||

verses.sa:
त्वक् चक्षुर्नासिका जिह्वा श्रोत्रमत्र च पत्र्चमम् ।
शब्दादीनामवाप्त्यर्थं बुद्धीयुक्तानि वै द्विज ॥
verses.rom:
tvak chakshurnasika jihva shrotramatra cha patrchamam |
shabdadinamavaptyartham buddhiyuktani vai dvija ||

verses.sa:
पायूपस्थौ करौ पादौ वाक् च मैत्रेय पत्र्चमी ।
विसर्गशिल्पगत्युक्ति कर्म तेषां च कथ्यते ॥
verses.rom:
payupasthau karau padau vak cha maitreya patrchami |
visargashilpagatyukti karma tesham cha kathyate ||

verses.sa:
आकाशवायुतेजांसि सलिलं पृथिवी तथा ।
शब्दादिभिर्गुणैर्ब्रह्मन्संयुक्तान्युत्तरोत्तरैः ॥
verses.rom:
akashavayutejamsi salilam prithivi tatha |
shabdadibhirgunairbrahmansamyuktanyuttarottaraih ||

verses.sa: शान्ता घोराश्च मूढाश्च विशेषास्तेन ते स्मृताः ॥
verses.rom: shanta ghorashcha mudhashcha visheshastena te smritah ||

verses.sa:
नानावीर्याः पृथग्भूतास्ततस्ते संहतिं विना ।
नाशक्रुवन्प्रजाः स्त्रष्टुमसमागम्य कृत्स्त्रशः ॥
verses.rom:
nanaviryah prithagbhutastataste samhatim vina |
nashakruvanprajah strashtumasamagamya kritstrashah ||

verses.sa:
समेत्यान्योन्यसंयोगं परस्परसमाश्रयाः ।
एकसंघातलक्ष्याश्च सम्प्राप्यैक्यमशेषतः ॥
verses.rom:
sametyanyonyasamyogam parasparasamashrayah |
ekasamghatalakshyashcha samprapyaikyamasheshatah ||

verses.sa: पुरुषाधिष्ठितताच्च प्रधानानुग्रहेण च महदाद्या विशेषान्ता ह्माण्डमुत्पादयन्ति ते ॥
verses.rom: purushadhishthitatachcha pradhananugrahena cha mahadadya visheshanta hmandamutpadayanti te ||

verses.sa:
तत्क्रमेण विवृद्धं सज्जलबुदबुदवत्समम् ।
भूतेभ्योऽण्डं महाबुद्धें महत्तदुदकेशयम् ।
प्राकृतं ब्रह्मरूपयस्य विष्णोः स्थानमनुत्तमम् ॥
verses.rom:
tatkramena vivriddham sajjalabudabudavatsamam |
bhutebhyo'ndam mahabuddhem mahattadudakeshayam |
prakritam brahmarupayasya vishnoh sthanamanuttamam ||

verses.sa:
तत्राव्यक्तस्वरूपोऽसौ व्यक्तरूपो जगत्पतिः ।
विष्णुर्ब्रह्मस्वरूपेण स्वयमेव व्यवस्थितः ॥
verses.rom:
tatravyaktasvarupo'sau vyaktarupo jagatpatih |
vishnurbrahmasvarupena svayameva vyavasthitah ||

verses.sa:
मेरुरुल्बमभूत्तस्य जरायुश्च महीधराः ।
गर्भोदकं समुद्राश्च तस्यासन्सुमहात्मनः ॥
verses.rom:
merurulbamabhuttasya jarayushcha mahidharah |
garbhodakam samudrashcha tasyasansumahatmanah ||

verses.sa:
साद्रिद्वीपसमुद्राश्च सज्योतिर्लोकसंग्रहः ।
तस्मिन्नण्डेऽभवद्विप्र सदेवासुरमानुषः ॥
verses.rom:
sadridvipasamudrashcha sajyotirlokasamgrahah |
tasminnande'bhavadvipra sadevasuramanushah ||

verses.sa:
वारिवह्‌न्यनिलाकाशैस्ततो भूतादिना बहिः ।
वृतं दशगुणैरण्डं भूतादिर्महता तथा ॥
verses.rom:
varivahnyanilakashaistato bhutadina bahih |
vritam dashagunairandam bhutadirmahata tatha ||

verses.sa:
अव्यक्तेनावृतो ब्रह्मांस्तैः सर्वोः सहितो महान् ।
एभिरावरणैरण्डं सप्तभिः प्राकृतैर्वृतम् ।
नारिकेलफलस्यान्तर्बीजं बाह्मदलैरिव ॥
verses.rom:
avyaktenavrito brahmamstaih sarvoh sahito mahan |
ebhiravaranairandam saptabhih prakritairvritam |
narikelaphalasyantarbijam bahmadalairiva ||

verses.sa:
जुषन रजो गुणं तत्र स्वयं विश्वेश्वरो हरिः ।
ब्रह्मा भूत्वास्य जगतो विसृष्टौ सम्प्रवर्त्तते ॥
verses.rom:
jushana rajo gunam tatra svayam vishveshvaro harih |
brahma bhutvasya jagato visrishtau sampravarttate ||

verses.sa:
सृष्टं च पात्यनुयुगं यावत्कल्पविकल्पना ।
सत्त्वभृद्भगवान्विष्णुरप्रमेयपराक्रमः ॥
verses.rom:
srishtam cha patyanuyugam yavatkalpavikalpana |
sattvabhridbhagavanvishnuraprameyaparakramah ||

verses.sa:
तमोद्रेकी चा कल्पान्ते रुद्ररूपी जनार्दनः ।
मैत्रेयाखिलभूतानि भक्षयत्यतिदारुणः ॥
verses.rom:
tamodreki cha kalpante rudrarupi janardanah |
maitreyakhilabhutani bhakshayatyatidarunah ||

verses.sa:
भक्षयित्वा च भूतानि जगत्येकार्णवीकृते ।
नागपर्यंकशयने शेते च परमेश्वरः ॥
verses.rom:
bhakshayitva cha bhutani jagatyekarnavikrite |
nagaparyamkashayane shete cha parameshvarah ||

verses.sa: प्रबुद्धश्च पुनः सृष्टिं करोति ब्रह्मरूपधृक् ॥
verses.rom: prabuddhashcha punah srishtim karoti brahmarupadhrik ||

verses.sa:
सृष्टिस्थित्यन्तकरणीं ब्रह्मविष्णुशिवात्मिकाम् ।
स संज्ञां याति भगवानेक एव जनार्दनः ॥
verses.rom:
srishtisthityantakaranim brahmavishnushivatmikam |
sa samjnam yati bhagavaneka eva janardanah ||

verses.sa:
स्त्रष्टा सृजति चात्मानं विष्णुः पाल्यंच पाति च ।
उपसंह्रियते चान्ते संहर्ता च स्वयं प्रभुः ॥
verses.rom:
strashta srijati chatmanam vishnuh palyamcha pati cha |
upasamhriyate chante samharta cha svayam prabhuh ||

verses.sa:
पृथिव्यापस्तथा तेजो वायुराकाश एव च ।.
सर्वोन्द्रियान्तः करणं पुरुषाख्यं हि यज्जगत् ॥
verses.rom:
prithivyapastatha tejo vayurakasha eva cha |.
sarvondriyantah karanam purushakhyam hi yajjagat ||

verses.sa:
स एव सर्वभूतात्मा विश्वरूपो यतोऽव्ययः ।
सर्गादिकं तु तस्यैव भूतस्थमुपकारकम् ॥
verses.rom:
sa eva sarvabhutatma vishvarupo yato'vyayah |
sargadikam tu tasyaiva bhutasthamupakarakam ||

verses.sa:
स एव सृज्यः स च सर्गकर्ता स एव पात्यत्ति च पाल्यते च ।
ब्रह्माद्यवस्थाभिरशेषमूर्ति र्विष्णुर्वरिष्ठो वरदो वरेण्यः ॥
verses.rom:
sa eva srijyah sa cha sargakarta sa eva patyatti cha palyate cha |
brahmadyavasthabhirasheshamurti rvishnurvarishtho varado varenyah ||

prose.en:
Parāçara said:—"I bow unto Him that is holy and eternal—the supreme Soul who is ever uniform,—even Vishnu, the Lord of all. I bow unto Hiranyagarbha, unto Hara and Sankara, unto Vasudeva the saviour, even him who bringeth about creation, maintenance and destruction to everything. I bow unto him that is uniform yet hath a multiplicity of forms; who is both subtle and gross;—who is manifested and unmanifested; unto Vishnu, the cause of salvation. I bow unto Vishnu, the supreme Soul, who pervadeth the universe, and who is the fundamental cause of the creation, sustenance and extinction of everything. And bowing down unto Him, who is the stay of the universe,—who is minuter than the minutest monad,—who resides in every being—unto the undeteriorating foremost Purusha, who is extremely pure, and constitutes knowledge of the highest kind,—who in consequence of the erroneous sight (of people) seemeth to be endowed with a shape; unto the Vishnu who can compass the creation, maintenance and destruction of the universe,—saluting the Lord of the world, un-born, unchangeable and undeteriorating,—I shall relate what formerly, asked by Paksha and other great ascetics, the reverend lotus sprung Great-sire said unto them, and what they rehearsed unto king Purukutsa on the banks of the Narmadā; and what he, in his turn, related to Sāraswata,—and the last unto me. He who is Prime and Greater than the greatest, who is the supreme Soul resident in himself,—who cannot be differentiated by by form, color, etc, who is without deterioration or destruction, and without birth, growth and dissolution; who can only be asserted as existing,—is called by the learned Vāsudeva, in consequence of his existing everywhere and in all objects. That Brahmā is prime and eternal,—without birth, change or deterioration. He is uniform, and pure in consequence of the absence of the ignoble. He is all this (that is)—he is Manifested and Unmanifested; and he exists as the Primal Purusha and Time. O twice-born one, the first form of the Primæval Brahmā is a Male Being. His other forms are Manifested and Unmanifested, Time and the rest. The wise see that sacred state of Vishnu, which is superior to Pradhāna Purusha, Manifest and Time. The forms of Vishnu, first consisting of Pradhāna, Purusha, Manifest and Time are the causes and expressions of creation, sustenance, and destruction. Do thou understand that Vyakta, Vishnu, Avyakta, Purusha and Time are the exertions of Him, resembling those of a child sporting. That which is the Unmanifested Cause, is called subtle Nature by the foremost saints,—external, and instinct with cause and effect. It is indestructible, supportless, immeasurable, undeteriorating, real devoid of sound or touch, and without form, etc. It hath three several modes;—and is the mother of the Universe, without beginning and is the end of all. Formerly after the universal dissolution, everything was permeated by it. O Brāhmana, those versed in the language of the Veda,—exercising self-control and meditating the Deity, read the sense expressive of Pradhāna, thus. Day was not, nor night, nor sky, nor earth. And there was neither darkness nor yet light. And there existed then Pradhāna, Brahmā and the Purusha,—incapable of being apprehended by ear and the other organs, or the intellect. As O Vipra, the prime Vishnu hath two forms, Pradhāna and Purusha, so, O twice-born one, he hath another, which is joined to him (on the occasion of creation) and severed from him during the universal dissolution; and this is called Kāla. (Time). During the past dissolution, in consequence of the Vyakta remaining nascent in Prakriti, this circumstance in popular parlance is called Kāla. O twice-born one, the revered Kāla hath no beginning and hath no end; and in it genesis, stability and dissolution are uninterrupted. On the occasion of the universal dissolution, when Prakriti and Purusha remain separate, O Maitreya, there exists the form of Vishnu termed Kāla. Then at the time of creation, the supreme Brahmā, the Prime spirit pervading the universe, reaching everywhere—the lord of all beings, and the soul of all—the foremost Lord, Hari, entering into Pradhāna and Purusha, agitated them. And as odour, simply by reason of its proximity, and without any act, stirreth the mind, even so did the Supreme Lord. That best of males, O Brāhmana, is he that stirreth, and He it is that is stirred; he possessing in himself the three modes alike when in equilibrium and when not, entereth into Pradhāna. And that Lord of lords, Vishnu, manifests himself in gross elements in subtle objects, and in such forms as Brahmā and others. And, O best of twice-born ones, on the occasion of creation, from the equipoise of the principles presided over by Kshetrajna, springs up that which manifests the principles. And then Pradhāna overspread Mahat; and the three kinds of Mahat pertaining respectively to goodness, passion and foulness, were enveloped by Pradhāna, even as the rind envelopeth the seed. And from the three kinds of Mahat sprang three kinds of ahankāra; (consciousness,) viz., vaikārika, taijasa and bhutādi. And, O mighty ascetic, as Pradhāna had enveloped Mahat, that cause of the elements and the senses, viz., akankāra from its containing the three principles, was in its turn, enveloped by Mahat. Then the bhutādi, etc., being wrought, produced the rudiments of sound, and from the latter came into being ether, having the property of sound. And (anon) the bhutādi overspread the rudiments of sound as well as the ether; and, ether being wrought, produced the rudiments of touch; and then sprang the powerful air, whose property is known to be touch. And ether furnished with nascent audibility, covered air, endowed with tangibility. And then the air, wrought up, brought forth the rudiments of form. Light came from the air, and its property is said to be form. And the rudimental air endowed with touch, enveloped the rudimental tangibility. And light, being agitated, caused the taste; and therefrom sprang water, the residence of taste. And the rudiments of form overspread the rudiments of taste. And water, stirred, developed the rudiments of odour; therefrom sprang hardness endued with the property of odour. The subtle condition of a property existing in diverse objects is called Tanmātra. In consequence of the Tanmātras not being differentiated, they are undistinguishable; they are not agreeable or unpleasant of cause dullness,—and they are not marked by any distinguishing feature. From the consciousness related to darkness sprang the five rudiments and the five elements; from the conciousness relating to light sprang the organs of sense and from the consciousness relating to goodness sprang the ten deities. The mind is the eleventh (organ). The deities are known to have sprung from the principle of goodness. O twice-born one, the touch, the eye, the nose, the tongue, and the ear for the fifth, are designed for the perception of sound, etc. and are backed by intellect. The other organs are the anus, the organs of generation, the hands, the feet, and the vocal organs for the fifth; and the functions of these are excretion, articulation, motion, and mechanic labor. Ether, air, light, water, and earth, O Brāhmana, are respectively furnished with the properties of sound etc. and in consequence of their being agreeable or otherwise, or bringing on delusion,—they are known as Vicesha.

"And endowed with distinct energies, they without combining, and being all of them interfused, could not create objects. And then, coming together, and each supporting the others, they attained firmness and harmony and a uniform appearance. And in consequence of their being presided over by the Purasha, and favored by Pradhana, (who was ripe for it), those, commencing from Mahat and ending in Vishesha, brought forth an egg. And that egg resembling a watery bubble, fostered by the elements, attained dimensions. O thou of exceeding intelligence; and that egg formed by Prakriti, resting on water, became the body of Vishnu wearing the form of Brahmā,—And there Vishnu—lord of the universe—who is incapable of being perceived,—becoming manifest, remained in the form of Brahmā. And Meru became the bellows-like inner covering of that exceedingly high-souled one, and the other mountains became his outer covering; and the seas served for his water in the womb. And, O Vipra, in that egg sprang mountains and islands, and seas, light, and numbers of worlds, and deities, Asuras and human beings. And that egg was environed ten times successively with water, fire, air, ether, and bhutādi and the bhutādi was surrounded in the same way by mahat. And mahat along with all those was also covered by avyakta. As the internal cocoanut fruit is covered by the external rind, etc., even so was the egg surrounded by the natural coverings. Then the lord of the universe, inspiring the principle of passion, and becoming Brahmā, became engaged on creation. And until the expiry of Kalpa, the worshipful Vishnu of immeasurable power, instinct with the principle of goodness, sustaineth creation. And at the end of a Kalpa, O Maitreya, Janārddana, surcharged with the principle of foulness, wearing a fierce form and becoming terrific swalloweth up all. And having swallowed up all beings, anon the cosmos becoming one ocean, the supreme Lord lieth down on the couch (formed by) the serpent. And walking, he, wearing the form of Brahmā, again addresseth himself to creation. And in consequence of his creating, sustaining and dissolving verily one Janārddana acquireth the appellations of Brahmā, Vishnu and Siva. As creator, Vishnu createth himself, and, as sustainer, he sustaineth himself, and, finally, becoming the destroyer, the Lord himself destroyeth everything. And as earth, water, light, air and ether, all the organs of sense and the heart go by the name Purusha, (Vishnu as being the Primal male, is the author of all these.) And, as he is the lord of all beings, and, as, knowing no decay, he hath the universe for his form, even he is the creator of all, and his also are the ends attained by beings".

verses.sa:
श्रीमैत्रेय उवाच
निर्गुणस्याप्रमेयस्य शुद्धस्याप्यमलात्मनः ।
कथं सर्गादिकर्तृत्वं ब्रह्मणोऽभ्युपगम्यते ॥
verses.rom:
shrimaitreya uvacha
nirgunasyaprameyasya shuddhasyapyamalatmanah |
katham sargadikartritvam brahmano'bhyupagamyate ||

verses.sa:
श्रीपराशर उवाच
शक्तयः सर्वभावानामचिन्त्यज्ञानगोचराः ।
यतोऽतो ब्रह्मणस्तास्तु सर्गाद्या भावशक्तयः ।
भवन्ति तपतां श्रेष्ठ पावकस्य यथोष्णता ॥
verses.rom:
shriparashara uvacha
shaktayah sarvabhavanamachintyajnanagocharah |
yato'to brahmanastastu sargadya bhavashaktayah |
bhavanti tapatam shreshtha pavakasya yathoshnata ||

verses.sa:
तन्निबोध यथा सर्गे भगवान्सम्प्रवर्त्तते ।
नारायणाख्यो भगवान्ब्रह्म लोकपितामहः ॥
verses.rom:
tannibodha yatha sarge bhagavansampravarttate |
narayanakhyo bhagavanbrahma lokapitamahah ||

verses.sa: उप्तन्नः प्रोच्यते विद्वन्नित्यमेवोपचारतः ॥
verses.rom: uptannah prochyate vidvannityamevopacharatah ||

verses.sa:
निजेन तस्य मानेन आयुर्वर्षशतं स्मृतम् ।
तत्पराख्यं तदर्द्ध च परार्द्धमभिधीयते ॥
verses.rom:
nijena tasya manena ayurvarshashatam smritam |
tatparakhyam tadarddha cha pararddhamabhidhiyate ||

verses.sa:
कालस्वरूपं विष्णोश्च यन्मयोक्तं तवानघ ।
तेन तस्य निबोध त्वं परिमाणोपपादनम् ॥
verses.rom:
kalasvarupam vishnoshcha yanmayoktam tavanagha |
tena tasya nibodha tvam parimanopapadanam ||

verses.sa:
अन्येषां चैव जन्तूनां चराणामचराश्च ये ।
भूभूभृत्सागरादीनामशेषाणां च सत्तम ॥
verses.rom:
anyesham chaiva jantunam charanamacharashcha ye |
bhubhubhritsagaradinamasheshanam cha sattama ||

verses.sa:
काष्ठा पत्र्चदशाख्याता निमेषा मुनिसत्तम ।
काष्ठा पत्र्चदशाख्याता निमेषा मनिसत्तम ।
काष्ठा त्रिंशत्कला त्रिंशत्कला मौहूर्तिको विधिः ॥
verses.rom:
kashtha patrchadashakhyata nimesha munisattama |
kashtha patrchadashakhyata nimesha manisattama |
kashtha trimshatkala trimshatkala mauhurtiko vidhih ||

verses.sa:
तावत्संख्यैरहोरात्रं मुहूर्तैर्मानुषं स्मृतम् ।
अहोरात्राणि तावानित मासः पक्षद्वयात्मकः ॥
verses.rom:
tavatsamkhyairahoratram muhurtairmanusham smritam |
ahoratrani tavanita masah pakshadvayatmakah ||

verses.sa:
तैः षड्‌भिरयनं वर्ष द्वेऽयनें दक्षिणोत्तरे ।
अयनं दक्षिणं रात्रिर्देवानामुत्तरं दिनम् ॥
verses.rom:
taih shadbhirayanam varsha dve'yanem dakshinottare |
ayanam dakshinam ratrirdevanamuttaram dinam ||

verses.sa:
दिव्यैर्वर्षसहस्त्रैस्तु कृतत्रेतदिसंज्ञितम् ।
चतुर्युगं द्वादशभिस्तद्विभागं निबोध मे ॥
verses.rom:
divyairvarshasahastraistu kritatretadisamjnitam |
chaturyugam dvadashabhistadvibhagam nibodha me ||

verses.sa:
चत्वारि त्रीणि द्वै चैकं कृतादिषु यथाक्रमम् ।
दिव्याब्दानां सहस्त्राणि युगेष्वाहुः पुराविदः ॥
verses.rom:
chatvari trini dvai chaikam kritadishu yathakramam |
divyabdanam sahastrani yugeshvahuh puravidah ||

verses.sa:
तत्प्रमाणैः शतैः सन्ध्या पूर्वा तत्राभिधीयते ।
सन्ध्यांशश्चैव तत्तुल्यो युगस्यानन्तरो हि सः ॥
verses.rom:
tatpramanaih shataih sandhya purva tatrabhidhiyate |
sandhyamshashchaiva tattulyo yugasyanantaro hi sah ||

verses.sa:
सन्ध्यासध्यांशयोरन्तर्यः कालो मुनिसत्तम ।
युगाख्यः स तु विज्ञेयः कृतत्रेतादिसंज्ञितः ॥
verses.rom:
sandhyasadhyamshayorantaryah kalo munisattama |
yugakhyah sa tu vijneyah kritatretadisamjnitah ||

verses.sa:
कृतं त्रेता द्वाररश्च कलिश्चैव चतुर्युगम् ।
प्रोच्यते तस्तहस्त्र च ब्रह्मणो दिवसं मुने ॥
verses.rom:
kritam treta dvararashcha kalishchaiva chaturyugam |
prochyate tastahastra cha brahmano divasam mune ||

verses.sa:
ब्रह्मणो दिवसे ब्रह्मन्मनवस्तु चतुर्दश ।
भवन्ति परिमाणं च तेषां कालकृतं श्रृणु ॥
verses.rom:
brahmano divase brahmanmanavastu chaturdasha |
bhavanti parimanam cha tesham kalakritam shrrinu ||

verses.sa:
सप्तर्षयः सुराः शक्रो मनुस्तत्सूनवो नृपाः ।
एककाले हि सृज्यन्ते संह्रियन्ते च पूर्ववत् ॥
verses.rom:
saptarshayah surah shakro manustatsunavo nripah |
ekakale hi srijyante samhriyante cha purvavat ||

verses.sa:
चतुर्यगुणां संख्याता साधिका ह्रोकासप्ततिः ।
मन्वन्तरं मनोः कालः सुरादीनां च सत्तम ॥
verses.rom:
chaturyagunam samkhyata sadhika hrokasaptatih |
manvantaram manoh kalah suradinam cha sattama ||

verses.sa:
अष्टौ शत सहस्त्राणि दिव्ययां संख्यया स्मृतम् ।
द्विपत्रचाशत्तथान्यानि सहस्त्राण्यधिकानि तु ॥
verses.rom:
ashtau shata sahastrani divyayam samkhyaya smritam |
dvipatrachashattathanyani sahastranyadhikani tu ||

verses.sa:
त्रिंशत्कोट्यस्तु सम्पूर्णाः संख्याताः संख्याया द्विज ।
सप्तषष्टिस्तथान्यानि नियुतानि महामुने ॥
verses.rom:
trimshatkotyastu sampurnah samkhyatah samkhyaya dvija |
saptashashtistathanyani niyutani mahamune ||

verses.sa:
विंशतिस्तु सह्स्त्राणि कालोऽयमधिकं विना ।
मन्वन्तरस्य सड्खयेयं मानुषैर्वत्सरैर्द्विज ॥
verses.rom:
vimshatistu sahstrani kalo'yamadhikam vina |
manvantarasya sadkhayeyam manushairvatsarairdvija ||

verses.sa:
चतुर्दशगुणो ह्योष कालो ब्राह्ममहः स्मृतम् ।
ब्राह्मो नैमित्तिको नाम तस्यान्ते प्रतिसत्र्चरः ॥
verses.rom:
chaturdashaguno hyosha kalo brahmamahah smritam |
brahmo naimittiko nama tasyante pratisatrcharah ||

verses.sa:
तदा ही दह्राते सर्वं त्रैलोक्यं भूर्भुवादिकम् ।
जनं प्रयान्ति तापार्था महर्लोकनिवासिनः ॥
verses.rom:
tada hi dahrate sarvam trailokyam bhurbhuvadikam |
janam prayanti tapartha maharlokanivasinah ||

verses.sa:
एकार्णवे तु त्रैलोक्ये ब्रह्म नारायणात्मकः ।
भोगिशय्यां गतः शेते त्रैलोक्यग्रासबृंहितः ॥
verses.rom:
ekarnave tu trailokye brahma narayanatmakah |
bhogishayyam gatah shete trailokyagrasabrimhitah ||

verses.sa:
जनस्थैर्योगिभिर्देवाश्चिन्त्यमानोऽब्जसम्भवः ।
तत्प्रमाणां हि तां रात्रिं तदन्ते सृजते पुनः ॥
verses.rom:
janasthairyogibhirdevashchintyamano'bjasambhavah |
tatpramanam hi tam ratrim tadante srijate punah ||

verses.sa:
एवं तु ब्रह्मणो वर्षमेवं वर्षशतं च यत् ।
शतं हि तस्य वर्षाणां परमायुर्महात्मनः ॥
verses.rom:
evam tu brahmano varshamevam varshashatam cha yat |
shatam hi tasya varshanam paramayurmahatmanah ||

verses.sa:
एकमस्य व्यतीतं तु परार्द्ध ब्रह्मणोऽनघ ।
तस्यान्तेऽभून्महाकल्पः पाद्य इत्यभिविश्रुतः ॥
verses.rom:
ekamasya vyatitam tu pararddha brahmano'nagha |
tasyante'bhunmahakalpah padya ityabhivishrutah ||

verses.sa:
द्वितीयस्य परार्द्धस्य वर्तमानस्य वै द्विज ।
वाराह इति कल्पोऽयं प्रथमः परिकीर्तितः ॥
verses.rom:
dvitiyasya pararddhasya vartamanasya vai dvija |
varaha iti kalpo'yam prathamah parikirtitah ||

prose.en: Maitreya said:—"How can Brahmā, who is devoid of quality and confineless and pure and unblamed of soul, possibly engage in creation, etc.?" Thereat Parāçara said,—"As the powers of many an object are incomprehensible and incapable of being construed to sense, the powers of creation etc., possessed by Brahmā, like the heat of fire, are also so. O foremost of ascetics, hearken how the Professor of the eight kinds of wealth becomes engaged in creation. O wise one, in consequence of the eternal reverend Vishnu coming into being from objects, as Brahmā the Grand-father, he is designated as produced. According to the measure set by him human life is known as consisting of an hundred years. This (age) is called para, and the half thereof Parārdha. O sinless one, do thou listen to me as I mention unto thee the divisions of that which I have named unto thee as the Time-form of Vishnu,—in relation to Him as well as other creatures, and mobile and immobile objects, and the seas and all other things, O best of men. O chief of ascetics, a kāsthā is composed of fifteen nimeshas; thirty kāsthās make up a kalā; and thirty kalās a muhurta; and as many muhurtas make up a day and a night unto human beings. As many days and nights form a month; and a month consists of two fortnights. Six months form an ayana; and a year is composed of two ayanas, one northern, the other southern. The southern ayana is the night of the celestials, as the northern is their day. The period of twelve thousand years of the deities constitute the four Yugas, viz. Krita, Tretā, and the others. Do thou understand that. Chronologists say that four, three, two, and one thousand divine years successively compose Krita and the other Yugas. An hundred divine years are said to constitute the first twilight, as another hundred years the last, of the Yuga. The space that intervenes between these twilights goeth by the name of Yuga, embracing Krita, Tretā and the rest. And O anchoret, a thousand of the four Yugas, Krita, Tretā, Dwāpara and Kali, constitute one day of Brahmā. One day of Brahmā O Brāhmana, compriseth four and ten reigns of the Manus. Listen to the chronology thereof! The seven saints, the celestials, Sakra, Manu, and his sons—kings all of them—are created at the same time and, as formerly, are destroyed at the same time, O excellent one, a little over seventy-one four Yugas constitute a Manwantara—the period of Manu as well as the gods. Manwantara takes up over eight lakshas and fifty-two thousand years; and, O twice-born one, full thirty kotis above sixty-seven niyutas and about twenty thousand human years. Ten and fourteen such periods form one day of Brahmā. Then comes on his sleep and at the end thereof, the universal dissolution. And then all the triune world, comprising Bhur, Bhuva and the rest, are in conflagration, and the dwellers of the regions of Maha, exercised with the heat, resort to the regions of Jana. On the three regions being reduced to one sheet of sea, that deity, the lotus-sprung Brahmā instinct with Nārāyana, contemplated by the Yogis of Janasthāna,—with the intention of swallowing up the three worlds,—lieth down on the bed (formed by) the serpent. And having spent the night measuring that period, at the end thereof he begins anew the work of creation. This is the year of Brahmā and thus is the space of his hundred years; and the life of that high-souled one is an hundred (such) years. O thou without sin, one half of Brahmās life is spent. On the expiration thereof passeth away a Mahākalpa—which is called Pādma. O twice-born one, this is the Kalpa distinguished as Vatrahā belonging to the second Parāddha, which is present".

verses.sa:
श्रीमैत्रेय उवाच ।
ब्रह्मानारायणाख्योऽसौ कल्पादौ भगवान्यथा ।
ससर्ज सर्वभूतानि तदाचक्ष्व महामुने ॥
verses.rom:
shrimaitreya uvacha |
brahmanarayanakhyo'sau kalpadau bhagavanyatha |
sasarja sarvabhutani tadachakshva mahamune ||

verses.sa:
श्रीपराशर उवाच ।
प्रजाः ससर्ज भगवान्ब्रह्मा नारायणात्मकः ।
प्रजापतिपतिर्देवो यथा तन्मे निशामय ॥
verses.rom:
shriparashara uvacha |
prajah sasarja bhagavanbrahma narayanatmakah |
prajapatipatirdevo yatha tanme nishamaya ||

verses.sa:
अतीतकल्पावसाने निशासुप्तोत्थितः प्रभुः ।
सत्त्वोद्रि क्तस्तथा ब्रह्मा शून्यं लोकमवैक्षत ॥
verses.rom:
atitakalpavasane nishasuptotthitah prabhuh |
sattvodri ktastatha brahma shunyam lokamavaikshata ||

verses.sa:
नारायणः परोऽचिन्त्यः परोषामपि स प्रभुः ।
ब्रह्मस्वरूपी भगवाननादिः सर्वसम्भवः ॥
verses.rom:
narayanah paro'chintyah paroshamapi sa prabhuh |
brahmasvarupi bhagavananadih sarvasambhavah ||

verses.sa:
इमं चोदाहरन्त्यत्र श्लोकं नारायणं प्रति ।
ब्रह्मस्वरूपिणं देवं जगतः प्रभवाप्ययम् ॥
verses.rom:
imam chodaharantyatra shlokam narayanam prati |
brahmasvarupinam devam jagatah prabhavapyayam ||

verses.sa:
आपो नारा इति प्रोक्ता आपो वै नरसूनवः ।
अयनं तस्य ताः पूर्वं तेन नारायणः स्मृतः ॥
verses.rom:
apo nara iti prokta apo vai narasunavah |
ayanam tasya tah purvam tena narayanah smritah ||

verses.sa:
तोयान्तःस्थां महीं ज्ञात्वा जगत्येकार्णवीकृते ।
अनुमानात्तदुद्धारं कर्तुकामः प्रजापतिः ॥
verses.rom:
toyantahstham mahim jnatva jagatyekarnavikrite |
anumanattaduddharam kartukamah prajapatih ||

verses.sa:
अकरोत्स्वतनूमन्यां कल्पादिषु यथा पुरा ।
सत्स्यकूर्मादिकां तद्वद्वाराहं वरुरास्थितः ॥
verses.rom:
akarotsvatanumanyam kalpadishu yatha pura |
satsyakurmadikam tadvadvaraham varurasthitah ||

verses.sa:
वेदयज्ञमयं रूपमश्षोजगतः स्थितौ ।
स्थितः स्थिरात्मा सर्वात्मा परमात्मा प्रजापतिः ॥
verses.rom:
vedayajnamayam rupamashshojagatah sthitau |
sthitah sthiratma sarvatma paramatma prajapatih ||

verses.sa:
जनलोकगतैस्सिद्धैस्सनकाद्यैरभिष्टुतः ।
प्रविवेश तदा तोयमात्माधारो धराधरः ॥
verses.rom:
janalokagataissiddhaissanakadyairabhishtutah |
pravivesha tada toyamatmadharo dharadharah ||

verses.sa:
निरीक्ष्य तं तदा देवी पातालातलमागतम् ।
तुष्टाव प्रणता भूत्वा भक्तिनम्रा वसुन्धरा ॥
verses.rom:
nirikshya tam tada devi patalatalamagatam |
tushtava pranata bhutva bhaktinamra vasundhara ||

verses.sa:
श्रीपृथिव्युवाच ।
नमस्ते पुण्डरीकाक्ष शंखचक्रगदाधर ।
मामुद्धरास्मादद्य त्वं त्वत्तोऽहं पूर्वमुत्थिता ॥
verses.rom:
shriprithivyuvacha |
namaste pundarikaksha shamkhachakragadadhara |
mamuddharasmadadya tvam tvatto'ham purvamutthita ||

verses.sa:
त्वयाहमुद्धृता पूर्वं त्वन्मयाहं जनार्दन ।
तथान्यानि च भूतानि गगनादीन्यश्षोतः ॥
verses.rom:
tvayahamuddhrita purvam tvanmayaham janardana |
tathanyani cha bhutani gaganadinyashshotah ||

verses.sa:
नमस्ते परमात्मात्मन्पुरुषात्मन्नमोस्तु ते ।
प्रधानव्यक्तभूताय कालभूताय ते नमः ॥
verses.rom:
namaste paramatmatmanpurushatmannamostu te |
pradhanavyaktabhutaya kalabhutaya te namah ||

verses.sa:
त्वं कर्ता सर्वभूतानां त्वं पाता त्वं विनाशकृत् ।
सर्गादिषु प्रभो ब्रह्मविष्णुरुद्रा त्मरूपधृक् ॥
verses.rom:
tvam karta sarvabhutanam tvam pata tvam vinashakrit |
sargadishu prabho brahmavishnurudra tmarupadhrik ||

verses.sa:
सम्भक्षयित्वा सकलं जगत्येकार्णवीकृते ।
श्षोए! त्वमेव गोविंद चिन्त्यमानो मनीषिभिः ॥
verses.rom:
sambhakshayitva sakalam jagatyekarnavikrite |
shshoe! tvameva govimda chintyamano manishibhih ||

verses.sa:
भवतो यत्परं तत्त्वं तन्न जानाति कश्चन ।
अवतारेषु यद्रू पं तदर्चन्ति दिवौकसः ॥
verses.rom:
bhavato yatparam tattvam tanna janati kashchana |
avatareshu yadru pam tadarchanti divaukasah ||

verses.sa:
त्वामाराध्य परं ब्रह्म याता मुक्तिं मुमुक्षवः ।
वासुदेवमनाराध्य को मोक्षं समवाप्स्यति ॥
verses.rom:
tvamaradhya param brahma yata muktim mumukshavah |
vasudevamanaradhya ko moksham samavapsyati ||

verses.sa:
यत्किंचिन्मनसा ग्राह्यं यद्ग्राह्यं चक्षुरादिभिः ।
बुद्ध्या च यत्परिच्छेद्यं तद्रू पमखिलं तव ॥
verses.rom:
yatkimchinmanasa grahyam yadgrahyam chakshuradibhih |
buddhya cha yatparichchhedyam tadru pamakhilam tava ||

verses.sa:
त्वन्मयाहं त्वदाधारा त्वत्सृष्टा त्वत्समाश्रया ।
माधवीमिति लोकोयमभिधत्ते ततो हि माम् ॥
verses.rom:
tvanmayaham tvadadhara tvatsrishta tvatsamashraya |
madhavimiti lokoyamabhidhatte tato hi mam ||

verses.sa:
जयाखिलज्ञानमय जय स्थूलमयाव्यय ।
जयाऽनन्त जयाव्यक्त जय व्यक्तमय प्रभो ॥
verses.rom:
jayakhilajnanamaya jaya sthulamayavyaya |
jaya'nanta jayavyakta jaya vyaktamaya prabho ||

verses.sa:
परापरात्मन्विश्वात्मञ्जय यज्ञपतेऽनघ ।
त्वं यज्ञस्त्वं वषट्कारस्त्वमॐकारस्त्वमग्नयः ॥
verses.rom:
paraparatmanvishvatmanjaya yajnapate'nagha |
tvam yajnastvam vashatkarastvamaomkarastvamagnayah ||

verses.sa:
त्वं वेदास्त्वं तदङ्गानि त्वं यज्ञपुरुषो हरे ।
सूर्यादयो ग्रहास्तारा नक्षत्राण्यखितं जगत् ॥
verses.rom:
tvam vedastvam tadangani tvam yajnapurusho hare |
suryadayo grahastara nakshatranyakhitam jagat ||

verses.sa:
मूर्तामूर्तमदृश्यं च दृश्यं च पुरुषोत्तम ।
यच्चोक्तं यच्च नैवोक्तं मयात्र परमेश्वर ।
तत्सर्वं त्वं नमस्तुभ्यं भूयोभूयो नमोनमः ॥
verses.rom:
murtamurtamadrishyam cha drishyam cha purushottama |
yachchoktam yachcha naivoktam mayatra parameshvara |
tatsarvam tvam namastubhyam bhuyobhuyo namonamah ||

verses.sa:
श्रीपराशर उवाच ।
एवं संस्तूयमानस्तु पृथिव्या धरणीधरः ।
सामस्वरध्वनिः श्रीमाञ् जगर्ज परिघर्घरम् ॥
verses.rom:
shriparashara uvacha |
evam samstuyamanastu prithivya dharanidharah |
samasvaradhvanih shriman jagarja parighargharam ||

verses.sa:
ततः समुत्क्षिप्य धरां स्वदंष्ट्रया महावराहः स्फुटपद्मलोचनः ।
रसातलादुत्पलपत्रसन्निभः समुत्थितो नील इवाचलो महान् ॥
verses.rom:
tatah samutkshipya dharam svadamshtraya mahavarahah sphutapadmalochanah |
rasataladutpalapatrasannibhah samutthito nila ivachalo mahan ||

verses.sa:
उत्तिष्ठता तेन मुखानिलाहतं तत्संभवाम्भो जनलोकसंश्रयान् ।
प्रक्षालयामास हि तान्महाद्युतीन् सनान्दनादीनपकल्मषान् मुनीन् ॥
verses.rom:
uttishthata tena mukhanilahatam tatsambhavambho janalokasamshrayan |
prakshalayamasa hi tanmahadyutin sanandanadinapakalmashan munin ||

verses.sa:
प्रयान्ति तोयानि खुराग्रविक्षतरसातलेऽधः कृतशब्दसन्तति ।
श्वासानिलास्ताः परितः प्रयांति सिद्धा जने ये नियता वसन्ति ॥
verses.rom:
prayanti toyani khuragravikshatarasatale'dhah kritashabdasantati |
shvasanilastah paritah prayamti siddha jane ye niyata vasanti ||

verses.sa:
उत्तिष्ठतस्तस्य जलार्द्र कुक्षेर्महावराहस्य महीं विगृह्य ।
विधुन्वतो वेदमयं शरीरं रोमान्तरस्था मुनयः स्तुवन्ति ॥
verses.rom:
uttishthatastasya jalardra kukshermahavarahasya mahim vigrihya |
vidhunvato vedamayam shariram romantarastha munayah stuvanti ||

verses.sa:
तं तुष्टुवुस्तोषपरीतचेतसो लोके जने ये निवसन्ति योगिनः ।
सनन्दनाद्या ह्यतिनम्रकन्धरा धराधरं धीरतरोद्धतेक्षणम् ॥
verses.rom:
tam tushtuvustoshaparitachetaso loke jane ye nivasanti yoginah |
sanandanadya hyatinamrakandhara dharadharam dhirataroddhatekshanam ||

verses.sa:
जयेश्वराणां परमेश केशव प्रभो गदाशंखधरासिचक्रधृक् ।
प्रसूतिनाशस्थितिहेतुरीश्वरस्त्वमेव नान्यत्परमं च यत्पदम् ॥
verses.rom:
jayeshvaranam paramesha keshava prabho gadashamkhadharasichakradhrik |
prasutinashasthitiheturishvarastvameva nanyatparamam cha yatpadam ||

verses.sa:
पादेषु वेदास्तव यूपदंष्ट्रा दन्तेषु जज्ञाश्चितयश्च वक्त्रे ।
हुताशजिह्वोसि तनूरुहाणि दर्भाः प्रभो यज्ञपुमांस्त्वमेव ॥
verses.rom:
padeshu vedastava yupadamshtra danteshu jajnashchitayashcha vaktre |
hutashajihvosi tanuruhani darbhah prabho yajnapumamstvameva ||

verses.sa:
विलोचने रात्र्! यहनी महात्मन्सर्वाश्रयं ब्रह्मपरं शिरस्ते ।
सूक्तान्यश्षोआ!णि सटाकलापो घ्राणं समस्तानि हवींषि देव ॥
verses.rom:
vilochane ratr! yahani mahatmansarvashrayam brahmaparam shiraste |
suktanyashshoa!ni satakalapo ghranam samastani havimshi deva ||

verses.sa:
स्रुक्तुण्डसामस्वरधीरनादप्राग्वंशकायाखिलसत्रसन्धे ।
पूर्तेष्टधर्मश्रवणोसि देव सनातनात्मन्भगवन्प्रसीद ॥
verses.rom:
sruktundasamasvaradhiranadapragvamshakayakhilasatrasandhe |
purteshtadharmashravanosi deva sanatanatmanbhagavanprasida ||

verses.sa:
पदक्रमाक्रान्तभुवं भवन्तमादिस्थितं चाक्षरविश्वमूर्ते ।
विश्वस्य विद्मः परमेश्वरोऽसि प्रसीद नाथोसि परावरस्य ॥
verses.rom:
padakramakrantabhuvam bhavantamadisthitam chaksharavishvamurte |
vishvasya vidmah parameshvaro'si prasida nathosi paravarasya ||

verses.sa:
दंष्ट्राग्रविन्यस्तमश्षोमेतद्भूमण्डलं नाथ विभाव्यते ते ।
विगाहतः पद्मवनं विलग्नं सरोजिनीपत्रमिवोढपंकम् ॥
verses.rom:
damshtragravinyastamashshometadbhumandalam natha vibhavyate te |
vigahatah padmavanam vilagnam sarojinipatramivodhapamkam ||

verses.sa:
द्यावापृथिव्योरतुलप्रभाव यदन्तरं तद्वपुषा तवैव ।
व्याप्तं जगद्व्याप्तिसमर्थदीप्ते हिताय विश्वस्य विभो भव त्वम् ॥
verses.rom:
dyavaprithivyoratulaprabhava yadantaram tadvapusha tavaiva |
vyaptam jagadvyaptisamarthadipte hitaya vishvasya vibho bhava tvam ||

verses.sa:
परमार्थस्त्वमेवैको नान्योस्ति जगतः पते ।
तवैष महिमा येन व्याप्तमेतच्चराचरम् ॥
verses.rom:
paramarthastvamevaiko nanyosti jagatah pate |
tavaisha mahima yena vyaptametachcharacharam ||

verses.sa:
यदेतदृश्यते मूर्त्तमेतज्ज्ञानात्मनस्तव ।
भ्रान्तिज्ञानेन पश्यन्ति जगद्रू पमयोगिनः ॥
verses.rom:
yadetadrishyate murttametajjnanatmanastava |
bhrantijnanena pashyanti jagadru pamayoginah ||

verses.sa:
ज्ञानस्वरूपमखिलं जगदेतदबुद्धयः ।
अर्थस्वरूपं पश्यन्तो भ्राम्यन्ते मोहसंप्लवे ॥
verses.rom:
jnanasvarupamakhilam jagadetadabuddhayah |
arthasvarupam pashyanto bhramyante mohasamplave ||

verses.sa:
ये तु ज्ञानविदः शुद्धचेतसस्तेऽखिलं जगत् ।
ज्ञानात्मकं प्रपश्यन्ति त्वद्रू पं परमेश्वर ॥
verses.rom:
ye tu jnanavidah shuddhachetasaste'khilam jagat |
jnanatmakam prapashyanti tvadru pam parameshvara ||

verses.sa:
प्रसीद सर्व सर्वात्मन्भवाय जगतामिमाम् ।
उद्धरोर्वीममेयात्मञ्छन्नो देह्यब्जलोचन ॥
verses.rom:
prasida sarva sarvatmanbhavaya jagatamimam |
uddharorvimameyatmanchhanno dehyabjalochana ||

verses.sa:
सत्त्वोद्रि क्तोऽसि भगवन् गोविंद पृथिवीमिमाम् ।
समुद्धर भवायेश शन्नो देह्यब्जलोचन ॥
verses.rom:
sattvodri kto'si bhagavan govimda prithivimimam |
samuddhara bhavayesha shanno dehyabjalochana ||

verses.sa:
सर्गप्रवृत्तिर्भवतो जगतामुपकारिणी ।
भवत्वेषा नमस्तेऽस्तु शन्नो देह्यब्जलोचन ॥
verses.rom:
sargapravrittirbhavato jagatamupakarini |
bhavatvesha namaste'stu shanno dehyabjalochana ||

verses.sa:
श्रीपराशर उवाच।
एवं संस्तूयमानस्तु परमात्मा महीधरः ।
उज्जहार क्षितिं क्षिप्रं न्यस्तवांश्च महाम्भसि ॥
verses.rom:
shriparashara uvacha|
evam samstuyamanastu paramatma mahidharah |
ujjahara kshitim kshipram nyastavamshcha mahambhasi ||

verses.sa:
तस्योपरि जलौघस्य महती नौरिव स्थिता ।
विततत्त्वात्तु देहस्य न मही याति संप्लवम् ॥
verses.rom:
tasyopari jalaughasya mahati nauriva sthita |
vitatattvattu dehasya na mahi yati samplavam ||

verses.sa:
ततः क्षितिं समां कृत्वा पृथिव्यां सोचिनोद्गिरीन् ।
यथाविभागं भगवाननादिः परमेश्वरः ॥
verses.rom:
tatah kshitim samam kritva prithivyam sochinodgirin |
yathavibhagam bhagavananadih parameshvarah ||

verses.sa:
प्राक्यसर्गदग्धानखिलान्पर्वतान्पृथिवीतले ।
अमोघेन प्रभावेण ससर्जामोघवाञ्छितः ॥
verses.rom:
prakyasargadagdhanakhilanparvatanprithivitale |
amoghena prabhavena sasarjamoghavanchhitah ||

verses.sa:
भूविभागं ततः कृत्वा सप्तद्वीपान्यथातथम् ।
भूराद्यांश्चतुरो लोकान्पूर्ववत्समकल्पयत् ॥
verses.rom:
bhuvibhagam tatah kritva saptadvipanyathatatham |
bhuradyamshchaturo lokanpurvavatsamakalpayat ||

verses.sa:
ब्रह्मरूपधरो देवस्ततोऽसौ रजसा वृतः ।
चकार सृष्टिं भगवांश्चतुर्वक्त्रधरो हरिः ॥
verses.rom:
brahmarupadharo devastato'sau rajasa vritah |
chakara srishtim bhagavamshchaturvaktradharo harih ||

verses.sa:
निमित्तमात्रमेवाऽसौ सृज्यानां सर्गकर्मणि ।
प्रधानकारणीभूता यतो वै सृज्यशक्तयः ॥
verses.rom:
nimittamatrameva'sau srijyanam sargakarmani |
pradhanakaranibhuta yato vai srijyashaktayah ||

verses.sa:
निमित्तमात्रं मुक्त्वैवं नान्यत्किंचिदपेक्षते ।
नीयते तपतां श्रेष्ठ स्वशक्त्या वस्तु वस्तुताम् ॥
verses.rom:
nimittamatram muktvaivam nanyatkimchidapekshate |
niyate tapatam shreshtha svashaktya vastu vastutam ||

verses.sa: इति श्रीविष्णुपुराणे प्रथमेंशो! पृथिव्युद्धारश्चतुर्थोऽध्यायः ॥
verses.rom: iti shrivishnupurane prathamemsho! prithivyuddharashchaturtho'dhyayah ||

prose.en:
Maitreya said:—"O mighty ascetic, relate unto me how the reverend Brahmā whose name is Nārāyana, created all beings at the commencement of the Kalpa". (Thereat) Parāçara said,—"Hear as to how that god, the lord of Prajāpati, the reverend Brahmā instinct with Nārāyana, created beings. On the expiration of the past Kalpa, that Master, Brahmā, surcharged with the energy of righteousness, awaking from his slumbers, saw the universe—void of all. And the supreme, incomprehensible Nārāyana—the lord of the greatest—as the worshipful Brahmā, became engaged in creation. This sloka is used with reference to the divine Nārāyana, the creator of the universe, in the form of Brahmā. Apa is named nāra, having been created by Nara; and in days of yore, (water) having been the abode of him, he hath hence been called Nārāyana.—And on the universe becoming one ocean, the creator of all beings, the Lord resting on water, inferring that the Earth was thus placed, set his heart on delivering her. And as he, on former occasions, had assumed the forms of a fish, a Tortoise, etc., he now assumed the form of a Boar. And for sustaining the entire universe, the lord of creatures, impregnated with the Veda and sacrifices, of serene soul and the soul of all,—the Supreme spirit—stay of soul, and the prop of the Earth,—hymned by the Siddhas inhabiting the region of Jana,—Sauaka and others,—then entered water.—And seeing him enter the nether regions, that exalted one, the Earth, bowing low in humility and reverence, began to praise him. And the Earth said,—'I bow unto thee, who art all being; I bow unto thee, holding the conch and the mace. Do thou rescue me from here, now, as, thou hadst formerly done. I had formerly been delivered by thee. O Janārddana, I as well as other things, such as the sky, etc., are permeated by thee. Reverence unto thee, O prime spirit, O male soul, I bow unto thee. I bow unto thee, who art pradhāna and vaykta, and who art Time. Thou, wearing the forms of Brahmā, Vishnu and Rudra, art the creator of all beings, and thou art the maintainer as well as the destroyer thereof. Having destroyed everything, thou, O Govinda, on the universe having become one Ocean,—contemplated by the pious, reposest (on the serpent-couch). None knoweth the high mystery encompassing thee; and the deities do but adore that form in which thou incarnatest thyself. O supreme Brahmā, adoring thee, those desirous of emancipation, attain the same. Who, not worshipping Vasudeva, obtaineth liberation? Thy entire form comprehends ail that may be secured by the mind, all that may be perceived by sight and the other senses, all that may be discriminated by thought. And I am supported, and created, and maintained by thee. And for this it is that people call me Mādhavi. Victory to thee, O thou that art all knowledge! Victory to thee, who art gross and undeteriorating! Victory to thee, O thou that art infinite! Victory to thee, thou that art the Nascent! Victory to thee, thou that art Manifest. Thou, O lord! O prime of prime souls! O soul of the Universe! Victory to thee, O master of sacrifice, thou, who art sinless! Thou art Sacrifice, and Vaskatkāra and thou, Omkarāa and thou, Fire. Thou art the Vedas, and thou the branches thereof, and thou Hari, art the person presiding; over sacrifice. Thou art the Sun, etc., and the planets and stars, and thou the entire universe. And O foremost god, thou art all that is formless and that is formed, and that is hard and, O best of male beings, all that I have mentioned and also all that I have left un mentioned. I bow down unto thee. I bow unto thee again and again.'"

Parāçara said:—Thus eulogised by Earth, that graceful one, the holder thereof, began to roar in Sāma accents. Then heaving up the Earth with his razors from the deep, the mighty Boar, having eyes resembling blown lotuses,—and himself like unto lotus-leaves,—rose up like a gigantic dark-blue mountain. And as he emerged, the troubled water dashed by the wind forced out from his mouth, surging up, splashed the highly resplendent and sinless ascetics, Sananda and others, dwellers of the regions of Jana. And on the nether regions being broken up by the hoof-impacts (of the boar), the water began to run down with roars; and the Siddhas constantly inhabiting the regions of Jana, were moved about by the air of his breath. And the ascetics, placed in the tactual pores of the mighty bore as he rose up holding the Earth in his abdominal cavity and kept shaking his Veda-impregnated person,—experienced the highest bliss. And yogis dwelling in the regions of Jana, Sananda and others, with delighted hearts, and with heads bent in humility, hymned the holder of the Earth, remaining moveless, with his eyes expanded,—saying,—"Victory unto thee, O foremost God of gods,—O Keçava, O wielder of the conch, mace, sword and discus! The cause of creation, destruction and sustentation, save thee, supreme state there is none whatever. The Vedas are thy feet, and the yupa, thy larger tooth, and Sacrifice, thy smaller; the place of the (sacrificial fire) is thy mouth, and the fire itself thy tongue; and darva is thy down. O Lord, thou art the person presiding over Sacrifice. O mighty soul, day and night are thy eyes; and that refuge of all—the state of Brahmā, himself—is thy head; the entire complement of Suktas composeth thy matted locks; and thy tongue is the sacrificial offerings, O god. O thou having the (sacrificial) ladle for thy face! O thou who hast the solemn accents of Sāma for thy voice, O thou that hast the front-part of the sacrificial ground, for thy body! O thou who hast all the sacrifices for thy joints! O god, thou hast for thy ears the morality of the Smritis as well as the Srutis. Be thou propitiated! O undeteriorating one, O thou that hast the Universe for thy form, we know thee as having covered the Earth with thy paces, and that thou art the cause and stay thereof. Thou art the foremost Lord of the cosmos. Be thou gracious! Thou art the master of the mobile and the immobile. Raised on thy razor-ends, all this Earth, O Lord, seemeth like a lotus-leaf besmeared with mud on the tusk of an elephant that hath plunged into a pool of lotuses. O thou of unparalleled power, all the space between heaven and earth hath been covered with thy body. O thou, the universe hath been enveloped with whose splendour, O Lord, prove thou of profit to the universe. Thou art the sole highest reality,—there is none other, sovereign of the universe. And this glory in which the mobile and the immobile are enfolded,—is thine. O thou that art knowledge, unspiritual people, through ignorance, look upon this form of thine displayed in the world. Foolish persons, regarding this entire universe impregnated with knowledge, as real, fall into a sea of delusion. But O supreme lord, those that are versed in knowledge and are of pure spirit, look on this entire universe as thy form replete with knowledge. O Sarva, O soul of all! Be thou gracious! For the good of this world do thou, O thou of immeasurable soul, raise the Earth up. O lotus-eyed one, confer on us what is good. Thou, O reverend one, art surcharged with the virtue of goodness. O Govinda, for the benefit (of all), O lord, raise up this Earth. O lotus-eyed one, confer on us what is good. Mayst thou incline thy mind to creation fraught with profit to the universe! We bow unto thee. O lotus-eyed one, confer on us what is good".

Parāçara said,—"Thus hymned by the divinities, that supreme soul, the holder of Earth, at once lifted her up, and set her on the mighty sea. And, resting on the sea like a giant bark, Earth did not sink in consequence of the flatness of her frame. Then leveling the Earth, the worshipful supreme Lord without beginning, placed mountains on her in proper order. And by his infallible power, that one of truthful purposes created on the Earth all the mountains that had been burnt on the occasion of the burning of the foregone creation. And then; properly dividing the land containing seven islands, he, as formerly, created the four regions, viz., Bhuva and the rest. And then, possessed with the principle of passion, the reverend Deity, Hari, wearing the form of Brahmā and assuming four faces, set about creation, But in the matter of creation, he was an instrument merely; as the force resident in the things created, was the principal Cause. Being ripe for development, (objects at the time of creation) desiderate nothing more. O foremost of those practising austerities, objects attain their objectivity by virtue of their inherent force".

verses.sa:
श्रीमैत्रेय उवाच
यथा ससर्ज देवोऽसौ देवर्षिपितृदानवान् ।
मनुष्यतिर्यग्वृक्षादीन्भूव्योमसलिलौकसः ॥
verses.rom:
shrimaitreya uvacha
yatha sasarja devo'sau devarshipitridanavan |
manushyatiryagvrikshadinbhuvyomasalilaukasah ||

verses.sa:
यद्गुणं यत्स्वभावं च यद्रू पं च जगद्द्विज।
सर्गादौ सृष्टवान्ब्रह्मा तन्ममाचक्ष्व कृत्स्नशः ॥
verses.rom:
yadgunam yatsvabhavam cha yadru pam cha jagaddvija|
sargadau srishtavanbrahma tanmamachakshva kritsnashah ||

verses.sa:
श्रीपराशर उवाच
मैत्रेय कथयाम्येतच्छृणुष्व सुसमाहितः ।
यथा ससर्ज देवोसौ देवादीनखिलान्विभुः ॥
verses.rom:
shriparashara uvacha
maitreya kathayamyetachchhrinushva susamahitah |
yatha sasarja devosau devadinakhilanvibhuh ||

verses.sa:
सृष्टिं चिंतय तस्तस्य कल्पादिषु यथा पुरा ।
अबुद्धिपूर्वकः सर्गः प्रादुर्भूतस्तमोमयः ॥
verses.rom:
srishtim chimtaya tastasya kalpadishu yatha pura |
abuddhipurvakah sargah pradurbhutastamomayah ||

verses.sa:
तमोमोहो महामोहस्तामिस्रो ह्यन्धसंज्ञितः ।
अविद्या पंचपर्वैषा प्रादुर्भूता महात्मनः ॥
verses.rom:
tamomoho mahamohastamisro hyandhasamjnitah |
avidya pamchaparvaisha pradurbhuta mahatmanah ||

verses.sa:
पञ्चधाऽवस्थितः सर्गो ध्यायतो प्रतिबोधवान् ।
बहिरन्तोऽप्रकाशश्च संवृतात्मा नगात्मकः ॥
verses.rom:
panchadha'vasthitah sargo dhyayato pratibodhavan |
bahiranto'prakashashcha samvritatma nagatmakah ||

verses.sa: मुख्या नगा यतः प्रोक्ता मुख्यसर्गस्ततस्त्वयम् ॥
verses.rom: mukhya naga yatah prokta mukhyasargastatastvayam ||

verses.sa: तं दृष्ट्वाऽसाधकं सर्गममन्यदपरं पुनः ॥
verses.rom: tam drishtva'sadhakam sargamamanyadaparam punah ||

verses.sa:
तस्याभिध्यायतः सर्गस्तिर्यक्स्त्रोतोभ्यवर्त्तत ।
यस्मात्तिर्यक्प्रवृत्तिस्स तिर्यक्स्रोतास्ततः स्मृतः ॥
verses.rom:
tasyabhidhyayatah sargastiryakstrotobhyavarttata |
yasmattiryakpravrittissa tiryaksrotastatah smritah ||

verses.sa:
पश्वादयस्ते विख्यातास्तमःप्राया ह्यवेदिनः ।
उत्पथग्राहिणश्चैव तेऽज्ञाने ज्ञानमानिनः ॥
verses.rom:
pashvadayaste vikhyatastamahpraya hyavedinah |
utpathagrahinashchaiva te'jnane jnanamaninah ||

verses.sa:
अहंकृता अहंमाना अष्टाविंशद्वधात्मकाः ।
अतः प्रकाशास्ते सर्वे आवृताश्च परस्परम् ॥
verses.rom:
ahamkrita ahammana ashtavimshadvadhatmakah |
atah prakashaste sarve avritashcha parasparam ||

verses.sa:
तमप्यसाधकं मत्वा ध्यायतोन्यस्ततोऽभवत् ।
ऊर्ध्वस्रोतास्तृतीयस्तु सात्त्विकोर्ध्वमवर्त्तत ॥
verses.rom:
tamapyasadhakam matva dhyayatonyastato'bhavat |
urdhvasrotastritiyastu sattvikordhvamavarttata ||

verses.sa:
ते सुखप्रीतिबहुला बहिरन्तश्च नावृताः ।
प्रकाशा बहिरन्तश्च ऊर्ध्वस्रोतोद्भवाः स्मृताः ॥
verses.rom:
te sukhapritibahula bahirantashcha navritah |
prakasha bahirantashcha urdhvasrotodbhavah smritah ||

verses.sa:
तुष्टात्मानस्तृतीयस्तु देवसर्गस्तु स स्मृतः ।
तस्मिन्सर्गेभवत्प्रीतिर्निष्पन्ने ब्रह्मणस्तदा ॥
verses.rom:
tushtatmanastritiyastu devasargastu sa smritah |
tasminsargebhavatpritirnishpanne brahmanastada ||

verses.sa:
ततोन्यं स तदा दध्यौ साधकं सर्गमुत्तमम् .
असाधकांस्तु ताञ्ज्ञात्वा मुख्यसर्गादिसम्भवान् ॥
verses.rom:
tatonyam sa tada dadhyau sadhakam sargamuttamam .
asadhakamstu tanjnatva mukhyasargadisambhavan ||

verses.sa:
तथाभिध्यायतस्तस्य सत्याभिध्यायिनस्ततः ।
प्रादुर्बभूव चाव्यक्तादर्वाक्स्रोतास्तु साधकः ॥
verses.rom:
tathabhidhyayatastasya satyabhidhyayinastatah |
pradurbabhuva chavyaktadarvaksrotastu sadhakah ||

verses.sa:
यस्मादर्वाग्व्यवर्त्तन्त ततोर्वाक्स्रोतसस्तु ते ।
ते च प्रकाशबहुलास्तमोद्रि क्ता रजोधिकाः ॥
verses.rom:
yasmadarvagvyavarttanta tatorvaksrotasastu te |
te cha prakashabahulastamodri kta rajodhikah ||

verses.sa:
तस्मात्ते दुःखबहुला भूयोभूयश्च कारिणः ।
प्रकाशा बहिरन्तश्च मनुष्याः साधकास्तु ते ॥
verses.rom:
tasmatte duhkhabahula bhuyobhuyashcha karinah |
prakasha bahirantashcha manushyah sadhakastu te ||

verses.sa:
इत्येते कथिताः सर्गाः षडत्र मुनिसत्तम ।
प्रथमो महतः सर्गो विज्ञेयो ब्रह्मणस्तु सः ॥
verses.rom:
ityete kathitah sargah shadatra munisattama |
prathamo mahatah sargo vijneyo brahmanastu sah ||

verses.sa:
तन्मात्राणां द्वितीयश्च भूतसर्गो हि स स्मृतः ।
वैकारिकस्तृतीयस्तु सर्ग ऐन्द्रि यकः स्मृतः ॥
verses.rom:
tanmatranam dvitiyashcha bhutasargo hi sa smritah |
vaikarikastritiyastu sarga aindri yakah smritah ||

verses.sa:
इत्येष प्राकृतः सर्गः सम्भूतो बुद्धिपूर्वकः ।
मुख्यसर्गश्चतुर्थस्तु मुख्या वै स्थावराः स्मृताः ॥
verses.rom:
ityesha prakritah sargah sambhuto buddhipurvakah |
mukhyasargashchaturthastu mukhya vai sthavarah smritah ||

verses.sa:
तिर्यक्स्रोतास्तु यः प्रोक्तस्तैर्यग्योन्यः स उच्यते ।
तदूर्ध्वस्रोतसां षष्ठो देवसर्गस्तु संस्मृतः ॥
verses.rom:
tiryaksrotastu yah proktastairyagyonyah sa uchyate |
tadurdhvasrotasam shashtho devasargastu samsmritah ||

verses.sa: ततोऽर्वाक्स्रोतसां सर्गः सप्तमः स तु मानुषः ॥
verses.rom: tato'rvaksrotasam sargah saptamah sa tu manushah ||

verses.sa:
अष्टमोऽनुग्रहः सर्गः सात्त्विकस्तामसश्च सः ।
पञ्चैते वैकृताः सर्गाः प्राकृतास्तु त्रयः स्मृताः ॥
verses.rom:
ashtamo'nugrahah sargah sattvikastamasashcha sah |
panchaite vaikritah sargah prakritastu trayah smritah ||

verses.sa:
प्राकृतो वैकृतश्चैव कौमारो नवमः स्मृतः ।
इत्येते वै समाख्याता नव सर्गाः प्रजापतेः ॥
verses.rom:
prakrito vaikritashchaiva kaumaro navamah smritah |
ityete vai samakhyata nava sargah prajapateh ||

verses.sa:
प्राकृता वैकृताश्चैव जगतो मूलहेतवः ।
सृजतो जगदीशस्य किमन्यच्छ्रोतुमिच्छसि ॥
verses.rom:
prakrita vaikritashchaiva jagato mulahetavah |
srijato jagadishasya kimanyachchhrotumichchhasi ||

verses.sa:
श्रीमैत्रेय उवाच
संक्षेपात्कथितः सर्गो देवादीनां मुने त्वया ।
विस्तराच्छ्रोतुमिच्छामि त्वत्तो मुनिवरोत्तम ॥
verses.rom:
shrimaitreya uvacha
samkshepatkathitah sargo devadinam mune tvaya |
vistarachchhrotumichchhami tvatto munivarottama ||

verses.sa:
श्रीपराशर उवाच
कर्मभिर्भाविताः पूर्वैः कुशलाः कुशलैस्तुताः ।
ख्यात्या तया ह्यनिर्मुक्ताः संहारे ह्युपसंहृताः ॥
verses.rom:
shriparashara uvacha
karmabhirbhavitah purvaih kushalah kushalaistutah |
khyatya taya hyanirmuktah samhare hyupasamhritah ||

verses.sa:
स्थावरान्ताः सुराद्यास्तु प्रजा ब्रह्मंश्चतुर्विधाः ।
ब्रह्मणः कुर्वतः सृष्टिं जज्ञिरे मानसास्तु ताः ॥
verses.rom:
sthavarantah suradyastu praja brahmamshchaturvidhah |
brahmanah kurvatah srishtim jajnire manasastu tah ||

verses.sa:
ततो देवासुरपितॄन्मनुष्यांश्च चतुष्टयम् ।
सिसृक्षुरम्भांस्येतानि स्वमात्मानमयूयुजत् ॥
verses.rom:
tato devasurapitrinmanushyamshcha chatushtayam |
sisrikshurambhamsyetani svamatmanamayuyujat ||

verses.sa:
युक्तात्मनस्तमोमात्रा ह्युद्रि क्ताऽभूत्प्रजापतेः ।
सिसृक्षोर्जघनात्पूर्वमसुरा जज्ञिरे ततः ॥
verses.rom:
yuktatmanastamomatra hyudri kta'bhutprajapateh |
sisrikshorjaghanatpurvamasura jajnire tatah ||

verses.sa:
उत्ससर्ज ततस्तां तु तमोमात्रात्मिकां तनुम् ।
सा तु व्यक्ता तनुस्तेन मैत्रेयाभूद्विभावरी ॥
verses.rom:
utsasarja tatastam tu tamomatratmikam tanum |
sa tu vyakta tanustena maitreyabhudvibhavari ||

verses.sa:
सिसृक्षुरन्यदेहस्थः प्रीतिमाप ततः सुराः ।
सत्त्वोद्रिक्ताः समुद्भूता मुखतो ब्रह्मणो द्विजः ॥
verses.rom:
sisrikshuranyadehasthah pritimapa tatah surah |
sattvodriktah samudbhuta mukhato brahmano dvijah ||

verses.sa:
त्यक्ता सापि तनुस्तेन सत्त्वप्रायमभूद्दिनम् ।
ततो हि बलिनो रात्रावसुरा देवता दिवा ॥
verses.rom:
tyakta sapi tanustena sattvaprayamabhuddinam |
tato hi balino ratravasura devata diva ||

verses.sa:
सत्त्वमात्रात्मिकामेव ततोन्यां जगृहे तनुम् ।
पितृवन्मन्यमानस्य पितरस्तस्य जज्ञिरे ॥
verses.rom:
sattvamatratmikameva tatonyam jagrihe tanum |
pitrivanmanyamanasya pitarastasya jajnire ||

verses.sa:
उत्ससर्ज ततस्तां तु पितॄन्सृष्ट्वापि स प्रभुः ।
सा चोत्सृष्टाभवत्संध्या दिननक्तान्तरस्थिता ॥
verses.rom:
utsasarja tatastam tu pitrinsrishtvapi sa prabhuh |
sa chotsrishtabhavatsamdhya dinanaktantarasthita ||

verses.sa:
रजोमात्रात्मिकामन्यां जगृहे स तनुं ततः ।
रजोमात्रोत्कटा जाता मनुष्या द्विजसत्तम ॥
verses.rom:
rajomatratmikamanyam jagrihe sa tanum tatah |
rajomatrotkata jata manushya dvijasattama ||

verses.sa:
तामप्याशु स तत्याज तनुं सद्यः प्रजापतिः ।
ज्योत्स्ना समभवत्सापि प्राक्सन्ध्या याऽभिधीयते ॥
verses.rom:
tamapyashu sa tatyaja tanum sadyah prajapatih |
jyotsna samabhavatsapi praksandhya ya'bhidhiyate ||

verses.sa:
ज्योत्स्नागमे तु बलिनो मनुष्याः पितरस्तथा ।
मैत्रेय संध्यासमये तस्मादेते भवन्ति वै ॥
verses.rom:
jyotsnagame tu balino manushyah pitarastatha |
maitreya samdhyasamaye tasmadete bhavanti vai ||

verses.sa:
ज्योत्स्ना रात्र्यहनी संध्या चत्वार्येतानि वै प्रभोः ।
ब्रह्मणस्तु शरीराणि त्रिगुणोपाश्रयाणि तु ॥
verses.rom:
jyotsna ratryahani samdhya chatvaryetani vai prabhoh |
brahmanastu sharirani trigunopashrayani tu ||

verses.sa:
रजोमात्रात्मिकामेव ततोन्यां जगृहे तनुम् ।
ततः क्षुद्ब्रह्मणो जाता जज्ञे कामस्तया ततः ॥
verses.rom:
rajomatratmikameva tatonyam jagrihe tanum |
tatah kshudbrahmano jata jajne kamastaya tatah ||

verses.sa:
क्षुत्क्षामानन्धकारेथ सोसृजद्भगवांस्ततः ।
विरूपाः श्मश्रुला जातास्तेभ्यधावंस्ततः प्रभुम् ॥
verses.rom:
kshutkshamanandhakaretha sosrijadbhagavamstatah |
virupah shmashrula jatastebhyadhavamstatah prabhum ||

verses.sa:
मैवं भो रक्ष्यतामेष यैरुक्तं राक्षसास्तु ते ।
ऊचुः खादाम इत्यन्ये ये ते यक्षास्तु जक्षणात् ॥
verses.rom:
maivam bho rakshyatamesha yairuktam rakshasastu te |
uchuh khadama ityanye ye te yakshastu jakshanat ||

verses.sa:
अप्रियेण तु तान्दृष्ट्वा केशाः शीर्यन्तवेधसः ।
हीनाश्च शिरसो भूयः समारोहन्त तच्छिरः ॥
verses.rom:
apriyena tu tandrishtva keshah shiryantavedhasah |
hinashcha shiraso bhuyah samarohanta tachchhirah ||

verses.sa:
सर्पणात्तेऽभवन् सर्पा हीनत्वादहयः स्मृताः ।
ततः क्रुद्धो जगत्स्रष्टा क्रोधात्मानो विनिर्ममे ।
वर्णेन कपिशेनोग्रभूतास्ते पिशिताशनाः ॥
verses.rom:
sarpanatte'bhavan sarpa hinatvadahayah smritah |
tatah kruddho jagatsrashta krodhatmano vinirmame |
varnena kapishenograbhutaste pishitashanah ||

verses.sa:
ध्यायतोंगात्समुत्पन्ना गन्धर्वास्तस्य तत्क्षणात् ।
पिबन्तो जज्ञिरे वाचं गन्धर्वास्तेन ते द्विज ॥
verses.rom:
dhyayatomgatsamutpanna gandharvastasya tatkshanat |
pibanto jajnire vacham gandharvastena te dvija ||

verses.sa:
एतानि सृष्ट्वा भगवान्ब्रह्म तच्छक्तिचोदितः ।
ततः स्वच्छन्दतोन्यानि वयांसि वयसोऽसृजत् ॥
verses.rom:
etani srishtva bhagavanbrahma tachchhaktichoditah |
tatah svachchhandatonyani vayamsi vayaso'srijat ||

verses.sa:
अवयो वक्षसश्चक्रे मुखतोजाः स सृष्टवान् ।
सृष्टवानुदराद्गाश्च पार्श्वभ्यां च प्रजापतिः ॥
verses.rom:
avayo vakshasashchakre mukhatojah sa srishtavan |
srishtavanudaradgashcha parshvabhyam cha prajapatih ||

verses.sa:
पद्भ्यां चाश्वान्समातङ्गान्रासभान्गवयान्मृगान्।
उष्ट्रानश्वतरांश्चैव न्यङ्कूनन्याश्च जातयः ॥
verses.rom:
padbhyam chashvansamatanganrasabhangavayanmrigan|
ushtranashvataramshchaiva nyankunanyashcha jatayah ||

verses.sa:
ओषध्यः फलमूलिन्यो रोमभ्यस्तस्य जज्ञिरे ।
त्रेतायुगमुखे ब्रह्मा कल्पस्यादौ द्विजोत्तम ।
सृष्ट्वापश्चौषधीः सम्यग्युयोजस तदाध्वरे ॥
verses.rom:
oshadhyah phalamulinyo romabhyastasya jajnire |
tretayugamukhe brahma kalpasyadau dvijottama |
srishtvapashchaushadhih samyagyuyojasa tadadhvare ||

verses.sa:
गौरजः पुरुषो मेषश्चाश्वाश्वतरगर्दभाः ।
एतान्ग्राम्यान्पशूनाहुरारण्यांश्च निबोध मे ॥
verses.rom:
gaurajah purusho meshashchashvashvataragardabhah |
etangramyanpashunahuraranyamshcha nibodha me ||

verses.sa:
श्वापदा द्विखुरा हस्ती वानराः पक्षिपंचमाः ।
औदकाः पशवः षष्ठाः सप्तमास्तु सरीसृपाः ॥
verses.rom:
shvapada dvikhura hasti vanarah pakshipamchamah |
audakah pashavah shashthah saptamastu sarisripah ||

verses.sa:
गायत्रं च ऋचश्चैव त्रिवृत्सोमं रथन्तरम् ।
अग्निष्टोमं च यज्ञानां निर्ममे प्रथमान्मुखात् ॥
verses.rom:
gayatram cha richashchaiva trivritsomam rathantaram |
agnishtomam cha yajnanam nirmame prathamanmukhat ||

verses.sa:
यजूंषि त्रैष्टुभं छन्दः स्तोमं पंचदशं तथा ।
बृहत्साम तथोक्थं च दक्षिणादसृजन्मुखात् ॥
verses.rom:
yajumshi traishtubham chhandah stomam pamchadasham tatha |
brihatsama tathoktham cha dakshinadasrijanmukhat ||

verses.sa:
सामानि जगतीछन्दः स्तोमं सप्तदशं तथा ।
वैरूपमतिरात्रं च पश्चिमादसृजन्मुखात् ॥
verses.rom:
samani jagatichhandah stomam saptadasham tatha |
vairupamatiratram cha pashchimadasrijanmukhat ||

verses.sa:
एकविंशमथर्वाणमाप्तोर्यामाणमेव च ।
अनुष्टुभं च वैराजमुत्तरादसृजन्मुखात् ॥
verses.rom:
ekavimshamatharvanamaptoryamanameva cha |
anushtubham cha vairajamuttaradasrijanmukhat ||

verses.sa:
उच्चावचानि भूतानि गात्रेभ्यस्तस्य जज्ञिरे ।
देवासुरपितॄन् सृष्ट्वा मनुष्यांश्च प्रजापतिः ॥
verses.rom:
uchchavachani bhutani gatrebhyastasya jajnire |
devasurapitrin srishtva manushyamshcha prajapatih ||

verses.sa:
ततः पुनः ससर्जादौ संकल्पस्य पितामहः ।
यक्षान् पिशाचान्गन्धर्वान् तथैवाप्सरसां गणान् ॥
verses.rom:
tatah punah sasarjadau samkalpasya pitamahah |
yakshan pishachangandharvan tathaivapsarasam ganan ||

verses.sa:
नरकिन्नररक्षांसि वयः पशुमृगोरगान् ।
अव्ययं च व्ययं चैव यदिदं स्थाणुजंगमम् ॥
verses.rom:
narakinnararakshamsi vayah pashumrigoragan |
avyayam cha vyayam chaiva yadidam sthanujamgamam ||

verses.sa:
तत्ससर्ज तदा ब्रह्म भगवानादिकृत्प्रभुः ।
तेषां ये यानि कर्माणि प्राक्सृष्ट्यां प्रतिपेदिरे ।
तान्येव ते प्रपद्यन्ते सृज्यमानाः पुनःपुनः ॥
verses.rom:
tatsasarja tada brahma bhagavanadikritprabhuh |
tesham ye yani karmani praksrishtyam pratipedire |
tanyeva te prapadyante srijyamanah punahpunah ||

verses.sa:
हिंस्राहिंस्रे मृदुक्रूरे धर्मधर्मावृतानृते ।
तद्भाविताः प्रपद्यन्ते तस्मात्तत्तस्य रोचते ॥
verses.rom:
himsrahimsre mridukrure dharmadharmavritanrite |
tadbhavitah prapadyante tasmattattasya rochate ||

verses.sa:
इन्द्रि यार्थेषु भूतेषु शरीरेषु च स प्रभुः ।
नानात्वं विनियोगं च धातैवं व्यसृजत्स्वयम् ॥
verses.rom:
indri yartheshu bhuteshu sharireshu cha sa prabhuh |
nanatvam viniyogam cha dhataivam vyasrijatsvayam ||

verses.sa:
नाम रूपं च भूतानां कृत्यानां च प्रपंचनम् ।
वेदशब्देभ्य एवादौ देवादीनां चकार सः ॥
verses.rom:
nama rupam cha bhutanam krityanam cha prapamchanam |
vedashabdebhya evadau devadinam chakara sah ||

verses.sa:
ऋषीणां नामधेयानि यथा वेदश्रुतानि वै ।
तथा नियोगयोग्यानि ह्यन्येषामपि सोऽकरोत् ॥
verses.rom:
