rishinam namadheyani yatha vedashrutani vai |
tatha niyogayogyani hyanyeshamapi so'karot ||

verses.sa:
यथर्तुष्वृतुलिंगानि नानारूपाणि पर्य ये ।
दृश्यन्ते तानि तान्येव तथा भावा युगादिषु ॥
verses.rom:
yathartushvritulimgani nanarupani parya ye |
drishyante tani tanyeva tatha bhava yugadishu ||

verses.sa:
करोत्येवंविधां सृष्टिं कल्पादौ स पुनःपुनः ।
सिसृक्षाशक्तियुक्तोसौ सृज्यशक्तिप्रचोदितः ॥
verses.rom:
karotyevamvidham srishtim kalpadau sa punahpunah |
sisrikshashaktiyuktosau srijyashaktiprachoditah ||

verses.sa: इति श्रीविष्णुपुराणे प्रथमेंशो! पंचमोऽध्यायः ॥
verses.rom: iti shrivishnupurane prathamemsho! pamchamo'dhyayah ||

prose.en:
Maitreya said:—"O twice-born one, tell thou me truly how the Deity created celestials, and saints, and Pitris, Dānavas, and men, and beasts, and trees, and those inhabiting land and water and air; as well as concerning (the respective) qualities and characters and natures (of the creatures) dwelling in Earth,—which Brahmā had created at the commencement of creation".

Thereat Parāçara said—"O Maitreya, listen thou heedfully! I shall tell thee how the Lord God created all,—deities and the rest. As he was contemplating creation as in former Kalpas, through lack of vigilance was generated Illusion, formed of Foulness.—Five are the kinds of Illusion which spring from this high-souled one, viz., tamas, moha, mahamoha, tamisra and andhatamisra. And as (Brahmā) contemplated, were created five kinds of things, trees, &c., having no sense, undeveloped internally as well as externally, and of pent-up selves. As these, trees etc. were the first objects of creation, they are designated the principal creation. But finding these incapable of answering the end, he thought of again creating other things. And as he was revolving creation, sprang up the Tiryyaksrotas. Those that live in Tiryyaksrotas. They are beasts, &c,—composed mainly of foulness, and devoid of liberal curiosity. Leading unrestrained lives, these, albeit devoid of knowledge, deem themselves as possessing the same. Proud, and considering vastly of themselves, they are subject to eight and twenty kinds of ills. And although developed internally, they cannot express themselves to each other. And finding even these as insufficient for his purpose, (Brahmā) bethought him of other ways; and there came into being the third class of objects, named Urddhasrotas to whom the principle of goodness predominates. They have great capacity for pleasure and happiness; and being developed alike externally and internally and, in consequence, more fitted to express themselves on both sides, have been designated Urddhasrotas. This third creation, that of the deities—is called Tushtatman. And great was the pleasure of Brahmā on the consummation of this creation. But, deeming these main creations as not fulfilling his purpose, he revolved within himself another excellent creation, capable of bringing about his end. As that one of true resolve was thus meditating, there came forth from avyakta the arvvyāksrotas competent to accomplish his purpose. And as these eat by swallowing down, they are called arvvyāksrotas. The are bountifully developed; and, albeit possessing a share of foulness, have passion in a larger measure. And it is for this that in them unhappiness preponderates, and that they act continually. They are developed internally and externally,—they are human beings fulfilling the purpose (of the Creator). Thus, O foremost of ascetics, have I narrated unto thee the genesis of the six orders of creation. Brahmā first created Mahata, next he created Tanmātras, which reckon as the second class, and are comprehended under the designation of Bhutasarga. The third creation is Vaikārika, and is known as aindriya. Thus hath been the creation of Buddhi and the others, which is called Prākrita. And the main creation counts as the fourth, and includes the immobile objects. By the name of Tiryyaksrotas is meant, beasts, &c. And the sixth creation is Urddhasrotas, which is known as Devasarga. And the seventh is Arvvāksrotas which is man. The eighth is the creation of Anugrahas composed of goodness and passion. Five are the Vaikrita acts of creation; and three are Prākrita.—And they together constitute Prākrita and Vaikrita. And the ninth is known as Kaumāra. Thus have I described unto thee the nine acts of creation of the Lord of creatures. The Prākrita and the Vaikrita are the radical causes of the world. What wouldst thou further hear of the Lord of the universe, engaged in creation?"

Maitreya said—"O ascetics, thou hast narrated unto me in brief the origin of gods &c. But, O best of the foremost anchorets, I wish to hear this at length". Parāçara said,—"O Brāhmana, on Brahmā being engaged in creation, from his mind issued the four orders of beings commencing with celestials and concluding with the immobile,—and although these are destroyed at the time of universal dissolution, they are never bereft of the mental tendencies they acquire in existence, consequent on their acts; or of the good or bad fortune resulting respectively from their fair or foul actions. Then desirous of creating deities, Asuras, ancestors and men, all going under the name of ambha, Brahmā began to contemplate. And as the lord of beings concentrated his soul, passion overspread him; and first from forth his hips came out Asuras. And then (Brahmā) renounced his person surcharged with darkness; and, O Maitreya, on being renounced by him, Foulness was converted into Night. And having assumed another body, he (again) became desirous of creating, and from the face of the pleased Brahmā, came forth, O twice-born one, celestials surcharged with the virtue of goodness. And that body also having been resigned, the quality of righteousness was turned into Day. And therefore it is that Asuras are powerful by night and deities by day. And he then assumed a person, fraught with goodness; and, he being honored as a sire, out of him sprang the ancestors. And having created the ancestors, the Lord renounced that form also. And on being renounced, the same became Twilight, remaining between day and night. And then he assumed a person filled with the principle of passion; and, O foremost of the twice-born ones, thereat sprang men fierce, with passion entering into their composition. And the lord of creatures speedily resigned that form also,—And it became Moonlight, which is termed prāksandhydā. And therefore it is, O Maitreya, man and the Pitris, become powerful in Moonlight and Twilight. Moonlight, Night, Day, and Twilight,—these four, are the bodies of Brahmā, endowed with the three principles. And then he assumed another body filled with the principle of passion, and thereat sprung Hunger from Brahmā, and from Hunger, wrath. Then the reverend one in the dark created beings frightful and bearded, and always exercised with hunger. And (as soon as these) were created, they rushed at the Lord. And of those that cried,—‘Ho! don't do this,—save him,'—are Rakshas; and others that said,—‘We shall eat him up,'—are Yakshas, from Yakshana eating. Seeing them mischievous, the hair of the Deity fell off,—and having fallen off from his head, it again rose to his head. And from their movement (sarpana), the hair became sarpas, —and from their having fallen off, they are known as ahis. Then the creator of the universe, waxing wroth, generated some beings of wrathful souls. Twenty-hued, they are beings subsisting on flesh. And then came forth from him Gandharvas, whose office is music. O regenerate one, as these came into being, drinking in strains (of music), they are called Gandharvas, All these beings created the reverend Brahmā, directed by inherent force resident in these (respectively). Then he at his pleasure created another order of beings—fowls of the air. And he created sheep from his breast, and goats from his mouth. And the lord of creatures created kine from his womb and flanks. And he created from his feet horses, elephants, sarabhas, gavayas, deer, camels, mules, nyankus, and other species. And from his down sprang medicinal herbs furnished with fruits and roots. And, O twice-born one, at the commencement of the Tretā-Yuga and on the eve of the Kalpa, Brahmā, having created the beasts and the drugs, then set them apart respectively for sacrifice. Fair complexioned males, sheep, horses, mules, and asses, were called Grāmyā animals. And know also those that are wild. (These are) beasts of prey, the cloven-hoofed, elephants, monkeys, and, fifthly, birds, and, sixthly, aquatic animals, and, seventhly, reptiles. Then from his first mouth he generated the Gāyatri, the Richas, the Trivatstoma the Rathantara, and the Agnishtoma among sacrifices. Then from his southern mouth he created the Yajus, the Trishutva metre, the fifteenth Stoma, the Vrihat Sāman, and the Uktha. And from his western mouth, he created the Sāmas and the Fagati metre, the seventeenth Stoma, the Vairupa and the Atirātra. And from his northern mouth he brought forth the twenty-first Stoma, the Atharva Veda, the Aptoryāma, the Anishtubha metre, and the Vairāyya Sāma. Thus from his person came forth noble and ignoble. And having created gods, Asuras, Pitris, and men, that lord of beings, the great-sire, at the commencement of the Kalpa, created Yakshas, Piçāchas, Gandharvas, and numbers of Apsaras; and that lord, the reverend Brahmā, the first Cause, created Naras, Kinnaras, Rākshasas, birds, beasts, deer, serpents, and mobile and immobile objects lasting or other-wise. And in successive creations, verily each creature is born into those acts which it used to perform in its former existence. Some are cruel and some kind, some mild and some harsh, some virtuous and some vicious, some truthful and some false,—in consequence of their inheriting their respective natures as developed in previous births; and it is also for this that each affects a particular course of conduct (in preference to others). The Deity is the lord of all objects of enjoyment, of all creatures, and all bodies; and it is the Deity who hath personally divided and differentiated them. And at the beginning from the Vedic Vocabulary he assigned names unto creatures, celestials and other, as well as unto sacrifices; and also fixed forms and shapes thereof. And from the auditory Veda, he assigned appellations unto the sages,—and appointed them to their respective functions. And as the signs of the seasons successively manifest themselves, the characteristics, of the Yugas are seen in due order. And instinct with energy arising from a desire of creation, He, actuated by the creative impulse, thus again and again bringeth about creation at the commencement of Kalpas".

verses.sa:
श्रीमैत्रेय उवाच
अर्वाक्स्रोतास्तु कथितो भवता यस्तु मानुषः ।
ब्रह्मन्विस्तरतो ब्रूहि ब्रह्म तमसृजद्यथा ॥
verses.rom:
shrimaitreya uvacha
arvaksrotastu kathito bhavata yastu manushah |
brahmanvistarato bruhi brahma tamasrijadyatha ||

verses.sa:
यथा च वर्णानसृजद्यद्गुणां श्च प्रजापतिः ।
यच्च तेषां स्मृतं कर्म विप्रादीनां तदुच्यताम् ॥
verses.rom:
yatha cha varnanasrijadyadgunam shcha prajapatih |
yachcha tesham smritam karma vipradinam taduchyatam ||

verses.sa:
श्रीपराशर उवाच
सत्याभिध्यायिनः पूर्वं सिसृक्षेर्ब्रह्मणो जगत् ।
अजायन्त द्विजश्रेष्ठ सत्त्वोद्रिक्ता मुखात्प्रजाः ॥
verses.rom:
shriparashara uvacha
satyabhidhyayinah purvam sisriksherbrahmano jagat |
ajayanta dvijashreshtha sattvodrikta mukhatprajah ||

verses.sa:
वक्षमो रजसोद्रिक्तास्तथा वै ब्रह्मणोऽभवन् ।
रजसा तमसा चैव समुद्रिक्तास्तथोरुतः ॥
verses.rom:
vakshamo rajasodriktastatha vai brahmano'bhavan |
rajasa tamasa chaiva samudriktastathorutah ||

verses.sa:
पद्भ्यामन्याः प्रजा ब्रह्मा ससर्ज द्विजसत्तम ।
तमःप्रधानास्ताः सर्वश्चातुर्वर्ण्यमिदं ततः ॥
verses.rom:
padbhyamanyah praja brahma sasarja dvijasattama |
tamahpradhanastah sarvashchaturvarnyamidam tatah ||

verses.sa:
ब्रह्मणाः क्षत्रिया वेश्याः शूद्राश्च द्विजसत्तम ।
पादोरुवक्षस्थलतो मुखतश्च समुद्गताः ॥
verses.rom:
brahmanah kshatriya veshyah shudrashcha dvijasattama |
padoruvakshasthalato mukhatashcha samudgatah ||

verses.sa:
यज्ञनिष्पत्तये सर्वमेतद्ब्रह्या चकार वै ।
चातुर्वर्ण्यं महाभाग यज्ञसाधनमुत्तमम् ॥
verses.rom:
yajnanishpattaye sarvametadbrahya chakara vai |
chaturvarnyam mahabhaga yajnasadhanamuttamam ||

verses.sa:
यज्ञैराप्यायिता देवा वृष्ट्युत्सर्गेण वै प्रजाः ।
आप्याययन्ते धर्मज्ञ यज्ञाः कल्याणहेतवः ॥
verses.rom:
yajnairapyayita deva vrishtyutsargena vai prajah |
apyayayante dharmajna yajnah kalyanahetavah ||

verses.sa:
निष्पाद्यन्ते नरैस्तैस्तु स्वधर्माभिरतैः सदा ।
विशुद्धाचरणैपेतैः सद्भिः सन्मार्गगामिभिः ॥
verses.rom:
nishpadyante naraistaistu svadharmabhirataih sada |
vishuddhacharanaipetaih sadbhih sanmargagamibhih ||

verses.sa:
स्वर्गापवर्गौ मानुष्यात्प्राप्नुवन्ति नरा मुने ।
यच्चाभिरुचितं स्थानं तद्यान्ति मनुजा द्विज ॥
verses.rom:
svargapavargau manushyatprapnuvanti nara mune |
yachchabhiruchitam sthanam tadyanti manuja dvija ||

verses.sa:
प्रजास्ता ब्रह्मणा सृष्टाश्चातुर्वर्ण्यव्यवस्थि ताः ।
सम्यक्छ्रद्धाः समाचारप्रवणा मुनिसत्तम ॥
verses.rom:
prajasta brahmana srishtashchaturvarnyavyavasthi tah |
samyakchhraddhah samacharapravana munisattama ||

verses.sa:
यथेच्छावासनिरताः सर्वबाधाविवर्जिताः ।
शुद्धान्तः करणाः शुद्धाः कर्मानुष्ठा ननिर्मलाः ॥
verses.rom:
yathechchhavasaniratah sarvabadhavivarjitah |
shuddhantah karanah shuddhah karmanushtha nanirmalah ||

verses.sa:
शुद्धे च तासां मनसि शुद्धेन्तःसंस्थिते हरौ ।
सुद्धज्ञानं प्रपश्यन्ति बिल्वाख्यं येन तत्पदम् ॥
verses.rom:
shuddhe cha tasam manasi shuddhentahsamsthite harau |
suddhajnanam prapashyanti bilvakhyam yena tatpadam ||

verses.sa:
ततः कालात्म को योऽसौ स चांशः कथितो हरेः ।
स पातयत्यघं घोरमल्पमल्पाल्पसारवत् ॥
verses.rom:
tatah kalatma ko yo'sau sa chamshah kathito hareh |
sa patayatyagham ghoramalpamalpalpasaravat ||

verses.sa:
अधर्मबीजमुद्भुतं तमोलोभसमुद्भवम् ।
प्रजासु तासु मैत्रेय रागादिकमसाधकम् ॥
verses.rom:
adharmabijamudbhutam tamolobhasamudbhavam |
prajasu tasu maitreya ragadikamasadhakam ||

verses.sa:
ततः सा सहजा सिद्धस्तासां नातीव जायते ।
रसोल्लासादयश्चान्याः सिद्धयोष्टौ भवन्ति याः ॥
verses.rom:
tatah sa sahaja siddhastasam nativa jayate |
rasollasadayashchanyah siddhayoshtau bhavanti yah ||

verses.sa:
तासु क्षीणास्वशेषासु वर्धमाने च पातके ।
द्वन्द्वाभिभवदुःखार्तास्ता भवन्ति ततः प्रजाः ॥
verses.rom:
tasu kshinasvasheshasu vardhamane cha patake |
dvandvabhibhavaduhkhartasta bhavanti tatah prajah ||

verses.sa:
ततो दुर्गाणि ताश्चक्रुर्धान्वं पार्वतमौदकम् ।
कृत्रिमं च तथा दुर्गं पुरखर्वटकादिकम् ॥
verses.rom:
tato durgani tashchakrurdhanvam parvatamaudakam |
kritrimam cha tatha durgam purakharvatakadikam ||

verses.sa:
गृहीणि च यथान्यायं तेषु चकुः पुरादिषु ।
शीतातपादिबाधानां प्रशमाय महामते ॥
verses.rom:
grihini cha yathanyayam teshu chakuh puradishu |
shitatapadibadhanam prashamaya mahamate ||

verses.sa:
प्रतीकारमिमं कत्वा शीतादेस्ताः प्रजाः पुनः ।
वार्तोपायं ततश्चक्रुर्हस्तसिद्धिं च कर्मजाम् ॥
verses.rom:
pratikaramimam katva shitadestah prajah punah |
vartopayam tatashchakrurhastasiddhim cha karmajam ||

verses.sa:
व्रीहयश्च यवाश्चैव गोधूमाश्चणवस्तिलाः ।
प्रियङ्गवो ह्युदा राश्च कोरदूषाः सतीनकाः ॥
verses.rom:
vrihayashcha yavashchaiva godhumashchanavastilah |
priyangavo hyuda rashcha koradushah satinakah ||

verses.sa:
माषा मुद्गा मसूराश्च निष्पावाः सकुलात्थकाः ।
आढक्यश्चणकाश्चैव शणाः सप्तदश स्मृताः ॥
verses.rom:
masha mudga masurashcha nishpavah sakulatthakah |
adhakyashchanakashchaiva shanah saptadasha smritah ||

verses.sa:
इत्येता ओषधीनां तु ग्राम्यानां जातयो मुने ।
ओषध्यो यज्ञियाश्चैव ग्राम्यारण्याश्चतुर्दश ॥
verses.rom:
ityeta oshadhinam tu gramyanam jatayo mune |
oshadhyo yajniyashchaiva gramyaranyashchaturdasha ||

verses.sa:
व्रीहयःसयवा माषा गोधूमाश्चाणव स्तिलाः ।
प्रियङ्गुसप्तमा ह्येते अष्टमास्तु कुलत्थकाः ॥
verses.rom:
vrihayahsayava masha godhumashchanava stilah |
priyangusaptama hyete ashtamastu kulatthakah ||

verses.sa:
श्यामाकास्त्वथ नीवारा जर्तिलाः सगवेधुकाः ।
तथा वेणुयवाः प्रोक्तस्तथा मर्कटका मुने ॥
verses.rom:
shyamakastvatha nivara jartilah sagavedhukah |
tatha venuyavah proktastatha markataka mune ||

verses.sa:
ग्राम्यारण्याः स्मृता ह्येता ओषध्यस्तु चतुर्दश ।
यज्ञनिष्पत्तये यज्ञस्तथासां हेतुरुत्तमः ॥
verses.rom:
gramyaranyah smrita hyeta oshadhyastu chaturdasha |
yajnanishpattaye yajnastathasam heturuttamah ||

verses.sa:
एताश्च सह यज्ञेन प्रजानां कारणं परम् ।
परावरविदः प्राज्ञास्ततो यज्ञान्वितन्वेत ॥
verses.rom:
etashcha saha yajnena prajanam karanam param |
paravaravidah prajnastato yajnanvitanveta ||

verses.sa:
अहन्यहन्यनुष्ठानं यज्ञानां मुनिसत्तम ।
उपकारकरं पुंसां क्रियमाणा घशान्तिदम् ॥
verses.rom:
ahanyahanyanushthanam yajnanam munisattama |
upakarakaram pumsam kriyamana ghashantidam ||

verses.sa:
येषां तु कालसृषोऽसौ पापबन्दुर्महामुने ।
चेतःसु ववृधे चक्रुस्ते न यज्ञेषु मानसम् ॥
verses.rom:
yesham tu kalasrisho'sau papabandurmahamune |
chetahsu vavridhe chakruste na yajneshu manasam ||

verses.sa:
वेदवादांस्तथा वेदान्यज्ञ कर्मादिकं च यत् ।
तत्सर्वं निन्दयामासुर्यज्ञव्यासेधकारिणः ॥
verses.rom:
vedavadamstatha vedanyajna karmadikam cha yat |
tatsarvam nindayamasuryajnavyasedhakarinah ||

verses.sa:
प्रवृत्तिमार्गव्युच्छित्तिकारिणो वेदनिन्दकाः ।
दुरात्मानो दुराचारा बभूवुः कुटिलाशयाः ॥
verses.rom:
pravrittimargavyuchchhittikarino vedanindakah |
duratmano durachara babhuvuh kutilashayah ||

verses.sa:
संसिद्धायां तु वार्तायां प्रजाः सृष्ट्वा प्रजापतिः ।
सर्यादां स्थापयामास यथास्थानं यथागुणम् ॥
verses.rom:
samsiddhayam tu vartayam prajah srishtva prajapatih |
saryadam sthapayamasa yathasthanam yathagunam ||

verses.sa:
वर्णा नामाश्रमाणां च धर्मधर्मभृतां वर ।
लोकांश्च सर्ववर्णानां सम्यग्धर्मानुपालिनाम् ॥
verses.rom:
varna namashramanam cha dharmadharmabhritam vara |
lokamshcha sarvavarnanam samyagdharmanupalinam ||

verses.sa:
प्रजापत्यं ब्रह्मणानां स्मृतं स्थानं क्रियावताम् ।
स्थानमैन्द्रं क्षत्रियाणां संग्रमेष्वनिवर्तताम् ॥
verses.rom:
prajapatyam brahmananam smritam sthanam kriyavatam |
sthanamaindram kshatriyanam samgrameshvanivartatam ||

verses.sa:
वैश्यानां मारुतं स्थानं स्वधर्ममनुवर्तिनाम् ।
गान्धर्वं शूद्रजातीनां.परिचर्यानुवर्तिनाम् ॥
verses.rom:
vaishyanam marutam sthanam svadharmamanuvartinam |
gandharvam shudrajatinam.paricharyanuvartinam ||

verses.sa:
अष्टाशीतिसहस्राणि मुनीनामूर्ध्वरेतसाम् ।
स्मृतं तेषां तु यत्स्थानं तदेव गुरुवासिनाम् ॥
verses.rom:
ashtashitisahasrani muninamurdhvaretasam |
smritam tesham tu yatsthanam tadeva guruvasinam ||

verses.sa:
सप्तर्षिणां तु यत्स्थानं स्मृतं तद्वै वनौकसाम् ।
प्राजापत्यं गृहस्थानां न्यासिनां ब्रह्मसंज्ञितम् ॥
verses.rom:
saptarshinam tu yatsthanam smritam tadvai vanaukasam |
prajapatyam grihasthanam nyasinam brahmasamjnitam ||

verses.sa: योगिनाममृतं स्थानं स्वात्मसंतोषकारिणाम् ॥
verses.rom: yoginamamritam sthanam svatmasamtoshakarinam ||

verses.sa:
एकान्तिनः सदा ब्रह्मध्यायिनो योगिनश्च ये ।
तेषां तु परमं स्थानं यत्तत्पश्यन्ति सूरयः ॥
verses.rom:
ekantinah sada brahmadhyayino yoginashcha ye |
tesham tu paramam sthanam yattatpashyanti surayah ||

verses.sa:
गत्वागत्वा निवर्तन्ते चन्द्रसूर्यादयो ग्रहाः ।
अद्यापि न निवर्तन्ते द्वादशाक्षरचिन्तकाः ॥
verses.rom:
gatvagatva nivartante chandrasuryadayo grahah |
adyapi na nivartante dvadashaksharachintakah ||

verses.sa:
तामिस्त्रमन्धतामिस्त्रं महारौरवरौरवौ ।
असिपत्रवनं घोरं कालसूत्रमवीचिकम् ॥
verses.rom:
tamistramandhatamistram maharauravarauravau |
asipatravanam ghoram kalasutramavichikam ||

verses.sa:
विनिन्दकानां वेदस्य यज्ञव्याघातकारिणाम् ।
स्थानमेतत्समाख्यातं स्वधर्मत्यागिनश्च ये ॥
verses.rom:
vinindakanam vedasya yajnavyaghatakarinam |
sthanametatsamakhyatam svadharmatyaginashcha ye ||

verses.sa: इति श्रीविष्णुरुराणे प्रथमेऽंशे षष्ठोऽध्यायः (६)
verses.rom: iti shrivishnururane prathame'mshe shashtho'dhyayah (6)

prose.en:
Maitreya said,—"Thou hast called man by the term Arvvāksrotas. But O Brāhmana, tell me at length how Brahmā created him. And tell me also how he created the orders,—and, O mighty ascetic, of their qualities; and the offices assigned to Vipras and the rest".

Parāçara said,—"O foremost of twice-born ones, Brahmā of true intents was inspired with the desire of creating the kosmos from his mouth, O foremost of twice-born ones, came out creatures surcharged with the principle of goodness; and from the breast of Brahmā creatures surcharged with the principle of passion; and from his thighs came out beings surcharged with both goodness and foulness; and, O best of regenerate ones, from his feet Brahmā created other beings, who were impregnated with the principle of dullness. This is the fore-fold division into orders. And, O excellent Brāhmana, Brāhmanas, Kshatriyas, Vaiçyas and Sudras, came from the feet, the thighs, the chest and the mouth of Brahmā. O exalted one, Brahmā brought into being these four orders capable of satisfactorily performing sacrifices, in order to the successful celebration of them. O thou cognisant of righteousness, the celestials, gratified with sacrifices, in turn gratify creatures,—and therefore sacrifices conduce to welfare. It is men engaged in observing their proper morality, of pure ways, and good, and walking the path of righteousness,—who perform sacrifices. It is by virtue of having been born as human beings that men, O ascetic, can obtain heaven and emancipation; and, O twice-born one, that they can go to the wished-for regions. O foremost of ascetics, men (at the beginning) having been divided into four orders, were reverent and of excellent ways. Then they lived wherever they liked,—without any let. And they were pure in heart,—unpolluted; and cleansed in consequence of their observing all rites. And their minds being pure and the Pure Hari residing in their heart, they perceived that state which goeth after the name of Vishnu, and which is genuine knowledge. Then that portion of Hari which is fraught with Fatality, spread sin (amongst men), causing slight pleasure and an overmeasure of woe. O Maitreya, this, composed of anger, &c, springs from the seed of unrighteousness and begets delusion and covetousness,—and stands in the way of the attainment (of the summum bonum). And men anon could not (any more) completely attain the eight kinds of success, Rasa, Ullāsa, &c. And on sin progressing, and those becoming exceedingly feeble, creatures became subject to physical changes and to all the miseries consequent thereon. Then they constructed forts composed of trees, or rocks, or water; and artificial forts; and cities; and towns. And, O mighty ascetic, they only made houses in those towns, for shelter from cold, the sun, and other (physical discomforts). Having thus provided against cold, etc., men then betook themselves to tasks capable of being performed with the hands, for subsistence. And Vrihi, barley, wheat, small seeds, sessame, prijangu, udāra, kodrava, chināka, māsha, mudga, masura, simbi, kulatkthaka, āraki, oats, and hemp,—these seventeen kinds, O ascetic, were among the rural plants grown. And fourteen sorts are the plants intended to be used in sacrifice, divided into grāmya and āranya Vrihi, barley, māsha, wheat, small seeds, prijangu, sessame, kulaththaka, these eight belong to villages. And Syāmāka, nirāba, jartila, gavedhuka, benuyava, and markataka, (these), O ascetic, (are the plants growing wild in the woods). These fourteen species of plants, grāmya and āranya, are intended for the celebration of sacrifices, and they are very useful for that purpose. All these plants together with sacrifices are the causes of the increase of population; and it is for this those versed in the highest significance of things celebrate sacrifices. By performing sacrifices day after day, one, O foremost of ascetics, reapeth great good, and hath one's sins, committed, shorn of their rancour. O mighty-minded one, it is those only in whose minds the drop of sin attaineth proportions, that set their face against sacrifices. These, reprobating the ordinance of the Veda and the divinities presiding over sacrifices, endeavour to stand in the way of sacrifices. And wicked wights of evil ways and crooked aims, running the Vedas down, lay the axe at the root of courses leading to progress. Having created men, the Lord, on their means of subsistence according with their respective qualities, having been settled, placed them duly in consonance with dignity; and, O best of those practising righteousness, ordained the codes of duty in respect of the orders; and their modes of life; and the regions attainable by them; concerning all the castes, observing the rules of their respective orders. And the sphere assigned to Brāhmanas observing the rules of their order, is that of the Creator himself. And the sphere assigned to Kshatriyas, not turning away from fight, is that of Indra. And Vaiçyas, following the laws of their order, attain the regions of Marut. And those belonging to the Sudra caste that spend their lives in serving (the other orders), attain the regions of the Gandharvas. Those practising the Brahmacharyya injunctions attain the regions of Marut belonging to the eight and eighty thousand ascetics that have drawn up their vital fluid. And those living in the forest reap the place of the seven sages; householders repair to the regions of the Creator; and mendicants, to the sphere named Brahmā. The sphere of the yogis is Amrita —which is the supreme state of Vishnu himself. Those yogis that contemplate Brahmā with a single soul,—of these is that supreme state which is seen by the celestials. The sun, the moon, and the other planets, going to this region again and again, return therefrom again and again,—but to this day those that contemplate the twelve-lettered (Mantra), do not have to return therefrom. Tāmisra, Andhatāmisra, Mahāraurava, Raurava, Asipatravana, Ghora, and the waveless Kālasutra,—these are appointed the regions of those that revile the Vedas,—that obstruct sacrifices; and that abandon their own religion".

verses.sa:
श्रीपराशर उवाच
ततोभिध्यायतस्तस्य जज्ञिरे मानसाः प्रजाः ।
तच्छरीरसमुत्पन्नैः कार्यैस्तैः करणैः सह ।
क्षेत्रज्ञाः समवर्तन्त गात्रेभ्यस्य स्यः धीमतः ॥
verses.rom:
shriparashara uvacha
tatobhidhyayatastasya jajnire manasah prajah |
tachchharirasamutpannaih karyaistaih karanaih saha |
kshetrajnah samavartanta gatrebhyasya syah dhimatah ||

verses.sa:
ते सर्वे समावर्तन्त ये मया प्रागुदाहताः ।
देवाद्याः स्थावरान्ताश्च त्रैगुण्यविषये स्थिताः ॥
verses.rom:
te sarve samavartanta ye maya pragudahatah |
devadyah sthavarantashcha traigunyavishaye sthitah ||

verses.sa: एवंभूतानि सृष्टानि चराणि स्थावराणि च ॥
verses.rom: evambhutani srishtani charani sthavarani cha ||

verses.sa:
यदास्य ताः प्रजाः सर्वा न व्यवर्धन्त धीमतः ।
अथान्यान्मानसान्पुत्रान्सदृशानात्मनोऽसृजत् ॥
verses.rom:
yadasya tah prajah sarva na vyavardhanta dhimatah |
athanyanmanasanputransadrishanatmano'srijat ||

verses.sa:
भृगुं पुलस्त्यं पुलहं क्रतुमङ्गिरसं तथा ।
मरीचिं दक्षमत्रिं च वसिष्ठं चैव मानसान् ॥
verses.rom:
bhrigum pulastyam pulaham kratumangirasam tatha |
marichim dakshamatrim cha vasishtham chaiva manasan ||

verses.sa: नव ब्रह्माण इत्येते पुराणे निश्चयं गताः ॥
verses.rom: nava brahmana ityete purane nishchayam gatah ||

verses.sa:
ख्यातिं भूतिं च संभूतिं क्षमां प्रीतिं तथैव च ।
सन्नतिं च तथैवोर्जमनसूयां तथैव च ॥
verses.rom:
khyatim bhutim cha sambhutim kshamam pritim tathaiva cha |
sannatim cha tathaivorjamanasuyam tathaiva cha ||

verses.sa:
प्रसूतिं च ततः सृष्ट्वा ददौ तेषां महात्मनाम् ।
पत्न्यो भवध्व मित्युक्त्वा तेषामेव तु दत्तवान् ॥
verses.rom:
prasutim cha tatah srishtva dadau tesham mahatmanam |
patnyo bhavadhva mityuktva teshameva tu dattavan ||

verses.sa:
सनन्दनादयो ये च पूर्वसृष्टास्तु वेधसा ।
न ते लोकेष्वसज्जन्त निरपेक्षाः प्रजासु ते ॥
verses.rom:
sanandanadayo ye cha purvasrishtastu vedhasa |
na te lokeshvasajjanta nirapekshah prajasu te ||

verses.sa:
सर्वे तेऽभ्या गतज्ञाना वीतरागा विमत्सराः ।
तेष्वेवं निरपेक्षेषु लोकसृष्टौ महात्मनाः ॥
verses.rom:
sarve te'bhya gatajnana vitaraga vimatsarah |
teshvevam nirapeksheshu lokasrishtau mahatmanah ||

verses.sa:
ब्रह्मणोभून्महान् क्रोधस्त्रैलोक्यदहनक्षमः ।
तस्य क्रोधात्स मुद्भूतज्वालामालातिदीपितम् ।
ब्रह्मणोभूत्तदा सर्वं त्रैलोक्यमखिलं मुने ॥
verses.rom:
brahmanobhunmahan krodhastrailokyadahanakshamah |
tasya krodhatsa mudbhutajvalamalatidipitam |
brahmanobhuttada sarvam trailokyamakhilam mune ||

verses.sa:
भ्रकुटीकुटिलात्तस्य ललाटात्क्रोधदीपितात् ।
समुत्पन्न स्तदा रुद्रो मध्याह्नार्कसमप्रभः ॥
verses.rom:
bhrakutikutilattasya lalatatkrodhadipitat |
samutpanna stada rudro madhyahnarkasamaprabhah ||

verses.sa:
अर्धनारीनरवपुः प्रचण्डोऽतिशरीरवान् ।
विभजात्मानमित्युक्त्वा तं ब्रह्मान्तर्दधे ततः ॥
verses.rom:
ardhanarinaravapuh prachando'tishariravan |
vibhajatmanamityuktva tam brahmantardadhe tatah ||

verses.sa:
तथोक्तोसौ द्विधा स्त्रीत्वं पुरुषत्वं तथाकरोत् ।
विभेदपुरुषत्वं च दशधा चैकधा पुनः ॥
verses.rom:
tathoktosau dvidha stritvam purushatvam tathakarot |
vibhedapurushatvam cha dashadha chaikadha punah ||

verses.sa:
सौम्यासौम्योस्तदाशान्ताशान्तैः स्त्रीत्वं च स प्रभुः ।
विभेद बहुधा देवाः स्वरूपैरसितैः सितैः ॥
verses.rom:
saumyasaumyostadashantashantaih stritvam cha sa prabhuh |
vibheda bahudha devah svarupairasitaih sitaih ||

verses.sa:
ततो ब्रह्मात्मसंभूतं पूर्वं स्वायंभुवं प्रभु ।
आत्मानमेव कृत वान्प्रजापाल्ये मनुं द्विज ॥
verses.rom:
tato brahmatmasambhutam purvam svayambhuvam prabhu |
atmanameva krita vanprajapalye manum dvija ||

verses.sa:
शतरूपां च तां नारीं तपोनिर्धूतकल्पषाम् ।
स्वायंभुवो मनुर्देवः पत्नीत्वे जगृहे प्रभुः ॥
verses.rom:
shatarupam cha tam narim taponirdhutakalpasham |
svayambhuvo manurdevah patnitve jagrihe prabhuh ||

verses.sa:
तस्मात्तु पुरुषाद्देवी शतरूपा व्यजायत ।
प्रियव्रतोत्तानपादौ प्रसूत्याकूतिसंज्ञितम् ॥
verses.rom:
tasmattu purushaddevi shatarupa vyajayata |
priyavratottanapadau prasutyakutisamjnitam ||

verses.sa:
कन्याद्वयं च धर्मज्ञ रूपौदार्यगुणान्वितम् ।
ददौ प्रसूतिं दक्षाय आकूतिं रुचये पुरा ॥
verses.rom:
kanyadvayam cha dharmajna rupaudaryagunanvitam |
dadau prasutim dakshaya akutim ruchaye pura ||

verses.sa:
प्रजापतिः स जग्राह तयोर्जज्ञे सदक्षिणः ।
पुत्रो यज्ञे महाभाग दम्पत्योर्मिथुनं ततः ॥
verses.rom:
prajapatih sa jagraha tayorjajne sadakshinah |
putro yajne mahabhaga dampatyormithunam tatah ||

verses.sa:
यज्ञस्य दक्षिणायां तु पुत्रा द्वादश जज्ञिरे ।
यामा इति समाख्याता देवाः स्वायंभुवे मनौ ॥
verses.rom:
yajnasya dakshinayam tu putra dvadasha jajnire |
yama iti samakhyata devah svayambhuve manau ||

verses.sa:
प्रसूत्यां च तथा दक्षश्चतस्त्रो विंशतिस्तथा ।
ससर्ज कन्यास्तासां च सम्यङ्नामानि मे शृणु ॥
verses.rom:
prasutyam cha tatha dakshashchatastro vimshatistatha |
sasarja kanyastasam cha samyannamani me shrinu ||

verses.sa:
श्रद्धा लक्ष्मीर्धृतिस्तुष्टिर्मेधा पुष्टिस्तथा क्रिया ।
बुद्धिर्लज्जा वपुः शान्तिः सिद्धिः कीर्तिस्त्रयोदशी ॥
verses.rom:
shraddha lakshmirdhritistushtirmedha pushtistatha kriya |
buddhirlajja vapuh shantih siddhih kirtistrayodashi ||

verses.sa:
पत्न्यर्थं प्रतिजग्राह धर्मो दाक्षायणीः प्रभुः ।
ताभ्यः शिष्टयवीयस्य एकादश सुलोचनाः ॥
verses.rom:
patnyartham pratijagraha dharmo dakshayanih prabhuh |
tabhyah shishtayaviyasya ekadasha sulochanah ||

verses.sa:
ख्यातिः सत्यथ संभूतिः स्मृतिः प्रीतिः क्षमा तथा ।
सन्ततिश्चानसूया च ऊर्जा स्वाहा स्वधा तथा ॥
verses.rom:
khyatih satyatha sambhutih smritih pritih kshama tatha |
santatishchanasuya cha urja svaha svadha tatha ||

verses.sa:
भृतुर्भवो मरीचिश्च तथा चैवाङ्गिरा मुनिः ।
पुलस्त्यः पुलहश्चैव क्रतुश्चर्षिवरस्तथा ॥
verses.rom:
bhriturbhavo marichishcha tatha chaivangira munih |
pulastyah pulahashchaiva kratushcharshivarastatha ||

verses.sa:
अत्रिर्वसिष्ठो वह्निश्च पितरश्च यथाक्रमम ।
ख्यात्याद्य जगृहुः कन्या मुनयो मुनि सत्तम ॥
verses.rom:
atrirvasishtho vahnishcha pitarashcha yathakramama |
khyatyadya jagrihuh kanya munayo muni sattama ||

verses.sa:
श्रद्धा कामं चला दर्पं नियमं धृतिरात्मजम् ।
सन्तोषं च तथा तुष्टिर्लोभं पुष्टिरसूयत ॥
verses.rom:
shraddha kamam chala darpam niyamam dhritiratmajam |
santosham cha tatha tushtirlobham pushtirasuyata ||

verses.sa: मेधा श्रुतं क्रिया दण्डं नयं विनयमेव च ॥
verses.rom: medha shrutam kriya dandam nayam vinayameva cha ||

verses.sa:
बोधं बुद्धिस्तथा लज्जा विनयं वपुरात्मजम् ।
व्यवसायं प्रजज्ञे वै क्षेमं शान्तिरसूयता ॥
verses.rom:
bodham buddhistatha lajja vinayam vapuratmajam |
vyavasayam prajajne vai kshemam shantirasuyata ||

verses.sa:
सुखं सिद्धिर्यशः कीर्तिरित्येते धर्मसूनवः ।
कामाद्रतिः सुतं हर्षं धर्मपौत्रमसूयत ॥
verses.rom:
sukham siddhiryashah kirtirityete dharmasunavah |
kamadratih sutam harsham dharmapautramasuyata ||

verses.sa:
हिंसा भार्या त्वधर्मस्य ततो जज्ञे तथानृतम् ।
कन्या च निकृतिस्ताभ्यां माया जज्ञे च वेदना ॥
verses.rom:
himsa bharya tvadharmasya tato jajne tathanritam |
kanya cha nikritistabhyam maya jajne cha vedana ||

verses.sa:
माया च वेदना चैव मिथुनं त्विदमेतयोः ।
तयोर्जज्ञेथ वै माया मृत्युं भूतापहारिणम् ॥
verses.rom:
maya cha vedana chaiva mithunam tvidametayoh |
tayorjajnetha vai maya mrityum bhutapaharinam ||

verses.sa:
वेदना स्वसूतं चापि दुःखं जज्ञेऽथ रौरवात् ।
मृत्योर्व्याधिजराशोकतृष्णक्रोधाश्च जज्ञिरे ॥
verses.rom:
vedana svasutam chapi duhkham jajne'tha rauravat |
mrityorvyadhijarashokatrishnakrodhashcha jajnire ||

verses.sa:
दुःखोत्तराः स्मृता ह्येते सर्वे चाधर्मलक्षणाः ।
नैषां पुत्रोस्ति वै भार्या ते सर्वे ह्यूर्ध्वरेतसः ॥
verses.rom:
duhkhottarah smrita hyete sarve chadharmalakshanah |
naisham putrosti vai bharya te sarve hyurdhvaretasah ||

verses.sa:
रौद्राण्येतानिरूपाणि विष्णोर्मुनिवरात्मज ।
नित्यप्रलयहेतुत्वं जगतोस्य प्रयान्ति वै ॥
verses.rom:
raudranyetanirupani vishnormunivaratmaja |
nityapralayahetutvam jagatosya prayanti vai ||

verses.sa:
दक्षो मरीचिरत्रिश्च भृग्वाद्याश्च प्रजेश्वराः ।
जगत्यत्र महाभाग नित्यसर्गस्य हेतवः ॥
verses.rom:
daksho marichiratrishcha bhrigvadyashcha prajeshvarah |
jagatyatra mahabhaga nityasargasya hetavah ||

verses.sa:
मनवो मनुपुत्राश्च भूपा वीर्यधराश्च ये ।
सन्मार्गनिरताः शूरास्ते सर्वे स्थितिकारिणः ॥
verses.rom:
manavo manuputrashcha bhupa viryadharashcha ye |
sanmarganiratah shuraste sarve sthitikarinah ||

verses.sa:
श्रीमैत्रेय उवाच
येयं नित्या स्थितिर्ब्रह्मन्नित्यसर्गस्तथेरितः ।
नित्याभावश्च तेषां वै स्वरूपं मम कथ्यताम् ॥
verses.rom:
shrimaitreya uvacha
yeyam nitya sthitirbrahmannityasargastatheritah |
nityabhavashcha tesham vai svarupam mama kathyatam ||

verses.sa:
श्रीपराशर उवाच
सर्गस्थितिविनाशांश्च भगवान्मधुसूदनः ।
तैस्तै रूपैरचिन्त्यात्मा करोत्यव्याहतो विभुः ॥
verses.rom:
shriparashara uvacha
sargasthitivinashamshcha bhagavanmadhusudanah |
taistai rupairachintyatma karotyavyahato vibhuh ||

verses.sa:
नैमित्तिकः प्राकृतिकस्तथैवात्यन्तिको द्विज ।
नित्यश्च सर्वभूतानां प्रलयोऽयं चतुर्विधः ॥
verses.rom:
naimittikah prakritikastathaivatyantiko dvija |
nityashcha sarvabhutanam pralayo'yam chaturvidhah ||

verses.sa:
ब्रह्मो नैमित्तिकस्तत्र च्छेतेयं जगतीपतिः ।
प्रयाति प्राकृतं चैव ब्रह्मण्डं प्रकृतौ लयम् ॥
verses.rom:
brahmo naimittikastatra chchheteyam jagatipatih |
prayati prakritam chaiva brahmandam prakritau layam ||

verses.sa:
ज्ञानादात्यन्तिकः प्रोक्तो योगिनः परमात्मनि ।
नित्यः सदैव भूतानां यो विनाशो दिवानिशम् ॥
verses.rom:
jnanadatyantikah prokto yoginah paramatmani |
nityah sadaiva bhutanam yo vinasho divanisham ||

verses.sa:
प्रसूतिः प्रकृतेर्या तु सा सृष्टिः प्राकृता स्मृता ।
दैनन्दिनी तथा प्रोक्ता नान्तरप्रलयादनु ॥
verses.rom:
prasutih prakriterya tu sa srishtih prakrita smrita |
dainandini tatha prokta nantarapralayadanu ||

verses.sa:
भूतान्यनुदिने यत्र जायन्ते मुनिसत्तम ।
नित्यसर्गो हि स प्रोक्तः पुराणार्थविचक्षणैः ॥
verses.rom:
bhutanyanudine yatra jayante munisattama |
nityasargo hi sa proktah puranarthavichakshanaih ||

verses.sa:
एवं सर्वशरीरेषु भगवान्भूतभावनः ।
संस्थितः कुरुते विष्णुरुत्पत्तिस्थितिसंयमान् ॥
verses.rom:
evam sarvasharireshu bhagavanbhutabhavanah |
samsthitah kurute vishnurutpattisthitisamyaman ||

verses.sa:
सृष्टि स्थितिविनाशानां शक्तयः सर्वदेहिषु ।
वैष्णव्यः परिवर्तन्ते मैत्रेयाहर्निशं समाः ॥
verses.rom:
srishti sthitivinashanam shaktayah sarvadehishu |
vaishnavyah parivartante maitreyaharnisham samah ||

verses.sa:
गुणत्रयमयं ह्यतद्ब्रह्यन् शक्तित्रयं महत् ।
योऽतियाति सा यात्येव परं नावर्तते पुनः ॥
verses.rom:
gunatrayamayam hyatadbrahyan shaktitrayam mahat |
yo'tiyati sa yatyeva param navartate punah ||

verses.sa:
इति श्रीविष्णुपुराणे प्रथमेऽंशे सप्तमोऽध्यायः (७)
पराशर उवाच ।
ततोऽभिध्यायतस्तस्य जज्ञिरे मानसीः प्रजाः ।
तच्छरीरसमुत्पन्नः कार्य्यैस्तैः कारणौः सह ॥
verses.rom:
iti shrivishnupurane prathame'mshe saptamo'dhyayah (7)
parashara uvacha |
tato'bhidhyayatastasya jajnire manasih prajah |
tachchharirasamutpannah karyyaistaih karanauh saha ||

verses.sa:
क्षेत्रज्ञाः समवर्त्तन्त गात्रेभ्यस्तस्य धीमतः ।
ते सर्व्वे समवर्त्तेन्त ये मया प्रागुदीरिताः ॥
verses.rom:
kshetrajnah samavarttanta gatrebhyastasya dhimatah |
te sarvve samavarttenta ye maya pragudiritah ||

verses.sa:
देवाद्याः स्थावरान्ताश्व त्रैगुण्यविषये स्थिताः ।
एवम्भूतानि सृष्टानि चराणि स्थावराणि च ॥
verses.rom:
devadyah sthavarantashva traigunyavishaye sthitah |
evambhutani srishtani charani sthavarani cha ||

verses.sa:
यदास्य ताः प्रजाः सर्त्वा न न व्यवर्द्धन्त धीमतः ।
अतान्यान् मानसान् पुत्रान् सदृशानात्मनोऽसृजत् ॥
verses.rom:
yadasya tah prajah sartva na na vyavarddhanta dhimatah |
atanyan manasan putran sadrishanatmano'srijat ||

verses.sa:
भृगुं पुलस्त्यं पुलहं क्रतुमङ्गिरसं तथ ।
मरीचिं दक्षमत्रिं च वशिष्ठं चैव मानसम् ॥
verses.rom:
bhrigum pulastyam pulaham kratumangirasam tatha |
marichim dakshamatrim cha vashishtham chaiva manasam ||

verses.sa:
नव ब्रह्माणा इत्येते पुराणो निश्चयं गताः ।
सनन्दनादयो ये च पूर्व्व सृष्टातु वेघसा ॥
verses.rom:
nava brahmana ityete purano nishchayam gatah |
sanandanadayo ye cha purvva srishtatu veghasa ||

verses.sa:
न ते लोकेष्वसज्जन्त निरपेक्षाः प्रजासु ते ।
सर्वे ते ह्मागतज्ञाना वीतरागा विमत्सराः ॥
verses.rom:
na te lokeshvasajjanta nirapekshah prajasu te |
sarve te hmagatajnana vitaraga vimatsarah ||

verses.sa:
तेष्वेवं निरपेक्षेषु लोकसॄष्टो महात्मनः ।
ब्रह्मणोऽभून्महाक्रो धस्वैलोक्यदहनक्षमः ॥
verses.rom:
teshvevam nirapeksheshu lokasrishto mahatmanah |
brahmano'bhunmahakro dhasvailokyadahanakshamah ||

verses.sa:
तस्य क्रोधात् समुदूभुतज्वालामालाविदीपितम् ।
ब्रह्मणोऽभूत् तदा सर्व्व त्रैलोक्यमखिलं मुने ॥
verses.rom:
tasya krodhat samudubhutajvalamalavidipitam |
brahmano'bhut tada sarvva trailokyamakhilam mune ||

verses.sa: समुत्पन्नस्तदा रुद्रो मध्याह्रार्कसमप्रभः ॥
verses.rom: samutpannastada rudro madhyahrarkasamaprabhah ||

verses.sa:
अर्द्धनारीनरवपुः प्रचण्डोऽतिशरीखान् ।
विभजात्मानमित्युत्तवा तं ब्रह्मान्तर्दधे ततः ॥
verses.rom:
arddhanarinaravapuh prachando'tisharikhan |
vibhajatmanamityuttava tam brahmantardadhe tatah ||

verses.sa:
तथोक्तोऽसौ द्रिधा स्त्रित्वं पुरुषत्वं तथाकरोत् ।
बिभेद पुरुषत्वं च दशधा चैकधा च सः ॥
verses.rom:
tathokto'sau dridha stritvam purushatvam tathakarot |
bibheda purushatvam cha dashadha chaikadha cha sah ||

verses.sa:
सौम्यासौम्यौस्तथा शान्ता शान्तेः स्त्रीत्वं च स प्रभुः ।
बिभेद बहधा देवः स्वरूपैरसितैः सितैः ॥
verses.rom:
saumyasaumyaustatha shanta shanteh stritvam cha sa prabhuh |
bibheda bahadha devah svarupairasitaih sitaih ||

verses.sa:
ततो ब्रह्मात्मसम्भूतं पूर्व्व सायम्भुवं प्रभुः ।
आत्मानमेव कृतवान् प्रजापाल्ये मनुं द्रिज ॥
verses.rom:
tato brahmatmasambhutam purvva sayambhuvam prabhuh |
atmanameva kritavan prajapalye manum drija ||

verses.sa: स्वायम्भुवो मनुर्देवः पलीत्वे जगृहे विभुः ॥
verses.rom: svayambhuvo manurdevah palitve jagrihe vibhuh ||

verses.sa:
तस्माज्व पुरुषाद् देवी सतरूपा व्यजायत ।
प्रियव्रतोत्तानपादौ प्रसूत्याकूतिसंज्ञितम् ॥
verses.rom:
tasmajva purushad devi satarupa vyajayata |
priyavratottanapadau prasutyakutisamjnitam ||

verses.sa:
कन्यादूयञ्च धर्मज्ञ रूपोदार्य्य गुणान्वितम् ।
ददौ प्रसूतीं दक्षाया तथाकूतिं रुचेः पुरा ॥
verses.rom:
kanyaduyancha dharmajna rupodaryya gunanvitam |
dadau prasutim dakshaya tathakutim rucheh pura ||

verses.sa:
प्रजापतिः स जग्राह तयोर्यज्ञः सदक्षिणाः ।
पुत्रोजज्ञे महाभाग दाम्पत्यं मिथुनं ततः ॥
verses.rom:
prajapatih sa jagraha tayoryajnah sadakshinah |
putrojajne mahabhaga dampatyam mithunam tatah ||

verses.sa:
यज्ञस्य दक्षिणायान्तु पुत्रा द्रादश जज्ञिरे ।
यामा इति समाख्याता देवाः स्वायम्भुवे मनौ ॥
verses.rom:
yajnasya dakshinayantu putra dradasha jajnire |
yama iti samakhyata devah svayambhuve manau ||

verses.sa:
प्रसूत्यां च तथा दक्षश्चतसो विंशतिस्तथा ।
ससर्ज्ज कन्यास्तासान्तु सम्यङू नामानि मे श्वृणु ॥
verses.rom:
prasutyam cha tatha dakshashchataso vimshatistatha |
sasarjja kanyastasantu samyanu namani me shvrinu ||

verses.sa:
श्वद्धा लक्ष्मीर्ध तिस्तुष्टिः पुष्टिर्म्मेधा क्रिया तथा ।
बुद्धिर्लज्जा वपुः शान्तिः सिद्धिः कीर्त्रिस्त्रयोदश ॥
verses.rom:
shvaddha lakshmirdha tistushtih pushtirmmedha kriya tatha |
buddhirlajja vapuh shantih siddhih kirtristrayodasha ||

verses.sa:
पल्यर्थ प्रतिजग्राह धर्म्मे दाक्षायणीः प्रभुः ।
ताभ्यः शिष्टा यवीयस्य एकादश सुलोचनाः ॥
verses.rom:
palyartha pratijagraha dharmme dakshayanih prabhuh |
tabhyah shishta yaviyasya ekadasha sulochanah ||

verses.sa:
ख्यातिः सत्यथ सम्भूतिः स्मृतिः प्रीतिः क्षमा तथा ।
सन्नतिश्चानसूया च ऊर्ज्ज स्वाहा स्वधा तथा ॥
verses.rom:
khyatih satyatha sambhutih smritih pritih kshama tatha |
sannatishchanasuya cha urjja svaha svadha tatha ||

verses.sa:
भृगुर्भवो मरीचिश्च तथा चैवाङ्गिरा मुनिः ।
पुलस्त्यः पुलहश्चैव क्रतुश्चर्षिवरस्तथा ॥
verses.rom:
bhrigurbhavo marichishcha tatha chaivangira munih |
pulastyah pulahashchaiva kratushcharshivarastatha ||

verses.sa:
अत्रिर्व्वशिष्ठो वह्रिश्च पितरश्च यथाक्रमम् ।
ख्यात्याद्या जग्वहुः कन्या मुनयो मुनिसत्तम ॥
verses.rom:
atrirvvashishtho vahrishcha pitarashcha yathakramam |
khyatyadya jagvahuh kanya munayo munisattama ||

verses.sa:
श्वद्धा कामं चला दर्प नियमं धृतिरात्मजम् ।
सन्तोषञ्च तथा तुष्टिर्लोभं पुष्टिरसूयत ॥
verses.rom:
shvaddha kamam chala darpa niyamam dhritiratmajam |
santoshancha tatha tushtirlobham pushtirasuyata ||

verses.sa:
मेधा श्वु तं क्रिया दण्डं नयं विनयमेव च ।
बोधं बुद्धिस्तथा लज्जा विनयं वपुरात्मजम् ॥
verses.rom:
medha shvu tam kriya dandam nayam vinayameva cha |
bodham buddhistatha lajja vinayam vapuratmajam ||

verses.sa:
व्यवसाय प्रजज्ञे वै क्षेमं शान्तिरसूयत ।
सुखं सिद्धिर्यशः सीर्त्तिरित्येते धर्म्मसूनवः ॥
verses.rom:
vyavasaya prajajne vai kshemam shantirasuyata |
sukham siddhiryashah sirttirityete dharmmasunavah ||

verses.sa:
कामान् नन्दा सुतं हर्ष धर्म्मपौत्रमसूयत ।
हिंसा भार्या त्वधर्म्मस्य तस्या जज्ञे तथातृतम् ।
कन्या च निकृतिस्ताभ्यां भय नरकमेव च ॥
verses.rom:
kaman nanda sutam harsha dharmmapautramasuyata |
himsa bharya tvadharmmasya tasya jajne tathatritam |
kanya cha nikritistabhyam bhaya narakameva cha ||

verses.sa:
माया च वेदना चैव मिथुनन्त्विदमेतयोः ।
तयोर्जज्ञोऽथ वै माया मृत्यु भूतापरिहारिणम् ॥
verses.rom:
maya cha vedana chaiva mithunantvidametayoh |
tayorjajno'tha vai maya mrityu bhutapariharinam ||

verses.sa:
वेदना स्वसुतञ्चापि दुः खं जज्ञोऽथ रौरवात् ।
मृत्योर्व्याधिजराशोकतृष्णाक्रोघश्च जज्ञिरे ॥
verses.rom:
vedana svasutanchapi duh kham jajno'tha rauravat |
mrityorvyadhijarashokatrishnakroghashcha jajnire ||

verses.sa:
दुः शोत्तराः स्मृता ह्मते सर्व्वे चाधर्म्मलक्षणाः ।
नैषां भार्य्यास्ति पुत्रो वा तें सर्व्वे ह्मू र्ध्वरेतसः ॥
verses.rom:
duh shottarah smrita hmate sarvve chadharmmalakshanah |
naisham bharyyasti putro va tem sarvve hmu rdhvaretasah ||

verses.sa:
सौद्राणि तानि रूपाणि विष्णुर्मुनिवरात्मज ।
नित्यप्र लयहेतुत्वं जगतोऽस्य प्रयान्ति वै ॥
verses.rom:
saudrani tani rupani vishnurmunivaratmaja |
nityapra layahetutvam jagato'sya prayanti vai ||

verses.sa:
दक्षो मरीचिरत्रश्च भृग्वाद्याश्च प्रजेश्वराः।
जगत्यत्र महाभाग नित्यसर्गस्य हेतवः ॥
verses.rom:
daksho marichiratrashcha bhrigvadyashcha prajeshvarah|
jagatyatra mahabhaga nityasargasya hetavah ||

verses.sa:
मनवो मनुपुत्राश्च भूपा वीर्य्यधनाशच ये ।
सन्मार्गाभिरताः शूरास्ते नित्यस्थितिकारिणः ॥
verses.rom:
manavo manuputrashcha bhupa viryyadhanashacha ye |
sanmargabhiratah shuraste nityasthitikarinah ||

verses.sa:
येयं नित्या स्थितिर्ब्र ह्मन् नित्यसर्गस्तथेरितः ।
नित्याभावाश्च तेषां वै स्वरूपं मम कथ्यताम् ॥
verses.rom:
yeyam nitya sthitirbra hman nityasargastatheritah |
nityabhavashcha tesham vai svarupam mama kathyatam ||

verses.sa:
पराशार उवाच ।
सर्गस्थितिविनाशांश्च भगवान् मधुसूदनः ।
तैस्तैरूपैरचिन्त्यात्मा करोत्यव्याहतान् विभुः ॥
verses.rom:
parashara uvacha |
sargasthitivinashamshcha bhagavan madhusudanah |
taistairupairachintyatma karotyavyahatan vibhuh ||

verses.sa:
नैमित्तिकः प्राकृतिकस्तथैवात्यन्तिको द्रिज ।
नित्यश्च सर्व्वभूतानां प्रलयोऽयं चतुर्व्विधः ॥
verses.rom:
naimittikah prakritikastathaivatyantiko drija |
nityashcha sarvvabhutanam pralayo'yam chaturvvidhah ||

verses.sa:
ब्राह्मो नैमित्तिकस्तत्र यच्छेते जगतः पतिः ।
प्रयाति प्राकृते चैव ब्रहाण्डं प्रकृतौ लयम् ॥
verses.rom:
brahmo naimittikastatra yachchhete jagatah patih |
prayati prakrite chaiva brahandam prakritau layam ||

verses.sa:
ज्ञानादात्यन्तिकः प्रोक्तो योगिनः परमात्मनि ।
नित्यः सदवै जातानां यो विनाशो दिवानिशम् ॥
verses.rom:
jnanadatyantikah prokto yoginah paramatmani |
nityah sadavai jatanam yo vinasho divanisham ||

verses.sa:
प्रसूतिः प्राकृतेर्या तु सा सृष्टिः प्राकृती स्मृता ।
दनैन्दिनी तथा प्रोक्ता यान्तरप्रलायादन् ॥
verses.rom:
prasutih prakriterya tu sa srishtih prakriti smrita |
danaindini tatha prokta yantarapralayadan ||

verses.sa:
भूतान्यनुदिनं यत्र जायन्ते मुनिसत्तम ।
नित्यः सर्गः स तु प्रोक्तः पुराणार्थविचक्षणौः ॥
verses.rom:
bhutanyanudinam yatra jayante munisattama |
nityah sargah sa tu proktah puranarthavichakshanauh ||

verses.sa:
एवं सर्व्वशरीरेषु भगवान् भूतभावनः ।
संस्थितः कुरुते विष्णुरुत्पत्तिस्थितिसंयमान् ॥
verses.rom:
evam sarvvasharireshu bhagavan bhutabhavanah |
samsthitah kurute vishnurutpattisthitisamyaman ||

verses.sa:
सृष्टिस्थितिविनाशानां शक्तयः सर्व्वदेहिषु ।
वैष्णव्यः परिवर्त्तन्ते मैत्रेयाऽहर्निशं सदा ॥
verses.rom:
srishtisthitivinashanam shaktayah sarvvadehishu |
vaishnavyah parivarttante maitreya'harnisham sada ||

verses.sa:
गुणत्रयमय ह्मतद् ब्रह्मन् शक्तित्रय महत् ।
योऽतियाति स चात्येव परं नावर्त्तते पुनः ॥
verses.rom:
gunatrayamaya hmatad brahman shaktitraya mahat |
yo'tiyati sa chatyeva param navarttate punah ||

prose.en:
Parāçara said—"Then came forth unto him the mind-sprung beings, embodying causes and consequences arising from his own person. And out of the body of that intelligent one came out the souls. And thus were generated all those mobile and immobile objects beginning with the deities and concluding with the immovable,—which are established in the three several spheres, —and of which I have told thee before. And when these beings of that intelligent one did not multiply, then he created other mind-begotten sons, resembling himself,— viz. Bhrigu, Pulastya, Pulaha, Kratu, Angiras, Marichi, Daksha, Atri, and the mind-sprung Vasishtha. The Purāna saith that these nine resemble Brahmā himself. Those who formerly had been created by Vedas, being bereft of love and hate, and possessed of the highest knowledge, did not take to the world, or produce offspring. And these being indifferent to the increase of people, a mighty wrath took possession of Brahmā, capable of consuming the three worlds. And, O anchoret, the entire triune universe was then illuminated with the flame flowing from the ire of Brahmā. And then from his furrowed forehead inflamed with wrath sprang Rudra, resembling the mid-day Sun; having a body, half-female,—terrific; and of a prodigious person. And saying unto him,—'Divide thou thyself.'—Brahmā then vanished. Thus directed, he divided himself into a male and a female. And then he divided the male into one and ten parts; and the Lord God also divided the female into Saumya, Asaumya, Santa, Asānta, Sita, Asita, and many other parts resembling himself. Then the Lord appointed the Self-create Manu, formerly sprung from Brahmā's self, and resembling himself, to rule creatures. And that lord, the divine Self-create Manu, took to wife the female Satarupā, purged of all sin through asceticism. And to that person Satarupā bore Priyavrata and Uttānapada; and two daughters, named Prasuti and Akuti,—endowed, O thou cognisant of righteousness, with the perfections of beauty, and nobility. And the Lord of creatures of old conferred Prasuti on Daksha, and Akuti on Rucha. And unto this wedded couple were born, O exceedingly righteous one, Yajna and Dakshina; and these were then united in marriage. And ten sons were borne to Yajna by Dakshina. At the time of the Self-create Manu, these went by the designations of Deva and Yāma. And on Prasuti, Daksha begat four and twenty daughters,—whose names do thou hear, Sraddhā, Lakshmi, Dhriti, Tushti Pushti, Medha, Kriya Buddhi, Lajja, Vapu, Santi, Siddhi, and Kriti. These thirteen daughters of Daksha were wedded by the Lord Dharma. The daughters remaining after these elder ones, were eleven, furnished with fair eyes,—Khyati, Sati, Sambhuti, Smriti, Priti Kshamā, Sannati, Anasuyā, Urjjā, Swahā, and Swadhā. Bhrigu, Bhava, Marichi, Angiras, Pulastya, Pulaha, Kratu, Atri, Vasishtha, Vanhi, and the pitris, espoused respectively the daughters, Khyāti and the rest, O foremost of ascetics. And then Sradhā brought forth Kāma; and Chalā, Darpa; and Dhriti, Niyama as her son; and Tushti, Santosha, and Pushti, Lobha And Medha brought forth Srutam; and Kriya, Dandam, Naya, and Vinaya; and Buddhi, Bodha; and Lajja, Vinayaj and Vapu, Vyavasaya as her son; and Santi brought forth Kshamā; and Siddhi, Sukha; and Kirti, Yaças. These are the offspring of Dharma. Nanda bore unto Kama, Harsha —grandson unto Dharma. Hinsā was the wife of Adharma; and from her were born Anrita, and a daughter—Nikriti. And from these came forth Bhaya and Naraka; and two daughters—Maya and Vedana. And Maya and Bhaya gave birth to Mrityu —that allayer of the three kinds of heat, And Vedana bore unto Rauraba, a son named Duhkha. And from Mrityu sprang Vyadhi Jwara, Soka, Trishnā, and Krodha. These ultimately lead to misery; and all have marks of unrighteousness. They have no wives, being all of vital fluid drawn up. And, O son of the Prime ascetic, these are the terrific forms of Vishnu; and they ever bring on the universal dissolution. And, O exalted one, Daksha, Marichi, Bhrigu, and others—lords of creatures—are always the causes of the creation of the universe. And the Manus and their sons and kings possessed of wealth and prowess, and ever abiding by the way of righteousness,—and heroic,—are the causes of the maintenance of the cosmos".

Maitreya said,—"O Brahmana, thou hast alluded to constant creation, constant sustenance and constant dissolution. Do thou describe unto me the characteristics of them".

(Thereat) Parāçara said,—"That one of incomprehensible soul,—the reverend destroyer of Madhu—the Lord assuming respective shapes, effecteth the creation, maintenance, and destruction (of the Universe). The dissolution (of beings) is of four kinds, viz., O twice-born one, Naimittika, Prākritika Atyantika, and Nitya. When, on the expiry of his Day, Brahmā—the lord of the Universe—lieth down, takes place the dissolution called Naimittika. When the mundane egg dissolveth itself away in Primæval Nature, takes place the Prākrita dissolution. The fusion of the Yogis into the Supreme Soul through knowledge, is the Atyantika dissolution. And the constant dissolution of things taking place day and night, goeth by the name of Nitya. The creation which comes of Primæval matter, is known as Prakriti; that which takes place at the end of a minor dissolution, is known as Damandini; and, O foremost of anchorets, the constant daily creation of beings, is called Nitya by the wise versed in the import of the Puranas. Thus that origin of all beings, Vishnu, remaining in the bodies of all things, bringeth about creation, maintenance and destruction. O Maitreya, the energies of Vishnu relative to creation, sustenance, and destruction, remaining in the bodies of all beings, are ever coursing on day and night. O Brahmana, he that, compounded of these mighty powers, overruleth the three principles, attaineth the Supreme state (of Vishnu), and hath not to come back to this scene".

verses.sa:
श्रीपारशर उवाच
कथितस्तामसः सर्गो ब्रह्मणस्ते महामुने ।
रुद्रसर्गं प्रवक्ष्यामि तन्मे निगदतः शृणु ॥
verses.rom:
shriparashara uvacha
kathitastamasah sargo brahmanaste mahamune |
rudrasargam pravakshyami tanme nigadatah shrinu ||

verses.sa:
कल्पादावात्मनस्तुल्यं सुतं प्रध्यायतस्ततः ।
प्रादुरासीत्प्रभोरङ्के कुमारो नीललोहितः ॥
verses.rom:
kalpadavatmanastulyam sutam pradhyayatastatah |
pradurasitprabhoranke kumaro nilalohitah ||

verses.sa:
रुरोद सुस्वरं सोथ प्राद्रवद्दि जसत्तम ।
किं त्वं रोदिषि तं ब्रह्म रुदन्तं प्रत्युवाच ह ॥
verses.rom:
ruroda susvaram sotha pradravaddi jasattama |
kim tvam rodishi tam brahma rudantam pratyuvacha ha ||

verses.sa:
नाम देहीति तं सोऽथ प्रत्युवाच प्रजापतिः ।
रुद्रस्त्वं देवनाम्नासि मारो दीर्धैर्यमावह ।
एवमुक्तः पुनः सोऽथ सप्तकृत्वो रुरोद वै ॥
verses.rom:
nama dehiti tam so'tha pratyuvacha prajapatih |
rudrastvam devanamnasi maro dirdhairyamavaha |
evamuktah punah so'tha saptakritvo ruroda vai ||

verses.sa:
ततोन्यानि ददौ तस्मै सप्त नामानि वै प्रभुः ।
स्थानानि चैषामष्टानां पत्नीः पुत्रांश्च स प्रभुः ॥
verses.rom:
tatonyani dadau tasmai sapta namani vai prabhuh |
sthanani chaishamashtanam patnih putramshcha sa prabhuh ||

verses.sa:
भवं शर्वमथेशानं तथा पशुपतिं द्विज ।
भीममुग्रं महादेवमुवाच स पितामहः ॥
verses.rom:
bhavam sharvamatheshanam tatha pashupatim dvija |
bhimamugram mahadevamuvacha sa pitamahah ||

verses.sa:
चक्रे नामान्यथैतानि स्थानान्येषां चकार सः ।
सूर्यो जलं मही वायुर्वह्निराकाशमेव च ।
दीक्षितो ब्रह्मणः सोम इत्येतास्तनवः क्रमात् ॥
verses.rom:
chakre namanyathaitani sthananyesham chakara sah |
suryo jalam mahi vayurvahnirakashameva cha |
dikshito brahmanah soma ityetastanavah kramat ||

verses.sa:
सुवर्चला तथैवोषा विकेशी चापरा शिवा ।
स्वाहा दिशस्तथा दीक्षा रोहिणी च यथाक्रमम् ॥
verses.rom:
suvarchala tathaivosha vikeshi chapara shiva |
svaha dishastatha diksha rohini cha yathakramam ||

verses.sa:
सूर्यादीनां द्विजश्रेष्ठ रुद्राद्यैर्नामभिः सह ।
पत्न्यः स्मृता महाभाग तदपत्यानि मे शृणु ॥
verses.rom:
suryadinam dvijashreshtha rudradyairnamabhih saha |
patnyah smrita mahabhaga tadapatyani me shrinu ||

verses.sa: एषां सूतिप्रसूतिभ्यामिदमापूरितं जगत् ॥
verses.rom: esham sutiprasutibhyamidamapuritam jagat ||

verses.sa:
शनैश्चरस्तथा शुक्रो लोहिताङ्गो मनोजवः ।
स्कन्दः सर्गोऽथ सन्तानो बुधश्चानुक्रमात्सुताः ॥
verses.rom:
shanaishcharastatha shukro lohitango manojavah |
skandah sargo'tha santano budhashchanukramatsutah ||

verses.sa:
एवंप्रकारो रुद्रोऽसौ सतीं भार्यामनिन्दिताम् ।
उपयेमे दुहितरं रक्षस्यैव प्रजापतेः ॥
verses.rom:
evamprakaro rudro'sau satim bharyamaninditam |
upayeme duhitaram rakshasyaiva prajapateh ||

verses.sa:
दक्षकोपाच्च तत्याज स सती स्वकलेवरम् ।
हिमवद्दुहित साभून्मेनायां द्विजसत्तम ॥
verses.rom:
dakshakopachcha tatyaja sa sati svakalevaram |
himavadduhita sabhunmenayam dvijasattama ||

verses.sa: उपयेमे पुनश्चोमामनन्यां भगवान्हरः ॥
verses.rom: upayeme punashchomamananyam bhagavanharah ||

verses.sa:
देवौ धातृविधातारौ भृगोः ख्यातिरसूयत ।
श्रियं च देवदेवस्य पत्नी नारायणस्य या ॥
verses.rom:
devau dhatrividhatarau bhrigoh khyatirasuyata |
shriyam cha devadevasya patni narayanasya ya ||

verses.sa:
श्रीमैत्रेय उवाच
क्षीराब्धौ श्रीः समुत्पन्ना श्रूयतेऽमृतमन्थने ।
भृगोः ख्यात्यां समुत्पन्नेत्येतदाह कथं भवात् ॥
verses.rom:
shrimaitreya uvacha
kshirabdhau shrih samutpanna shruyate'mritamanthane |
bhrigoh khyatyam samutpannetyetadaha katham bhavat ||

verses.sa:
श्रीपराशर उवाच
नित्यैवैषा जगन्माता विष्णोः श्रीरनपायिनि ।
यथा सर्वगतो विष्णुस्तथैवेयं द्विजोत्तम ॥
verses.rom:
shriparashara uvacha
nityaivaisha jaganmata vishnoh shriranapayini |
yatha sarvagato vishnustathaiveyam dvijottama ||

verses.sa:
अर्थो विष्णुरियं वाणी नीतिरेषा नयो हरिः ।
बोधो विष्णुरियं बुद्धिर्धर्मोऽसौ सत्क्रिया त्वियम् ॥
verses.rom:
artho vishnuriyam vani nitiresha nayo harih |
bodho vishnuriyam buddhirdharmo'sau satkriya tviyam ||

verses.sa:
स्त्रष्टा विष्णुरियं सृष्टिः श्रीर्भूमिर्भूधरो हरिः ।
सन्तोषो भगवाल्लङ्क्ष्मीस्तुष्टिर्मैत्रेय शाश्वती ॥
verses.rom:
strashta vishnuriyam srishtih shrirbhumirbhudharo harih |
santosho bhagavallankshmistushtirmaitreya shashvati ||

verses.sa:
इच्छा श्रीर्भगवान्कामो यज्ञोऽसौ दक्षिणा त्वियम् ।
आज्याहुतिरसौ देवी पुरोडाशो जनार्दनः ॥
verses.rom:
ichchha shrirbhagavankamo yajno'sau dakshina tviyam |
ajyahutirasau devi purodasho janardanah ||

verses.sa:
पत्नीशाला मुने लक्ष्मीः प्राग्वंशौ मधुसूदनः ।
चितिर्लक्ष्मीर्हरिर्यूप इध्मा श्रीर्भगवान्कुशः ॥
verses.rom:
patnishala mune lakshmih pragvamshau madhusudanah |
chitirlakshmirhariryupa idhma shrirbhagavankushah ||

verses.sa:
सामास्वरूपी भगवानुद्गीतिः कमलालया ।
स्वाहा लक्ष्मीर्जगन्नाथो वासुदेवो हुता शनः ॥
verses.rom:
samasvarupi bhagavanudgitih kamalalaya |
svaha lakshmirjagannatho vasudevo huta shanah ||

verses.sa:
शङ्करो भगवाञ्छौरिर्गौरीलक्ष्मीर्द्विजोत्तम ।
मैत्रेय केशवः सूर्यस्तत्प्रभा कमलालया ॥
verses.rom:
shankaro bhagavanchhaurirgaurilakshmirdvijottama |
maitreya keshavah suryastatprabha kamalalaya ||

verses.sa:
विष्णुः पितृगणः पद्मा स्वधा शाश्वतपुष्टिदा ।
द्यौः श्रीः सर्वात्मको विष्णुरवकाशोतिविस्तरः ॥
verses.rom:
vishnuh pitriganah padma svadha shashvatapushtida |
dyauh shrih sarvatmako vishnuravakashotivistarah ||

verses.sa:
शशाङ्कः श्रीधरः कान्तिः श्रीस्तथैवानपायिनी ।
धृतिर्लक्ष्मीर्जगच्चेष्टा वायुः सर्वत्रगो हरिः ॥
verses.rom:
shashankah shridharah kantih shristathaivanapayini |
dhritirlakshmirjagachcheshta vayuh sarvatrago harih ||

verses.sa:
जलधिर्द्विजगोविन्दस्तद्वेला श्रीर्महामुने ।
लक्ष्मीस्वरूपमिन्द्राणी देवेन्द्रो मधुसूदनः ॥
verses.rom:
jaladhirdvijagovindastadvela shrirmahamune |
lakshmisvarupamindrani devendro madhusudanah ||

verses.sa:
यमश्चक्रधरः साक्षाद्धूमोर्णा कमलालया ।
ऋद्धिः श्रीः श्रीधरो देवः स्वयमेव धनेश्वरः ॥
verses.rom:
yamashchakradharah sakshaddhumorna kamalalaya |
riddhih shrih shridharo devah svayameva dhaneshvarah ||

verses.sa:
गौरी लक्ष्मीमंहाबागा केशवो वरुणः स्वयम् ।
श्रीर्देवसेना विप्रेन्द्र देवसेनापतिर्हरिः ॥
verses.rom:
gauri lakshmimamhabaga keshavo varunah svayam |
shrirdevasena viprendra devasenapatirharih ||

verses.sa:
अवष्टंभो गदापाणिः शक्तिर्लक्ष्मीर्द्विजोत्तम ।
काष्ठा लक्ष्मीर्निमेषोऽसौ मुहूर्तोऽसौ कला त्वियम् ॥
verses.rom:
avashtambho gadapanih shaktirlakshmirdvijottama |
kashtha lakshmirnimesho'sau muhurto'sau kala tviyam ||

verses.sa:
ज्योत्स्ना लक्ष्मीः प्रदीपोऽसौ सर्वः सर्वेश्वरो हरिः ।
लताभूता जगन्माता श्रीर्विष्णुर्द्रुमसंज्ञितः ॥
verses.rom:
jyotsna lakshmih pradipo'sau sarvah sarveshvaro harih |
latabhuta jaganmata shrirvishnurdrumasamjnitah ||

verses.sa:
विभावरी श्रीर्दिवसो देवचक्रगदाधरः ।
वरप्रदो वरो विष्णुर्वधूः पद्मवनाल या ॥
verses.rom:
vibhavari shrirdivaso devachakragadadharah |
varaprado varo vishnurvadhuh padmavanala ya ||

verses.sa:
नदस्वरूपी भगवाञ्छ्रीर्नदीरूपसंस्थिता ।
ध्वजश्च पुण्डरीकाक्षः पताका कमलालया ॥
verses.rom:
nadasvarupi bhagavanchhrirnadirupasamsthita |
dhvajashcha pundarikakshah pataka kamalalaya ||

verses.sa:
तृष्णा लक्ष्मीर्जगन्नाथो लोभो नारायणः परः ।
रती रागश्च मैत्रेय लक्ष्मीर्गोविन्द एव च ॥
verses.rom:
trishna lakshmirjagannatho lobho narayanah parah |
rati ragashcha maitreya lakshmirgovinda eva cha ||

verses.sa: किं चातिबहुनोक्तेन संक्षेपेणेदमुच्यते ॥
verses.rom: kim chatibahunoktena samkshepenedamuchyate ||

verses.sa:
देवतिर्यङ्मनुष्यादौ पुन्नामा भगवान्हरिः ।
स्त्रीनाम्नी श्रीश्च विज्ञेया नानयोर्विद्यते परम् ॥
verses.rom:
devatiryanmanushyadau punnama bhagavanharih |
strinamni shrishcha vijneya nanayorvidyate param ||

verses.sa: इति श्रीविष्णुपुराणे प्रथमेऽंशे अष्टमोऽध्यायः (८)
verses.rom: iti shrivishnupurane prathame'mshe ashtamo'dhyayah (8)

prose.en:
Parāçara said,—"O mighty ascetic, I have narrated unto thee the creation of Brahmā connected with the principle of dullness. Now I shall unfold unto thee the creation called Rudra. Do thou hearken as I proceed! At the outset of a Kalpa, as the Lord was rapt in thoughts about a son resembling himself, on his lap appeared one hued red-blue. And, O best of regenerate persons, crying in sweet tones, he went about. And as he was crying, Brahmā asked him,—'Why dost thou weep?' And thereon, he said unto the Lord of creatures,—let me have a name.' And (the Lord said),—‘O divine one, thou art named Rudra. Do not cry. Have patience.' Thus accosted, he again cried for seven times. And thereat the Lord gave him seven other names; and assigned six receipients thereof, as well as the six wives and sons of the latter. Bhava, Sarva, Isana, Pasupati, Bhima, Ugra, and Mahadeva,—these seven names were mentioned by the Great-father, And the holders thereof were respectively the Sun, water, earth, fire, air, ether, the initiated Brāhmana, and Soma. And Suvarchala, Uma, Sukesi, Siva, Dik, Dikshā, and Rohini,—are, O best of men, the wives of the Rudras, named the Sun, etc. And hearken (unto me) reciting the names of their offspring, whose sons and grandsons have filled the universe. Sanaischara, Suka, Lohitānga, Manojava, Skanda, Swarga, Santāna and Budha,—these are respectively the sons (of the Eight Forms.) Rudra, formed thus, took to his wife Sati, And through Daksha's ire, Sati renounced her person. And then, O best of the born ones, she became the daughter of Himavat by name Umā. Then the reverend Bhava again married Umā, who was his solely. And Bhrigu's wife, Khyati, brought forth the gods—Dhata and Vidhata; as well as Sri, who is Nārāyana's spouse".

Maitreya said:—"We have heard that Sri arose from the Ocean of milk on the occasion of the churning of the deep. But why dost thou say that she was begot by Bhrigu on Khyati?"

Thereat Parāçara said;—"That mother of the Universe—Vishuu's energy—is enduring and undeteriorating, O foremost of the twice-born ones, even as Vishnu is omnipresent, so this one also. Vishnu is the sense and she is the word; she is morality, Vishnu is justice; Vishnu is perception, and she the power thereof; he is merit, and she the act of piety.—Vishnu is the creator, and she the creation; Sri is earth,—and Hari, the supporter thereof. The reverend one is contentment, and, O Maitreya, Lakshmi is permanent peace; Sri is desire, and the worshipful one is Kama; he is sacrifice, and she the dakshina; the goddess is the first libation, and Janārddana is Purodāsa; O ascetic, Lakshmi is patuisālā, and Madhusudana is the prākvansa (of a sacrifice); Lakshmi is the chitti and Hari is the yupa; Lakshmi is sacrificial fuel, and the reverend one is Kuça; The reverend one is Sāman, the Lotus-dwelling Sri is Udgiti; Lakshmi is Swāhā, that Lord of the Universe,—Vāsudeva—is fire, the worshipful Sauri is Sankara, (the mistress of) Wealth is, O best of the twice-born one, Gauri. O Maitreya, Kesava is the Sun, the Lotus-seated one is the splendour thereof; Vishnu are the paternal manes, and the Lotus-throned one is Swadha, ever conferring gratification; Sri is the city of the celestials, that soul of all—Vishnu—is the exceedingly spacious sky; the support of Sri is the Moon, and Sri is the constant resplendence thereof; Lakshmi is Fortitude and Exertion; Hari is the air-coursing everywhere. O twice-born one, Govinda is the Ocean; and, O magnanimous Vipra, Sri is the shore thereof. Lakshmi is like the spouse of Indra, and the Destroyer of Madhu is the Indra of the immortals; the holder of the discus is Yama himself, and the Lotus-presiding one is Dhumorna. Sri is Prosperity, that god—the supporter of Sri—is the Lord himself of riches. Lakshmi is the highly exalted Gauri and Kesava is Varnna himself. Sri is the celestial host, O foremost of Vipras, and Hari is the lord thereof. The mace-handed one is Avashtambha, and, O best of the regenerate, Lakshmi is Energy. Lakshmi is Kastha. and he is Nimesha. He is muhurta, and she is kalā; Lakshmi is the light, and Hari, or Sarva—lord of all—is the lamp. The Mother of the universe is the plant, and Vishnu—the spouse of Sri—is the tree established. Sri is Night, and that deity—the holder of the discus and mace—is Day. The boon-bestowing Vishnu is the bridegroom, and she dwelling in the lotus-grove is the Bride. The reverend One is like a male river. Pundarikaksha is the (banner), and the Lotus-seated Sri is the Ensign. Lakshmi is Thirst, and that master of the Universe, the Great Nārāyana, is Desire. And, O thou cognisant of righteousness, Lakshmi and Govinda are respectively Attachment and Love. What is the use of dilating? I tell thee this in brief,—the Reverend Hari compriseth gods, men, beasts and other creatures that are termed male; and, O Maitreya, Lakshmi compriseth all that are termed female. There exists naught that is beyond these".

verses.sa:
पराशर उवाच ।
इदञ्च श्वृण मैत्रेय यत् पृष्टोऽहमिह त्वया ।
श्रीसम्बद्ध मया ह्म तच्छ्र तमासीनूमरीचितः ॥
verses.rom:
parashara uvacha |
idancha shvrina maitreya yat prishto'hamiha tvaya |
shrisambaddha maya hma tachchhra tamasinumarichitah ||

verses.sa:
दुर्व्वासाः शङ्करस्यांशश्चचार पृथिवीमिमाम् ।
स ददर्श स्त्रजं दिव्यामषिर्विद्याधरीकरे ॥
verses.rom:
durvvasah shankarasyamshashchachara prithivimimam |
sa dadarsha strajam divyamashirvidyadharikare ||

verses.sa:
सन्तानाकानामखिलं यस्या गन्धेन वासितम् ।
अतिसेव्यमभूद् ब्रह्मनू तदूवनं वनचारिणाम् ॥
verses.rom:
santanakanamakhilam yasya gandhena vasitam |
atisevyamabhud brahmanu taduvanam vanacharinam ||

verses.sa:
उन्मत्तव्रतधृगू विप्रस्तां दृष्ट्वा शोभनां स्त्रजम्
तां ययाचे वरारोहां विद्याधरवधूं ततः ॥
verses.rom:
unmattavratadhrigu viprastam drishtva shobhanam strajam
tam yayache vararoham vidyadharavadhum tatah ||

verses.sa:
याचिता तेन तन्वङ्गी मालां विद्याधराङ्गना ।
ददौ तस्मै विशालाक्षी सादरं प्रणिपत्य च ॥
verses.rom:
yachita tena tanvangi malam vidyadharangana |
dadau tasmai vishalakshi sadaram pranipatya cha ||

verses.sa:
तामादायात्मनो मूर्ध्रि स्त्रजमुन्मत्तरूपधृक् ।
कृत्वा स विप्रो मैत्रय परिबभ्राम मेदिनीम् ॥
verses.rom:
tamadayatmano murdhri strajamunmattarupadhrik |
kritva sa vipro maitraya paribabhrama medinim ||

verses.sa:
स ददर्श समायान्तमुन्मत्तैरावतस्थितम् ।
त्रैलोक्याधिपतिं देवं सह देवैः शचीपतिम् ॥
verses.rom:
sa dadarsha samayantamunmattairavatasthitam |
trailokyadhipatim devam saha devaih shachipatim ||

verses.sa:
तामात्मनः स शिरसः स्त्रजमुन्मत्तषटूपदाम् ।
आदायामरराजाय चिक्षेपोन्मत्तवन्मुनिः ॥
verses.rom:
tamatmanah sa shirasah strajamunmattashatupadam |
adayamararajaya chiksheponmattavanmunih ||

verses.sa:
गृहीत्वामराराजेन स्त्रगैरावतमूर्द्धनि ।
न्यस्ता रराज कैलासशिखरे जाह्नवी यथा ॥
verses.rom:
grihitvamararajena stragairavatamurddhani |
nyasta raraja kailasashikhare jahnavi yatha ||

verses.sa:
मदान्धकारिताक्षोऽसौ गन्धाकृष्टेन वारणाः ।
करेणाघ्राय चिक्षेप तां स्रजं धरणीतले ॥
verses.rom:
madandhakaritaksho'sau gandhakrishtena varanah |
karenaghraya chikshepa tam srajam dharanitale ||

verses.sa:
ततश्चुक्रोध भगवातन् दुर्वासा मुनिसत्तमः ।
मैत्रेय देवराजं तं क्रु द्धश्चैतदुवाच ह ॥
verses.rom:
tatashchukrodha bhagavatan durvasa munisattamah |
maitreya devarajam tam kru ddhashchaitaduvacha ha ||

verses.sa:
दुर्वासा उवाच ।
ऐश्वर्यमत्त दुष्टात्मन्नतिस्तब्धोऽसि वासव ।
श्वियो धाम स्रजं यस्त्वं मद्दत्तां नाभिनन्दसि ॥
verses.rom:
durvasa uvacha |
aishvaryamatta dushtatmannatistabdho'si vasava |
shviyo dhama srajam yastvam maddattam nabhinandasi ||

verses.sa:
प्रसाद इति नोक्तं ते प्रणिपातपुरः सरम् ।
हर्षोतूफुल्लकापोलेन न चापि शिरसा धृता ॥
verses.rom:
prasada iti noktam te pranipatapurah saram |
harshotuphullakapolena na chapi shirasa dhrita ||

verses.sa:
मया दत्तामिमां मालां यस्मान्न बहु मन्यसे ।
त्रैलोक्यश्रीरतो मूढ़ विनाशमुपयास्यति ॥
verses.rom:
maya dattamimam malam yasmanna bahu manyase |
trailokyashrirato murha vinashamupayasyati ||

verses.sa:
मां मन्यतेऽन्यैः सदृशं न्यूनं शक्र भवान् द्रिजैः ।
अतोऽवमानमस्माकं मानिना भवता कृतम् ॥
verses.rom:
mam manyate'nyaih sadrisham nyunam shakra bhavan drijaih |
ato'vamanamasmakam manina bhavata kritam ||

verses.sa:
मद्दत्ता भवता यस्मात् क्षिप्ता माला महीतले ।
तस्मात् प्रनष्टलक्ष्मीकं त्रैलोक्यं ते भवतिष्यति ॥
verses.rom:
maddatta bhavata yasmat kshipta mala mahitale |
tasmat pranashtalakshmikam trailokyam te bhavatishyati ||

verses.sa:
यस्य सञ्जातकोपस्य भयमेति चराचरम् ।
तं त्वं मामतिगर्वेणा देवराजावमन्यसे ॥
verses.rom:
yasya sanjatakopasya bhayameti characharam |
tam tvam mamatigarvena devarajavamanyase ||

verses.sa:
महेन्द्रो वारणस्कन्धादवतीर्य्य त्वरान्वितः ।
प्रसादयामास तदा दुर्वाससमकल्मषम् ॥
verses.rom:
mahendro varanaskandhadavatiryya tvaranvitah |
prasadayamasa tada durvasasamakalmasham ||

verses.sa:
प्रसाद्यामानः स तदा प्रणिपातपुरः सरम् ।
प्रत्युवाच सहस्राक्षं दुर्व्वासा मुनिसत्तमः ॥
verses.rom:
prasadyamanah sa tada pranipatapurah saram |
pratyuvacha sahasraksham durvvasa munisattamah ||

verses.sa:
नाहं कृपालुह्टदयो न च मां भजते क्षमा ।
अन्ये ते मुनयः शक्र दुर्व्वाससमवेहि माम् ॥
verses.rom:
naham kripaluhtadayo na cha mam bhajate kshama |
anye te munayah shakra durvvasasamavehi mam ||

verses.sa:
गौतमादिबिरन्यस्त्वं गर्व्वमापादितो मुधा ।
अक्षान्तिसारसर्वस्वं दुर्वाससमवेहि माम् ॥
verses.rom:
gautamadibiranyastvam garvvamapadito mudha |
akshantisarasarvasvam durvasasamavehi mam ||

verses.sa:
वसिष्ठाद्यदैयासारैः स्तोत्रं कुर्व्वद्भिरुज्वकैः ।
गर्व्व गतोऽसि येनैवं मामप्यद्यावमन्यसे ॥
verses.rom:
vasishthadyadaiyasaraih stotram kurvvadbhirujvakaih |
garvva gato'si yenaivam mamapyadyavamanyase ||

verses.sa:
ज्वलज्जटाकलापस्य भृकुटीकुटिलं मुखम ।
निरीक्ष्य कस्त्रिभुवने मम यो न गतो भयम् ॥
verses.rom:
jvalajjatakalapasya bhrikutikutilam mukhama |
nirikshya kastribhuvane mama yo na gato bhayam ||

verses.sa:
नाहं क्षमिष्ये बहुना किमुक्तन शतक्रतो ।
विड़म्बनामिमां भूयः करोष्यनुनयात्मिकाम् ॥
verses.rom:
naham kshamishye bahuna kimuktana shatakrato |
virambanamimam bhuyah karoshyanunayatmikam ||

verses.sa:
इत्युत्तवा प्रययौ विप्रो देवराजोऽपि तं पुनः ।
आरुह्म रावतं ब्रह्मन् प्रययावमरावतीम् ॥
verses.rom:
ityuttava prayayau vipro devarajo'pi tam punah |
aruhma ravatam brahman prayayavamaravatim ||

verses.sa:
ततः प्रभृति निःश्रीकं सशक्र भुवनत्रयम् ।
मैत्रैयासीदपध्वस्तं संक्षीणौषधिवीरुधम् ॥
verses.rom:
tatah prabhriti nihshrikam sashakra bhuvanatrayam |
maitraiyasidapadhvastam samkshinaushadhivirudham ||

verses.sa:
न यज्ञाः संप्रवर्त्तन्ते न तपस्यन्ति तापसाः ।
न च दानादिधर्मषु मनश्चक्रे तदा जनः ॥
verses.rom:
na yajnah sampravarttante na tapasyanti tapasah |
na cha danadidharmashu manashchakre tada janah ||

verses.sa:
निसत्त्वा सकला लोका लोभाद्यु पहतेन्दिरियाः ।
स्वल्पेऽपि हि बभूवुस्ते साभिलाषा द्रिजोत्तम ॥
verses.rom:
nisattva sakala loka lobhadyu pahatendiriyah |
svalpe'pi hi babhuvuste sabhilasha drijottama ||

verses.sa:
यतः सत्त्वं ततो लक्ष्मीः सत्त्वं भूत्यनुसारि च ।
निःश्रीकाणां कुतः सत्वं विना तेन गुणाः कुतः ॥
verses.rom:
yatah sattvam tato lakshmih sattvam bhutyanusari cha |
nihshrikanam kutah satvam vina tena gunah kutah ||

verses.sa:
बलशौर्य्याद्यभावश्च पुरुषाणां गुणौर्व्विना ।
लङ्वनीयः समस्तस्य बलशौर्य्य विवर्जितः ॥
verses.rom:
balashauryyadyabhavashcha purushanam gunaurvvina |
lanvaniyah samastasya balashauryya vivarjitah ||

verses.sa:
भवत्यपध्वस्तमतिर्लङूघितः प्रथितः पुमान्
एवमत्यन्तनिःश्रीके त्रैलोक्ये सत्त्ववर्ज्जिते ॥
verses.rom:
bhavatyapadhvastamatirlanughitah prathitah puman
evamatyantanihshrike trailokye sattvavarjjite ||

verses.sa:
देवान् प्रति बलोद्योगं चक्रु र्दैतेयदानवाः ।
लोभाभिभूता निश्रीका दैत्याः सत्त्वविवर्जिताः ॥
verses.rom:
devan prati balodyogam chakru rdaiteyadanavah |
lobhabhibhuta nishrika daityah sattvavivarjitah ||

verses.sa:
श्रिया विहीनैर्निः सत्त्वैर्देवैश्चक्रु स्ततो रणम् ।
विजितास्त्रिदशा दैत्य रिन्द्राद्याः शरणां ययुः ॥
verses.rom:
shriya vihinairnih sattvairdevaishchakru stato ranam |
vijitastridasha daitya rindradyah sharanam yayuh ||

verses.sa:
पितामहं महाभागं हुताशनपुरोगमाः ।
यथावत् कथिते देवैर्ब्र ह्मा प्राह ततः सुरान् ॥
verses.rom:
pitamaham mahabhagam hutashanapurogamah |
yathavat kathite devairbra hma praha tatah suran ||

verses.sa:
परापरेशं शरणां ब्रजध्वमसुरार्द्दनम् ।
उत्पत्तिस्थितिनाशानामहेतुं हेतुमीश्वरम् ॥
verses.rom:
paraparesham sharanam brajadhvamasurarddanam |
utpattisthitinashanamahetum hetumishvaram ||

verses.sa:
प्रजापतिपतिं विष्णुमनन्तमपराजितम् ।
प्रधानपुंसोरजयोः कारणं कार्य्य भूतयोः ॥
verses.rom:
prajapatipatim vishnumanantamaparajitam |
pradhanapumsorajayoh karanam karyya bhutayoh ||

verses.sa:
प्रणतार्त्तिहरं विष्णुं स वः श्र यो विधास्यति ।
एवभुतवा सुरान् सर्व्वान् ब्रह्मा लोकपितामहः ।
क्षीरोदस्योत्तरे तीरं तैरेव सहितो ययौ ॥
verses.rom:
pranatarttiharam vishnum sa vah shra yo vidhasyati |
evabhutava suran sarvvan brahma lokapitamahah |
kshirodasyottare tiram taireva sahito yayau ||

verses.sa:
स गत्वा त्रिदशः सर्व्वैः समवेतः पितामहः ।
तुष्टाव वागुभिरिष्टाभिः परापरपतिं हरिम् ॥
verses.rom:
sa gatva tridashah sarvvaih samavetah pitamahah |
tushtava vagubhirishtabhih paraparapatim harim ||

verses.sa:
नमाम सर्व्व सर्व्वशमनन्तमजमव्ययम् ।
लोकधामधराधारमप्रकाशमभदिनम् ॥
verses.rom:
namama sarvva sarvvashamanantamajamavyayam |
lokadhamadharadharamaprakashamabhadinam ||

verses.sa:
नारायणमणीयांसमशेषाणानणीयसाम् ।
समस्तानां गरिष्ठं यदू भूरादीनां गरीयसाम् ॥
verses.rom:
narayanamaniyamsamasheshanananiyasam |
samastanam garishtham yadu bhuradinam gariyasam ||

verses.sa:
यत्र सर्व्व यतः सर्व्वमुत्पन्नं सतुपुरःसरम् ।
सर्व्वभूतश्च यो देवः पराणामपि यः परः ॥
verses.rom:
yatra sarvva yatah sarvvamutpannam satupurahsaram |
sarvvabhutashcha yo devah paranamapi yah parah ||

verses.sa:
परः परस्मात् पुरुषात् परमात्मस्वरूपधृक् ।
योगिभिश्चिन्त्यते योऽसौ मुक्तिहेतुर्म्मुक्षुभिः ॥
verses.rom:
parah parasmat purushat paramatmasvarupadhrik |
yogibhishchintyate yo'sau muktiheturmmukshubhih ||

verses.sa:
सत्तादयो न सन्तीशे यत्र च प्राकृता गुणाः ।
स शुद्धः सर्व्वशुद्ध भ्यः पुमानाद्यः प्रसीदतु ॥
verses.rom:
sattadayo na santishe yatra cha prakrita gunah |
sa shuddhah sarvvashuddha bhyah pumanadyah prasidatu ||

verses.sa:
कला - काष्ठा-निमेषादिकालसूत्रस्य गोचरे ।
यस्य शक्तिर्न शुद्धस्य प्रसीदतु स नो हरिः ॥
verses.rom:
kala - kashtha-nimeshadikalasutrasya gochare |
yasya shaktirna shuddhasya prasidatu sa no harih ||

verses.sa:
प्रोच्यते परमेशो हि यः शुद्धोऽप्युपचारतः ।
प्रसीदतु स नो विष्णुरात्मा यः सर्व्वदेहिनाम् ॥
verses.rom:
prochyate paramesho hi yah shuddho'pyupacharatah |
prasidatu sa no vishnuratma yah sarvvadehinam ||

verses.sa:
यः कारणञ्च कार्य्य ञ्च कारणस्यापि कारणम् ।
कार्य्यापि च यः कार्य्य प्रसीदतु स नो हरिः ॥
verses.rom:
yah karanancha karyya ncha karanasyapi karanam |
karyyapi cha yah karyya prasidatu sa no harih ||

verses.sa:
कार्य्यकार्य्यश्य यः कार्य्य तत्कार्यस्यापि यः स्वयम् ।
तत्कार्य्यकार्य्यभूतो यस्ततश्च प्रणताः स्म तम् ॥
verses.rom:
karyyakaryyashya yah karyya tatkaryasyapi yah svayam |
tatkaryyakaryyabhuto yastatashcha pranatah sma tam ||

verses.sa:
कारणां कारणस्यापि तस्य कांरणकारणम् ।
तत्कारणानां हेतुं त्वां प्रणताः स्म सुरेश्वरम् ॥
verses.rom:
karanam karanasyapi tasya kamranakaranam |
tatkarananam hetum tvam pranatah sma sureshvaram ||

verses.sa:
भोक्तारं भोज्यभूतञ्ज स्त्रष्टारं सृस्टमेव च ।
कार्य्य कर्म्मस्वरूपं तं प्रणताः स्म परं पदम् ॥
verses.rom:
bhoktaram bhojyabhutanja strashtaram sristameva cha |
karyya karmmasvarupam tam pranatah sma param padam ||

verses.sa:
विशुद्ध बोधनं नित्यमजमक्षयमव्ययम् ।
अव्यक्तमविकारं यत् तद्रिष्णोः परमं पदम् ॥
verses.rom:
vishuddha bodhanam nityamajamakshayamavyayam |
avyaktamavikaram yat tadrishnoh paramam padam ||

verses.sa:
न स्थूलं न च सूक्ष्मं यन्न विशेषणगोचरम् ।
तत्पदं परमं विष्णोः प्रणमामः सदामलम् ॥
verses.rom:
na sthulam na cha sukshmam yanna visheshanagocharam |
tatpadam paramam vishnoh pranamamah sadamalam ||

verses.sa:
यस्यायुतायुतांशांशे विश्वशक्तिरियं स्थिता ।
परं ब्रह्मस्वरूपं यत् प्रणमामस्तमव्ययम् ॥
verses.rom:
yasyayutayutamshamshe vishvashaktiriyam sthita |
param brahmasvarupam yat pranamamastamavyayam ||

verses.sa:
यन्न देवा न मुनयो न चाहं न च शंकरः ।
जानन्ति परमेशस्य तद्रिष्णोः परम पदम् ॥
verses.rom:
yanna deva na munayo na chaham na cha shamkarah |
jananti parameshasya tadrishnoh parama padam ||

verses.sa:
यदू योगिनः सदोदूयुक्ताः पुण्यपापक्षयेऽक्षयम् ।
पश्यन्ति प्रणावे चिन्त्यं तद्रिष्णोः परमं पदम् ॥
verses.rom:
yadu yoginah sadoduyuktah punyapapakshaye'kshayam |
pashyanti pranave chintyam tadrishnoh paramam padam ||

verses.sa:
शक्तयो यस्य देवस्य ब्रह्मविष्णुशिवादिकाः ।
भवन्त्यभूतपूर्वस्य तद्रिष्णोः परमं पदम् ॥
verses.rom:
shaktayo yasya devasya brahmavishnushivadikah |
bhavantyabhutapurvasya tadrishnoh paramam padam ||

verses.sa:
सव्वेश सर्व्वभूतात्मन् सर्व्व सर्वाश्रयाच्युत ।
प्रसीद विष्णो भक्तानां भक्तानां व्ररकज नो दृष्टिगोचरम् ॥
verses.rom:
savvesha sarvvabhutatman sarvva sarvashrayachyuta |
prasida vishno bhaktanam bhaktanam vrarakaja no drishtigocharam ||

verses.sa:
इत्युदीरितमाकर्ण्य ब्रह्मणस्त्रिदशास्ततः ।
प्रणम्योचुः प्रसीदेति व्रज नो दृष्टिगोचरम् ॥
verses.rom:
ityudiritamakarnya brahmanastridashastatah |
pranamyochuh prasideti vraja no drishtigocharam ||

verses.sa:
यन्नाय भगवान् ब्रह्मा जानाति परमं पदम् ।
तन्नताः स्म जगद्धा तव सर्व्व गताच्युत ॥
verses.rom:
yannaya bhagavan brahma janati paramam padam |
tannatah sma jagaddha tava sarvva gatachyuta ||

verses.sa:
इत्यन्ते वचसस्तेषां देवानां ब्रह्मणस्तथा ।
ऊचुर्देवर्षयः सर्व्वै बृहस्पतिपुरोगमाः ॥
verses.rom:
ityante vachasastesham devanam brahmanastatha |
uchurdevarshayah sarvvai brihaspatipurogamah ||

verses.sa:
आद्यो यज्ञपुमानिडयो यः सर्व्वेषाञ्च पूर्व्वजः ।
तं नताः स्म जगत्स्त्रष्टुः स्त्रष्टारमविशेषणम् ॥
verses.rom:
adyo yajnapumanidayo yah sarvveshancha purvvajah |
tam natah sma jagatstrashtuh strashtaramavisheshanam ||

verses.sa:
भगवन् भूतभव्येश जगन्मूर्त्तिधराव्यय ।
प्रसीद प्रणतानां त्वं सर्व्वेषां देहि दर्शनम् ॥
verses.rom:
bhagavan bhutabhavyesha jaganmurttidharavyaya |
prasida pranatanam tvam sarvvesham dehi darshanam ||

verses.sa:
एष ब्रह्मा तथैवायं सह रुदैस्त्रिलोचनः ।
सर्वादित्यः समं पूषा पावकोऽय सहाग्निभिः ॥
verses.rom:
esha brahma tathaivayam saha rudaistrilochanah |
sarvadityah samam pusha pavako'ya sahagnibhih ||

verses.sa:
अश्विनौ वसवश्चेमे सव चैते मरुदूगणाः ।
साध्या विश्वे तथा देवा देवेन्द्रश्चायमीश्वरः ॥
verses.rom:
ashvinau vasavashcheme sava chaite maruduganah |
sadhya vishve tatha deva devendrashchayamishvarah ||

verses.sa:
प्रणामप्रवणा नाथ दैत्यसैन्यपराजिताः ।
शरणां त्वामनुप्राप्ताः समस्ता देवतागणाः ॥
verses.rom:
pranamapravana natha daityasainyaparajitah |
sharanam tvamanupraptah samasta devataganah ||

verses.sa:
एव संस्तूयमानस्तु भगवाञ्छरङ्वचक्रधूक् ।
जगाम दर्शनं तेषां मैत्रेय परमेश्वरः ॥
verses.rom:
eva samstuyamanastu bhagavanchharanvachakradhuk |
jagama darshanam tesham maitreya parameshvarah ||

verses.sa:
तं दृष्ट्वा ते तदा देवाः शर्ङ्वचक्रगदाधरम् ।
अपूर्व्वरूपसंस्थानं तेजसां राशिमूर्ज्जितम् ॥
verses.rom:
tam drishtva te tada devah sharnvachakragadadharam |
apurvvarupasamsthanam tejasam rashimurjjitam ||

verses.sa:
प्रणम्य प्रणताः पूर्व्वं संक्षोभस्तिमितेक्षणाः ।
तुष्टुवुः पुण्डरीकाक्षं पितामहपुरोगमाः ॥
verses.rom:
pranamya pranatah purvvam samkshobhastimitekshanah |
tushtuvuh pundarikaksham pitamahapurogamah ||

verses.sa:
नमो नमोऽविशेषस्त्वं त्वं ब्रह्मा त्वं पिनाकधृक् ।
इन्द्रस्त्वमग्रिः पवनो वरुणः सविता यमः ॥
verses.rom:
namo namo'visheshastvam tvam brahma tvam pinakadhrik |
indrastvamagrih pavano varunah savita yamah ||

verses.sa:
वसवो मरुतः साध्या विश्वे देवगणा भवान् ।
योऽयं तवागतो देव समीपं देवतागणः ॥
verses.rom:
vasavo marutah sadhya vishve devagana bhavan |
yo'yam tavagato deva samipam devataganah ||

verses.sa:
स त्वमेव जगत्स्त्रष्टा यतः सर्व्वगतो भवान् ।
त्वं यज्ञस्त्वं वषटूकारस्त्वमोङ्करः प्रजापतिः ॥
verses.rom:
sa tvameva jagatstrashta yatah sarvvagato bhavan |
tvam yajnastvam vashatukarastvamonkarah prajapatih ||

verses.sa:
वेद्यावेद्यञ्च सर्व्वात्मंस्त्वन्मयञ्चाखिलं जगत् ।
त्वामत्र शरणां विष्णो प्रयाता दैत्यनिर्ज्जिताः ॥
verses.rom:
vedyavedyancha sarvvatmamstvanmayanchakhilam jagat |
tvamatra sharanam vishno prayata daityanirjjitah ||

verses.sa:
वयं प्रसीद सर्वात्मंस्तेजस्याप्याययस्व नः ।
तावदर्त्तिस्तथा वाञ्छा तावन्मोहस्तथासुखम् ॥
verses.rom:
vayam prasida sarvatmamstejasyapyayayasva nah |
tavadarttistatha vanchha tavanmohastathasukham ||

verses.sa:
यावन्नायाति शरणं त्वामशेषाघनाशनम् ।
त्वं प्रसादं प्रसन्नात्मन् प्रपन्नानां कुरुष्व नः ॥
verses.rom:
yavannayati sharanam tvamasheshaghanashanam |
tvam prasadam prasannatman prapannanam kurushva nah ||

verses.sa: तेजसां नाथ सर्वेषां स्वशत्त्याप्यायनं कुरु ॥
verses.rom: tejasam natha sarvesham svashattyapyayanam kuru ||

verses.sa:
एवं संस्तूयमानस्तु प्रणतैरमरैर्हरिः ।
प्रसन्नदृष्टिर्भगवानिदमाह स विश्वकृत् ॥
verses.rom:
evam samstuyamanastu pranatairamarairharih |
prasannadrishtirbhagavanidamaha sa vishvakrit ||

verses.sa:
तेजसो भवतां देवाः करिष्याम्युपबृ हणम् ।
वदाम्यहं यत् क्रियतां भवद्भिस्तदिद सुराः ॥
verses.rom:
