tejaso bhavatam devah karishyamyupabri hanam |
vadamyaham yat kriyatam bhavadbhistadida surah ||

verses.sa:
आनीय सहिता दत्यैः क्षीराब्धौ सकलौषधीः ।
मन्थानं मन्दरं कृत्वा नेत्रं कृत्वा तु वासुकिम् ॥
verses.rom:
aniya sahita datyaih kshirabdhau sakalaushadhih |
manthanam mandaram kritva netram kritva tu vasukim ||

verses.sa:
मथ्यतामभृतं देवाः सहाये मय्यवस्थिते ।
सामपूर्व्वञ्च दैतेयास्तत्र साहाय्यकर्मणि ॥
verses.rom:
mathyatamabhritam devah sahaye mayyavasthite |
samapurvvancha daiteyastatra sahayyakarmani ||

verses.sa:
सामान्यफलभोक्तारो यूयं वाच्या भविष्यथ
मथ्यमाने च तत्राब्धौ यतू समुत्पद्यतेऽमृतम् ॥
verses.rom:
samanyaphalabhoktaro yuyam vachya bhavishyatha
mathyamane cha tatrabdhau yatu samutpadyate'mritam ||

verses.sa:
तत्पानाद् बलिनो यूयममराश्व भविष्यथ ।
तथा चाहं करिष्यामि यथा त्रिदशाविद्रिषः ।
न प्राप्स्यन्त्यमृतं देवाः केवलं क्लेशभागिनः ॥
verses.rom:
tatpanad balino yuyamamarashva bhavishyatha |
tatha chaham karishyami yatha tridashavidrishah |
na prapsyantyamritam devah kevalam kleshabhaginah ||

verses.sa:
इत्युत्तवा देवदेवेन सर्व्व एव ततः सुराः ।
सन्धानमसुरैः कृत्वा यत्नवन्तोऽमृतेऽभवन् ॥
verses.rom:
ityuttava devadevena sarvva eva tatah surah |
sandhanamasuraih kritva yatnavanto'mrite'bhavan ||

verses.sa:
नानौषधीः समानीय देव-दैतेयदानवाः ।
क्षिप्त्वा क्षिराब्धीपयसि शरदभ्रामलत्विषि ॥
verses.rom:
nanaushadhih samaniya deva-daiteyadanavah |
kshiptva kshirabdhipayasi sharadabhramalatvishi ||

verses.sa:
मन्थानं मन्दरं नेत्रं कृत्वा च वासुकिम् ।
ततो मथितुमारब्धा मैत्रैय तरसामृतम् ॥
verses.rom:
manthanam mandaram netram kritva cha vasukim |
tato mathitumarabdha maitraiya tarasamritam ||

verses.sa:
विबुधाः सहिताः सर्व्वे यतः पुच्छं ततःकृताः ।
कृष्णेन वासुकेर्दैत्याः पूर्व्वकाये निवेशिताः ॥
verses.rom:
vibudhah sahitah sarvve yatah puchchham tatahkritah |
krishnena vasukerdaityah purvvakaye niveshitah ||

verses.sa:
ते तस्य फणनिः श्वास- वह्निनापहतत्विषः ।
निस्तेजसोऽसुराः सर्वे बभुवुरमितद्यु ते ॥
verses.rom:
te tasya phananih shvasa- vahninapahatatvishah |
nistejaso'surah sarve babhuvuramitadyu te ||

verses.sa:
तेनैव मुखनिःशास-वायुनास्तबलाहकैः
पुच्छप्रदेशे वर्षद्भिस्तथा चाप्यायिताः सुराः ॥
verses.rom:
tenaiva mukhanihshasa-vayunastabalahakaih
puchchhapradeshe varshadbhistatha chapyayitah surah ||

verses.sa:
क्षीरोदमध्ये भगवान् कूर्म्मरूपो स्वयं हरिः ।
मन्थनाद्रे रधिष्ठानं भ्रमतोऽभून्महामुने ॥
verses.rom:
kshirodamadhye bhagavan kurmmarupo svayam harih |
manthanadre radhishthanam bhramato'bhunmahamune ||

verses.sa:
रूपेणान्येन देवानां मध्ये चक्रगदाधरः ।
चकर्ष भोगिराजानं दैत्यमध्येऽपरेण च ॥
verses.rom:
rupenanyena devanam madhye chakragadadharah |
chakarsha bhogirajanam daityamadhye'parena cha ||

verses.sa:
उपर्य्यक्रान्तवान् शैलं बृहदूरूपेण केशवः ।
तथापरेण मैत्रय यन्न दृष्टं सुरासुरैः ॥
verses.rom:
uparyyakrantavan shailam brihadurupena keshavah |
tathaparena maitraya yanna drishtam surasuraih ||

verses.sa:
तेजसा नागराजानं तथाप्यायितवान् हरिः ।
अन्येन तेजसा देवान् उपबृं हितवान् विभुः ॥
verses.rom:
tejasa nagarajanam tathapyayitavan harih |
anyena tejasa devan upabrim hitavan vibhuh ||

verses.sa:
मथ्यमाने ततस्तस्मिन् क्षीराब्धौ देव-दानवैः ।
हविर्धामाभवत् पूर्व्व सुरभिः सुरपूजिता ॥
verses.rom:
mathyamane tatastasmin kshirabdhau deva-danavaih |
havirdhamabhavat purvva surabhih surapujita ||

verses.sa:
जग्मुर्म्मुदं ततो देवा दानवाश्च महामुने ।
व्याक्षिप्तचेतसश्चैव बभूवुस्तिमितेक्षणाः ॥
verses.rom:
jagmurmmudam tato deva danavashcha mahamune |
vyakshiptachetasashchaiva babhuvustimitekshanah ||

verses.sa:
किमेतदिति सद्धानां दिवि चिन्तयतां ततः ।
बभूव वारुणो देवी मदाधूर्णितलोचना ॥
verses.rom:
kimetaditi saddhanam divi chintayatam tatah |
babhuva varuno devi madadhurnitalochana ||

verses.sa:
कृतावर्त्तातू ततस्तस्मात् क्षीरोदादू वासयन् जगत् ।
गन्धेन पारिजातोऽभूदू देवस्त्रीनन्दस्तरुः ॥
verses.rom:
kritavarttatu tatastasmat kshirodadu vasayan jagat |
gandhena parijato'bhudu devastrinandastaruh ||

verses.sa:
रूपौदार्य्यगुणोपेतस्ततश्चाप्सरसां गणः ।
क्षीरोदधेः समुत्पन्नो मैत्रय परमाद्भुतः ॥
verses.rom:
rupaudaryyagunopetastatashchapsarasam ganah |
kshirodadheh samutpanno maitraya paramadbhutah ||

verses.sa:
ततः शीतांशुरभवजूजगृहे त्वं महेश्वरः ।
जगृहुश्च विषं नागाः क्षीरोदाज्व समुत्थितम् ॥
verses.rom:
tatah shitamshurabhavajujagrihe tvam maheshvarah |
jagrihushcha visham nagah kshirodajva samutthitam ||

verses.sa:
ततो धन्वन्तरिर्देवः श्वेताम्बरधरस्स्वयम् ।
विभ्रत्कमण्डलुं पुर्णममृतस्य समुत्थितः ॥
verses.rom:
tato dhanvantarirdevah shvetambaradharassvayam |
vibhratkamandalum purnamamritasya samutthitah ||

verses.sa:
ततः स्वस्थमनस्कास्ते सर्व्वे दैतेय-दानवाः ।
बभूवुर्म्मुदिताः सर्व्वे मैत्रेय मुतिभिः सह ॥
verses.rom:
tatah svasthamanaskaste sarvve daiteya-danavah |
babhuvurmmuditah sarvve maitreya mutibhih saha ||

verses.sa:
ततः स्फुरत्कान्तिमती विकासिकमले स्थिता ।
श्रीर्देवी पयसस्तस्मादुत्थिता भृतपंकजा ॥
verses.rom:
tatah sphuratkantimati vikasikamale sthita |
shrirdevi payasastasmadutthita bhritapamkaja ||

verses.sa:
तां तुष्टु वुर्म्मुदा युक्ताः श्रीसूक्तेने महर्षयः ।
विशावसुमुखास्तस्या गन्धर्वाः पुरतो जगुः ॥
verses.rom:
tam tushtu vurmmuda yuktah shrisuktene maharshayah |
vishavasumukhastasya gandharvah purato jaguh ||

verses.sa:
घृताचीप्रमुखा ब्रह्मन् ननृतुश्चाप्सरोगणाः ।
गङ्गाद्याः सरितस्तोयैः स्नानार्थमुपतस्थिरे ॥
verses.rom:
ghritachipramukha brahman nanritushchapsaroganah |
gangadyah saritastoyaih snanarthamupatasthire ||

verses.sa:
दीगूगजा हेमपात्रस्थम् आदाय विमलं जलम् ।
स्नापयाञ्चक्रिरे देवीं सर्व्वलोकामम्लहेश्वरीम् ॥
verses.rom:
digugaja hemapatrastham adaya vimalam jalam |
snapayanchakrire devim sarvvalokamamlaheshvarim ||

verses.sa:
क्षीरोदो रुपधृक् तस्यै मालामम्लानपङ्कजाम् ।
ददौ विभूषणान्यङ्ग विश्वकर्मा चकार च ॥
verses.rom:
kshirodo rupadhrik tasyai malamamlanapankajam |
dadau vibhushananyanga vishvakarma chakara cha ||

verses.sa:
दिव्यमाल्याम्बरधरा स्नाता भूषणभूषिता ।
पश्यतां सर्व्वदेवानां ययौ वक्षःस्थलं हरेः ॥
verses.rom:
divyamalyambaradhara snata bhushanabhushita |
pashyatam sarvvadevanam yayau vakshahsthalam hareh ||

verses.sa:
तयावलोकिता देवा हरिवक्षःस्थलस्थया ।
लक्ष्म्या मैत्रय सहसा परां निर्वृतिमागताः ॥
verses.rom:
tayavalokita deva harivakshahsthalasthaya |
lakshmya maitraya sahasa param nirvritimagatah ||

verses.sa:
उद्रगं परमं जग्मुर्दैत्या विष्णुपराङूमुखाः ।
त्यक्ता लक्षम्या महाभाग विप्रचित्तिपुरोगमाः ॥
verses.rom:
udragam paramam jagmurdaitya vishnuparanumukhah |
tyakta lakshamya mahabhaga viprachittipurogamah ||

verses.sa:
ततस्ते जगृहुर्द्दैत्या धन्वन्तरिकरे स्थितम् ।
कमण्डलुं महावीर्य्या यत्रास्ते तदू द्रिजामृतम् ॥
verses.rom:
tataste jagrihurddaitya dhanvantarikare sthitam |
kamandalum mahaviryya yatraste tadu drijamritam ||

verses.sa:
मायया लोभयित्वा तान् विष्णुः स्त्रीरूपमास्थितः ।
दानवेभ्यस्तदादाय देवेभ्यः प्रददौ विभुः ॥
verses.rom:
mayaya lobhayitva tan vishnuh strirupamasthitah |
danavebhyastadadaya devebhyah pradadau vibhuh ||

verses.sa:
ततः पपुः सुरगणाः शक्राद्यास्तत् तदामृतम् ।
उद्यतायुधनिस्त्रिंशा दैत्यास्तांश्व समभ्ययुः ॥
verses.rom:
tatah papuh suraganah shakradyastat tadamritam |
udyatayudhanistrimsha daityastamshva samabhyayuh ||

verses.sa:
पीतेऽमृते च बलिभिर्देवैर्दैत्यचमुस्तदा ।
वध्यमाना दिशो भेजे पातालं तु विवेश वै ॥
verses.rom:
pite'mrite cha balibhirdevairdaityachamustada |
vadhyamana disho bheje patalam tu vivesha vai ||

verses.sa:
तदा देवा मुदा युक्ताः शङ्र्वचक्रगदाभृतम् ।
प्रणिपत्य यथापूर्वम् आशासत त्रिविष्टपम् ॥
verses.rom:
tada deva muda yuktah shanrvachakragadabhritam |
pranipatya yathapurvam ashasata trivishtapam ||

verses.sa:
ततः प्रसन्नभाः सूर्य्यः प्रययौ स्वेन वर्त्मना ।
ज्योतींषि च यथामार्ग प्रययुर्मु निसत्तम ॥
verses.rom:
tatah prasannabhah suryyah prayayau svena vartmana |
jyotimshi cha yathamarga prayayurmu nisattama ||

verses.sa:
जज्वाल भगवांश्वोज्व श्वौरुदीप्तिर्व्विभावसुः ।
धर्म्मे च सर्व्वभूतानां तदा मतिरजायत ॥
verses.rom:
jajvala bhagavamshvojva shvaurudiptirvvibhavasuh |
dharmme cha sarvvabhutanam tada matirajayata ||

verses.sa:
त्रैलोक्यञ्च श्रिया जुष्टं बभूव मुनिसत्तम ।
शक्रश्व त्रिदशश्रेष्ठः पुनः श्रीमानजायत ॥
verses.rom:
trailokyancha shriya jushtam babhuva munisattama |
shakrashva tridashashreshthah punah shrimanajayata ||

verses.sa:
सिंहासनगतः शक्रः सम्प्राप्य त्रिदिवं पुनः ।
देवराज्ये स्थितो देवीं तुष्टावाब्जकरां ततः ॥
verses.rom:
simhasanagatah shakrah samprapya tridivam punah |
devarajye sthito devim tushtavabjakaram tatah ||

verses.sa:
नमस्ये सर्व्वभूतांनां जननीमब्जसम्भवाम् ।
श्रियमुन्नद्रपह्माक्षी विष्णोर्वक्षः स्थलस्थिताम् ॥
verses.rom:
namasye sarvvabhutamnam jananimabjasambhavam |
shriyamunnadrapahmakshi vishnorvakshah sthalasthitam ||

verses.sa:
त्वं सिद्धिस्त्वं सुधा स्वाहा स्वधा त्वं लोकपावनि ।
सन्धाय रात्रिः प्रभा भूतिर्मेधा श्रद्धा सरस्वती ॥
verses.rom:
tvam siddhistvam sudha svaha svadha tvam lokapavani |
sandhaya ratrih prabha bhutirmedha shraddha sarasvati ||

verses.sa:
यज्ञविद्या महाविद्या गुह्मविद्या च शोभने ।
आत्मविद्या च देवि त्वं विमुक्तिफलदायिनी ॥
verses.rom:
yajnavidya mahavidya guhmavidya cha shobhane |
atmavidya cha devi tvam vimuktiphaladayini ||

verses.sa:
आन्वीक्षिकी त्रयी वार्त्ता दण्डनीतिस्त्वमेव च ।
सौम्यासौम्यैर्ज्जगद्रू पैस्त्वयैतद्द वि पूरितम् ॥
verses.rom:
anvikshiki trayi vartta dandanitistvameva cha |
saumyasaumyairjjagadru paistvayaitadda vi puritam ||

verses.sa:
का त्वन्या त्वामृते देवि सर्व्वयज्ञमयं वपुः ।
अध्यास्ते देवदेवस्य योगिचिन्त्यं गदाभृतः ॥
verses.rom:
ka tvanya tvamrite devi sarvvayajnamayam vapuh |
adhyaste devadevasya yogichintyam gadabhritah ||

verses.sa:
त्वया देवि परित्यक्तं सकलं भुवनत्रयम् ।
विनष्टप्रायमभवत् त्वयेदानीं समेधितम् ॥
verses.rom:
tvaya devi parityaktam sakalam bhuvanatrayam |
vinashtaprayamabhavat tvayedanim samedhitam ||

verses.sa:
दाराः पुत्रास्तथागारं सुह्टदू धान्यधनादिकम् ।
भवत्येतन्महाभागे नित्यं त्वदूवीक्षणान्नृणाम् ॥
verses.rom:
darah putrastathagaram suhtadu dhanyadhanadikam |
bhavatyetanmahabhage nityam tvaduvikshanannrinam ||

verses.sa:
शरीरारोग्यमैश्वर्य्यमरिपक्षक्षयः सुखम् ।
देवि त्वदूदृष्टिदृष्टानां पुरुषाणां दुर्ल्ल भम् ॥
verses.rom:
sharirarogyamaishvaryyamaripakshakshayah sukham |
devi tvadudrishtidrishtanam purushanam durlla bham ||

verses.sa:
त्वं माता सर्व्वभूतानां देवदवो हरिः पिता ।
त्वयैतद विष्णुना चाद्य जगदूव्याप्तं चराचरम् ॥
verses.rom:
tvam mata sarvvabhutanam devadavo harih pita |
tvayaitada vishnuna chadya jagaduvyaptam characharam ||

verses.sa:
मा नः कोशं तथा गोष्ठं मा गृहं मा परिच्दम् ।
मा शरीरं कलत्रञ्च त्यजेथाः सर्व्वपावनि ॥
verses.rom:
ma nah kosham tatha goshtham ma griham ma parichdam |
ma shariram kalatrancha tyajethah sarvvapavani ||

verses.sa:
मा पुत्त्रान् मा सुह्टदूवर्ग मा पशून् मा विभूषणम् ।
त्यजेथा मम देवस्य विष्णोर्व्वक्षःस्थलालये ॥
verses.rom:
ma puttran ma suhtaduvarga ma pashun ma vibhushanam |
tyajetha mama devasya vishnorvvakshahsthalalaye ||

verses.sa:
सत्त्वैन सत्यशौचाभ्यां तथा शीलादिभिर्गुणैः ।
त्यज्यन्ते ते नराः सद्यः सन्त्यक्ता ये त्वयामले ॥
verses.rom:
sattvaina satyashauchabhyam tatha shiladibhirgunaih |
tyajyante te narah sadyah santyakta ye tvayamale ||

verses.sa: त्वयावलोकिताः मुह्मन्ते पुरुषा निर्गुणा अपि ॥
verses.rom: tvayavalokitah muhmante purusha nirguna api ||

verses.sa:
स श्लाध्यः स गुणी धन्यः स कुलीनः स बुद्धिमान् ।
स शूरः स च विक्रान्तो यस्त्वया देवि वीक्षितः ॥
verses.rom:
sa shladhyah sa guni dhanyah sa kulinah sa buddhiman |
sa shurah sa cha vikranto yastvaya devi vikshitah ||

verses.sa:
सद्यो वैगुण्यमायान्ति शीलाद्याः सकला गुणाः ।
पराङूमुखी जगद्धात्रि यस्य त्वं विष्णुवल्लभे ॥
verses.rom:
sadyo vaigunyamayanti shiladyah sakala gunah |
paranumukhi jagaddhatri yasya tvam vishnuvallabhe ||

verses.sa:
न ते वर्णायितुं शक्ता गुणान् जिह्वापि वेधसः ।
प्रसीद देवि पह्माक्षि मास्मांस्त्याक्षीः कदाचन ॥
verses.rom:
na te varnayitum shakta gunan jihvapi vedhasah |
prasida devi pahmakshi masmamstyakshih kadachana ||

verses.sa:
एवं श्रीः संस्तुता सम्यक् प्राह देवी शतक्रतुम् ।
श्वृण्वतां सर्वदेवानां सर्व्वभूतस्थिता द्रिज ॥
verses.rom:
evam shrih samstuta samyak praha devi shatakratum |
shvrinvatam sarvadevanam sarvvabhutasthita drija ||

verses.sa:
परितुष्टास्मि देवेश स्त्रोत्रेणानेन ते हरे ।
वरं वृणीष्व यस्त्विष्टो वरदाहं तवागता ॥
verses.rom:
paritushtasmi devesha strotrenanena te hare |
varam vrinishva yastvishto varadaham tavagata ||

verses.sa:
वरदा यदि मे देवि वरार्हो यदि वाप्यहम् ।
त्रैलोक्यं न त्वया त्याज्यमेष मेऽस्तु वरः परः ॥
verses.rom:
varada yadi me devi vararho yadi vapyaham |
trailokyam na tvaya tyajyamesha me'stu varah parah ||

verses.sa:
स्त्रोत्रणे यस्तथेतेन त्वां स्तोष्यत्यब्धिसम्भवे ।
स त्वया न परित्याज्यो द्रितीयोऽस्तु वरो मम ॥
verses.rom:
strotrane yastathetena tvam stoshyatyabdhisambhave |
sa tvaya na parityajyo dritiyo'stu varo mama ||

verses.sa:
त्रैलोक्यं त्रिदशश्रष्ठे न सत्यक्ष्यामि वासव ।
दत्तो वरो मया यस्ते स्तोत्राराधनतुष्टया ॥
verses.rom:
trailokyam tridashashrashthe na satyakshyami vasava |
datto varo maya yaste stotraradhanatushtaya ||

verses.sa:
यश्च सायं तथा प्रातः स्तोत्रेणानोन मानवः ।
मां स्तोष्यति न तस्याहं भविष्यामि पराङूमुखी ॥
verses.rom:
yashcha sayam tatha pratah stotrenanona manavah |
mam stoshyati na tasyaham bhavishyami paranumukhi ||

verses.sa:
एवं वरं ददौ देवी देवराजाय वै पुरा ।
मेत्रेय श्रीर्महाभागा स्तोत्राराधनतोषिता ॥
verses.rom:
evam varam dadau devi devarajaya vai pura |
metreya shrirmahabhaga stotraradhanatoshita ||

verses.sa:
भृगोः ख्यात्यां समुतूपन्ना श्रीः पूर्व्वमुदधेः पुनः ।
देव-दानवयत्नेन प्रसूतामृतमन्थने ॥
verses.rom:
bhrigoh khyatyam samutupanna shrih purvvamudadheh punah |
deva-danavayatnena prasutamritamanthane ||

verses.sa:
एवं यथा जगत्स्वामी देवदेवो जनार्द्दनः ।
अवतारं करोत्येष करोत्येष तथा श्रीस्तत्सहायिनी ॥
verses.rom:
evam yatha jagatsvami devadevo janarddanah |
avataram karotyesha karotyesha tatha shristatsahayini ||

verses.sa:
पुनश्व पह्मादुदूभूता आदित्योऽभूद् यदा हरिः ।
यदा तु भार्गवो रामस्तदाभूद् धरणी त्वियम् ॥
verses.rom:
punashva pahmadudubhuta adityo'bhud yada harih |
yada tu bhargavo ramastadabhud dharani tviyam ||

verses.sa:
राघवत्वेऽभवत् सीता रुक्मिणो कृष्णजन्मनि ।
अन्येषु चावतारेषु विष्णोरेषा सहायिनी ॥
verses.rom:
raghavatve'bhavat sita rukmino krishnajanmani |
anyeshu chavatareshu vishnoresha sahayini ||

verses.sa:
देवत्वे देवदेहेय मनुष्यत्वे च मानुषी ।
विष्णोर्देहानुरूपां वै करोत्येषात्मनस्तनुम् ॥
verses.rom:
devatve devadeheya manushyatve cha manushi |
vishnordehanurupam vai karotyeshatmanastanum ||

verses.sa:
यश्चैतच्छणुयाज्जन्म लक्ष्म्या यश्व पठेन्नरः ।
श्वियो न विच्युतिस्तस्य गृहे यावत् कुलत्रयम् ॥
verses.rom:
yashchaitachchhanuyajjanma lakshmya yashva pathennarah |
shviyo na vichyutistasya grihe yavat kulatrayam ||

verses.sa:
पठ्यते येषु चैवैष गृहेषु श्रीस्तवो मुने ।
अलक्ष्मीः कलहाधारा न तेष्वास्ते कदाचन ॥
verses.rom:
pathyate yeshu chaivaisha griheshu shristavo mune |
alakshmih kalahadhara na teshvaste kadachana ||

verses.sa:
एतत् ते कथितं ब्रह्मने यन्मां त्वं परिपृच्छसि ।
क्षीराब्धौ श्रीर्यथा जाता पूर्व्व भृगुसुता सती ॥
verses.rom:
etat te kathitam brahmane yanmam tvam pariprichchhasi |
kshirabdhau shriryatha jata purvva bhrigusuta sati ||

verses.sa:
इति सकलविभूत्यवाप्तिहेतुः
स्तुतिरियमिन्द्रमुखोदूगता हि लक्ष्म्याः ।
अनुदनमिह पठ्यते नृबिर्यै र्वसति नेषु कदाचिदप्यलक्ष्मीः ॥
verses.rom:
iti sakalavibhutyavaptihetuh
stutiriyamindramukhodugata hi lakshmyah |
anudanamiha pathyate nribiryai rvasati neshu kadachidapyalakshmih ||

prose.en:
Parāçara said:—"O Maitreya, listen to what I say anent thy question about Sri, as I had heard from Marichi. That Emanation of Sankara—Durvasa—was ranging this Earth. And it came to pass that the sage saw in the hand of a Vidyadhari a celestial garland,—perfumed by which, O Brahmana, that entire forest of Santanakas had become surpassingly charming to the rangers of woods. And it came to pass that on seeing that graceful garland, that mad Vipra practising the vows, asked for the same of that bride of a Vidyadhara. And solicited by him, that slender-framed and large-eyed spouse of a Vidyadhara, saluting him with regard made it over unto him. And thereat, laying the wreath on his head, that Vipra wearing the form of a maniac proceeded to roam about the earth. And then he saw that deity—Sachi's lord—sovereign of the three regions—mounted on the mad Airavata,—approaching along with the celestials. And the ascetic, resembling a mad man, taking from his head that garland, whose odour was maddening six-footed (black-bees), threw it on the sovereign of the celestials. And thereon the king of the immortals, taking the wreath, placed it over the head of Airavata; and thus placed, the same appeared like the Jahnavi on the peak of Kailasa. And it came to pass that the elephant with his eyes blinded by the temporal exudation,—on being assailed by the odour, smelt the perfume with his trunk (raised),—and then cast the same away to the earth. Then was wroth the reverend Durvasa, best of anchorets; and, O Maitreya, being enraged, he spoke unto the sovereign of the celestials, saying,—‘O thou intoxicated with wealth! O wicked of soul! O Vāsava! how art thou puffed up! But inasmuch as thou dost not regard this wreath, which is the abode of Auspiciousness,—and as, bowing down the head, thou hast not, said,—Thy favour!—nor, with thy cheeks beaming with delight, hast thou placed it on thy head,—as, in (brief), thou dost not pay high homage to this garland given by me,—O fool, thy celestial prosperity shall depart from thee. Surely, O Sakra, me thou deemest like other twice-born ones; and therefore, thou thinking immensely of thyself, hast thus slighted me. And as thou hast cast away the wreath given by me to the earth, therefore thy Triune world shall be reft of Auspiciousness. Me whom when wroth the mobile and the immobile fear,—thou, O monarch of the immortals, hast insulted from thy excess of arrogance".

Parāçara said;—"Thereat the great Indra, swiftly alighting from the back of his elephant, propitiated the sinless Durvasa. And propitiated by him with his head humbled, that best of ascetics—Durvasa—answered the thousand-eyed (Deity),—saying,—‘I am not kind of heart; nor doth forgiveness find, a place in me. They, O Sakra, are other ascetics; but know me as Durvasa. Gautama and others have for nothing fostered thy pride. But me thou must know as Durvasa, who is nothing if not unforgiving. And having been hymned aloud by Vasistha and others,—overflowing with clemency, thou hast grown haughty,—and it is for this reason that thou insultest even me in this way. Who is there in all these three regions that beholding the frowning face of mine furnished with flaming matted locks,—can keep off fear; forgive I will not. What then is the use, O thou of an hundred sacrifices, of thy expending much speech. Thou again and again puttest thyself to useless trouble in thus beseeching me".

Parāçara said:—Having said this, the Vipra went away. And, O Brahmana, the monarch of the immortals also, mounting Airavata, went to Amaravati. O Maitreya, from that time the three worlds with Sakra became shorn of Auspiciousness, and the glory thereof faded; and sacrifices and medicinal herbs grew feebler. And no sacrifices are performed, and none practiseth asceticism; and none taketh any delight in good works, such as charity. And all men, void of power, came under the masterdom of the senses; and O prime of the regenerate ones, they could not restrain their hearts even in things intrinsically small. Where strength is, there is Prosperity, and strength ever followeth Prosperity. Where is the strength of the inauspicious? And without strength, where are virtues? And without virtues, persons cannot have power, affluence, etc. And those divorced by power and wealth, are; overriden by all. And, when, overruled a person albeit possessed of time, loseth his sense. On the three worlds, shorn of Auspiciousness, being bereft of strength Daityas and Dānavas began to use force against the celestials. And the Daityas, shorn of Auspiciousness and devoid of strength, being overmastered by covetousness, entered upon hostilities with the celestials, having neither Auspiciousness nor strength. And the celestials, Indra and the rest, on being vanquished by the Daityas,—with the god of Fire at their head,—sought the protection of the exceedingly exalted Great-father. And, having been addressed duly by the deities, Brahmā, then spoke unto the celestials. And Brahmā said,—‘Do ye seek the protection of the Supreme of supreme deities, that Lord, the Destroyer of Asuras, the cause of all,—as well as of creation, protection and destruction, the Lord of the lord of creatures—Vishnu; Infinite; the unvanquished; the cause of the unborn Pradhana and Purusha ripe for creation; Him that taketh off the misery of the humble; even Vishnu. He will provide for your welfare.' Having spoken thus unto the assembled celestials, Brahmā—Great father of all—went along with them to the Northern shore of the Milky Ocean. And repairing thither surrounded by all the celestials, the Great-father, with excellent speech eulogized the prime of prime and the master—Hari. And Brahmā said,—"We bow unto thee, who art All and the Lord of all,—who art infinite, unborn and unspent: who art the stay of the worlds, and the prop of the Earth; who art unmanifested and without difference; Nārāyana,—who art the subtlest of all subtile objects: and who art the weightiest of all things weighty on earth; He in whom and from whom are all things that have sprung into existence, commencing with Sat: who surpassest the Prime person; and art the Embodiment of the Supreme Spirit; who are contemplated in order to emancipation by Yogis desirous of deliverence; in whom are not Goodness and the rest,—nor the attributes inhereing in Prakriti. May that one pure beyond all things pure—that primaeval Male be propitious (to us)! May that pure Hari, whose power is not tethered to kalā, kāshthā, nimesha, etc., prove propitious (to us)! May He that is styled the Supreme Lord, who is free from all things,—that Vishnu who is the Soul of embodied things,—be propitious (to us)! May that Hari, who is cause as well as effect, who is the cause even of the cause,—who again is, the effect of the effect,—prove propitious to me! We bow down unto Him who is the effect of the effect of the effect,—and who also is Himself the effect of that effect,—and who is the effect of the effect thereof. We bow unto thee who art the foremost of the celestials,—who art the cause of even the cause,—and the cause of the cause of that cause,—and the origin of all these causes combined. We bow down unto that Supreme State which is the creator as well as the created,—and which is at once cause and consequence. We bow unto that Prime State of Vishnu which is pure cognition, which is constant, causeless, undeteriorating and unspent; and which is the unmanifested and unmodified. We bow down unto that Prime and ever pure state of Vishnu, which is not gross and yet not subtile; which cannot be differentiated. We bow unto that undeteriorating one who is the Supreme Brahmā,—and in one of whose Ayuta of Ayuta portions is this cosmic energy established. We bow unto that Prime State of Vishnu—that Supreme Deity—which is not known either to the deities, or the ascetics, or me, or Sankara himself. We bow unto that Suprenje incomprehensible and indestructible State of Vishnu, which, on the exhaustion of their merits and demerits, the Yogis, ever perservering, view, grounded in the Pranava. We bow to the Prime State of that God Vishnu, who is without equal, and whose energy is Brahmā, Vishnu and Siva. O Lord of all! O soul of all beings! O thou that art all! O refuge of all! O thou that never fallest off! O Vishnu, be thou propitious! Come thou within the ken of us who are thy devotees". Hearing this invocation of Brahmā, and then the deities, bowing down, said,—"Be propitious! Come thou within the range of our vision? O thou that art in every thing! O thou that never fallest off! O support of the Universe! we bow unto that Prime State which even the reverend Brahmā doth not know". When the deities as well as Brahmā had ended thus, the Devarshis, headed by Vrihaspati, said,—"We bow down unto him—the creator of the cosmos devoid of difference—who is primæval, who is the Sacrificial Person, who is worthy of being extolled, and who is prior in birth to everything. O Worshipful one! O thou that art the Lord of Past and Future! O thou who hast the Universe for thy form! O undeteriorating one! Be propitious; and manifest thyself unto us who humble ourselves. This is Brahmā; and this is Trilochona in Company with the Rudras. And this is the Sun along with the Adityas and this is the God of Fire with Agni. And these are the two Açwinas and the Vasus; and these are the Maruts. And these are the Sidhyas, and these the Viçwas; and these the deities,—and this the Lord Indra of the celestials. O Lord, all the hosts of the celestials, having been routed by the forces of the Daityas, seek shelter at thy hands, standing in humble guise".

Parāçara said:—O Maitreya, thus hymned (by the deities), that reverend one—the holder of the conch and discus—that Supreme Lord—rendered himself visible unto them. And seeing then that holder of the conch, discus, and mace, that abode of wonderful grace,—a very mass of energy,—the deities, with the Great-father at their head, bowing down in humble guise, with their eyes quivering with agitation, began to hymn Pundarikāksha. And the celestials said,—"Salutation! Salutation unto thee! O thou that art without difference! Thou art Brahmā, and thou art the holder of Pināka. Thou art Indra, and Agni and Pavana, and Varuna, and the Sun, and Yama. And the Vasus, and the Maruts, and the Sādhyas, and the Viçwa gods thou. And, O god, those deities that have come unto thee are even thyself, who art the creator of the Universe,—since thou art in everything. Thou art sacrifice, and thou Vashatkāra, and thou Prajāpati. And, O soul of all, thou art knowable and unknowable; and this entire universe is permeated with thee. O Vishnu, worsted by the Daityas, we seek refuge of thee. O Soul of all, be propitious unto us; and do thou favour us by vouchsafing us thy energy. So long affliction lasts, so long the desire of defeating the foe agitates the heart, as long doth stupor last and so long is misery experienced,—as one doth not throw one's self on thy protection, O thou that destroyest all sins. Therefore, O thou of complacent soul, do thou extend thy grace unto us. O master of all energy, do thou favour us with thy own power".

Parāçara said:—"Thus eulogised by the immortals, that creator of the cosmos—the worshipful Hari—casting a complacent glance, spoke (as follows). And the auspicious reverend One said,—‘Ye gods, I shall increase your power. Let the deities do as I say. Bring in company with the Daityas all the medicinal plants to the shore of the Ocean of milk, and making Mandāra the churning-stick and Vāsuki the cord, let the deities churn (the Ocean) for ambrosia, I assisting them. And concluding peace with the progeny of the Daitya's, ye should enlist their services in this task; and tell them,—Ye shall in common with us reap the fruit of this undertaking. And on the sea being churned, ye should by drinking the nectar that will come up, attain access of strength and be immortal to boot. And, ye gods, I shall so order that the enemies of the celestials shall not get ambrosia,—but shall only undergo all the trouble".

Parāçara said:—Thus addressed by the god of gods, all the celestials, concluding peace with the Asuras, set about churning for ambrosia. And procuring various medicinal herbs, the deities, the offspring of the Daityas, and the Dānavas,—throwing the same into the waters of the ocean of milk, resembling autumnal clouds,—and O Maitreya, making Mandāra the churning-stick and Vāsuki the twine,—at once addressed themselves to churning for ambrosia. And instructed by Krishna, the gods in a body held that (part of Vāsuki's body) where the tail was, and the Daityas held by the fore-part of his body. And, O thou of measureless Splendour, the Asuras, smitten with the fire sprung from the breath of Vāsuki's hood, became enfeebled. And clouds scattered by the breath issuing from Vāsuki's mouth, showering down at his tail, the deities were enlivened. And, O mighty ascetic, remaining in the midst of the Milky sea in the shape of a tortoise, the revered Hari himself became the support of the churning-stick. And the holder of the discus and mace, remaining in one form in the midst of the immortals, and in another, in the midst of the Daityas,—began to pull the king of serpents. And, O Maitreya, in another gigantic form, Keçava pulled the mountain upwards,—which form was seen neither of the celestials nor the Asuras. And Hari obliged with energy the king of serpents; and the Lord invigorated the immortals with another energy. And on the milky-sea being churned by the celestials and the Asuras, first came into existence Surabhi, worshipped of the celestials,—home of clarified butter. And thereat both the deities and the Dānavas experienced very great delight, O great ascetic; and with their minds attracted, they steadily gazed at her. And as the Siddhas were questioning within themselves,—"What is this?"—out came the exalted Vāruni, with her eyes rolling in consequence of intoxication. And then perfuming the universe with odor, from forth a whirlpool of the Milky-sea arose Pārijāta—the tree in which the celestial females delight. And then, O Maitreya, from the Milky-occan arose numbers of Apsarās, wonderful exceedingly, and furnished with grace and nobility. And then sprang the Mild-rayed one; and Maheçwara appropriated him. And the serpents appropriated the poison that sprang from the Milky-sea. And then arose the divine Dhanwantari; clad in white raiment, bearing a Kamandalu filled with nectar. And thereat, O Maitreya, all the Daityas' sons and the Dānavas, along with the ascetics, felt delighted. And then from the water arose the exalted Sri, endowed with excellent grace,—seated on a blown lotus, and carrying also a lotus in her hand. And filled with delight, her hymned the mighty saints with the Srī Sukta; and the Gandharvas, headed by Viçwāvasu, began to chant before her. And, O Brāhmana, bevies of Apsarās—Ghritāchi and others—began to dance, and the rivers—Gangā and the rest—came with water, for bathing her. And an elephant of one of the cardinal points, taking water out of the golden vessels, bathed that goddess—the mighty Mistress of all the worlds. And the Milky-sea, assuming a form, presented her with a wreath of unfading lotuses; and Viswakarmā decked her person with ornaments. And wearing divine garlands and attire, bathed and adorned with ornament, she in the sight of all the celestials sought the bosom of Hari, And on being gazed at by the goddess Lakshmi remaining in Hari's bosom, the celestials, O Maitreya, suddenly attained excess of delight. And, O exceedingly pious one, on being overlooked by Lakshmi, the Daityas, ever disregarding Vishnu—headed by Viprachitti—were wrought up with extreme anxiety. And then, O twice-born one, the Daityas, endowed with great prowess, possessed themselves of the Kamandalu that was in the hand of Dhanwantari, and which contained the ambrosia. And then Vishnu, assuming a female form, and thereby exciting their desire, secured the same, and then the Lord made it over unto the celestials. And then the immortals,—Sakra and the rest—quaffed off the ambrosia; and thereat the Daityas rushed against them with upraised weapons and Nistrinsas. And having drunk ambrosia, the invigorated gods beat the Daitya-hosts, and these flew in all directions and entered the nether regions. Then the deities, bowing down unto the bearer of the conch, discus and mace, as formerly, began to govern the celestial regions. And then the glad-rayed Sun began to course in his own path; and, O best of ascetics, the luminaries also gyrated in their own orbits. And then the reverend Fire, crowned with a fair splendour, began to burn brightly. And, all creatures felt a regard for righteousness. And, O foremost of anchorets, the triune world was furnished with grace; and that chief of the celestials—Sakra—again waxed graceful. And Sakra, seated on his throne, receiving back the celestial regions, and established in his celestial sovereignty, began to hymn the Goddess holding a lotus in her hand. And Indra said,—"I salute the Lotus-sprung mother of all beings—unto Sri having lotus-like eyes, and reposing in the bosom of Vishnu. Thou art Siddhi, and thou art nectar, and thou Swāhā and Swadhā, O purifier of the worlds. And thou art twilight and light and lustre, and affluence, and intelligence, and veneration, and Saraswati. Thou art the learning of sacrifice; thou art the worship of the Universe-form (of the Most High); thou art the Occult Learning, O beauteous one; and thou art the knowledge of Brahmā, O goddess,—and thou art the bestower of the fruit of emancipation. And thou art the Science of Dialectics; and thou art the Three (Vedas); and thou art the Vārttā; and thou art the knowledge of chastisement, etc. O goddess, this universe is filled with thy gentle and terrific forms. And, O goddess, who, save thee, can dwell in the person of that god of gods, the bearer of the mace, who is contemplated by the yogis. O goddess, the triple world, having been renounced by thee, had come to the verge of destruction; and, through thee hath it again recovered its position. And, O exalted one, men come by wives and sons, and houses, and friends, and corn, and wealth through thy kind look. And, O goddess, freedom from bodily ailments, riches, destruction of foes, and felicity, are not difficult of attainment for those people that view thy glances. Thou art the mother of all creatures, as that god of gods—Hari—is their father. And this universe consisting of mobile and immobile, was primævally permeated by thee as well as Vishnu. And, O thou that purifiest everything, if thou forsakest (us), neither our treasures, nor our cattle, nor our houses, nor our attires, nor our bodies, nor our wives, are secure unto us. O thou that residest in the bosom of that god, Vishnu, if thou forsakest me, neither sons, nor friends, nor ornaments are secure unto me. O stainless one, he that is forsaken by thee, is also forsaken by goodness, truth, purity character, and other virtues. And, those that are glanced at by thee,—albeit devoid of any good quality, ever attain note, on account of character and other virtues, as well as lineage, and wealth. And, O goddess, he that is looked at by thee, is praiseworthy and accomplished and blessed and intelligent and high-born and heroic and possessed of prowess. And, O nurse of the Universe, O beloved of Vishnu, all virtues, character, etc., are instantly prevented in him from whom thou turnest away thy countenance. But the tongue even of the Deity is incapable of celebrating thy perfections. O lotus-eyed one, prove auspicious! Me mayest thou never renounce."

Parāçara said,—"Thus eulogised to the height, the goddess Sri resident in all beings spoke unto Satakratu in the hearing of all the gods. And Sri said,—'O chief of the celestials, O Hari, pleased am I with thy hymn. Do thou mention the boon thou desirest. I have come hither to confer the same on thee.' Thereat Indra said,—‘O goddess, if thou wouldst confer a boon on me, if I am worthy of one, let this be the great boon, that this triple world thou wouldst not forsake. And let this be the second boon that him also thou woudst not forsake, who, O ocean-sprung One, shall propitiate thee with this hymn.' Thereat Sri said,—‘O foremost of the celestials, O Vāsava, this triple world will I not leave. I confer upon thee this boon, being pleased with thy hymn and prayer. And I shall never be displeased with him whoever shall chant this hymn.'"

Parāçara said,—"O Maitreya, formerly the great goddess, Sri being pleased with the hymn and prayer, conferred this boon on the lord of the celestials. In the days of yore, Sri was begot of Bhrigu on Khyati. And she again came out of the Ocean when it was churned by the celestials. As the great god Janārddana, the lord of the Universe, goes through incarnations, so does Sri to help Him. When Hari assumed the form of a dwarf, she took birth as a lotus, and when He descended on earth as Parasurāma, she appeared as the Earth. At time of the incarnation of Rāma, she became Sitā, and when He was born as Krishna, she became Rukhmini. And thus in all the incarnations, she assisted Vishnu. When he had a celestial shape, she assumed the shape of a celestial, and when he assumed a human form, she took a human shape. She changed her body (human or celestial) according as Vishnu did. Sri does not renounce the abode of him for three generations, who reads or hears of this story of her birth. O sage, never can quarrelsome Alakshmi, dwell in that house where this hymn of Sri is chanted. O Brāhmana, I have related unto thee everything of what thou didst ask me for—how Sri formerly was born as the daughter of Bhrigu and how she afterwards came out of the Ocean of milk. This eulogy of Lakshmi, the source of all wealth, came out of the mouth of the lord of celestials. Poverty can never infest those persons on earth, who chant this hymn every day".

verses.sa:
मैत्रेय उवाच ।
कथितं मे त्वया सर्व्व यत्पृष्टोऽसि महामुने ।
भृगुसर्गात् प्रभृत्येष सर्गो मे क्थ्यतां पुनः ॥
verses.rom:
maitreya uvacha |
kathitam me tvaya sarvva yatprishto'si mahamune |
bhrigusargat prabhrityesha sargo me kthyatam punah ||

verses.sa:
पराशर उवाच ।
भृगोः ख्यात्यां समुत्पन्ना लक्ष्मीर्विष्णुपरिग्रहः ।
तथा धातृविधातरौ ख्यात्यां जातौ सुतौ भृगोः ॥
verses.rom:
parashara uvacha |
bhrigoh khyatyam samutpanna lakshmirvishnuparigrahah |
tatha dhatrividhatarau khyatyam jatau sutau bhrigoh ||

verses.sa:
आयतिर्नियतिश्चैव मैरोः कन्ये महात्मनः ।
धातृविधात्रोस्ते भार्य्ये तयोर्जातौ सुतावुभौ ॥
verses.rom:
ayatirniyatishchaiva mairoh kanye mahatmanah |
dhatrividhatroste bharyye tayorjatau sutavubhau ||

verses.sa:
प्राणश्चैव मृकण्डुश्च मार्कण्डेयो मृकण्जुतः ।
ततो वेदशीरा जज्ञे प्राणस्यापि सुतं श्वृणु ॥
verses.rom:
pranashchaiva mrikandushcha markandeyo mrikanjutah |
tato vedashira jajne pranasyapi sutam shvrinu ||

verses.sa:
प्राणस्य कृतिमान् पुत्रो राजवांश्व ततोऽभवत् ।
ततो वंशो महाभाग विस्तारं भार्गवो गतः ॥
verses.rom:
pranasya kritiman putro rajavamshva tato'bhavat |
tato vamsho mahabhaga vistaram bhargavo gatah ||

verses.sa:
पत्नी मरीचेः सम्भूतिः पौर्णामासमसूयत ।
विरजाः सर्व्वगश्चैव तस्य पुत्रौ महात्मनः ॥
verses.rom:
patni maricheh sambhutih paurnamasamasuyata |
virajah sarvvagashchaiva tasya putrau mahatmanah ||

verses.sa:
वंशसंकीर्त्तने पुत्रान् वदिष्येऽहं तयोद्रिज ।
स्मृतिश्वाङ्गिरसः पत्री प्रसूताः कन्यकास्तथा ॥
verses.rom:
vamshasamkirttane putran vadishye'ham tayodrija |
smritishvangirasah patri prasutah kanyakastatha ||

verses.sa:
सिनीवाली कुहूशचैव राका चानुमतिस्तथा ।
अनुसूया तथैवात्रेर्जज्ञ पुत्रानकल्मषान् ॥
verses.rom:
sinivali kuhushachaiva raka chanumatistatha |
anusuya tathaivatrerjajna putranakalmashan ||

verses.sa: प्रीत्यां पुलस्त्यभार्य्ययां दत्तोलिस्तत्सुतोऽभवत् ॥
verses.rom: prityam pulastyabharyyayam dattolistatsuto'bhavat ||

verses.sa:
पूर्व्वजन्मनि योऽगस्त्यः स्मृतः स्वायम्भुवेऽन्तरे ।
कर्दमश्वावरीयांश्व सहिष्णुश्व सूतत्रयम् ॥
verses.rom:
purvvajanmani yo'gastyah smritah svayambhuve'ntare |
kardamashvavariyamshva sahishnushva sutatrayam ||

verses.sa:
क्षमा तु सुषुवे भार्य्या पुलहस्य प्रजापतेः ।
क्रतोश्व सन्नतिर्भार्य्या बालखिल्यानसूयत ॥
verses.rom:
kshama tu sushuve bharyya pulahasya prajapateh |
kratoshva sannatirbharyya balakhilyanasuyata ||

verses.sa:
षष्टिर्यानि सहस्त्राणि यतीनामूद्ध्व रेतसाम् ।
अङ्गुष्ठपर्व्वमात्राणां जलदूभास्करतेजसाम् ॥
verses.rom:
shashtiryani sahastrani yatinamuddhva retasam |
angushthaparvvamatranam jaladubhaskaratejasam ||

verses.sa:
ऊर्ज्जायाञ्च विशिष्ठस्य सप्ताजायन्त वै सुताः ।
रजोगात्रोर्ध्वबाहुश्व वसनश्वानघस्तथा ॥
verses.rom:
urjjayancha vishishthasya saptajayanta vai sutah |
rajogatrordhvabahushva vasanashvanaghastatha ||

verses.sa:
सुतपाः शुक्र इत्येते सर्व्वे सप्तर्षयोऽमलाः ।
योऽसावग्निरभिमानी ब्रह्मणस्तनयोऽग्रजः ॥
verses.rom:
sutapah shukra ityete sarvve saptarshayo'malah |
yo'savagnirabhimani brahmanastanayo'grajah ||

verses.sa:
तस्मात् स्वाहा सुतांल्लेभे त्रीणुदारौजसो द्रिज ।
पावकं पावमानञ्च शुचिञ्चापि जलाशिनम् ॥
verses.rom:
tasmat svaha sutamllebhe trinudaraujaso drija |
pavakam pavamanancha shuchinchapi jalashinam ||

verses.sa:
तेषान्तु सन्ततावन्ये चत्वारिंशज्व पञ्च च ।
एवमेकोनपञ्चाशद् वह्नयः परिकीर्तिताः ॥
verses.rom:
teshantu santatavanye chatvarimshajva pancha cha |
evamekonapanchashad vahnayah parikirtitah ||

verses.sa:
कथ्यन्ते वह्नयश्चैते पिता पुत्रत्रयञ्च यत् ।
पितरो ब्रह्मणा सृष्टा व्याख्याता ये मया तव ॥
verses.rom:
kathyante vahnayashchaite pita putratrayancha yat |
pitaro brahmana srishta vyakhyata ye maya tava ||

verses.sa:
अग्रिष्वात्ता बहिर्षदोऽनग्रयः साग्नयश्व ये ।
तेभेयः स्वधा सुते जज्ञ मैनां वैधारिणीं तथा ॥
verses.rom:
agrishvatta bahirshado'nagrayah sagnayashva ye |
tebheyah svadha sute jajna mainam vaidharinim tatha ||

verses.sa:
ते उबे ब्रह्मवादिन्यौ योगिन्यौ चाप्युभे द्रिज ।
उत्तमज्ञानसम्पन्ने सर्व्वैः समुदितैर्गुणौः ॥
verses.rom:
te ube brahmavadinyau yoginyau chapyubhe drija |
uttamajnanasampanne sarvvaih samuditairgunauh ||

verses.sa:
इत्येषा दक्षकन्यानां कथितापत्यसन्ततिः ।
श्वद्धावान् संस्मरन्नेताम् अनपत्यो न जायते ॥
verses.rom:
ityesha dakshakanyanam kathitapatyasantatih |
shvaddhavan samsmarannetam anapatyo na jayate ||

prose.en:
Maitreya said,—"O great sage, thou hast related unto me all I had asked thee for. Do thou now give me again an account of the family of Bhrigu from Bhrigu downwards".

Parāçara said,—"Lakshmi was born of Bhrigu and Kyāti and became the spouse of Vishnu. And two more sons were born of Bhrigu and Kyāti namely Dhātā and Bidhātā. Two daughters, by name Ayati and Niyati were born of the high-souled Meru. And Dhāta and Bidhātā took them as their wives. They gave birth to two sons named Prāna and Mirkandu. Of Mirkandu again was born a son named Mārkandeya. And hear then again, a son was born of Prāna by name Vedaçirā. Of the other sons of Prāna one was named Kritimān and the other Rājavān. And in this way did spread the family of the great Bhrigu. Māricha's spouse Satmbhuti gave birth to a son named Paurnamasam. And of him were born two sons named Birajā and Sarvaga. And their sons I shall mention, O twice-born one, when I shall relate the lineage at leisure. And Angirā's wife Smriti gave birth to four daughters, named Sinibali, Kuhoo, Rākā and Anumati. And by Atri, Anasuyā gave birth to three sons untouched by sin named Soma, Durbāsā and the sage Dattatreyo. And Pulastya's wife Preeti gave birth to a child named Dattoli, who in his former birth or in the Sayambhava Manwantara was known as the sage Agāstya. Kshamā, the wife of the Patriarch Pulaha was the mother of three sons; Kardama, Avarian and Sahishnu. The wife of Krātu, Sannati, brought forth the sixty thousand Bālakhilyas, pigmy sages, no bigger than a joint of the thumb, chaste, pious, resplendent as the rays of the Sun. Vasishtha had seven sons by his wife Urjja, Rajas, Gātra, Urdhabhahu, Basana, Anagha, Sutapas and Sukra, the seven pure sages. The Agni, named Abhimani, who is the eldest born of Brahmā, had, by Swahā, three sons of surpassing brilliancy:—Pavaka, Pavamana and Suchi who drinks up water. They had forty-five sons who (with the son of Brahmā, the Agni named Abhimani and his three descendants) constitute the forty-nine Fires. I have mentioned the progenitors (Pritras) who were created by Brahmā. Of those by Agnishwattas and Varhishads the former being devoid and the latter, possessed of Fires, Swadha had two daughters Mena and Baidhārini. They were both, O twice-born one, acquainted with theological truth and given up to religious meditation, accomplished in perfect wisdom and adorned with all estimable qualities, Thus I have narrated the progeny of the daughters of Daksha. He who hears it with reverence, shall never want offspring".

verses.sa:
श्रीपराशर उवाच
प्रियव्रतोत्तानपादौ मनोः स्वायंभुवस्य तु ।
द्वौ पुत्रौ तु महावीर्यौ धर्मज्ञौ कथितौ तव ॥
verses.rom:
shriparashara uvacha
priyavratottanapadau manoh svayambhuvasya tu |
dvau putrau tu mahaviryau dharmajnau kathitau tava ||

verses.sa:
तयोरुत्तानपादस्य सुरुच्यामुत्तमः सुतः ।
अभीष्टायामभूद्ब्रह्यन्पितुरत्यन्तवल्लभः ॥
verses.rom:
tayoruttanapadasya suruchyamuttamah sutah |
abhishtayamabhudbrahyanpituratyantavallabhah ||

verses.sa:
सुनीतिर्नाम या राज्ञस्तस्यासीन्महिषी द्विज ।
स नाति प्रीतिमांस्तस्यामभूद्यस्या ध्रुवः सुतः ॥
verses.rom:
sunitirnama ya rajnastasyasinmahishi dvija |
sa nati pritimamstasyamabhudyasya dhruvah sutah ||

verses.sa:
राजासनस्थितस्याङ्कं पितुर्भ्रतरमाश्रितम् ।
दृष्ट्वोत्तमं ध्रुव श्चक्रे तमारोढुं मनोरथम् ॥
verses.rom:
rajasanasthitasyankam piturbhrataramashritam |
drishtvottamam dhruva shchakre tamarodhum manoratham ||

verses.sa:
प्रत्यक्षं भूपतिस्तस्याः सुरुच्या नाभ्यनन्दत ।
प्रणयेनागतं पुत्रमुत्संगारोहणोत्सुकम् ॥
verses.rom:
pratyaksham bhupatistasyah suruchya nabhyanandata |
pranayenagatam putramutsamgarohanotsukam ||

verses.sa:
सपत्नी तनयं दृष्ट्वा तमङ्कारोहणोत्सुकम् ।
स्वपुत्रं च तथारूढं सुरुचिर्वाक्यमब्रवीत् ॥
verses.rom:
sapatni tanayam drishtva tamankarohanotsukam |
svaputram cha tatharudham suruchirvakyamabravit ||

verses.sa:
क्रियते किं वृथा वत्स महानेष मनोरथः ।
अन्यस्त्रीगर्भजातेन ह्यसंभूय ममोदरे ॥
verses.rom:
kriyate kim vritha vatsa mahanesha manorathah |
anyastrigarbhajatena hyasambhuya mamodare ||

verses.sa:
उत्तमोत्तममप्राप्यमविवेको हि वाञ्छसि ।
सत्यं सुतस्त्वमप्यस्य किं तु न त्वं मया धृतः ॥
verses.rom:
uttamottamamaprapyamaviveko hi vanchhasi |
satyam sutastvamapyasya kim tu na tvam maya dhritah ||

verses.sa:
एतद्राजासनं सर्व भूभृत्संश्रयकेतनम् ।
योग्यं ममैव पुत्रस्य किमात्मा क्लिश्यतेत्वया ॥
verses.rom:
etadrajasanam sarva bhubhritsamshrayaketanam |
yogyam mamaiva putrasya kimatma klishyatetvaya ||

verses.sa:
उच्चैर्मनोरथस्तेयं मत्पुत्रस्येव किं वृथा ।
सुनीत्यामात्मनो जन्म किं त्वया नावगम्यते ॥
verses.rom:
uchchairmanorathasteyam matputrasyeva kim vritha |
sunityamatmano janma kim tvaya navagamyate ||

verses.sa:
श्रीपराशर वाच
उत्सृज्य पितरं बालस्तच्छ्रुत्वा मातृभाषितम् ।
जगाम कुपितो मातुर्निजाया द्विजमन्दिरम् ॥
verses.rom:
shriparashara vacha
utsrijya pitaram balastachchhrutva matribhashitam |
jagama kupito maturnijaya dvijamandiram ||

verses.sa:
तं दृष्ट्वा कुपितं पुत्रमीषत्प्रस्फुरिताधरम् ।
सुनीतिरङ्कमारोप्य मैत्रेयेदमभाषत ॥
verses.rom:
tam drishtva kupitam putramishatprasphuritadharam |
sunitirankamaropya maitreyedamabhashata ||

verses.sa:
वत्स कः कोपहेतुस्ते कश्च त्वां नाभि नन्दति ।
कोवजानाति पितरं वत्स यस्तेपराध्यति ॥
verses.rom:
vatsa kah kopahetuste kashcha tvam nabhi nandati |
kovajanati pitaram vatsa yasteparadhyati ||

verses.sa:
श्रीपराशर वाच
इत्युक्तः सकलं मात्रे कथयामास तद्यथा ।
सुरुचिः प्राह भूपालप्रत्यक्षमतगर्विता ॥
verses.rom:
shriparashara vacha
ityuktah sakalam matre kathayamasa tadyatha |
suruchih praha bhupalapratyakshamatagarvita ||

verses.sa:
विनिश्वस्येति कथिते तस्मिन्पुत्रेण दुर्मनाः ।
श्वसक्षामेक्षणा दीना सुनीतिर्वाक्यमब्रवीत् ॥
verses.rom:
vinishvasyeti kathite tasminputrena durmanah |
shvasakshamekshana dina sunitirvakyamabravit ||

verses.sa:
सुनीतिरुवाच
सुरुचिः सत्यमाहेदं मन्दभाग्योसिःपुत्रक ।
न हि पुण्यवतां वत्स सपत्नैरेव मुच्यते ॥
verses.rom:
sunitiruvacha
suruchih satyamahedam mandabhagyosihputraka |
na hi punyavatam vatsa sapatnaireva muchyate ||

verses.sa:
नोद्वेगस्तात कर्तव्यः कृतं यद्भवता पुरा ।
तत्कोपहर्तु शक्नोति दातुं कश्चाकृतं त्वया ॥
verses.rom:
nodvegastata kartavyah kritam yadbhavata pura |
tatkopahartu shaknoti datum kashchakritam tvaya ||

verses.sa: तत्त्वया नात्र कर्तव्यं दुःखं तद्वाक्यसम्भवम् ॥
verses.rom: tattvaya natra kartavyam duhkham tadvakyasambhavam ||

verses.sa:
राजासनं राजच्छत्रं वराश्चावरवारणाः ।
यस्य पुण्यानि तस्यैते मत्वैतच्छांम्य पुत्रक ॥
verses.rom:
rajasanam rajachchhatram varashchavaravaranah |
yasya punyani tasyaite matvaitachchhammya putraka ||

verses.sa:
अन्यजन्मकृतैः पुण्यैः सुरुच्या सुरुचिर्नृपः ।
भार्येति प्रोच्यते चान्यां मद्विधा पुण्यवर्जिता ॥
verses.rom:
anyajanmakritaih punyaih suruchya suruchirnripah |
bharyeti prochyate chanyam madvidha punyavarjita ||

verses.sa:
पुण्योपचयसंपन्नस्तस्याः पुत्रस्तथोत्तमः ।
मम पुत्रस्तथा जातः स्वल्पपुण्यो ध्रुवो भवान् ॥
verses.rom:
punyopachayasampannastasyah putrastathottamah |
mama putrastatha jatah svalpapunyo dhruvo bhavan ||

verses.sa:
तथापि दुःखं न भवान् कर्तुमर्हसि पुत्रक ।
यस्य यावत्स तेनैव स्वेन तुष्यति मानवः ॥
verses.rom:
tathapi duhkham na bhavan kartumarhasi putraka |
yasya yavatsa tenaiva svena tushyati manavah ||

verses.sa:
यदि ते दुःखमत्यर्थं सुरुच्या वचसाभवत् ।
तत्पुण्योपचये यत्नं कुरु सर्वफलप्रदे ॥
verses.rom:
yadi te duhkhamatyartham suruchya vachasabhavat |
tatpunyopachaye yatnam kuru sarvaphalaprade ||

verses.sa:
सुशीलो भव धर्मात्मा मैत्रः प्राणिहिते रतः ।
निम्नं यथापः प्रवणाः पात्रमायान्ति सम्पदः ॥
verses.rom:
sushilo bhava dharmatma maitrah pranihite ratah |
nimnam yathapah pravanah patramayanti sampadah ||

verses.sa:
ध्रुव उवाच
अम्ब यत्त्वमिदं प्रात्थ प्रशमाय वचो मम ।
नैतद्दुर्वाचसा भिन्ने हृदये मम तिष्ठति ॥
verses.rom:
dhruva uvacha
amba yattvamidam prattha prashamaya vacho mama |
naitaddurvachasa bhinne hridaye mama tishthati ||

verses.sa:
सोऽहं तथा यतिष्यामि यथा सर्वोत्तमोत्तमम् ।
स्थानं प्राप्स्याम्यशोषाणां जगतामभि पूजितम् ॥
verses.rom:
so'ham tatha yatishyami yatha sarvottamottamam |
sthanam prapsyamyashoshanam jagatamabhi pujitam ||

verses.sa:
सुरुचिर्दयिता राज्ञस्तस्या जातोस्मि नोदरात् ।
प्रभावं पश्य मेंब त्वं वृद्धस्यापि तवोदरे ॥
verses.rom:
suruchirdayita rajnastasya jatosmi nodarat |
prabhavam pashya memba tvam vriddhasyapi tavodare ||

verses.sa:
उत्तमः स मम भ्राता यो गर्भेण धृतस्तया ।
स राजासनमाप्नोतु पित्रा दत्तं तथास्तु तत् ॥
verses.rom:
uttamah sa mama bhrata yo garbhena dhritastaya |
sa rajasanamapnotu pitra dattam tathastu tat ||

verses.sa:
नान्यदत्तमभीप्स्यामि स्तानमम्ब स्वकर्मणा ।
इच्छामि तदहं स्थानं यत्र प्राप पिता मम ॥
verses.rom:
nanyadattamabhipsyami stanamamba svakarmana |
ichchhami tadaham sthanam yatra prapa pita mama ||

verses.sa:
श्रीपराशर उवाच
निर्जगाम गृहान्मातुरित्युक्त्वा मातरं ध्रुवः ।
पुराच्च निर्गम्य ततस्तद्बाह्योपवनं ययो ॥
verses.rom:
shriparashara uvacha
nirjagama grihanmaturityuktva mataram dhruvah |
purachcha nirgamya tatastadbahyopavanam yayo ||

verses.sa:
स ददर्श मुनींस्तत्र सप्तपूर्वागतान्ध्रुवः ।
कुष्माजिनोत्तरीयेषु विष्टरेषु समास्थितान् ॥
verses.rom:
sa dadarsha munimstatra saptapurvagatandhruvah |
kushmajinottariyeshu vishtareshu samasthitan ||

verses.sa:
स राजपुत्रस्तान्सर्वान्प्रणिपत्याभ्य भाषत ।
प्रश्रयावनतः सम्यगभिवादनपूर्वकम् ॥
verses.rom:
sa rajaputrastansarvanpranipatyabhya bhashata |
prashrayavanatah samyagabhivadanapurvakam ||

verses.sa:
ध्रुव उवाच
उत्तानपादतनयं मां निबोधत सत्तमाः ।
जातं सुनीत्यां निर्वेदाद्युष्माकं प्राप्तमन्तिकम् ॥
verses.rom:
dhruva uvacha
uttanapadatanayam mam nibodhata sattamah |
jatam sunityam nirvedadyushmakam praptamantikam ||

verses.sa:
ऋषय ऊचुः
चतुःपञ्चा ब्दसंभूतो बालस्त्वं तृपनन्दन ।
निर्वेदकारणं किञ्चित्तव नाद्यापि वर्तते ॥
verses.rom:
rishaya uchuh
chatuhpancha bdasambhuto balastvam tripanandana |
nirvedakaranam kinchittava nadyapi vartate ||

verses.sa:
न चिन्त्यं भवतः किञ्चिद्ध्रयते भूपतिः पिता ।
न चैवैष्ट वियोगादि तव पश्याम बालक ॥
verses.rom:
na chintyam bhavatah kinchiddhrayate bhupatih pita |
na chaivaishta viyogadi tava pashyama balaka ||

verses.sa:
शरीरे न च ते व्याधिरस्माभिरुपलक्ष्यते ।
निर्वेदः किन्निमित्तस्ते कथ्यतां यदि विद्यते ॥
verses.rom:
sharire na cha te vyadhirasmabhirupalakshyate |
nirvedah kinnimittaste kathyatam yadi vidyate ||

verses.sa:
श्रीपराशर उवाच
ततः स कथयामास सुरुच्या यदुदाहृतम् ।
तन्निशम्य ततः प्रोचुर्मुनयस्ते परस्परम् ॥
verses.rom:
shriparashara uvacha
tatah sa kathayamasa suruchya yadudahritam |
tannishamya tatah prochurmunayaste parasparam ||

verses.sa:
अहो क्षात्रं परं तेजो बालस्यापि यदक्षमा ।
सपत्न्या मातुरुक्तं यद्धृदयान्नापसर्पति ॥
verses.rom:
aho kshatram param tejo balasyapi yadakshama |
sapatnya maturuktam yaddhridayannapasarpati ||

verses.sa:
भोभोः क्षत्रियदायादः निर्वेदाद्यत्त्वायाधुना ।
कर्तुं व्यवसितं तन्नः कथ्यतां यदि रोचते ॥
verses.rom:
bhobhoh kshatriyadayadah nirvedadyattvayadhuna |
kartum vyavasitam tannah kathyatam yadi rochate ||

verses.sa:
यच्च कार्यं तवास्माभिः साहाय्यममितद्युते ।
तदुच्यतां विवक्षुस्त्वमस्माभिरुपलक्ष्यसे ॥
verses.rom:
yachcha karyam tavasmabhih sahayyamamitadyute |
taduchyatam vivakshustvamasmabhirupalakshyase ||

verses.sa:
ध्रुव उवाच
नाह मर्थमभीप्सामि न राज्यं द्विजसत्तमाः ।
तत्स्थानमेकमिच्छामि भुक्तं नान्येन यत्पुरा ॥
verses.rom:
dhruva uvacha
naha marthamabhipsami na rajyam dvijasattamah |
tatsthanamekamichchhami bhuktam nanyena yatpura ||

verses.sa:
एतन्मे क्रियतां सम्यक्कथ्यतां प्राप्यते यथा ।
स्थानमग्र्यं समस्तेभ्यः स्थानेभ्यो मुनिसत्तमाः ॥
verses.rom:
etanme kriyatam samyakkathyatam prapyate yatha |
sthanamagryam samastebhyah sthanebhyo munisattamah ||

verses.sa:
मरीचिरुवाच
अनाराधितगोविन्दैर्नरैः स्थानं नृपात्मज ।
न हि संप्राप्यते श्रेष्ठं तस्मादाराधयाच्युतम् ॥
verses.rom:
marichiruvacha
anaradhitagovindairnaraih sthanam nripatmaja |
na hi samprapyate shreshtham tasmadaradhayachyutam ||

verses.sa:
अत्रिरुवाच
परः पराणां पुरुषो यस्य तुष्टो जनार्दनः ।
संप्राप्नोत्यक्षयं स्थानमेतत्सत्यं मयोदितम् ॥
verses.rom:
atriruvacha
parah paranam purusho yasya tushto janardanah |
samprapnotyakshayam sthanametatsatyam mayoditam ||

verses.sa:
अङ्गिरा उवाच
यस्यान्तः सर्वमेवेदमच्युतस्याव्ययात्मनः ।
तमाराधय गोविन्दं स्थानमग्र्यं यदीच्छसि ॥
verses.rom:
angira uvacha
yasyantah sarvamevedamachyutasyavyayatmanah |
tamaradhaya govindam sthanamagryam yadichchhasi ||

verses.sa:
पुलस्त्य उवाच
परं ब्रह्म परं धाम योऽसौ ब्रह्म तथा परम् ।
तमाराध्य हरिं याति मुक्तिमप्यति दुर्लभाम् ॥
verses.rom:
pulastya uvacha
param brahma param dhama yo'sau brahma tatha param |
tamaradhya harim yati muktimapyati durlabham ||

verses.sa:
पुलह उवाच
ऐन्द्रमिन्द्रः परं स्थानं यमाराध्य जगत्पतिम् ।
प्राप यज्ञपतिं विष्णुं तमाराधय सुव्रत ॥
verses.rom:
pulaha uvacha
aindramindrah param sthanam yamaradhya jagatpatim |
prapa yajnapatim vishnum tamaradhaya suvrata ||

verses.sa:
क्रतुरुवाच
यो यज्ञपुरुषो यज्ञो योगेशः परमः पुमान् ।
तस्मिंस्तुष्टे यदप्राप्यं किन्तदस्ति जनार्दने ॥
verses.rom:
kraturuvacha
yo yajnapurusho yajno yogeshah paramah puman |
tasmimstushte yadaprapyam kintadasti janardane ||

verses.sa:
वसिष्ठ उवाच
प्राप्नोष्याराधिते विष्णौ मनसा यद्यदिच्छति ।
त्रेलोक्यान्तर्गतं स्थानं किमु वत्सोत्तमोत्तमम् ॥
verses.rom:
vasishtha uvacha
prapnoshyaradhite vishnau manasa yadyadichchhati |
trelokyantargatam sthanam kimu vatsottamottamam ||

verses.sa:
ध्रुव उवाच
आराध्यः कथितो देवो भवद्भिः प्रणतस्य मे ।
मया तत्परीतोषाय यज्जप्तव्यं तदुच्यताम् ॥
verses.rom:
dhruva uvacha
aradhyah kathito devo bhavadbhih pranatasya me |
maya tatparitoshaya yajjaptavyam taduchyatam ||

verses.sa:
यथा चाराधनं तस्य मया कार्यं महात्मनः ।
प्रसादसुमुखास्तन्मे कथयन्तु महर्षयः ॥
verses.rom:
yatha charadhanam tasya maya karyam mahatmanah |
prasadasumukhastanme kathayantu maharshayah ||

verses.sa:
ऋषय ऊचुः
राजपुत्र यथा विष्णोराराधनपरैर्नरैः ।
कार्यमाराधनं तन्नो यथावच्छ्रोतुमर्हसि ॥
verses.rom:
rishaya uchuh
rajaputra yatha vishnoraradhanaparairnaraih |
karyamaradhanam tanno yathavachchhrotumarhasi ||

verses.sa:
बाह्यार्थादखिलाच्चित्तं त्याजयेत्प्रथमं नरः ।
तस्मिन्नेव जगद्धाम्नि ततः कुर्वित निश्चलम् ॥
verses.rom:
bahyarthadakhilachchittam tyajayetprathamam narah |
tasminneva jagaddhamni tatah kurvita nishchalam ||

verses.sa:
एवमेकाग्रचित्तेन तन्मयेन धृतात्मना ।
जप्तव्यं यन्नि बोधैतत्तन्रः पार्थिवनन्दन ॥
verses.rom:
evamekagrachittena tanmayena dhritatmana |
japtavyam yanni bodhaitattanrah parthivanandana ||

verses.sa:
हिरण्यगर्भपुरुषप्रधानव्यक्तरूपिणे ।
ओं नमो वासुदेवाय शुद्धज्ञानस्वरूपिमे ॥
verses.rom:
hiranyagarbhapurushapradhanavyaktarupine |
om namo vasudevaya shuddhajnanasvarupime ||

verses.sa:
एतज्जजाप भगवान् जप्यं स्वायंभुवो मनुः ।
पितामहस्तव पुरा तस्य तुष्टो जनार्दनः ॥
verses.rom:
etajjajapa bhagavan japyam svayambhuvo manuh |
pitamahastava pura tasya tushto janardanah ||

verses.sa:
ददो यथाभिलषितां सिद्धिं त्रैलोक्यदुर्लभाम् ।
तथा त्वमपि गोविन्दं तोषयैतत्सदा जपन् ॥
verses.rom:
dado yathabhilashitam siddhim trailokyadurlabham |
tatha tvamapi govindam toshayaitatsada japan ||

verses.sa: इति श्रीविष्णुपुराणे प्रथमेंश एकादशोऽध्यायः (११)
verses.rom: iti shrivishnupurane prathamemsha ekadasho'dhyayah (11)

prose.en:
Parāçara said:—I mentioned unto you that the Menu Swāyambhava had two heroic and pious sons Priyavrata and and Uttanpada. O these two, O Brahman, Uttanpada, had, by his favourite wife Suruchi, a son, Uttama, whom he dearly loved. O twice-born one, the king had another queen by name Suniti, to whom he was less attached. By her he had another son Dhruva. Beholding his brother Uttama on the lap of his father as he was seated upon his throne, Dhruva was desirous of ascending to the same place. But as Suruchi was present the king could not receive his son, approaching there delightedly and desiring to be taken on his father's knee. Beholding the child of her sapatni thus anxious to be placed on his father's lap and her own son already seated there Suruchi said,—"O child, why do you vainly cherish such a presumptuous desire born as thou art from a different mother and art no son of mine. Thou art inconsiderate enough to aspire to a station which is fit for excellent Uttama. It is true thou art the son of the king but I have not given thee birth. This regal throne, the seat of the king of kings is suited to my son only; why shouldst thou trouble thyself for it. Why does thou idly cherish such an ambition as if thou wert my son? Dost thou not know that thou art the offspring of Suniti?" Parāçara said;—O twice-born one, hearing the words of his step-mother, and quitting his father, the boy repaired in a passion to the apartment of his own mother. Beholding him angry and his lips trembling, Suniti took him upon her lap and said,—"O child, who is the cause of your anger? Who hath not welcomed thee? Who doth not know, that by behaving ill towards thee he hath offended thy father?" Being thus addressed Dhruva repeated to his mother all that the arrogant Suruchi had said to him in the presence of the king. Her son having related all these sighing, she was greatly distressed. And Suniti, rendered poorly, with her eyes dimmed, sighed and said,—"Suruchi has rightly spoken; thine, child, is as an unfortunate fate: those who are born to fortune are not liable to the insults of their step-mothers. Yet be not afflicted, my child, for who shall efface what thou hast formerly done, or shall assign to thee what thou hast left undone. The regal throne, the umbrella of royalty, excellent horses and elephants are his whose virtues have deserved them; remember this my son and be consoled. That the king favours Suruchi is the reward of her merits in a former birth. The name of wife alone belongs to such as I, who have not equal merit. Her son is the progeny of accumulated piety and is born as Uttama and mine son art thou, O Dhruva, of inferior merit. It does not behove thee, O my child, to be sorry on this account; a wise man will be satisfied with the degree which appertains to him. If thou art greatly hurt at the words of Suruchi, do you try to amass piety which bestows all good. Be thou good-natured, virtuous-souled, friendly and engaged in doing good to all living creatures; for prosperity descends upon worthy persons as water flows towards low ground".

Dhruva said;—"O mother, what thou hast said to console me doth not find place in my heart which has been rent asunder by harsh words. I shall so exert that I may attain to the most exalted rank adored by the whole world. I am not born of Suruchi who is the favourite wife of the king. Do thou behold my prowess, O mother, who am born of and reared by thee. Let Uttama, my brother, who is not born of thee, receive the regal throne, conferred on him by my father.

"I do not wish to have that which is given by others, O mother. I shall by my actions acquire such a position which had not been enjoyed even by my father". Parāçara said:—Having addressed his mother thus, Dhruva issued out of his mother's dwelling. And quitting the city, he repaired to a neighbouring thicket. He beheld there seven ascetics, who had repaired there before, sitting upon the hides of the black antelope, which they had taken from off their persons, and spread over the holy kusa grass. Saluting them respectfully and bowing unto them humbly the prince said, "Do ye know me, O great ascetics, as the son of Uttanpada, born of Suniti. Being dissatisfied with the world, I have appeared before you". The Rishis replied:—"O prince, thou art only a boy and but four or five years of age. There can be no reason why you should be dissatisfied with life. You cannot be disgusted with anxiety since thy father reigns; we cannot imagine, O boy, that you suffer the pain of separation from the object of your affections. Nor do we see any sign of disease on your person. What is the cause of your dissatisfaction? Tell us if it is known to you". Parāçara said,—Thereupon he repeated unto them what Suruchi had spoken to him. And having heard that they said to one another,—"Oh! How wonderful is the vehemence of Kshatriya nature? He is a mere boy and still he cannot stoop to indignities and he has not been able to remove from his mind what his step-mother had said. O son of Kshatriya, if it pleases thee, tell us what thou desirest to do through your dissatisfaction with the world. O thou of immeasurable prowess, tell us in what thou wishest to have our help? Speak freely: for we perceive that thou desirest to have something from us". Dhruva said:—"O ye foremost of twice-born ones, I wish not for riches, neither do I long for a kingdom. I aspire to a station which hath never been acquired by any before. O excellent sages, tell me how I may effect this and attain to that station which is the most elevated in this world". Maychi said—"O Prince, none can attain to that best of stations who does not propitiate Govinda. Do thou therefore worship the undecaying". Attri said—"He with whom is pleased the first of spirits Janārddana, gets at this imperishable dignity—I mention unto you the truth". Angira said,—"If thou desirest for an exalted station do thou worship Govinda in whom immutable and undecaying, all that is, exists". Pulastya said,—"Worshipping the divine Hari, the Supreme Soul, the Supreme Stay and Supreme Brahmā thou mayst attain to eternal liberation, what of reaching that most exalted station". Kratu said,—"Nothing is difficult to attain if Janārddana is pleased, who is the soul of sacrifice in sacrifices and supreme spirit in abstract contemplation". Pulaha said,—"Do thou adore, O pious boy, that Vishnu, the lord of sacrifice, and Universe, worshipping whom Indra obtained the dignity of a king of the celestials". Vasishtha observed:—"Anything, that a man desires, may be obtained in this world by adoring Vishnu what of that exalted position". Dhruva said:—"You have told me, humbly bowing before, what is the deity to be adored: do ye now inform me of the prayer which is to be meditated by me to propitiate him. May the great ascetics, delightedly inform me of the prayer by which I may propitiate the God". The Rishis said,—"O Prince, hear, we shall relate unto thee, how those, who are devoted unto Vishnu, shall worship Him. They shall first withdraw their minds from all exterior objects and then fix it steadily on that being in whom the world exists. O Prince, hear from us the prayer that is to be recited by him, who has thus concentrated his thoughts on one only object, whose heart is filled with his spirit, and who has controlled himself. 'Om, salutation to Vasudeva, who is manifest as Brahmā, Vishnu and Siva, and whose form is inscrutable'. This prayer was offered in olden times by your grandsire, the Manu Swayambhuva, and propitiated by which, Janārddana conferred upon him prosperity, which he desired, unequalled in three worlds. Do thou therefore try to propitiate Govinda by reciting this prayer continually".

verses.sa:
श्रीपराशर उवाच
निशम्यैतदशेषेण मैत्रेय नृपते सुतः ।
निर्जगाम वनात्तस्मात्प्रणिपत्य स तानृषीन् ॥
verses.rom:
shriparashara uvacha
nishamyaitadasheshena maitreya nripate sutah |
nirjagama vanattasmatpranipatya sa tanrishin ||

verses.sa:
कृतकृत्यमिवात्मानं मन्यमानस्ततो द्विज ।
मधुसंज्ञं महापुण्यं जगाम यमुनातटम् ॥
verses.rom:
kritakrityamivatmanam manyamanastato dvija |
madhusamjnam mahapunyam jagama yamunatatam ||

verses.sa:
पुनश्च मधुसंज्ञेन दैत्येनाधिष्ठितं यतः ।
ततो मधुवनं नाम्ना ख्यातमत्र महीतले ॥
verses.rom:
punashcha madhusamjnena daityenadhishthitam yatah |
tato madhuvanam namna khyatamatra mahitale ||

verses.sa:
हत्वा च लवणं रक्षो मधुपुत्रं महाबलम् ।
शत्रुघ्नो मधुरां नाम पुरीं यत्र चकार वै ॥
verses.rom:
hatva cha lavanam raksho madhuputram mahabalam |
shatrughno madhuram nama purim yatra chakara vai ||

verses.sa:
यत्र वै देवदेवस्य सान्निध्यं हरिमेधसः ।
सर्वपापहरे तस्मिंस्तपस्तीर्थे चकार सः ॥
verses.rom:
yatra vai devadevasya sannidhyam harimedhasah |
sarvapapahare tasmimstapastirthe chakara sah ||

verses.sa:
मरीचिमुख्यैर्मुनिभिर्यथोद्दिष्टमभूत्तथा ।
आत्मन्यशेपदेवेशं स्थितं विष्णुममन्यत ॥
verses.rom:
marichimukhyairmunibhiryathoddishtamabhuttatha |
atmanyashepadevesham sthitam vishnumamanyata ||

verses.sa:
अनन्यचेतसस्तस्य ध्यायतो भगवान्हरिः ।
सर्वभूतगतो विप्र सर्वभावगतोऽभवत् ॥
verses.rom:
ananyachetasastasya dhyayato bhagavanharih |
sarvabhutagato vipra sarvabhavagato'bhavat ||

verses.sa:
मनस्यवस्थिते तस्मिन्विष्णौ मैत्रेय योगिनः ।
न शशाक धरा भारमुद्वोढुं भूतधारिणी ॥
verses.rom:
manasyavasthite tasminvishnau maitreya yoginah |
na shashaka dhara bharamudvodhum bhutadharini ||

verses.sa:
वामपादस्थिते तस्मिन्ननामार्धेन मेदिनी ।
द्वितीयं च ननामार्धं क्षितेर्दक्षिणतः स्थिते ॥
verses.rom:
vamapadasthite tasminnanamardhena medini |
dvitiyam cha nanamardham kshiterdakshinatah sthite ||

verses.sa:
पादांगुष्ठेन संपीड्य यथा स वसुधां स्थितः ।
तदा समस्ता वसुधा चचाल सह पर्वतैः ॥
verses.rom:
padamgushthena sampidya yatha sa vasudham sthitah |
tada samasta vasudha chachala saha parvataih ||

verses.sa:
नद्यो नदाः समुद्राश्च संक्षोभं परमं ययुः ।
तत्क्षोभादमराः क्षोभं परं जग्मुर्महामुने ॥
verses.rom:
nadyo nadah samudrashcha samkshobham paramam yayuh |
tatkshobhadamarah kshobham param jagmurmahamune ||

verses.sa:
यामा नाम तदा देवा मैत्रेय परमाकुलाः ।
इन्द्रेण सह संमन्त्र्य ध्यानभङ्गं प्रचक्रमुः ॥
verses.rom:
yama nama tada deva maitreya paramakulah |
indrena saha sammantrya dhyanabhangam prachakramuh ||

verses.sa:
कूष्माण्डा विविधै रूपैर्महेन्द्रेण महामुने ।
समाधिभङ्गमत्यन्तमारब्धाः कर्तुमातुराः ॥
verses.rom:
kushmanda vividhai rupairmahendrena mahamune |
samadhibhangamatyantamarabdhah kartumaturah ||

verses.sa:
सुनीतिर्नाम तन्माता सास्त्रा तत्पुरतः स्थिता ।
पुत्रेति करुणां वाचमाह मायामयी तदा ॥
verses.rom:
sunitirnama tanmata sastra tatpuratah sthita |
putreti karunam vachamaha mayamayi tada ||

verses.sa:
पुत्रकास्मान्निवर्तस्व शरीरात्ययदारुणात् ।
निर्बन्धतो मया लब्धो बहुभिस्त्वं मनोरथै ॥
verses.rom:
putrakasmannivartasva shariratyayadarunat |
nirbandhato maya labdho bahubhistvam manorathai ||

verses.sa:
दीनामेकां परित्यक्तुमनाथां न त्वमर्हसि ।
सपत्नीवचनाद्वत्स अगतेस्त्वं गतिर्मम ॥
verses.rom:
dinamekam parityaktumanatham na tvamarhasi |
sapatnivachanadvatsa agatestvam gatirmama ||

verses.sa:
क्व च त्वं पञ्चवर्षीयः क्वचैतद्दारूणं तपः ।
निवर्ततां मनः कष्टान्निर्बन्धात्फलवर्जितात् ॥
verses.rom:
kva cha tvam panchavarshiyah kvachaitaddarunam tapah |
nivartatam manah kashtannirbandhatphalavarjitat ||

verses.sa:
कालः क्रीडनकानान्ते तदन्तेऽध्ययनस्य ते ।
ततः समस्तभोगानां तदन्ते चेष्यते तपः ॥
verses.rom:
kalah kridanakanante tadante'dhyayanasya te |
tatah samastabhoganam tadante cheshyate tapah ||

verses.sa:
कालः क्रीडनकानां यस्तव बालस्य पुत्रक ।
तस्मिंस्त्वमिच्छसि तपः किं नाशायात्मनो रतः ॥
verses.rom:
kalah kridanakanam yastava balasya putraka |
tasmimstvamichchhasi tapah kim nashayatmano ratah ||

verses.sa:
मत्प्रीतिः परमो धर्मो वयोवस्थाक्रियाक्रमम् ।
अनुवर्तस्व मा मोहान्निवर्तास्मादधर्मतः ॥
verses.rom:
matpritih paramo dharmo vayovasthakriyakramam |
anuvartasva ma mohannivartasmadadharmatah ||

verses.sa:
परित्यजति वत्साध्य यध्येतन्न भवांस्तपः ।
त्यक्ष्याम्यहमिह प्राणांस्ततो वै पश्यतस्तव ॥
verses.rom:
parityajati vatsadhya yadhyetanna bhavamstapah |
tyakshyamyahamiha pranamstato vai pashyatastava ||

verses.sa:
श्रीपराशर उवाच
तां प्रलापवतीमेवं बाष्पाकुलविलोचनाम् ।
समाहितमना विष्णौ पश्यन्नपि न दृष्टवान् ॥
verses.rom:
shriparashara uvacha
tam pralapavatimevam bashpakulavilochanam |
samahitamana vishnau pashyannapi na drishtavan ||

verses.sa:
वत्स वत्स सुघोराणि रक्षांस्येतानि भीषणे ।
वनेऽभ्युद्यतशस्त्राणीः समायान्त्यपगम्यताम् ॥
verses.rom:
vatsa vatsa sughorani rakshamsyetani bhishane |
vane'bhyudyatashastranih samayantyapagamyatam ||

verses.sa:
इत्युक्त्वा प्रययौ साथ रक्षांस्याविर्बभुस्ततः ।
अभ्युद्यतोग्रशस्त्राणि ज्वालामालाकुलैर्मुखैः ॥
verses.rom:
ityuktva prayayau satha rakshamsyavirbabhustatah |
abhyudyatograshastrani jvalamalakulairmukhaih ||

verses.sa:
ततो नादानतीवोग्रन्राजपुत्रस्य ते पुरः ।
मुमुचुर्दीप्तशस्त्राणि भ्रामयन्तो निशाचराः ॥
verses.rom:
tato nadanativogranrajaputrasya te purah |
mumuchurdiptashastrani bhramayanto nishacharah ||

verses.sa:
शिवाश्च शतशो नेदुः सज्वालाः कवलैर्मुखैः ।
त्रासाय तस्य बालस्य योगयुक्तस्य सर्वदा ॥
verses.rom:
shivashcha shatasho neduh sajvalah kavalairmukhaih |
trasaya tasya balasya yogayuktasya sarvada ||

verses.sa:
हन्यतां दन्यतामेष छिद्यतां छिद्यतामयम् ।
भक्ष्यतां भक्ष्यतां चाय मित्युचुस्ते निशाचराः ॥
verses.rom:
hanyatam danyatamesha chhidyatam chhidyatamayam |
bhakshyatam bhakshyatam chaya mityuchuste nishacharah ||

verses.sa:
ततो नानाविधान्नादान् सिंहोष्ट्रमकराननाः ।
त्रासाय राजपुत्रस्य नेदुस्ते रजनीचराः ॥
verses.rom:
tato nanavidhannadan simhoshtramakarananah |
trasaya rajaputrasya neduste rajanicharah ||

verses.sa:
रक्षांसि तानि ते नादाः शिवास्तान्यायुधानि च ।
गोविन्दासक्तचित्तस्य ययुर्नन्द्रियगोचरम् ॥
verses.rom:
rakshamsi tani te nadah shivastanyayudhani cha |
govindasaktachittasya yayurnandriyagocharam ||

verses.sa:
एकाग्रचेताः सततं विष्णुमेवात्मसंश्रयम् ।
दृष्टवान् पृथिवीनाथपुत्रो नान्यं कथञ्चन ॥
verses.rom:
ekagrachetah satatam vishnumevatmasamshrayam |
drishtavan prithivinathaputro nanyam kathanchana ||

verses.sa:
ततः सर्वासु मायासु विलीनासु पुनः सुराः ।
संक्षोभं परमं जग्मुस्तत्पराभवशङ्किताः ॥
verses.rom:
tatah sarvasu mayasu vilinasu punah surah |
samkshobham paramam jagmustatparabhavashankitah ||

verses.sa:
ते समेत्य जगद्योनिमनादिनिधनं हरिम् ।
शरण्यं शरणं यातास्तपसा तस्य तापिताः ॥
verses.rom:
te sametya jagadyonimanadinidhanam harim |
sharanyam sharanam yatastapasa tasya tapitah ||

verses.sa:
देवा ऊचुः
देवदेव जगन्नाथ परेश पुरुषोत्तम ।
ध्रुवस्य तपसा तप्तास्त्वां वयं शरणं गताः ॥
verses.rom:
deva uchuh
devadeva jagannatha paresha purushottama |
dhruvasya tapasa taptastvam vayam sharanam gatah ||

verses.sa:
दिने दिने कलालेशैः शशाङ्क पूर्यते यथा ।
तथायं तपसा देव प्रयात्यृद्धिमहर्निंशम् ॥
verses.rom:
dine dine kalaleshaih shashanka puryate yatha |
tathayam tapasa deva prayatyriddhimaharnimsham ||

verses.sa:
औतानपादितपसा वयमित्थं जनार्दन ।
भीतास्त्वां शरणं यातास्तपसस्तं निवर्तय ॥
verses.rom:
autanapaditapasa vayamittham janardana |
bhitastvam sharanam yatastapasastam nivartaya ||

verses.sa:
नविद्मः किं स शक्रत्वं सूर्यत्वं किमभीप्सति ।
वित्तपाम्बुपसोमानां साभिलाषः पदेषु किम् ॥
verses.rom:
navidmah kim sa shakratvam suryatvam kimabhipsati |
vittapambupasomanam sabhilashah padeshu kim ||

verses.sa:
तदस्माकं प्रसीदेश हृदयाच्छल्यमुद्धर ।
उत्तानपादतनयं तपसः सन्निवर्तय ॥
verses.rom:
tadasmakam prasidesha hridayachchhalyamuddhara |
uttanapadatanayam tapasah sannivartaya ||

verses.sa:
श्रीभगवानुवाच
नेन्द्रत्वं न च सूर्यत्वं नैवाम्बुपधनेशताम् ।
प्रार्थयत्येष यं कामं तं करोम्यखिलं सुरा ॥
verses.rom:
shribhagavanuvacha
nendratvam na cha suryatvam naivambupadhaneshatam |
prarthayatyesha yam kamam tam karomyakhilam sura ||

verses.sa:
यात देवा यथाकाम स्वस्थानं विगतज्वराः ।
निवर्तयाम्यहं बालं तपस्यासक्तमानसम् ॥
verses.rom:
yata deva yathakama svasthanam vigatajvarah |
nivartayamyaham balam tapasyasaktamanasam ||

verses.sa:
श्रीपराशर उवाच
इत्युक्ता देवदेवेन प्रणम्य त्रिदशास्ततः ।
प्रययुः स्वानि धिष्ण्यानि शतक्रतुपुरोगमाः ॥
verses.rom:
shriparashara uvacha
ityukta devadevena pranamya tridashastatah |
prayayuh svani dhishnyani shatakratupurogamah ||

verses.sa:
भगवानपि सर्वात्मा तन्मयत्वेन तोषितः ।
गत्वा ध्रुवमुवाचेदं चतुर्भुजवपुर्हरिः ॥
verses.rom:
bhagavanapi sarvatma tanmayatvena toshitah |
gatva dhruvamuvachedam chaturbhujavapurharih ||

verses.sa:
श्रीभगवानुवाच
औत्तानपादे भद्रं ते तपसा परितोषितः ।
वरदोहमनुप्राप्तो वरं वरय सुव्रत ॥
verses.rom:
shribhagavanuvacha
auttanapade bhadram te tapasa paritoshitah |
varadohamanuprapto varam varaya suvrata ||

verses.sa:
ब्राह्यार्थनिरपेक्षं ते मयि चित्तं यदा हितम् ।
तुष्टोहं भवतस्तेन तद्वृणीष्व वरं परम् ॥
verses.rom:
brahyarthanirapeksham te mayi chittam yada hitam |
tushtoham bhavatastena tadvrinishva varam param ||

verses.sa:
पराशर उवाच
श्रुत्वेत्थं गदितं तस्य देवदेवस्य बालकः ।
उन्मीलिताक्षो ददृशे ध्यानदृष्टं हरिं पुरः ॥
verses.rom:
parashara uvacha
shrutvettham gaditam tasya devadevasya balakah |
unmilitaksho dadrishe dhyanadrishtam harim purah ||

verses.sa:
शङ्खचक्रगदाशार्ङ्गवरासिधरमच्युतम् ।
किरीटिनं समालोक्य जगाम शिरसा महीम् ॥
verses.rom:
shankhachakragadasharngavarasidharamachyutam |
kiritinam samalokya jagama shirasa mahim ||

verses.sa:
रोमाञ्चिताङ्गः सहसा साध्वसं परमं गतः ।
स्तवाय देवदेवस्य स चक्रे मानसं ध्रुवः ॥
verses.rom:
romanchitangah sahasa sadhvasam paramam gatah |
stavaya devadevasya sa chakre manasam dhruvah ||

verses.sa:
किं वदामि स्तुतावस्य केनोक्तेनास्य संस्तुतिः ।
इत्याकुल मतिर्देवं तमेव शरणं ययौ ॥
verses.rom:
kim vadami stutavasya kenoktenasya samstutih |
ityakula matirdevam tameva sharanam yayau ||

verses.sa:
ध्रुव उवाच
भगवन्यदि मे तोषं तपसा परमं गतः ।
स्तोतुं तदहमिच्छामि वरमेनं प्रयच्छ मे ॥
verses.rom:
dhruva uvacha
bhagavanyadi me tosham tapasa paramam gatah |
stotum tadahamichchhami varamenam prayachchha me ||

verses.sa:
(ब्रह्माद्यौर्यस्य वेदज्ञैर्ज्ञायते यस्य नो गतिः ।
तं त्वां कथमहं देव स्तोतुं शक्रोमि बालकः ।
त्वद्भक्तिप्रवणं ह्येतत्परमेश्वर मे मनः ।
स्तोतुं प्रवृत्तं त्वत्पादौ तत्र प्रज्ञां प्रयच्च मे)
श्रीपराशर उवाच
शङ्खप्रान्तेन गोविन्दस्तं पस्पर्श कृताञ्जलिम् ।
उत्तानपादतनयं द्विजवर्य जगत्पतिः ॥
verses.rom:
(brahmadyauryasya vedajnairjnayate yasya no gatih |
tam tvam kathamaham deva stotum shakromi balakah |
tvadbhaktipravanam hyetatparameshvara me manah |
stotum pravrittam tvatpadau tatra prajnam prayachcha me)
shriparashara uvacha
shankhaprantena govindastam pasparsha kritanjalim |
uttanapadatanayam dvijavarya jagatpatih ||

verses.sa:
अथ प्रसन्नवदनः स क्षणान्नृपनन्दनः ।
तुष्टाव प्रणतो भूत्वा भूतधातारमच्युतम् ॥
verses.rom:
atha prasannavadanah sa kshanannripanandanah |
tushtava pranato bhutva bhutadhataramachyutam ||

verses.sa:
ध्रुव उवाच
भूमिरापोनलो वायुः खं मनो बुद्धिरेव च ।
भूतादिरादि प्रकृतिर्यस्य रूपं नतोस्मि तम् ॥
verses.rom:
dhruva uvacha
bhumiraponalo vayuh kham mano buddhireva cha |
bhutadiradi prakritiryasya rupam natosmi tam ||

verses.sa:
शुद्धः सूक्ष्मोखिलव्यापी प्रधानात्परतः पुमान् ।
यस्य रूपं नमस्तस्मै पुरुषाय गुणात्मने ॥
verses.rom:
shuddhah sukshmokhilavyapi pradhanatparatah puman |
yasya rupam namastasmai purushaya gunatmane ||

verses.sa:
भूतादीनां समस्तानां गन्धादीनां च शाश्वतः ।
बुध्यादीनां प्रधानस्य पुरुषस्य च यः परः ॥
verses.rom:
bhutadinam samastanam gandhadinam cha shashvatah |
budhyadinam pradhanasya purushasya cha yah parah ||

verses.sa:
तं ब्रह्मभूतमात्मानमशेषजगतः पतिम् ।
प्रपद्ये शरणं शुद्धं त्वद्रूपं परमेश्वर ॥
verses.rom:
tam brahmabhutamatmanamasheshajagatah patim |
prapadye sharanam shuddham tvadrupam parameshvara ||

verses.sa:
बृहत्त्वाद्बृंहणत्वाच्च यद्रूपं ब्रह्मसंज्ञितम् ।
तस्मै नमस्ते सर्वात्मन्योगिचिन्त्याविकारिणे ॥
verses.rom:
brihattvadbrimhanatvachcha yadrupam brahmasamjnitam |
tasmai namaste sarvatmanyogichintyavikarine ||

verses.sa:
सहस्रशीर्षा पुरुषः सहस्राक्षः सहस्रपात् ।
सर्वव्यापी भुवः स्पर्शादत्यतिष्ठद्दशाङ्गुलम् ॥
verses.rom:
sahasrashirsha purushah sahasrakshah sahasrapat |
sarvavyapi bhuvah sparshadatyatishthaddashangulam ||

verses.sa:
यद्भूतं यच्च वै भव्यं पुरूषोत्तम तद्भवान् ।
त्वत्तौ विराट्स्वराट्सम्राट्त्वत्तश्चप्यधिपूरुषः ॥
verses.rom:
yadbhutam yachcha vai bhavyam purushottama tadbhavan |
tvattau viratsvaratsamrattvattashchapyadhipurushah ||

verses.sa:
अत्यरिच्यत सोधश्च तिर्यगूर्ध्वं च वै भुवः ।
त्वत्तो विश्वमिदं जातं त्वत्तौ भूतं भविष्यति ॥
verses.rom:
atyarichyata sodhashcha tiryagurdhvam cha vai bhuvah |
tvatto vishvamidam jatam tvattau bhutam bhavishyati ||

verses.sa:
त्वद्रूपधारिणश्चान्तः सर्वभूतमिदं जगत् ।
त्वत्तो यज्ञः सर्वहुतः पृषदाज्यं पशुर्द्विधा ॥
verses.rom:
tvadrupadharinashchantah sarvabhutamidam jagat |
tvatto yajnah sarvahutah prishadajyam pashurdvidha ||

verses.sa:
त्वत्तो ऋचोथ सामानि त्वत्तश्छन्दांसि जज्ञिरे ।
त्वत्तो यजूंष्यजायन्त त्वत्तोश्वाश्चैकतो दतः ॥
verses.rom:
tvatto richotha samani tvattashchhandamsi jajnire |
tvatto yajumshyajayanta tvattoshvashchaikato datah ||

verses.sa:
गावस्त्वत्तः समुद्भूतास्त्व त्तोजा अवयो मृगाः ।
त्वमन्मुखाद्ब्राह्मणा बाह्वोस्त्वत्तो क्षत्रमजायत ॥
verses.rom:
gavastvattah samudbhutastva ttoja avayo mrigah |
tvamanmukhadbrahmana bahvostvatto kshatramajayata ||

verses.sa:
वैश्वास्तवोरुजाः शूद्रास्तव पद्भ्यां समुद्गताः ।
आक्ष्णोः सूर्योऽनिलः प्राणाच्चन्द्रमा मनसस्तव ॥
verses.rom:
vaishvastavorujah shudrastava padbhyam samudgatah |
akshnoh suryo'nilah pranachchandrama manasastava ||

verses.sa:
प्राणोन्तः मुषिराज्जातो मुखादग्निरजायत ।
नाभितो गगनं द्यौश्च शिरसः समवर्तत ॥
verses.rom:
pranontah mushirajjato mukhadagnirajayata |
nabhito gaganam dyaushcha shirasah samavartata ||

verses.sa: दिशः श्रोत्रात्क्षितिः पद्भ्यां त्वत्तः सर्वमभूदिदिम् ॥
verses.rom: dishah shrotratkshitih padbhyam tvattah sarvamabhudidim ||

verses.sa:
न्यग्रोधः सुमहानल्पे यथा बीजे व्यवस्थितः ।
संयमे विस्वमखिलं बीजभूते तथात्वायि ॥
verses.rom:
nyagrodhah sumahanalpe yatha bije vyavasthitah |
samyame visvamakhilam bijabhute tathatvayi ||

verses.sa:
बीजादङ्कुरसम्भूते न्यग्रोधस्तु समुत्थितः ।
विस्तारं च यथा याति त्वत्तः सृष्टौ तथा जगत् ॥
verses.rom:
bijadankurasambhute nyagrodhastu samutthitah |
vistaram cha yatha yati tvattah srishtau tatha jagat ||

verses.sa:
यथा हि कदली नान्या त्वक्पत्रादपि दृस्यते ।
एवं विश्वस्य नान्यस्त्वं त्वस्थयीश्वर दृश्येत ॥
verses.rom:
yatha hi kadali nanya tvakpatradapi drisyate |
evam vishvasya nanyastvam tvasthayishvara drishyeta ||

verses.sa:
ह्लादिनी संधिनी संवित्त्वय्येका सर्वसंस्थितौ ।
ह्लादतापकरी मिश्रा त्वयि नो गुणवर्जिते ॥
verses.rom:
hladini samdhini samvittvayyeka sarvasamsthitau |
hladatapakari mishra tvayi no gunavarjite ||

verses.sa:
पृथग्भूतैकभूताय भूतभूताय ते नमः ।
प्रभूतभूतभूताय तुभ्यं भूतात्मने नमः ॥
verses.rom:
prithagbhutaikabhutaya bhutabhutaya te namah |
prabhutabhutabhutaya tubhyam bhutatmane namah ||

verses.sa:
व्यक्तं प्रधानपुरुषौ विराट्सम्राट्स्वराट्तथा ।
विभाव्यतेन्तःकरणे पुरुषेष्वक्षयो भवान् ॥
verses.rom:
vyaktam pradhanapurushau viratsamratsvarattatha |
vibhavyatentahkarane purusheshvakshayo bhavan ||

verses.sa:
सर्वस्मिन्सर्वभूतस्त्वं सर्वः सर्वस्वरूपधृक् ।
सर्वं त्वत्तस्ततश्च त्वं नमः सर्वात्मनेऽस्तु ते ॥
verses.rom:
sarvasminsarvabhutastvam sarvah sarvasvarupadhrik |
sarvam tvattastatashcha tvam namah sarvatmane'stu te ||

verses.sa:
सर्वात्मकोसि सर्वेश सर्वभूतस्थितो यतः ।
कथयामि ततः किं ते सर्वं वेत्सि हृति स्थितम् ॥
verses.rom:
sarvatmakosi sarvesha sarvabhutasthito yatah |
kathayami tatah kim te sarvam vetsi hriti sthitam ||

verses.sa:
सर्वात्मन्सर्वभूतेश सर्वसत्त्वसमुद्भव ।
सर्वभूतो भवान्वेत्ति सर्वसत्त्वमनोरथम् ॥
verses.rom:
sarvatmansarvabhutesha sarvasattvasamudbhava |
sarvabhuto bhavanvetti sarvasattvamanoratham ||

verses.sa:
यो मे मनोरथो नाथ सफलः स त्वया कृतः ।
तपश्च तप्तं सफलं यद्दृष्टोऽसि जगत्पते ॥
verses.rom:
yo me manoratho natha saphalah sa tvaya kritah |
tapashcha taptam saphalam yaddrishto'si jagatpate ||

verses.sa:
श्रीभगवानुवाच
तपसस्तत्फलं यद्दृष्टोऽहं त्वया ध्रुव ।
मदृर्शनं हि विफलं राजपुत्र न जायते ॥
verses.rom:
shribhagavanuvacha
tapasastatphalam yaddrishto'ham tvaya dhruva |
