madrirshanam hi viphalam rajaputra na jayate ||

verses.sa:
वरं वरय तस्मात्त्वं यथाभिमतमात्मनः ।
सर्वं संपद्यते पुंसां मयि दृष्टिपथं गते ॥
verses.rom:
varam varaya tasmattvam yathabhimatamatmanah |
sarvam sampadyate pumsam mayi drishtipatham gate ||

verses.sa:
ध्रुव उवाच
भगवन्भूतभव्येश सर्वस्यास्ते भवान् हृदि ।
किमज्ञातं तव ब्रह्मन्मनसा यन्मयेक्षितम् ॥
verses.rom:
dhruva uvacha
bhagavanbhutabhavyesha sarvasyaste bhavan hridi |
kimajnatam tava brahmanmanasa yanmayekshitam ||

verses.sa:
तथापि तुभ्यं देवेश कथयिष्यामि यन्मया ।
प्रार्थ्यते दुर्विनीतेन हृदयेनातिदुर्लभम् ॥
verses.rom:
tathapi tubhyam devesha kathayishyami yanmaya |
prarthyate durvinitena hridayenatidurlabham ||

verses.sa:
किं वा सर्वजगत्स्त्रष्टः प्रसन्ने त्वयि दुर्लभम् ।
त्वत्प्रसादफलं भुङ्क्ते त्रैलोक्यं मघ वानपि ॥
verses.rom:
kim va sarvajagatstrashtah prasanne tvayi durlabham |
tvatprasadaphalam bhunkte trailokyam magha vanapi ||

verses.sa:
नैतद्राजासनं योग्यमजातस्य ममोदरात् ।
इति गर्वदवोचन्मां सपत्नीमातुरुच्चकैः ॥
verses.rom:
naitadrajasanam yogyamajatasya mamodarat |
iti garvadavochanmam sapatnimaturuchchakaih ||

verses.sa:
आधारभूतं जगतः सर्वेषामुत्तमोत्तमम् ।
प्रार्थयामि प्रभो स्थानं त्वत्प्रसादादतोव्ययम् ॥
verses.rom:
adharabhutam jagatah sarveshamuttamottamam |
prarthayami prabho sthanam tvatprasadadatovyayam ||

verses.sa:
श्रीभगवानुवाच
यत्त्वया प्रार्थ्यते स्थानमेतत्प्राप्स्यति वै भवान् ।
त्वयाहं तोषितः पूर्वमन्यजन्मनि वालक ॥
verses.rom:
shribhagavanuvacha
yattvaya prarthyate sthanametatprapsyati vai bhavan |
tvayaham toshitah purvamanyajanmani valaka ||

verses.sa:
त्वमासीर्ब्रह्मणः पूर्वं मय्येकाग्रमतिः सदा ।
मातापित्रोश्च शुश्रषुर्निजधर्मानुपालकः ॥
verses.rom:
tvamasirbrahmanah purvam mayyekagramatih sada |
matapitroshcha shushrashurnijadharmanupalakah ||

verses.sa:
कालेन गच्छता मित्रं राजपुत्रस्तवाभवत् ।
योवनेखिलभोगाढ्यो दर्शनीयोज्ज्वलाकृतिः ॥
verses.rom:
kalena gachchhata mitram rajaputrastavabhavat |
yovanekhilabhogadhyo darshaniyojjvalakritih ||

verses.sa:
तत्सङ्गात्तस्य तामृद्धिमवलोक्यादिदुर्लभाम् ।
भवेयं राजपुत्रोहमिति वाञ्छा त्वया कृता ॥
verses.rom:
tatsangattasya tamriddhimavalokyadidurlabham |
bhaveyam rajaputrohamiti vanchha tvaya krita ||

verses.sa:
ततो यथाभिलषिता प्राप्ता ते राजपुत्रता ।
उत्तानपादस्य गृहे जातोसि ध्रुव दुर्लभे ॥
verses.rom:
tato yathabhilashita prapta te rajaputrata |
uttanapadasya grihe jatosi dhruva durlabhe ||

verses.sa: अन्येषां दुर्लभं स्थानं कुले स्वायम्भुवस्य यत् ॥
verses.rom: anyesham durlabham sthanam kule svayambhuvasya yat ||

verses.sa:
तस्यैतदपरं बाल येनाहं परितोषितः ।
मामाराध्य नरो मुक्तिमवाप्नोत्यविलम्बिताम् ॥
verses.rom:
tasyaitadaparam bala yenaham paritoshitah |
mamaradhya naro muktimavapnotyavilambitam ||

verses.sa: मय्यर्पितमना बाल किमु स्वर्गादिकं पदम् ॥
verses.rom: mayyarpitamana bala kimu svargadikam padam ||

verses.sa:
त्रैलोक्यादधिके स्थाने सर्वताराग्रहाश्रयः ।
भविष्यति न संदेहो मत्प्रसादाद्भावन्ध्रुव ॥
verses.rom:
trailokyadadhike sthane sarvataragrahashrayah |
bhavishyati na samdeho matprasadadbhavandhruva ||

verses.sa:
सूर्यात्सोमात्तथा भौमात्सोमपुत्राद्बृहस्पतेः ।
सितार्कतनयादीनां सर्वर्क्षाणां तथा ध्रुवः ॥
verses.rom:
suryatsomattatha bhaumatsomaputradbrihaspateh |
sitarkatanayadinam sarvarkshanam tatha dhruvah ||

verses.sa:
सप्तर्षिणामशेषाणां ये च वैमानिकाः सुराः ।
सर्वेषामुपरि स्थानं तव दत्तं मया ध्रुव ॥
verses.rom:
saptarshinamasheshanam ye cha vaimanikah surah |
sarveshamupari sthanam tava dattam maya dhruva ||

verses.sa:
केचिच्चतुर्युगं यावत्केचिन्मन्वन्तरं सुराः ।
तिष्ठन्ति भवतो दत्ता मया वै कल्पसंस्थितिः ॥
verses.rom:
kechichchaturyugam yavatkechinmanvantaram surah |
tishthanti bhavato datta maya vai kalpasamsthitih ||

verses.sa:
सुनीतिरपि ते माता त्वदासन्नातिनिर्मला ।
विमाने तारका भूत्वा तावत्कालं निवत्स्यति ॥
verses.rom:
sunitirapi te mata tvadasannatinirmala |
vimane taraka bhutva tavatkalam nivatsyati ||

verses.sa:
ये च त्वां मानवाः प्रातः सायं च सुसमाहि ताः ।
कीर्तयिष्यन्ति तेषां च महत्पुण्यं भविष्यति ॥
verses.rom:
ye cha tvam manavah pratah sayam cha susamahi tah |
kirtayishyanti tesham cha mahatpunyam bhavishyati ||

verses.sa:
श्रीपराशर उवाच
एवं पूर्वं जगन्नाथाद्देवदेवाज्जनार्दनात् ।
वरं प्राप्य ध्रुवः स्थान मध्यास्ते स महामते ॥
verses.rom:
shriparashara uvacha
evam purvam jagannathaddevadevajjanardanat |
varam prapya dhruvah sthana madhyaste sa mahamate ||

verses.sa:
स्वयं शुश्रूषणाद्धर्म्यान्मातापित्रोश्च वै तथा ।
द्धादशाक्षरमाहत्म्यात्तपसश्च प्रभावतः ॥
verses.rom:
svayam shushrushanaddharmyanmatapitroshcha vai tatha |
ddhadashaksharamahatmyattapasashcha prabhavatah ||

verses.sa:
तस्याभिमानमृद्धिं च महिमानं निरिक्ष्य हि ।
देवासुराणामाचार्यः श्लोकमत्रोशना जगौ ॥
verses.rom:
tasyabhimanamriddhim cha mahimanam nirikshya hi |
devasuranamacharyah shlokamatroshana jagau ||

verses.sa:
अहोस्य तपसो वीर्यमहोस्य तपसः फलम् ।
यदेनं पुरतः कृत्वा ध्रुवं सप्तर्षयः स्थिताः ॥
verses.rom:
ahosya tapaso viryamahosya tapasah phalam |
yadenam puratah kritva dhruvam saptarshayah sthitah ||

verses.sa:
ध्रुवस्य जननी चेयं सुनीतिर्नाम सूनृता ।
अस्याश्च महिमानं कः शक्तो वर्णयितुं भुवि ॥
verses.rom:
dhruvasya janani cheyam sunitirnama sunrita |
asyashcha mahimanam kah shakto varnayitum bhuvi ||

verses.sa:
त्रैलोक्यश्रयतां प्राप्तं परं स्थानं स्तिरायति ।
स्थानं प्राप्ता परं धृत्वा या कुक्षिविवरे ध्रुवम् ॥
verses.rom:
trailokyashrayatam praptam param sthanam stirayati |
sthanam prapta param dhritva ya kukshivivare dhruvam ||

verses.sa:
यश्चैतत्कीर्तयेन्नित्यं ध्रुवस्यारोहणं दिवि ।
सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तः स्वर्गलोके महीयते ॥
verses.rom:
yashchaitatkirtayennityam dhruvasyarohanam divi |
sarvapapavinirmuktah svargaloke mahiyate ||

verses.sa:
स्थानभ्रंशं न चाप्नोति दिवि वा यदि वा भुवि ।
सर्वकल्याणसंयुक्तो दीर्घकालं स जीवति ॥
verses.rom:
sthanabhramsham na chapnoti divi va yadi va bhuvi |
sarvakalyanasamyukto dirghakalam sa jivati ||

verses.sa: इति श्रीविष्णुपुराणे प्रथमेऽंशे द्वादशोऽध्यायः (१२)
verses.rom: iti shrivishnupurane prathame'mshe dvadasho'dhyayah (12)

prose.en:
Parāçara said:—O Maitreya, hearing these words from beginning to end, that Prince, saluting these sages, issued out of that thicket. And confiding in the accomplishment of his object, O twice-born one, he repaired to the holy place on the banks of the Yamuna called Madhuvana, or the grove of Madhu, called after the name of a demon of that name who resided there and was known thus on the earth. Slaying the highly powerful son of the Rakshasa, Madhu—Lavana, Satrughna (the youngest son of Daçaratha,) founded a city at that spot which was named Mathura. And Dhruva engaged in performing penance at that holy shrine the purifier of all sin, where was Mahadeva, the god of Gods meditating upon Hari. In accordance with instruction given by Marichi and others, he began to contemplate, Vishnu the sovereign of the gods, seated in himself. O twice-born one, Dhruva, thus contemplating him, having his mind perfectly withdrawn from all other thoughts, the Great Hari, ever existing in all creatures and natures, took possession of his heart. O Maitreya, Vishnu thus occupying the heart of that one engaged in his meditation, the earth, the supporter of elemental life, could not sustain his height. When he used to stand upon his left foot (for praying) one half of the earth bent beneath him and when he used to stand upon his right foot the other half of the earth sank down. And when he used to stand touching the earth with his toes, the whole earth shook with its mountains and rivers, O twice-born one. The rivers and seas were greatly agitated thereby and even the celestials called Yāmas, being greatly alarmed, in consultation with Indra began to concert measures for interrupting the devout exercises of Dhruva. And, O great ascetics, the Kushmandas in company with Indra, assuming, various shapes actively engaged in obstructing his meditations. One assuming, by virtue of illusion, the shape of his mother Suniti, stood before him, with tears in his eyes, and saying in tender accents—"My son, desist from this penance, that is destroying thy health. I have after many troubles gained thee and have formed many hopes in thee. O child, it does not behove thee to forsake me, at the words of my rival, helpless, alone and unprotected. Thou art my only refuge. Thou art a boy of five years old. Such a hard penance doth not become thee. Desist therefore from such fearful practices which are not productive of any beneficial result. For thee this is the time of youthful pastime, then comes the season for study, then the period of worldly enjoyment and lastly that of austere devotion. O my boy, thou art but a child, this is the season of thy play—why hast thou thou engaged in asceticism to destroy thyself? Thy chief duty consists in thy devotion to me now. Do thou engage in such works as become thy age and circumstances. Be not guided by bewildering error and desist from such unrighteous actions, If thou dost not renounce to-day these devout austerities I shall terminate my life before thee". Parāçara said:—But Dhruva being wholly intent upon seeing Vishnu did not behold his mother weeping, with her eyes bleared with tears. "O child! O child! fly, the hideous Rākshasas, with uplifted weapons are coming this side of the forest". Saying this (the illusion) disappeared. Instantly crowded there the Rākshasas uplifting terrible arms and with countenances emitting fiery flame. They began to emit hideous cries before that prince and whirl and toss their threatening weapons. Hundreds of jackals, from whose mouths gushed out flame, while they expanded them, yelled horrible cries to appal the boy wholly engrossed by meditation. Those night-rangers cried out: "Kill him, kill him, tear him to pieces; eat him up, eat him up". And those goblins having faces of lions, and camels, and crocodiles, howled about to strike terror into the heart of the prince. All these (illusions of) Rākshasas and jackals, their cries and weapons made no impression upon his senses whose mind was completely given up to the meditation of Govinda. The son of the lord of earth, entirely taken up by one idea, beheld continually. Vishnu only seated in himself and saw no other object All these illusions being thus baffled the celestials were greatly disturbed. Being terrified at this discomfiture and afflicted by the devout austerities of the boy the celestials assembled and repaired in a body for help to Hari, who is the creator of the universe, and without beginning or end. The celestials said:—"O lord of the celestials! O lord of the world! O great god! O supreme spirit! being afflicted by the devout austerities of Dhruva, we have come to thee to seek thy refuge. As the moon increases in his orb day by day, so, O lord, (this boy) by his devotion is approaching incessantly superhuman power. O Janārddana, we have been greatly alarmed by the devout austerities of the son of Uttanpadā and have taken thy refuge: do thou desist him from his devout exercises. We do not know whose position, he aspireth to—whether the throne of Sakra, of the sun, of the lord of wealth or that of Varuna the lord of water.

"O lord, be propitiated with us, remove this mace of affliction from our breast and desist the son of Uttanpada from his devout exercises". The Great God (Vishnu) replied:—"He aspireth not to the throne of Indra, nor to the sovereignty of the solar orb or the deep, nor to the rank of the lord of riches. I shall soon confer on him, O celestials, what he desireth to have. Removed of your anxiety do you all proceed to your respective quarters—I shall soon desist that boy, whose mind is wholly engrossed with devout meditation".

Parāçara said:—Being thus addressed by Vishnu the celestials headed by the performer of hundred sacrifices, saluting him, repaired to their respective habitations. And that Great God, who is all things, being pleased with Dhruva's whole-minded devotedness to him, assuming his shape with four arms, approached him and said,—"May good betide thee, O son of Uttanapada! I am pleased with thy devout exercises. I have come here to confer boons on thee—do thou beg one, O thou of firm vows. Withdrawing thy mind from external objects while thou hast dedicated it to me alone—I am greatly pleased with thee; do thou therefore beg of me an excellent boon". Parāçara said—Hearing the words of that great God, the boy opened his eyes and beheld before him that Hari whom he had seen in his meditation. And beholding him with the conch, the discus, the mace, the bow and the scimitar in hand and crowned with a diadem, he bowed his head down to the earth. With his hair standing erect and being greatly stricken with fear, Dhruva addressed himself for worshipping that great God. Reflecting how he could offer thanks unto him, and what he could say in his praise, he was greatly perplexed with anxiety and then at last had recourse to that deity. Dhruva said,—"O great God if thou art greatly pleased with my devout exercise, do thou confer upon me this boon, that I may praise thee whenever I wish. O god, I am a boy, how shall I be able to sing thy glory, whom even the great sages like Brahmā, conversant with Vedas, have not been able to know sufficiently. My heart is filled with devotion to thee, O lord, do thou grant me the understanding of placing my praises at thy feet". Parāçara said,—O foremost of twice-born ones, the lord of the earth Govinda touched with the tip of his conch, the son of Uttanapada standing with jollied palms. And greatly pleased, that prince, bending low his head, praised that undecaying protector of living beings. Dhruva said,—"I bow unto Him whose forms are earth, water, fire, air, ether, mind, intellect, the first element, primæval nature, and the pure, subtle, all-pervading soul that excels nature. Salutation unto that Purusha who is devoid of qualities, pure, subtle, extending all over the earth, and who is separate from Prakriti; who is supreme over all elements, all objects of sense, intellect and who is separate even from Purusha. I seek refuge unto him, who is one with Brahmā, who is the soul of the whole universe, pure, and who is the foremost of all gods. Salutation unto that form of thine, O thou the soul of all things, which is designated as Brahmā by virtue of his pervading and maintaining the whole Universe, which is unchangeable and meditated upon by the sages. Thou art the great god pervading the whole universe with a thousand heads, a thousand eyes, a thousand feet and who passes ten inches beyond its contact. Thou art that excellent Purusha—whatever has been and whatever is to be. Thou art the progenitor of Virāt, Swarat, Samrāt, and Adipurusha. The lower and upper and middle parts of the earth are not without thee—the whole universe is from thee—whatever has been and whatever shall be. The whole universe is thy form and exists in thee. From thee is sacrifice derived, and all oblations and curds and ghee and animals of either class (domestic or wild). From thee the Rig Veda, the Shāma Veda, the metres of the Vedas and the Yajur Veda have sprung. Horses and cows having teeth in one jaw only have been created by thee and as well as goats, sheep and deer. Brahmanas originated from thy mouth; warriors from thy arms; Vaiçyas from thy thighs and Sudras from thy feet. From thine eyes came the Sun, from thy mind the moon, from thy central veins the Vital breath, from thy mouth the fire, from thy navel the sky, from thy head the heavens, from thy ears the regions and from thy feet the earth. And from thee the whole world was derived. As the wide-spreading Nyagrodha (Indian fig-tree) exists (before it grows up into a tree) in a small seed, so at the time of dissolution, the whole world exists in thee as its germ. As the Nyagrodha, originating from its seed, spread gradually into a huge tree, so the creation originating from thee expands itself into the universe. O lord, as nothing is visible of a plantain tree, except its bark and leaves, so nothing is seen in thee except the whole universe. The faculties of intellect that are the source of pleasure and pain exist in thee as one with all existence. But the sources of pleasure and pain, singly or blended, do not exist in thee freed as thou art from all qualities. Salutation to thee, who art the subtile rudiment, who art single when a cause, but manifold in actions. Salutation to thee, who art the proximate cause of life and action and identical with the great elements. Thou art manifest in spiritual knowledge, thou art the great Purusha, Brahmana, Brahmā and Manu. Thou art beheld by mental contemplation and imperishable. Thou abidest in all, art element of all; thou assumest all forms; all elements are from thee and thou art the soul of all—glory unto thee as thou art the soul of all, lord of all things—the origin of all things. What shall I speak unto thee, as thou knowest every thing, being seated in all hearts? O thou the soul of all thing, the sovereign lord of all creations-the source of all elements, thou knowest all creatures and their desires. O lord, do thou satisfy my desire. O lord of earth, my devout exercises have been crowned with success to-day since I have beheld thee". The Lord said:—"Thy devotion hath been crowned with success since thou hast beheld me, O Dhruva. The sight of me, never goes without any result, O prince. Do thou ask of me a boon, whatever thou wishest for; whenever I appear before men all their desires are satisfied". Dhruva said "O lord! O sovereign of all creatures, thou dost exist in the hearts of all. How can that be unknown to thee, O lord what I am cherishing in my mind? Yet O lord of celestials, I shall mention unto thee, the object hard to attain, which my presumptuous mind panteth after. But what can there be which cannot be got at, if thou art pleased, O creator of the universe; for it is by thy favour, that Indra enjoyed the sovereignty of three worlds. 'This regal throne is not for thee, since thou art not born of me'. These haughty words my step-mother addressed loudly unto me. By thy favour I beg of thee, O lord, an exalted station, which surpasses all others, which is the support of the universe and shall last for ever". The Lord said:—"Forsooth shalt thou attain to the station thou art soliciting for; for, O boy even in thy former birth, thou didst satisfy me (with thy austere devotion). Thou wast, in thy previous existence, a Brahmin, devoted with all thy heart unto me, ever dutiful to thy parents and always satisfying thy duties. In course of time, a prince became thy friend, who in his youth indulged in all sensual pleasures, who was of a beautiful appearance and bright form. While in his company and beholding his riches, hard to acquire, thou didst desire that you might be born as the son of a king. It is by virtue of that desire, thou art born as a prince in the mansion of Uttānpāda, O Dhruva, which cannot be easily obtained. The birth, in the race of Swambhuva, is considered by others, as a great boon, and for this I was propitiated by thee, O boy; but now thou art not valuing it so much. The man, who worships me, obtains in no time, liberation from life: what is the abode of celestials to one whose mind is centered in me, O boy! Thou shalt, by my favour, O Dhruva, attain to a station which is above the three worlds and become the stay of stars and planets: there is not the least doubt about it. I do confer upon thee, O Dhruva, a station, which is above those of the Sun, the Moon, stars, Mercury, Venus, Saturn and all other constellations; above the regions of the seven Rishis and the divinities who traverse the atmosphere. Some of the celestials live for four ages; some for the reign of a Manu; but thou shalt live the duration of a Kalpa. Thy mother, Sunoti too, metamorphosed into a clear star, shall exist by thee in the welkin for the same period. People singing thy glory, with concentrated minds, morning and evening, shall attain to an accession of piety". Parāçara said:—O thou of a great mind, obtaining this boon, from Janārddana, the sovereign of the celestials and the lord of earth, Dhurva attained to this excellent station. Beholding the increase of his honor and glory, the preceptor of the celestials and Asuras, Usānas, repeated these verses. "Oh how great is the strength of his austere devotion, and how mighty is the success thereof, since the seven Rishis are preceded by him. This too is Dhruva's mother Suniti, who is otherwise named Sunritā. Who on this earth, can recount her glory? Giving birth to Dhruva, she hath got at a station which is the refuge of the three worlds, and which is a station eminent above all. He, who shall celebrate the translation of Dhruva into the abode of the celestials, shall be released from his sins, and be adored in heaven. He shall not lose his station, either in this world, or in heaven (after death) and shall live long, possessed of every blessing".

verses.sa:
श्रीपराशर उवाच ॥
ध्रुवाच्छिष्टिं च भव्यं च भव्याच्छम्भुर्व्यजायत।
शिष्टेराधत्त सुच्छाया पञ्चपुत्रानकल्मषान् ॥
verses.rom:
shriparashara uvacha ||
dhruvachchhishtim cha bhavyam cha bhavyachchhambhurvyajayata|
shishteradhatta suchchhaya panchaputranakalmashan ||

verses.sa:
रिपुं रिपुञ्जयं विप्रं वृकलं वृकतेजसम्।
रिपोराधत्त बृहती चाक्षुषं सर्वतेजसम् ॥
verses.rom:
ripum ripunjayam vipram vrikalam vrikatejasam|
riporadhatta brihati chakshusham sarvatejasam ||

verses.sa:
अजीजनत्पुष्करिण्यां वारुण्यां चाक्षुषो मनुम्।
प्रजापतेरात्मजायां वीरणस्य महात्मनः ॥
verses.rom:
ajijanatpushkarinyam varunyam chakshusho manum|
prajapateratmajayam viranasya mahatmanah ||

verses.sa:
मनोरजायन्त दश नड्वलायां महौजसः
कन्यायां तपतां श्रेष्ठ वैराजस्य प्रजापतेः ॥
verses.rom:
manorajayanta dasha nadvalayam mahaujasah
kanyayam tapatam shreshtha vairajasya prajapateh ||

verses.sa:
कुरुः पुरुः शत द्युम्नस्तपस्वी सत्यवाञ्छुचिः।
अग्निष्टोमोतिरात्रश्च सुद्युम्नश्चेति ते नव।
अभिमन्युश्च दशमो नड्वलायां महौजसः ॥
verses.rom:
kuruh puruh shata dyumnastapasvi satyavanchhuchih|
agnishtomotiratrashcha sudyumnashcheti te nava|
abhimanyushcha dashamo nadvalayam mahaujasah ||

verses.sa:
कुरोरजनयत्पुत्रान् षडाग्नेयी महाप्रभान्।
अङ्गं सुमनसं ख्यातिं क्रतुमङ्गिरसं शिबिम् ॥
verses.rom:
kurorajanayatputran shadagneyi mahaprabhan|
angam sumanasam khyatim kratumangirasam shibim ||

verses.sa:
अङ्गात्सुनीथापत्यं वै वेनमेकमजायत।
प्रजार्थमृषयस्तस्य ममन्थुर्दक्षिणं करम् ॥
verses.rom:
angatsunithapatyam vai venamekamajayata|
prajarthamrishayastasya mamanthurdakshinam karam ||

verses.sa:
वेनस्य पाणौ मथिते सम्बभूव महामुने।
वैन्यो नाम महीपालो यः पृथुः परिकीर्त्तितः ॥
verses.rom:
venasya panau mathite sambabhuva mahamune|
vainyo nama mahipalo yah prithuh parikirttitah ||

verses.sa: येन दुग्धा मही पूर्वं प्रजानां हितकारणात् ॥
verses.rom: yena dugdha mahi purvam prajanam hitakaranat ||

verses.sa:
मैत्रेय उवाच
किमर्थं मथितः पाणिर्वेनस्य परमर्षिभिः।
यत्र जज्ञे महावीर्यः स पृथुर्मुनिसत्तम ॥
verses.rom:
maitreya uvacha
kimartham mathitah panirvenasya paramarshibhih|
yatra jajne mahaviryah sa prithurmunisattama ||

verses.sa:
श्रीपराशर उवाच
सुनीथा नाम या कन्या मृत्यो प्रथमतोऽभवत्।
अङ्गस्य भार्या सा दत्ता तस्यां वेनो व्यजायत ॥
verses.rom:
shriparashara uvacha
sunitha nama ya kanya mrityo prathamato'bhavat|
angasya bharya sa datta tasyam veno vyajayata ||

verses.sa:
स मातामहदोषेण तेन मृत्योः सुतात्मजः।
निसर्गादेष मैत्रेय दुष्ट एव व्यजायत ॥
verses.rom:
sa matamahadoshena tena mrityoh sutatmajah|
nisargadesha maitreya dushta eva vyajayata ||

verses.sa:
अभिषिक्तो यदा राज्ये स वेनः परमर्षिभिः।
घोषयामास स तदा पृथिव्यां पृथिवीपतिः ॥
verses.rom:
abhishikto yada rajye sa venah paramarshibhih|
ghoshayamasa sa tada prithivyam prithivipatih ||

verses.sa:
न यष्टव्यं न दातव्यं न होतव्यं कथञ्चन।
भोक्ता यज्ञस्य कस्त्वन्योऽह्यहं यज्ञपतिः प्रभुः ॥
verses.rom:
na yashtavyam na datavyam na hotavyam kathanchana|
bhokta yajnasya kastvanyo'hyaham yajnapatih prabhuh ||

verses.sa:
ततस्तमृषयः पूर्वं संपूज्यं पृथिवीपतिम्।
ऊचुः सामाकलं वाक्यं मैत्रेय समपस्थिताः ॥
verses.rom:
tatastamrishayah purvam sampujyam prithivipatim|
uchuh samakalam vakyam maitreya samapasthitah ||

verses.sa:
ऋषय ऊचुः।
भोभो राजन् शृणुष्व त्वं यद्वदाम महीपते।
राज्यं देहोपकाराय प्रजानां च हितं परम् ॥
verses.rom:
rishaya uchuh|
bhobho rajan shrinushva tvam yadvadama mahipate|
rajyam dehopakaraya prajanam cha hitam param ||

verses.sa:
दीर्घसत्रेण देवेशं सर्वयज्ञेश्वरं हरिम्।
पूजयिष्याम भद्रं। ते तस्यांशस्ते भविष्यति ॥
verses.rom:
dirghasatrena devesham sarvayajneshvaram harim|
pujayishyama bhadram| te tasyamshaste bhavishyati ||

verses.sa:
यज्ञेन यज्ञपुरुषो विष्णुः संप्रीणितो नृप।
अस्माभिर्भवतः कामान्सर्वानेव प्रदास्यति ॥
verses.rom:
yajnena yajnapurusho vishnuh samprinito nripa|
asmabhirbhavatah kamansarvaneva pradasyati ||

verses.sa:
यज्ञैर्यज्ञेश्वरो येषां राष्ट्रे संपूज्यते हरिः।
तेषां सर्वेप्सितावाप्तिं ददाति नृप भूभृताम् ॥
verses.rom:
yajnairyajneshvaro yesham rashtre sampujyate harih|
tesham sarvepsitavaptim dadati nripa bhubhritam ||

verses.sa:
वेन उवाच
मत्तः कोऽभ्यधिकोन्योस्ति कश्चाराध्यो ममापरः।
कोयं हरिरिति ख्यातो यो वो यज्ञेश्वरो मतः ॥
verses.rom:
vena uvacha
mattah ko'bhyadhikonyosti kashcharadhyo mamaparah|
koyam haririti khyato yo vo yajneshvaro matah ||

verses.sa:
ब्रह्मा जनार्दनः शम्भुरिन्द्रो। वायुर्यमो रविः।
हुतभुग्वरुणो धाता पूषा भूमिर्निंशाकरः ॥
verses.rom:
brahma janardanah shambhurindro| vayuryamo ravih|
hutabhugvaruno dhata pusha bhumirnimshakarah ||

verses.sa:
एते चान्ये च ये देवाः शापानुग्रहकारिणः।
नृपस्यैते शरीरस्थाः सर्वदेवमयो नृपः ॥
verses.rom:
ete chanye cha ye devah shapanugrahakarinah|
nripasyaite sharirasthah sarvadevamayo nripah ||

verses.sa:
एवं ज्ञास्वा मयाज्ञप्तं यद्यथा क्रियतां तथा।
न दातव्यं न यष्टव्यं न होतव्यं च भो द्विजाः ॥
verses.rom:
evam jnasva mayajnaptam yadyatha kriyatam tatha|
na datavyam na yashtavyam na hotavyam cha bho dvijah ||

verses.sa:
भर्तृशुश्रूषणं धर्मो यथा स्त्रीणां परो मतः
ममाज्ञापालनं धर्मो भवतां च तथा द्विजाः ॥
verses.rom:
bhartrishushrushanam dharmo yatha strinam paro matah
mamajnapalanam dharmo bhavatam cha tatha dvijah ||

verses.sa:
ऋषय ऊचुः
देह्यनुज्ञां महाराज मा धर्मो यातु संक्षयम्।
हविषां परिणामोऽयं यदेतदखिलं जगत् ॥
verses.rom:
rishaya uchuh
dehyanujnam maharaja ma dharmo yatu samkshayam|
havisham parinamo'yam yadetadakhilam jagat ||

verses.sa:
श्रीपराशर उवाच
इति विज्ञाप्यमानोऽपि स वेनः परमर्षिभिः।
यदा ददाति नानुज्ञां प्रोक्तः प्रोक्तः पुनः पुनः ॥
verses.rom:
shriparashara uvacha
iti vijnapyamano'pi sa venah paramarshibhih|
yada dadati nanujnam proktah proktah punah punah ||

verses.sa:
ततस्ते मुनयः सर्वे कोपामर्षसमन्विताः।
हन्यतां हन्यतां पाप इत्यूचुस्ते परस्परम् ॥
verses.rom:
tataste munayah sarve kopamarshasamanvitah|
hanyatam hanyatam papa ityuchuste parasparam ||

verses.sa:
यो यज्ञपुरुषं विष्णुमनादिनिधनं प्रभुम्।
विनिन्दत्यधमाचारो न स योग्यो भुवः पतिः ॥
verses.rom:
yo yajnapurusham vishnumanadinidhanam prabhum|
vinindatyadhamacharo na sa yogyo bhuvah patih ||

verses.sa:
इत्युक्त्वा मंत्रपूतैस्तैः कुशैर्मुनिगणानृपम्।
निजघ्नुर्निहतं पुर्वं भगवन्निन्दनादिना ॥
verses.rom:
ityuktva mamtraputaistaih kushairmunigananripam|
nijaghnurnihatam purvam bhagavannindanadina ||

verses.sa:
ततश्च मुनयो रेणुं ददृशुः सर्वतो द्विज।
किमेतदिति चासन्नात्पप्रच्छुस्ते जनास्तदा ॥
verses.rom:
tatashcha munayo renum dadrishuh sarvato dvija|
kimetaditi chasannatpaprachchhuste janastada ||

verses.sa:
आख्यातं च जनैस्तेषां चोरीभूतैरराजके।
राष्ट्रे तु लोकैरारब्धं परस्वादानमातुरैः ॥
verses.rom:
akhyatam cha janaistesham choribhutairarajake|
rashtre tu lokairarabdham parasvadanamaturaih ||

verses.sa:
तेषामुदीर्णवेगानां चोराणां मुनिसत्तमाः।
सुमहद्दृश्यते रेणुः परवित्तापहारिणाम् ॥
verses.rom:
teshamudirnaveganam choranam munisattamah|
sumahaddrishyate renuh paravittapaharinam ||

verses.sa:
ततः संमंत्र्! य ते सर्वे सुनयस्तस्य भूभृतः।
ममन्थुरूरुं पुत्रार्थमनपत्यस्य यत्नतः ॥
verses.rom:
tatah sammamtr! ya te sarve sunayastasya bhubhritah|
mamanthururum putrarthamanapatyasya yatnatah ||

verses.sa:
मथ्यमानात्समुत्तस्थौ तस्योरोः पुरुषः किल।
दग्धस्थूणाप्रतीकाशः खल्वाटास्योतिह्रस्वकः ॥
verses.rom:
mathyamanatsamuttasthau tasyoroh purushah kila|
dagdhasthunapratikashah khalvatasyotihrasvakah ||

verses.sa:
किं करोमीति तान्सर्वान्स विप्रानाह चातुरः।
निषीदेति तमूचुस्ते निषादस्तेन सोऽभवत् ॥
verses.rom:
kim karomiti tansarvansa vipranaha chaturah|
nishideti tamuchuste nishadastena so'bhavat ||

verses.sa:
ततस्तत्संभवा जाता विन्ध्यशैलनिवासिनः।
निषादा मुनिशार्दूल पापकर्मोपलक्षणाः ॥
verses.rom:
tatastatsambhava jata vindhyashailanivasinah|
nishada munishardula papakarmopalakshanah ||

verses.sa:
तेन द्वारेण तत्पापं निष्क्रान्तं तस्य भूपतेः।
निषादास्ते ततो जाता वेनकल्मषनाशनाः ॥
verses.rom:
tena dvarena tatpapam nishkrantam tasya bhupateh|
nishadaste tato jata venakalmashanashanah ||

verses.sa: तस्यैव दक्षिणं हस्तं ममन्थुस्ते ततो द्विजाः ॥
verses.rom: tasyaiva dakshinam hastam mamanthuste tato dvijah ||

verses.sa:
मथ्यमाने च तत्राभूत्पृथुर्वैन्यः प्रतापवान्।
दीप्यमानः स्ववपुषा साक्षादग्निरिव ज्वलन् ॥
verses.rom:
mathyamane cha tatrabhutprithurvainyah pratapavan|
dipyamanah svavapusha sakshadagniriva jvalan ||

verses.sa:
आद्यमाजगवं नाम खात्पपात ततो धनुः।
शराश्च दिव्या नभसः कवचं च पपात ह ॥
verses.rom:
adyamajagavam nama khatpapata tato dhanuh|
sharashcha divya nabhasah kavacham cha papata ha ||

verses.sa: तस्मिन् जाते तु भूतानि संप्रहृष्टानि सर्वशः ॥
verses.rom: tasmin jate tu bhutani samprahrishtani sarvashah ||

verses.sa:
सत्पुत्रेणैव जातेन वेनोपि त्रिदिवं ययौ।
पुन्नाम्नो नरकात् त्रातः सुतेन सुमहात्मना ॥
verses.rom:
satputrenaiva jatena venopi tridivam yayau|
punnamno narakat tratah sutena sumahatmana ||

verses.sa:
तं समुद्रा श्च नद्यश्च रत्नान्यादाय सर्वशः।
तोयानि चाभिषेकार्थं सर्वाण्येवोपतस्थिरे ॥
verses.rom:
tam samudra shcha nadyashcha ratnanyadaya sarvashah|
toyani chabhishekartham sarvanyevopatasthire ||

verses.sa:
पितामहश्च भगवान्देवैराङ्गिरसैः सह।
स्थावराणि च भूतानि जङ्गमानि च सर्वशः।
समागम्य तदा वैन्यमभ्यसिञ्चन्नराधिपम् ॥
verses.rom:
pitamahashcha bhagavandevairangirasaih saha|
sthavarani cha bhutani jangamani cha sarvashah|
samagamya tada vainyamabhyasinchannaradhipam ||

verses.sa:
हस्ते तु दक्षिणे चक्रं दृष्ट्वा तस्य पितामहः।
विष्णोरंशं पृथुं मत्वा परितोषं परं ययौ ॥
verses.rom:
haste tu dakshine chakram drishtva tasya pitamahah|
vishnoramsham prithum matva paritosham param yayau ||

verses.sa:
विष्णुचक्र करे चिह्नं सर्वेषां चक्रवर्तिनाम्।
भवत्यव्याहतो यस्य प्रभावस्त्रिदशैरपि ॥
verses.rom:
vishnuchakra kare chihnam sarvesham chakravartinam|
bhavatyavyahato yasya prabhavastridashairapi ||

verses.sa:
महता राजराज्येन पृथुर्वैन्यः प्रतापवान्।
सोभिषिक्तो महातेजा विधिवद्धर्मको विदै ॥
verses.rom:
mahata rajarajyena prithurvainyah pratapavan|
sobhishikto mahateja vidhivaddharmako vidai ||

verses.sa:
पित्रा पराजितास्तस्य प्रजास्तेनानुरञ्जिताः।
अनुरागात्ततस्तस्य नाम राजेत्यजायत ॥
verses.rom:
pitra parajitastasya prajastenanuranjitah|
anuragattatastasya nama rajetyajayata ||

verses.sa:
आपस्तस्तंभिरे चास्य समुद्र मभियास्यतः।
पर्वताश्च ददुर्मार्गं ध्वजभङ्गश्च नाभवत् ॥
verses.rom:
apastastambhire chasya samudra mabhiyasyatah|
parvatashcha dadurmargam dhvajabhangashcha nabhavat ||

verses.sa:
अकृष्टपच्या पृथिवी सिद्धन्त्यन्नानि चिंतया।
सर्वकामदुघा गावः पुटके पुटके मधु ॥
verses.rom:
akrishtapachya prithivi siddhantyannani chimtaya|
sarvakamadugha gavah putake putake madhu ||

verses.sa:
तस्य वै जातमात्रस्य यज्ञे पैतामहे शुभे।
सूतः सूत्यां समुत्पन्नः सौत्येऽहनि महामतिः ॥
verses.rom:
tasya vai jatamatrasya yajne paitamahe shubhe|
sutah sutyam samutpannah sautye'hani mahamatih ||

verses.sa:
तस्मिन्नेव महायज्ञेजज्ञे प्राज्ञेऽथ मागधः।
प्रोक्तौ तदा मुनिवरैस्तावुभौ सूतमागधौ ॥
verses.rom:
tasminneva mahayajnejajne prajne'tha magadhah|
proktau tada munivaraistavubhau sutamagadhau ||

verses.sa:
स्तूयतामेष नृपतिः पृथुर्वैन्यः प्रतापवान्।
कर्मैतदनुरूपं वां पात्रं स्तोत्रस्य चापरम् ॥
verses.rom:
stuyatamesha nripatih prithurvainyah pratapavan|
karmaitadanurupam vam patram stotrasya chaparam ||

verses.sa:
ततस्तावूचतुर्विप्रान्सर्वानेव कृताञ्जली।
अद्य जातस्य नो कर्म ज्ञायतेस्य महीपतेः ॥
verses.rom:
tatastavuchaturvipransarvaneva kritanjali|
adya jatasya no karma jnayatesya mahipateh ||

verses.sa:
गुणा न चास्य ज्ञायन्ते न चास्य प्रथितं यशः।
स्तोत्रं किमाश्रयं त्वस्य कार्यमस्माभिरुच्यताम् ॥
verses.rom:
guna na chasya jnayante na chasya prathitam yashah|
stotram kimashrayam tvasya karyamasmabhiruchyatam ||

verses.sa:
ऋषय ऊचुः।
करिष्यत्येष यत्कर्म चक्रवर्ती महाबलः।
गुणा भविष्या ये चास्य तैरयं स्तूयतां नृपः ॥
verses.rom:
rishaya uchuh|
karishyatyesha yatkarma chakravarti mahabalah|
guna bhavishya ye chasya tairayam stuyatam nripah ||

verses.sa:
श्रीपराशर उवाच
ततः स नृपतिस्तोषं तच्छ्रत्वा परमं ययौ।
सद्गुणैः श्लाघ्यतामेति तस्माच्छ्लाघ्या गुणा मम ॥
verses.rom:
shriparashara uvacha
tatah sa nripatistosham tachchhratva paramam yayau|
sadgunaih shlaghyatameti tasmachchhlaghya guna mama ||

verses.sa:
तस्माद्यदद्य स्तोत्रेण गुणनिर्वर्णनं त्विमौ।
करिष्येते करिष्यामि तदेवाहं समाहितः ॥
verses.rom:
tasmadyadadya stotrena gunanirvarnanam tvimau|
karishyete karishyami tadevaham samahitah ||

verses.sa:
यदिमौ वर्जनीयं च किंचिदत्र वदिष्यतः।
तदहं वर्जयिष्यामीत्येवं चक्रे मतिं नृपः ॥
verses.rom:
yadimau varjaniyam cha kimchidatra vadishyatah|
tadaham varjayishyamityevam chakre matim nripah ||

verses.sa:
अथ तौ चक्रतुः स्तोत्रं पृथोर्वैन्यस्य धीमतः।
भविष्यैः कर्मभिः सम्यक्सुस्वरौ सूतमागधौ ॥
verses.rom:
atha tau chakratuh stotram prithorvainyasya dhimatah|
bhavishyaih karmabhih samyaksusvarau sutamagadhau ||

verses.sa:
सत्यवाग्दानशीलोयं सत्यसन्धो नरेश्वरः।
ह्रीमान्मैत्रः क्षमाशीलो विक्रान्तो दुष्टशासनः ॥
verses.rom:
satyavagdanashiloyam satyasandho nareshvarah|
hrimanmaitrah kshamashilo vikranto dushtashasanah ||

verses.sa:
धर्मज्ञश्च कृतज्ञश्च दयावान् प्रियभाषकः।
मान्यान्मानयिता यज्वा ब्रह्मण्यः साधुसम्मतः ॥
verses.rom:
dharmajnashcha kritajnashcha dayavan priyabhashakah|
manyanmanayita yajva brahmanyah sadhusammatah ||

verses.sa: समः शत्रौ च मित्रे च व्यवहारस्थितौ नृपः ॥
verses.rom: samah shatrau cha mitre cha vyavaharasthitau nripah ||

verses.sa:
सूतेनोक्तान् गुणानित्थं स तदा मागधेन च।
चकार हृदि तादृक् च कर्मणा कृतवानसौ ॥
verses.rom:
sutenoktan gunanittham sa tada magadhena cha|
chakara hridi tadrik cha karmana kritavanasau ||

verses.sa:
ततस्तु पृथिवीपालः पालयन्पृथिवीमिमाम्।
इयाज विविधैर्यज्ञैर्महद्भिर्भूरिदक्षिणैः ॥
verses.rom:
tatastu prithivipalah palayanprithivimimam|
iyaja vividhairyajnairmahadbhirbhuridakshinaih ||

verses.sa:
तं प्रजाः पृथिवीनाथमुपतस्थुः क्षुधार्दिताः।
ओषधीषु प्रणष्टासु तस्मिन्काले ह्यराजके।
तमूचुस्ते नताः पृष्टास्तत्रागमनकारणम् ॥
verses.rom:
tam prajah prithivinathamupatasthuh kshudharditah|
oshadhishu pranashtasu tasminkale hyarajake|
tamuchuste natah prishtastatragamanakaranam ||

verses.sa:
प्रजा ऊचुः
अराजके नृपश्रेष्ठ धरित्र्! या सकलौषधीः।
ग्रस्तास्ततः क्षयं यान्ति प्रजाः सर्वाः प्रजेश्वर ॥
verses.rom:
praja uchuh
arajake nripashreshtha dharitr! ya sakalaushadhih|
grastastatah kshayam yanti prajah sarvah prajeshvara ||

verses.sa:
त्वन्नो वृत्तिप्रदो धात्रा प्रजापालो निरूपितः।
देहि नः क्षुत्परीतानां प्रजानां जीवनौषधीः ॥
verses.rom:
tvanno vrittiprado dhatra prajapalo nirupitah|
dehi nah kshutparitanam prajanam jivanaushadhih ||

verses.sa:
श्रीपराशर उवाच
ततस्तु नपतिर्दिव्यमादायजगवं धनुः।
शरांश्च दिव्यान्कुपितः सोन्वधावद्वसुन्धराम् ॥
verses.rom:
shriparashara uvacha
tatastu napatirdivyamadayajagavam dhanuh|
sharamshcha divyankupitah sonvadhavadvasundharam ||

verses.sa:
ततो ननाश त्वरिता गौर्भूत्वा च वसुन्धरा।
सा लोकान्ब्रह्मलोकादीन्संत्रासादगमन्मही ॥
verses.rom:
tato nanasha tvarita gaurbhutva cha vasundhara|
sa lokanbrahmalokadinsamtrasadagamanmahi ||

verses.sa:
यत्र यत्र ययौ देवी सा तदा भूतधारिणी।
तत्र तत्र तु सा वैन्यं ददृशो!ऽभ्युद्यतायुधम् ॥
verses.rom:
yatra yatra yayau devi sa tada bhutadharini|
tatra tatra tu sa vainyam dadrisho!'bhyudyatayudham ||

verses.sa:
ततस्तं प्राह वसुधा पृथुं राजपराक्रमम्।
प्रवेपमाना तद्बाणपरित्राणपरायणा ॥
verses.rom:
tatastam praha vasudha prithum rajaparakramam|
pravepamana tadbanaparitranaparayana ||

verses.sa:
पृथिव्युवाच
स्त्रीवधे त्वं महापापं किं नरेन्द्र। न पश्यसि।
येन मां हंतुमत्यर्थं प्रकरोषि नृपोद्यमम् ॥
verses.rom:
prithivyuvacha
strivadhe tvam mahapapam kim narendra| na pashyasi|
yena mam hamtumatyartham prakaroshi nripodyamam ||

verses.sa:
पृथुरुवाच
एकस्मिन् यत्र निधनं प्रापिते दुष्टकारिणि।
बहूनां भवति क्षेमं तस्य पुण्यप्रदो वधः ॥
verses.rom:
prithuruvacha
ekasmin yatra nidhanam prapite dushtakarini|
bahunam bhavati kshemam tasya punyaprado vadhah ||

verses.sa:
पृथिव्युवाच
प्रजानामुपकाराय यदि मां त्वं हनिष्यसि
आधारः कः प्रजानां ते नृपश्रेष्ठ भविष्यति ॥
verses.rom:
prithivyuvacha
prajanamupakaraya yadi mam tvam hanishyasi
adharah kah prajanam te nripashreshtha bhavishyati ||

verses.sa:
पृथुरुवाच
त्वां हत्वा वसुधे बाणैर्मच्छासनपराङ्मुखीम्।
आत्मयोगबलेनेमा धारयिष्याम्यहं प्रजाः ॥
verses.rom:
prithuruvacha
tvam hatva vasudhe banairmachchhasanaparanmukhim|
atmayogabalenema dharayishyamyaham prajah ||

verses.sa:
श्रीपराशर उवाच
ततः प्रणम्य वसुधा तं भूयः प्राह पार्थिवम्।
प्रवेपिताङ्गी परमं साध्वसं समुपागता ॥
verses.rom:
shriparashara uvacha
tatah pranamya vasudha tam bhuyah praha parthivam|
pravepitangi paramam sadhvasam samupagata ||

verses.sa:
पृथिव्युवाच
उपायतः समारब्धाः सर्वे सिद्ध्यन्त्युपक्रमाः।
तस्माद्वदाम्युपायं ते तं कुरुष्व यदीच्छसि ॥
verses.rom:
prithivyuvacha
upayatah samarabdhah sarve siddhyantyupakramah|
tasmadvadamyupayam te tam kurushva yadichchhasi ||

verses.sa:
समस्ता या मया जीर्णा नरनाथ महौषधीः।
यदीच्छसि प्रदास्यामि ताः क्षीरपरिणामिनीः ॥
verses.rom:
samasta ya maya jirna naranatha mahaushadhih|
yadichchhasi pradasyami tah kshiraparinaminih ||

verses.sa:
तस्मात्प्रजाहितार्थाय मम धर्मभृतां वर।
तं तु वत्सं कुरुष्व त्वं क्षरेयं येन वत्सला ॥
verses.rom:
tasmatprajahitarthaya mama dharmabhritam vara|
tam tu vatsam kurushva tvam kshareyam yena vatsala ||

verses.sa:
समां च कुरु सर्वत्र येन क्षीरं समंततः।
वरौषधीबीजभूतं बीजं सर्वत्र भावये ॥
verses.rom:
samam cha kuru sarvatra yena kshiram samamtatah|
varaushadhibijabhutam bijam sarvatra bhavaye ||

verses.sa:
श्रीपराशर उवाच
तत उत्सारयामास शैलान् शतसहस्रशः।
धनुष्कोट्या पदा वैन्यस्तेन शैला विवर्द्धिताः ॥
verses.rom:
shriparashara uvacha
tata utsarayamasa shailan shatasahasrashah|
dhanushkotya pada vainyastena shaila vivarddhitah ||

verses.sa:
न हि पूर्वविसर्गे वै विषमे पृथिवीतले।
प्रविभागः पुराणां वा ग्रामाणां वा पुराऽभवत् ॥
verses.rom:
na hi purvavisarge vai vishame prithivitale|
pravibhagah puranam va gramanam va pura'bhavat ||

verses.sa:
न सस्यानि न गोरक्ष्यं न कृषिर्न वणिक्पथः।
वैन्यात्प्रभृति मैत्रेय सर्वस्यैतस्य सम्भवः ॥
verses.rom:
na sasyani na gorakshyam na krishirna vanikpathah|
vainyatprabhriti maitreya sarvasyaitasya sambhavah ||

verses.sa:
यत्रयत्र समं त्वस्य भूमेरासीद्द्विजोत्तम।
तत्रतत्र प्रजाः सर्वा निवासं समरोचयत् ॥
verses.rom:
yatrayatra samam tvasya bhumerasiddvijottama|
tatratatra prajah sarva nivasam samarochayat ||

verses.sa:
आहारः फलमूलानि प्रजानामभवत्तदा।
कृच्छ्रेण महता सोपि प्रणष्टास्वौषदीषु वै ॥
verses.rom:
aharah phalamulani prajanamabhavattada|
krichchhrena mahata sopi pranashtasvaushadishu vai ||

verses.sa:
स कल्पयित्वा वत्सं तु मनुं स्वायंभुवं प्रभुम्।
स्वपाणौ पृथिवीनाथो दुदोह पृथिवीं पृथुः।
सस्यजातानि सर्वाणि प्रजानां हितकाम्यया ॥
verses.rom:
sa kalpayitva vatsam tu manum svayambhuvam prabhum|
svapanau prithivinatho dudoha prithivim prithuh|
sasyajatani sarvani prajanam hitakamyaya ||

verses.sa: तेनान्नेन प्रजास्तात वर्तन्तेद्यापि नित्यशः ॥
verses.rom: tenannena prajastata vartantedyapi nityashah ||

verses.sa:
प्राणप्रदाता स पृथुर्यस्माद्भूमेरभूत्पिता।
ततस्तु पृथिवीसंज्ञामवापाखिलधारिणी ॥
verses.rom:
pranapradata sa prithuryasmadbhumerabhutpita|
tatastu prithivisamjnamavapakhiladharini ||

verses.sa:
ततश्च देवैर्मुनिभिर्दैत्यै रक्षोभिरद्रि भिः।
गन्धर्वैरुरगैर्यक्षैः पितृभिस्तरुभिस्तथा ॥
verses.rom:
tatashcha devairmunibhirdaityai rakshobhiradri bhih|
gandharvairuragairyakshaih pitribhistarubhistatha ||

verses.sa:
तत्तत्पात्रमुपादाय तत्तद्दुग्धं मुने पयः।
वत्सदोग्धृविश्षोआ!श्च तेषां तद्योनयोऽभवन् ॥
verses.rom:
tattatpatramupadaya tattaddugdham mune payah|
vatsadogdhrivishshoa!shcha tesham tadyonayo'bhavan ||

verses.sa:
सैषा धात्री विधात्री च धारिणी पोषणी तथा।
सर्वस्य तु ततः पृथ्वी विष्णुपादतलोद्भवा ॥
verses.rom:
saisha dhatri vidhatri cha dharini poshani tatha|
sarvasya tu tatah prithvi vishnupadatalodbhava ||

verses.sa:
एवं प्रभावस्स पृथुः पुत्रो वैन्यस्य वीर्यवान्।
जज्ञे महीपतिः पूर्वो राजाभूज्जनरञ्जनात् ॥
verses.rom:
evam prabhavassa prithuh putro vainyasya viryavan|
jajne mahipatih purvo rajabhujjanaranjanat ||

verses.sa:
य इदं जन्म वैन्यस्य पृथोः संकीर्त्तरेन्नरः।
न तस्य दुष्कृतं किंचित्फलदायि प्रजायते ॥
verses.rom:
ya idam janma vainyasya prithoh samkirttarennarah|
na tasya dushkritam kimchitphaladayi prajayate ||

verses.sa:
दुस्स्वप्नोपशमं नॄणां शृण्वतामेतदुत्तमम्।
पृथोर्जन्म प्रभावश्च करोति सततं नृणाम् ॥
verses.rom:
dussvapnopashamam nrinam shrinvatametaduttamam|
prithorjanma prabhavashcha karoti satatam nrinam ||

verses.sa: इति श्रीविष्णुपुराणे प्रथमेंशे त्रयोदशोध्यायः ॥
verses.rom: iti shrivishnupurane prathamemshe trayodashodhyayah ||

verses.sa:
ध्रुवाच्छिष्टिञ्च भव्यञ्च भव्याच्छम्भुर्व्यजायत ।
शिष्टरोधत्त सुच्छाया पञ्च पुत्रानकाल्मषान् ॥
verses.rom:
dhruvachchhishtincha bhavyancha bhavyachchhambhurvyajayata |
shishtarodhatta suchchhaya pancha putranakalmashan ||

verses.sa:
रिपुं रिपुञ्जयं विप्रं वृकलं वृकतेजसम् ।
रिपोराधत्त बृहती चाक्षुषं सर्वतेजसम् ॥
verses.rom:
ripum ripunjayam vipram vrikalam vrikatejasam |
riporadhatta brihati chakshusham sarvatejasam ||

verses.sa:
अजीजनत् पुष्करिण्यां वारुण्यां चाक्षुषो मनुम् ।
प्रजापतेरात्मजायामरणयस्य महात्मनः ॥
verses.rom:
ajijanat pushkarinyam varunyam chakshusho manum |
prajapateratmajayamaranayasya mahatmanah ||

verses.sa:
मनोरजायन्त दश नदूलायां मबौजसः ।
कन्यायां जगतां श्वेष्ठ वैराजस्य प्रजापतेः ॥
verses.rom:
manorajayanta dasha nadulayam mabaujasah |
kanyayam jagatam shveshtha vairajasya prajapateh ||

verses.sa:
उरुः पुरुः शतद्यु म्नस्तपस्वी सत्यवाक् कविः ।
अग्निष्टोमोऽतिरात्रश्व सुद्युम्नश्चेति ते न व ॥
verses.rom:
uruh puruh shatadyu mnastapasvi satyavak kavih |
agnishtomo'tiratrashva sudyumnashcheti te na va ||

verses.sa:
अबिमन्युश्च दशामो नदूलायां महौजसः ।
ऊरोरजनयत् पुत्रान् षड़ाग्नेयी महाप्रभान् ॥
verses.rom:
abimanyushcha dashamo nadulayam mahaujasah |
urorajanayat putran sharagneyi mahaprabhan ||

verses.sa:
अङ्ग समनसं स्वातिं क्रतुमह्किरसं शिवम् ।
अङ्गात् सुनीथापत्यं वै वेणमेकमजायत ॥
verses.rom:
anga samanasam svatim kratumahkirasam shivam |
angat sunithapatyam vai venamekamajayata ||

verses.sa:
प्रजार्थमृषयस्तस्य ममन्थुर्दक्षिणां करम् ।
वेणस्य पाणौ मथिते सम्बबूव महामुने ॥
verses.rom:
prajarthamrishayastasya mamanthurdakshinam karam |
venasya panau mathite sambabuva mahamune ||

verses.sa:
वैण्यो नाम महीपालो यछ पृथुः परिकीत्तिंतः ।
येन दुग्धा मही पूर्वं प्रजानां हितकारणात् ॥
verses.rom:
vainyo nama mahipalo yachha prithuh parikittimtah |
yena dugdha mahi purvam prajanam hitakaranat ||

verses.sa:
किमर्थं मथितः पाणिर्वेणास्य परमर्षिभिः ।
यत्र यज्ञे महावीर्य्यः स पृथुर्मुनिसत्तमः ॥
verses.rom:
kimartham mathitah panirvenasya paramarshibhih |
yatra yajne mahaviryyah sa prithurmunisattamah ||

verses.sa:
सुनीथा नाम या कन्या मृत्योः प्रथमतोऽभवत् ।
अङ्गस्य भार्या सा दत्ता तस्यां वेणो व्यजायत ॥
verses.rom:
sunitha nama ya kanya mrityoh prathamato'bhavat |
angasya bharya sa datta tasyam veno vyajayata ||

verses.sa:
समातामहदोषेण तेन मृत्योः सुतात्मजः ।
निसर्गदेव मैत्रेय दुष्ट एव व्यजायत ॥
verses.rom:
samatamahadoshena tena mrityoh sutatmajah |
nisargadeva maitreya dushta eva vyajayata ||

verses.sa:
अभिषिक्तो यदा राज्ये स वेणः परमर्षिभिः ।
घोषयामास तदा पृथिव्यां पृथिवीपतिः ॥
verses.rom:
abhishikto yada rajye sa venah paramarshibhih |
ghoshayamasa tada prithivyam prithivipatih ||

verses.sa:
न यष्टव्यं न होतव्यं न दातव्यं कदाचन ।
भोक्ता यज्ञस्य कस्त्वन्यो ह्महं यज्ञपतिः प्रभुः ॥
verses.rom:
na yashtavyam na hotavyam na datavyam kadachana |
bhokta yajnasya kastvanyo hmaham yajnapatih prabhuh ||

verses.sa:
ततस्तमृषयः पूर्व संपूज्य जगतीपतिम् ।
उचुः सामकलं सम्यङू मैत्रेय समुपस्थिताः ॥
verses.rom:
tatastamrishayah purva sampujya jagatipatim |
uchuh samakalam samyanu maitreya samupasthitah ||

verses.sa:
भो भो राजन् श्वृणुष्व त्वं यदू वदामस्तव प्रभो ।
राज्यदेहोपकाराय प्रजानाञ्च हितं परम् ॥
verses.rom:
bho bho rajan shvrinushva tvam yadu vadamastava prabho |
rajyadehopakaraya prajanancha hitam param ||

verses.sa:
दीर्घसत्रेण देवेशं सर्व्वयज्ञेश्वरं हरिम् ।
पूजयिष्याम भद्रं ते तस्यांशस्ते भविष्यति ॥
verses.rom:
dirghasatrena devesham sarvvayajneshvaram harim |
pujayishyama bhadram te tasyamshaste bhavishyati ||

verses.sa:
यज्ञेन यज्ञपुरुषो हरिः संप्रीणितो नृप ।
अस्माभिर्भवतः कामान् सर्वानेव प्रदास्यति ॥
verses.rom:
yajnena yajnapurusho harih samprinito nripa |
asmabhirbhavatah kaman sarvaneva pradasyati ||

verses.sa:
यज्ञैर्यज्ञश्वेरो येषां राष्टे संपूज्यते हरिः ।
तेषां सर्वेप्सितावाप्तिं ददाति नृप भूभृताम् ॥
verses.rom:
yajnairyajnashvero yesham rashte sampujyate harih |
tesham sarvepsitavaptim dadati nripa bhubhritam ||

verses.sa:
मत्तः कोऽभ्यधिकोऽन्योऽस्ति यश्वाराध्यो ममापरः ।
कोऽयं हरिरिति ख्यातो योऽयं यज्ञ श्वरो मतः ॥
verses.rom:
mattah ko'bhyadhiko'nyo'sti yashvaradhyo mamaparah |
ko'yam haririti khyato yo'yam yajna shvaro matah ||

verses.sa:
ब्रह्मा जनार्दनः शम्भुरिन्द्रो वायुर्यमो रविः ।
हुतभुग वरुणो धाता पूषा भूमिर्निशाकरः ॥
verses.rom:
brahma janardanah shambhurindro vayuryamo ravih |
hutabhuga varuno dhata pusha bhumirnishakarah ||

verses.sa:
एते चान्ये च ये देवाः शापानुग्रहकारिणः ।
नृपस्यैते शरीरस्थाः सर्व्वदेवमयो नृपः ॥
verses.rom:
ete chanye cha ye devah shapanugrahakarinah |
nripasyaite sharirasthah sarvvadevamayo nripah ||

verses.sa:
एतजूज्ञात्वा मयाज्ञप्तं यथावत् क्रियतां तथा ।
दातव्यं न होतव्यं न यष्टव्यञ्च वो द्रिजाः ॥
verses.rom:
etajujnatva mayajnaptam yathavat kriyatam tatha |
datavyam na hotavyam na yashtavyancha vo drijah ||

verses.sa:
भर्दृ शुश्व षणां धर्म्मो यथा स्त्रीणां परो मतः ।
ममाज्ञापालनं धर्म्मो भवताञ्च तथा द्रिजाः ॥
verses.rom:
bhardri shushva shanam dharmmo yatha strinam paro matah |
mamajnapalanam dharmmo bhavatancha tatha drijah ||

verses.sa:
देह्मनुज्ञां महाराज मा धर्म्मो यातु संक्षयम् ।
हविषां परिणामोऽयं यदेतदखिलं जगत् ॥
verses.rom:
dehmanujnam maharaja ma dharmmo yatu samkshayam |
havisham parinamo'yam yadetadakhilam jagat ||

verses.sa:
इति वज्ञौप्यमानोऽपि स वेणः परमर्षिबिः ।
यदा ददाति नानज्ञां प्रोक्तः प्रोक्तः पुनः पुनः ॥
verses.rom:
iti vajnaupyamano'pi sa venah paramarshibih |
yada dadati nanajnam proktah proktah punah punah ||

verses.sa:
ततस्तु मुनयः सर्वे कोपामर्।समन्विताः ।
हन्यतां हन्यतां पाप इत्यूचुस्ते परस्परम् ॥
verses.rom:
tatastu munayah sarve kopamar|samanvitah |
hanyatam hanyatam papa ityuchuste parasparam ||

verses.sa:
यो यज्ञापुरुषं देवमनादिनिधनं प्रबुम् ।
विनिन्दत्यधमाचारो न स योग्यो भुवः पतिः ॥
verses.rom:
yo yajnapurusham devamanadinidhanam prabum |
vinindatyadhamacharo na sa yogyo bhuvah patih ||

verses.sa:
इत्युत्तवा मन्त्रपूतैस्तैः कुशैर्मुनिगणा नृपम् ।
निजध्नुर्निहतं पूर्वं भगावन्निन्दनादिना ॥
verses.rom:
ityuttava mantraputaistaih kushairmunigana nripam |
nijadhnurnihatam purvam bhagavannindanadina ||

verses.sa:
ततश्च मुनयोः रेणुं ददृशुः सर्वतो द्रिज ।
किमेतदिति चासन्नं पप्रच्छुस्ते जनं तदा ॥
verses.rom:
tatashcha munayoh renum dadrishuh sarvato drija |
kimetaditi chasannam paprachchhuste janam tada ||

verses.sa:
अखायतञ्च जनैस्तेषां चैरीभूतैरराजके ।
राष्ट्र तु लोकैरारश्धं परस्वादानमातुरैः ॥
verses.rom:
akhayatancha janaistesham chairibhutairarajake |
rashtra tu lokairarashdham parasvadanamaturaih ||

verses.sa:
तेषामुदीर्णावेगानां चौराणां मुनिसत्तमः ।
सुमहान् दृश्यते रेणुः परवित्तापहरिणाम् ॥
verses.rom:
teshamudirnaveganam chauranam munisattamah |
sumahan drishyate renuh paravittapaharinam ||

verses.sa:
ततः समंमन्त्र्य ते सर्व्वे मुनयस्तस्य भूभृतः ।
ममन्थुरूरुं पुत्रार्थम् अनपत्यस्य यत्नातः ॥
verses.rom:
tatah samammantrya te sarvve munayastasya bhubhritah |
mamanthururum putrartham anapatyasya yatnatah ||

verses.sa:
मथ्यतश्व समुत्तस्थौ तस्योरोः पुरुषः किल ।
दग्धस्थूणाप्रतीकाशः सर्बटास्योऽतिह्नस्वकः ॥
verses.rom:
mathyatashva samuttasthau tasyoroh purushah kila |
dagdhasthunapratikashah sarbatasyo'tihnasvakah ||

verses.sa:
किं करोमीति तान् सर्व्वान् विप्रान् प्राह त्वरान्वितः ।
निषीदेति तमूचुस्ते निषादस्तेन सोऽभवत् ॥
verses.rom:
kim karomiti tan sarvvan vipran praha tvaranvitah |
nishideti tamuchuste nishadastena so'bhavat ||

verses.sa:
ततस्ततूसम्भवा जाता विन्ध्यशैलनिवासिनः ।
निषादा मुनिशाद्दूल पापकर्मोपलक्षणाः ॥
verses.rom:
tatastatusambhava jata vindhyashailanivasinah |
nishada munishaddula papakarmopalakshanah ||

verses.sa:
तेन द्रारेणा पापं निष्क्रान्तं तस्य भूपतेः ।
निषादास्ते ततो जाता वेणकल्मषनाशानाः ॥
verses.rom:
tena drarena papam nishkrantam tasya bhupateh |
nishadaste tato jata venakalmashanashanah ||

verses.sa:
ततोऽस्य दक्षिणां हस्तं ममन्थुस्तस्य ते द्विजाः ।
मथ्यमाने च तत्राभूत् पृथुर्वैण्यः प्रतापवान् ॥
verses.rom:
tato'sya dakshinam hastam mamanthustasya te dvijah |
mathyamane cha tatrabhut prithurvainyah pratapavan ||

verses.sa:
दीप्यमानः स वपुषा साक्षादग्निरिव ज्वलन् ।
आद्यमाजगवं नाम खात् पपाग ततो धनुः ॥
verses.rom:
dipyamanah sa vapusha sakshadagniriva jvalan |
adyamajagavam nama khat papaga tato dhanuh ||

verses.sa:
शराश्व दिव्या नभसः कवचञ्च पपात ह ।
तस्मिन् जाते तु भूतानि सम्प्रहृष्टानि सर्व्वशः ॥
verses.rom:
sharashva divya nabhasah kavachancha papata ha |
tasmin jate tu bhutani samprahrishtani sarvvashah ||

verses.sa:
सत्पुत्रेणा च जैतेन वैणोऽपि त्रिदिवं ययौ ।
पुन्नाम्नो नरकात् त्रातः स तेन सुमहात्मना ॥
verses.rom:
satputrena cha jaitena vaino'pi tridivam yayau |
punnamno narakat tratah sa tena sumahatmana ||

verses.sa:
तं समुद्राश्च नद्यश्च रत्रान्यादाय सर्व्वशः ।
तोयानि चाभिषेकार्थं सर्व्वाण्योवोपतस्थिरे ॥
verses.rom:
tam samudrashcha nadyashcha ratranyadaya sarvvashah |
toyani chabhishekartham sarvvanyovopatasthire ||

verses.sa:
पितामहश्व भगवान् देवैराङ्गिरसैः सह ।
स्थावराणि च भूतानि जंगमानि च सर्व्वशः ॥
verses.rom:
pitamahashva bhagavan devairangirasaih saha |
sthavarani cha bhutani jamgamani cha sarvvashah ||

verses.sa:
समागम्य तदा वैण्यमभ्यषिञ्चन् नराधिपम् ।
हस्ते तु दक्षिणो चक्रं दृष्टूवा तस्य पितामहः ॥
verses.rom:
samagamya tada vainyamabhyashinchan naradhipam |
haste tu dakshino chakram drishtuva tasya pitamahah ||

verses.sa:
विष्णोरंशं पृथुं मत्वा परितोषं परं ययौ ।
विष्णुचिह्नं करे चक्रं सर्व्वेषां चक्रवर्त्तिनाम् ॥
verses.rom:
vishnoramsham prithum matva paritosham param yayau |
vishnuchihnam kare chakram sarvvesham chakravarttinam ||

verses.sa:
भवत्यव्याहतो यस्य प्रभावस्त्रिदशौरपि ।
महता राजराज्येन पृथुर्व्वैण्यः प्रतापवान् ॥
verses.rom:
bhavatyavyahato yasya prabhavastridashaurapi |
mahata rajarajyena prithurvvainyah pratapavan ||

verses.sa:
सोऽबिषिक्तो महातेजा विधिवद्धर्म्मकोविदैः ।
पित्रा परञ्जितास्तस्य प्रजास्तेनानुरञ्जिताः ॥
verses.rom:
so'bishikto mahateja vidhivaddharmmakovidaih |
pitra paranjitastasya prajastenanuranjitah ||

verses.sa:
अनुरागात् ततस्तस्य नाम राजेत्यजायत ।
आपस्तस्तम्भिरे चास्य समुद्रमभियास्यतः ॥
verses.rom:
anuragat tatastasya nama rajetyajayata |
apastastambhire chasya samudramabhiyasyatah ||

verses.sa:
पर्व्वताश्व ददुर्मागं ध्वजभङ्गश्व नाभवत् ।
अकृष्टपच्या पृथिवी सिध्यन्त्यन्नानि चिन्तया ॥
verses.rom:
parvvatashva dadurmagam dhvajabhangashva nabhavat |
akrishtapachya prithivi sidhyantyannani chintaya ||

verses.sa:
सर्व्वकामदुधा गावः पृटके पुटके मधु ।
तस्य वै जातमात्रस्य यज्ञे पैतामहे शुभे ॥
verses.rom:
sarvvakamadudha gavah pritake putake madhu |
tasya vai jatamatrasya yajne paitamahe shubhe ||

verses.sa:
सूतः सूत्यां समुत्पन्नः सौत्येऽहनि महामतिः ।
तस्मिन्नेव महायज्ञे जज्ञ प्राज्ञोऽथ मागधः ॥
verses.rom:
sutah sutyam samutpannah sautye'hani mahamatih |
tasminneva mahayajne jajna prajno'tha magadhah ||

verses.sa:
प्रोक्तौ तदा मुनिवरैस्तावुभौ सुतमागधौ ।
स्तूयतामेष नृपतिः पृथुर्वैण्यः प्रतापवान् ॥
verses.rom:
proktau tada munivaraistavubhau sutamagadhau |
stuyatamesha nripatih prithurvainyah pratapavan ||

verses.sa:
कर्म्मैतदनुरूपं वां पात्रं स्तोत्रस्य चाप्ययम् ।
ततस्तावूचतुर्व्विप्रान् सर्व्वानेव कृताञ्जली ॥
verses.rom:
karmmaitadanurupam vam patram stotrasya chapyayam |
tatastavuchaturvvipran sarvvaneva kritanjali ||

verses.sa:
अद्य जातस्य नो कर्म ज्ञायतेऽस्य महीपतेः ।
गुणा न चास्य ज्ञायन्ते न चास्य प्रथितं यशः ।
स्तोत्रं किमाश्वयञ्चास्य कार्य्यमस्माभिरुच्यताम् ॥
verses.rom:
adya jatasya no karma jnayate'sya mahipateh |
guna na chasya jnayante na chasya prathitam yashah |
stotram kimashvayanchasya karyyamasmabhiruchyatam ||

verses.sa:
करिष्यत्येष यत् कर्म्म चक्रवत्ती महाबलः ।
गुणा भविष्या ये चास्य तैरयं स्तूयतां नृपः ॥
verses.rom:
karishyatyesha yat karmma chakravatti mahabalah |
guna bhavishya ye chasya tairayam stuyatam nripah ||

verses.sa:
ततः स नृपतिस्तोषं तधु त्वा परमं ययौ ।
सदुगुणौः श्लाध्यतामेति स्तव्याश्वाभ्यां गुणा मम ॥
verses.rom:
tatah sa nripatistosham tadhu tva paramam yayau |
sadugunauh shladhyatameti stavyashvabhyam guna mama ||

verses.sa:
तस्माद् यदद्य स्तोत्रेण गुणनिर्व्वर्णनं त्विमौ ।
करिष्येते करिष्यामि तदेवाहं समाहितः ॥
verses.rom:
tasmad yadadya stotrena gunanirvvarnanam tvimau |
karishyete karishyami tadevaham samahitah ||

verses.sa: यदिमौ वर्ज्जनीयञ्चक्ते मतिं नृपः ॥
verses.rom: yadimau varjjaniyanchakte matim nripah ||

verses.sa:
अथ तौ चक्ततुः स्तोत्रं पृथोर्वैण्यस्य धीमतः ।
भविष्यैः कर्मभिः सम्यक् सुस्वरौ सूतमागधौ ॥
verses.rom:
atha tau chaktatuh stotram prithorvainyasya dhimatah |
bhavishyaih karmabhih samyak susvarau sutamagadhau ||

verses.sa:
पुत्यवाग् दामशीलोऽयं सत्यसन्धो नरेश्वरः ।
ह्रीमान् मैत्रः क्षमाशीलो विक्रान्तो दुष्टशासनः ॥
verses.rom:
putyavag damashilo'yam satyasandho nareshvarah |
hriman maitrah kshamashilo vikranto dushtashasanah ||

verses.sa:
धर्मज्ञाश्व क्रतज्ञश्व दयावान् प्रियभाषकः ।
मान्यमानयिता यज्वा ब्रह्मण्यःसाधुसम्मतः ॥
verses.rom:
dharmajnashva kratajnashva dayavan priyabhashakah |
manyamanayita yajva brahmanyahsadhusammatah ||

verses.sa:
समः शत्रौ च मित्रे च व्यवहारे स्थितो नृपः ।
सूतेनोक्त नू गुणानित्थं स तदा मागधेन च ॥
verses.rom:
samah shatrau cha mitre cha vyavahare sthito nripah |
sutenokta nu gunanittham sa tada magadhena cha ||

verses.sa:
चकार ह्टदि तादृक् च कर्मणा कृतवानसौ ।
ततः स पृथिवीपालः पालयन् वसुधामिमाम् ॥
verses.rom:
chakara htadi tadrik cha karmana kritavanasau |
tatah sa prithivipalah palayan vasudhamimam ||

verses.sa:
इयाज विविधैर्य्यज्ञैर्महद्भिर्भूरिदक्षिणैः ।
तं प्रजाः पृप्वीनाथमुपतस्थुः क्षुधादिंताः ॥
verses.rom:
iyaja vividhairyyajnairmahadbhirbhuridakshinaih |
tam prajah pripvinathamupatasthuh kshudhadimtah ||

verses.sa:
ओषदीषु प्रनष्टाषु तास्मिन् काले ह्मराजके ।
तमूचुस्तेन ताः पृष्टास्तत्रागमनकारणम् ॥
verses.rom:
oshadishu pranashtashu tasmin kale hmarajake |
tamuchustena tah prishtastatragamanakaranam ||

verses.sa:
अराजके नृपश्वेष्ठे धरिव्या सकलौषधीः ।
ग्रस्तास्ततः क्षयं यान्ति प्रजाः सर्व्वाः प्रजेश्वर ॥
verses.rom:
arajake nripashveshthe dharivya sakalaushadhih |
grastastatah kshayam yanti prajah sarvvah prajeshvara ||

verses.sa:
त्वं नो वृत्तिप्रदो धात्रा प्रजापालो निरूपितः ।
देहि नः क्षु तूपरीतानां प्रजानां जीवनौषधीः ॥
verses.rom:
tvam no vrittiprado dhatra prajapalo nirupitah |
dehi nah kshu tuparitanam prajanam jivanaushadhih ||

verses.sa:
ततोऽथ नृपतिर्दिव्यमादायाजगवं धनुः ।
शरांश्व दिव्यान् कुपितः सोऽन्वधावद् वसुन्धराम् ॥
verses.rom:
tato'tha nripatirdivyamadayajagavam dhanuh |
sharamshva divyan kupitah so'nvadhavad vasundharam ||

verses.sa:
ततो ननाश त्वरिता गौर्भूत्वा तु वसुन्धरा ।
सा लोकान् ब्रह्मलोकादीन् तत्वासादगमन्मही ॥
verses.rom:
tato nanasha tvarita gaurbhutva tu vasundhara |
sa lokan brahmalokadin tatvasadagamanmahi ||

verses.sa:
यत्र यत्र ययौ देवी सा तदा भूतधारिणी ।
तत्र तत्र तु सा वैण्यं ददर्शाभ्युद्यतायुधम् ॥
verses.rom:
yatra yatra yayau devi sa tada bhutadharini |
tatra tatra tu sa vainyam dadarshabhyudyatayudham ||

verses.sa:
ततस्तं प्राह वसुधा पृथुं पृथुपराक्रमम् ।
प्रवेपमाणा तदूवाणापरित्राणपरायणा ॥
verses.rom:
tatastam praha vasudha prithum prithuparakramam |
pravepamana taduvanaparitranaparayana ||

verses.sa:
स्त्रीवधे त्व महापापं किं नरेन्द्र न पश्यसि ।
येन मां हन्तुमत्यर्थं प्रकरोषि नृपोद्यमम् ॥
verses.rom:
strivadhe tva mahapapam kim narendra na pashyasi |
yena mam hantumatyartham prakaroshi nripodyamam ||

verses.sa:
एकस्मिन् यत्र निधनं प्रापिते दुष्टकारिणि ।
बहूनां भवति क्षेमं तस्य पुणयप्रदौ वधः ॥
verses.rom:
ekasmin yatra nidhanam prapite dushtakarini |
bahunam bhavati kshemam tasya punayapradau vadhah ||

verses.sa:
प्रजानामुपकाराय यदि मां त्वं हनिष्यसि ।
आधारः कः प्रजानां ते नपश्वेष्ठे भविष्यति ॥
verses.rom:
prajanamupakaraya yadi mam tvam hanishyasi |
adharah kah prajanam te napashveshthe bhavishyati ||

verses.sa:
त्वं हत्वा वसुधे वाणौर्मच्छासनपराङूमुखीम् ।
आत्मयोगबलेनेमा धारयिष्याम्यहं प्रजाः ॥
verses.rom:
tvam hatva vasudhe vanaurmachchhasanaparanumukhim |
atmayogabalenema dharayishyamyaham prajah ||

verses.sa:
ततः प्रणाम्य वसुधा तं भूयः प्राह पार्थिवम् ।
प्रवेपिताङ्गी परमं साध्वसं समुपागता ॥
verses.rom:
tatah pranamya vasudha tam bhuyah praha parthivam |
pravepitangi paramam sadhvasam samupagata ||

verses.sa:
उपायतः समारब्धाः सर्वे सिध्यन्त्युपक्रमाः ।
तस्माद् वदाम्युपायं ते ततू कुरुष्व यदिच्छसि ॥
verses.rom:
upayatah samarabdhah sarve sidhyantyupakramah |
tasmad vadamyupayam te tatu kurushva yadichchhasi ||

verses.sa:
समस्तास्ता मया जीर्णा नरनाथ महौषधीः ।
यदीच्छसि प्रदास्यामि ताः क्षीरपरिणामिनीः ॥
verses.rom:
samastasta maya jirna naranatha mahaushadhih |
yadichchhasi pradasyami tah kshiraparinaminih ||

verses.sa:
तस्मात् प्रजाहितार्थाय मम धर्म्मबृतां वर ।
तं तु वतूसं प्रयच्छत्वं क्षरेयं येन वतूसला ॥
verses.rom:
tasmat prajahitarthaya mama dharmmabritam vara |
tam tu vatusam prayachchhatvam kshareyam yena vatusala ||

verses.sa:
समाञ्च कुरु सर्वत्र येन क्षीरं समन्ततः ।
वरोषधी बीजभूतं वीर सर्वत्र भावये ॥
verses.rom:
samancha kuru sarvatra yena kshiram samantatah |
varoshadhi bijabhutam vira sarvatra bhavaye ||

verses.sa:
तत उत्सारयामास शैलांञ् शतसहस्त्रशः ।
धनुः कोटया तदा वैरायस्ततः शैला विवर्ज्जिताः ॥
verses.rom:
tata utsarayamasa shailamn shatasahastrashah |
dhanuh kotaya tada vairayastatah shaila vivarjjitah ||

verses.sa:
न हि पूर्वविसर्गे वै विषमे पृथिवीतले ।
प्रविभागः पुराणां वा ग्रामाणां वा तदाभवत् ॥
verses.rom:
na hi purvavisarge vai vishame prithivitale |
pravibhagah puranam va gramanam va tadabhavat ||

verses.sa:
न शस्यानि न गोरक्षं न कृषिर्न वणिकूपथः ।
वैणयातूप्रभृति मैत्रेय सर्वस्यैतस्य सम्भवः ॥
verses.rom:
na shasyani na goraksham na krishirna vanikupathah |
vainayatuprabhriti maitreya sarvasyaitasya sambhavah ||

verses.sa:
यत्र यत्र समं तस्या भूमेरासीनूनराधिपः ।
तत्र तत्र प्रजानां हि निवासं समरोचयते ॥
verses.rom:
yatra yatra samam tasya bhumerasinunaradhipah |
tatra tatra prajanam hi nivasam samarochayate ||

verses.sa:
आहारः फलमूलानि प्रजानामभवत् तदा ।
कृच्छ्रणे महता सोऽपि प्रनष्टास्वौषधीषु वै ॥
verses.rom:
aharah phalamulani prajanamabhavat tada |
krichchhrane mahata so'pi pranashtasvaushadhishu vai ||

verses.sa:
स कल्पयित्वा वतूसं तुमनुं स्वायम्भुवं प्रभुः ।
स्वे पाणौ पृथिवीनाथो दुदोह पृथिवीं पृथुः ॥
verses.rom:
sa kalpayitva vatusam tumanum svayambhuvam prabhuh |
sve panau prithivinatho dudoha prithivim prithuh ||

verses.sa:
शस्यजातानि सर्वाणि प्रजानां हितकाम्यया ।
तेनान्नेन प्रजास्तात वर्त्तन्तेऽद्यापि नित्यशः ॥
verses.rom:
shasyajatani sarvani prajanam hitakamyaya |
tenannena prajastata varttante'dyapi nityashah ||

verses.sa:
प्राणाप्रदानात् स पृथु र्यस्मादू भूमेरभूत् पिता ।
ततस्तु पृथिवीसंज्ञामवापाखिलधारिणी ॥
verses.rom:
pranapradanat sa prithu ryasmadu bhumerabhut pita |
tatastu prithivisamjnamavapakhiladharini ||

verses.sa:
ततश्व देवैर्मुनिबिर्दैत्यैरक्षोभिरद्रिभिः ।
गन्धर्वैरुरगैर्यक्षैः पितृभिस्तरुभिस्तथा ॥
verses.rom:
tatashva devairmunibirdaityairakshobhiradribhih |
gandharvairuragairyakshaih pitribhistarubhistatha ||

verses.sa:
तत ततू पात्रमुपादाय तत् तदू तुग्धा मुने पयः ।
वत्सदोग्धृविशेषाश्व तेषां तदूयोनयोऽभवन् ॥
verses.rom:
tata tatu patramupadaya tat tadu tugdha mune payah |
vatsadogdhrivisheshashva tesham taduyonayo'bhavan ||

verses.sa:
सैषा धात्री विधात्री च धारिणी पोषिणी तथा ।
सर्वस्य जगतः पृथ्वी विष्णुपादतलोद्भवा ॥
verses.rom:
saisha dhatri vidhatri cha dharini poshini tatha |
sarvasya jagatah prithvi vishnupadatalodbhava ||

verses.sa:
एवं प्रभावः स पृथुः पुत्रो वेणस्य वीर्य्यवान् ।
जज्ञे महीपतिः पूर्वो राजाभूज्जनरञ्चनात् ॥
verses.rom:
evam prabhavah sa prithuh putro venasya viryyavan |
jajne mahipatih purvo rajabhujjanaranchanat ||

verses.sa:
य इदं जन्म वैण्यस्य पृथोः कीर्त्तयते नरः ।
न तस्य दुष्कृतं किञ्चित् फलदायी प्रजायते ॥
verses.rom:
ya idam janma vainyasya prithoh kirttayate narah |
na tasya dushkritam kinchit phaladayi prajayate ||

verses.sa:
दुःस्वप्नोपशामं नॄ णां श्वृणवतां चैतदुत्तमम् ।
पृथोर्जन्म प्रभावश्व करोति सततं नृणाम् ॥
verses.rom:
duhsvapnopashamam nri nam shvrinavatam chaitaduttamam |
prithorjanma prabhavashva karoti satatam nrinam ||

prose.en: Parāçara said,—By Dhruva the abode of all blessings, his spouse Shambhu gave birth to two sons, Shisti and Vabya. Suchaya, the wife of Sishti gave birth to five sons, freed from sin, by name, Ripu, Ripunjaya, Sipra, Vrikala, and Vrikatejas. Of these Ripu begat upon Vrihatee a highly effulgent son named Chakshusa, who again begot the Manu Chakshusa on Pushkarini of the race of Varuna, who was the daughter of the high-souled patriarch Aranya. O great sage, the patriarch Vairaja had a daughter named Nadbala, on whom Manu begot ten highly effulgent sons—Uru, Pooru, Satadumnya, Tapasher, Satyavak, Kavi, Agnistoma, Atiratra, Sudyumnya and Abhimanyu. Uru begot on his wife Agneyi six highly effulgent sons—Anga, Sumanas, Svati, Kratu, Angiras and Siva. And Anga begot on Suneetha one son named Vena. O great sages, with a view to multiply his progeny, the Rishis rubbed his right hand. And from his arm sprang a famous king named Vainya, who was celebrated as Prithu for milking the earth for the advantage of his subjects. Maitreya said,—"O foremost of ascetics, do thou tell me why the right hand of Vena was rubbed by the great Rishis, in consequence of which the mighty and powerful Prithu was born". Parāçara said:—Originally a daughter was born of Mritya named Suneetha. Anga married her. And she gave birth to Vena. O Maitieya, being born from the daughter of Mrityu, he inherited the evil propensities of his grand father. When he was inaugurated by the great Rishis, Vena caused it to be proclaimed everywhere that he was the lord of the earth. No one would undertake any sacrifice, offer any oblation or make any gift. "I am the king the lord of sacrifice, no one is entitled to oblations except myself". Thereupon the Rishis assembled there and worshipping the lord of earth, addressed him, O Maitreya, with sweet words. The Rishis said,—"O king, O lord, do thou hear, what we speak unto thee, for then thy health as well as the interest of thy subjects shall be secure. We purpose to worship, for thy welfare, with protracted rites, Hari, the lord of the celestials and sacrifices. And thou shalt also be entitled to a share in it. If, O king, with our sacrifices, the lord of sacrifices is propitiated, he shall also satisfy all thy desires. In whose kingdom, O king, Hari, the lord of sacrifices is worshipped with sacrifices, he confers on him, the satisfaction of all his desires". Vena said—"Who is there above me that, I even, shall have to worship him. Who is that person, who is known as Hari and whom ye do all consider as the lord of sacrifices? Brahmā, Janārddana, Sambhu, Indra, Vayu, Jama, the Sun, Fire, Varuna, Dhata, Pusha, (the sun) Bhumi (earth) and the lord of earth (the moon)—these and all others who are capable of imprecating curses and conferring boons (on mankind) do all exist in the person of a king for the essence of a sovereign is all that is divine. O twice born ones, understanding this full well, do ye all obey my commands—you should not make gifts or offer oblations unto any one (but me) and should not worship any body else. As to serve her own husband is the prime duty of a female, so it is incumbent upon you, O twice-born ones, to satisfy my behests only". The Rishis said,—"Give us command, O great king, to undertake sacrifices, so that piety may not suffer decrease. All this world is but the outcome of oblations". Parāçara said:—Being thus addressed by the great Rishis and requested by them often and often, Vena did not give them. Thereupon all the ascetics, being stricken with excessive ire, cried out "Kill him!—kill this vicious weight! He, who vilifies our lord the sovereign of sacrifices, without beginning or end, is not worthy of the sovereignty of the earth". Saying this, the ascetics slew that king with the blades of Kusa grass, consecrated by prayer, who had already been, destroyed by his impiety towards God. Thereupon those ascetics beheld dust on all sides and said to the people who were nigh, "What is this?" To which the people replied—"The kingdom is without a king and hence the robbers and thieves have engaged in their dishonest work of encroaching upon the property of others. And O great ascetics, this dust has been raised by those robbers hastening to seize other's property". Thereupon consulting with each other those ascetics, intent upon creating a prince, began to rub the thigh of that childless monarch. The thigh being thus rubbed, there arose a being of the complexion of a charred stake, with flattened features and of a dwarfish stature. And he speedily addressed all the ascetics there saying, "What shall I do?" Whereto they replied—"Sit down" (Nishada) and thence his name was Nishada. O foremost of ascetics, from this person sprang a race called Nishadas who inhabit the Vindya mountain and are characterised by the exterior tokens of depravity. By this means the wickedness of the king (Vena) was extracted and the Nishadas was thus born destroying Vena's son's. Thereupon those twice-born ones began to rub the right hand of Vena from which sprang the highly powerful son of Vena named Prithu resplendent in person and burning like the fire itself. Thereupon from the welkin fell down the original bow of Hara named Pinaka, and the celestial arrow and the celestial armour. Prithu thus born, all the beings around were greatly delighted. And at the birth of that pious son. Vena too attained to the region of celestials and was delivered by that high-souled one from the hell named Pat. Thereupon the seas and rivers from all sides come there with holy water and pearls and gems of diverse kinds, for his inauguration on the throne. The great parent of all, Brahmā, with the celestials and the descendants of Angiras (the fires) and with all things, animate or inanimate, came there and performed the ceremony of consecrating the lord of people—the son of king of Vena. And beholding in his right hand the mark of the discus of Vishnu and recognising a portion of that deity in Prithu the great parent attained to an excess of delight. For all those who become the sovereign kings of the earth, have always the mark of the discus of Vishnu in their hands. The highly powerful Prithu, the son of Vena, being thus invested with a mighty dominion, his power was unimpeded even in the region of the celestials. That highly effulgent one, being installed according to due rites, by these who were skilled in religious rites, those subjects even, who were disaffected in his father's regeme, became fully attached unto him. And in consequence of his attachment unto his subjects he was known all over as "the king". The waters became solid when he traversed the deep; the mountains opened him a way and his banners were unbroken even when he passed through the forests. (In his time) the earth yielded crops without cultivation; people got their food without any thought—the king gave milk at any time and honey was stored in every flower. At the auspicious sacrifice which was performed at the birth of Prithu and which was headed by the great parent—the highly intelligent Suta was produced from the juice of the moon plant. And in that great sacrifice the highly intelligent Māgadha was also born. Thereupon the Rishis accosted Suta and Māgadha saying "Do you sing the glory of this powerful king Prithu, the son of Vena. This is your special function and he is the fit object of your praise". Thereupon both of them, with folded hands, spoke unto the twice-born ones saying—"This king is born to-day—his works or merits we are not cognizant of; nor his fame has spread abroad—tell us on what subject shall we base our praise?" The Rishis said—"Sing his glory mentioning the works he shall perform, becoming the emperor of the earth and the merits he shall be crowned with". Parāçara said:—Hearing these words the king was highly gratified and reflected, saying—"Persons (in this world) are eulogised for their various actions. And surely my virtuous actions shall be the theme of these bards. And whatever merits, they will relate in their panegyric, I will acquire with all my attention. And whatever faults they shall recommend to be avoided I shall always shun". The king resolved thus. Thereupon Suta and Māgadha, with sweet-voiced discourses, sang the future virtues of the intelligent Prithu, the son of Vena.—"He shall be truthful, charitable, observer of his promises, the lord of people, wise, benevolent, patient, valient and the supresser of the wicked; pious, grateful, kind, sweet-spoken; shall always respect the venerable, perform sacrifices, respect the Brāhmins and shall be always recognised by the pious. He shall cherish the good and in administering justice shall be indifferent to friend or foe". He cherished in his mind the virtues thus celebrated by Suta and Māgadha and practised them in his life. Thereupon that king governed the earth and performed many sacrifices accompanied with liberal donations. One day the subjects stricken with hunger approached the king for the edible plants had perished during the season of anarchy. And when asked by him the cause of thus coming they said—"O foremost of kings, during the period of anarchy all vegetable products were withheld and, O lord of men, many are now perishing for want of food. Thou hast been appointed (by the Providence) as our lord and sustainer—grant us vegetable—the support of our lives who are dying with hunger". Parāçara said:—Hearing this, the king, inflamed with wrath, took up his bow Pināka and his celestial arrows and issued forth to assail the Earth. And the Earth too, assuming the shape of a cow, instantly fled away. From his fear she traversed the Brahmā, and all other regions—and wherever she, the supporter of elements, went, she beheld the son of Vena, with uplifted weapons. At last trembling with terror, the earth, desirous to escape his arrows, addressed Prithu, the hero of resistless prowess,—"O lord of men, do thou not know that there is a great sin hanging upon the destruction of females—why dost thou then try to slay me?" Prithu said,—"O thou the perpetrator of vicious deeds, when by the destruction of one malignant being the happiness of many is secured—that destruction is considered as an act of virtue". The Earth said,—"If dost thou, for the behoof of thy subjects, slay me, who shall support them, O foremost of kings?" Prithu said,—"O Earth, slaying thee with my arrows, who art beyond my control, I shall support my own men, by virtue of my own devotion". Parāçara said,—Thereupon the earth, overcome with fear, trembled and bowing unto him, addressed that king again, saying,—"All undertakings prove successful whenever suitable means to accomplish them are employed. I shall now suggest thee a means, which, if pleases thee, thou mayst accept. O lord of men, the edible plants, which I had devoured before, I may return thee, if thou likest, in the shape of milk. O thou the foremost of the pious, for the behoof of thy subjects, give me a calf by which I may be able to secrete milk. O hero, make also all places level, so that I may produce, equally around, milk which is the source of all vegetation". Parāçara said,—Thereupon the son of Vena with his bow and, uprooted mountains by hundreds and thousands and thenceforth all the hills are lying scattered all around. Before this the surface of the earth was irregular, and there was no boundaries of villages and cities. There was no cultivation, no pasture, no agriculture, no high way for merchants; all these originated, O Maitreya, in the reign of the son of Vena. Whatever there was level ground, the king made habitations for the subjects. Before his time, the fruits and roots, which were the staple food of the subjects, were procured with great difficulty for all vegetables were destroyed. Thereupon having made, the Swaymbhuva, Manu, the calf, that lord of men, Prithu, milked the earth with his own hands. He desiring the benefit of his subjects, corns and vegetables of all kinds were produced upon which the people even now and perpetually subsist. By conferring life on her, Prithu became the father of the Earth and thence she got the patronymic Prithivi (the daughter of Prithu). Thereupon the celestials the ascetics, the demons, the Rākshasas, the mountains, the Gandharvas, the Uragas, the Yakshas, the Pitris, and the trees, with their respective vessels, milked the earth, as much O Manu, as they required. And the milker and the calf were both peculiar to their own species. The Earth, the mother, the nurse, the supporter and the nourisher of all creations was produced from the sole of the foot of Vishnu. And Prithu, the son of Vena, became so very powerful, that by virtue of his pleasing the subjects he was the first man who was styled the lord of the earth. He who shall relate the story of the birth of the son of Vena shall never suffer any retribution for his iniquitous deeds. And he who shall hear of the birth and virtues of Prithu shall be relieved from the affliction of evil dreams.

verses.sa:
पृथोः पुत्रौ महावीर्यौ जज्ञातोऽन्तर्द्धिपालिनौ
शिखण्डिनी हविर्द्धानमन्तर्द्धानाद् व्यजायत ॥
verses.rom:
prithoh putrau mahaviryau jajnato'ntarddhipalinau
shikhandini havirddhanamantarddhanad vyajayata ||

verses.sa:
हविर्द्धानात् षडाग्नेयी धिषणाजनयत् सुतान् ।
प्राचीनबर्हिषं शुक्रं गयं कृष्णं व्रजाजिनौ ॥
verses.rom:
havirddhanat shadagneyi dhishanajanayat sutan |
prachinabarhisham shukram gayam krishnam vrajajinau ||

verses.sa:
प्राचीनबर्हिर्भगवान् महानासीत् प्रजापतिः ।
हविर्धानान्महाभाग येन संवर्धिताः प्रजाः ॥
verses.rom:
prachinabarhirbhagavan mahanasit prajapatih |
havirdhananmahabhaga yena samvardhitah prajah ||

verses.sa:
प्राचीनाग्राः कुशास्तस्य पृथिव्यां विश्रुता मुने ।
प्राचीनबर्हिरभवत्ख्यातो भुवि महाबलः ॥
verses.rom:
prachinagrah kushastasya prithivyam vishruta mune |
prachinabarhirabhavatkhyato bhuvi mahabalah ||

verses.sa:
समुद्रतनयायां तु कृतदारो महीपतिः ।
महतस्तमसः पारे सवर्णायां महामते ॥
verses.rom:
samudratanayayam tu kritadaro mahipatih |
mahatastamasah pare savarnayam mahamate ||

verses.sa:
सवर्णाधत्त सामुद्री दश प्राचीनबर्हिषः ।
सर्वे प्राचेतसो नाम धनुर्वेदस्य पारगाः ॥
verses.rom:
savarnadhatta samudri dasha prachinabarhishah |
sarve prachetaso nama dhanurvedasya paragah ||

verses.sa:
अपृथग्धर्मचरणास्ते तप्यन्त महत्तपः ।
दशवर्षसहस्राणि समुद्रसलिलेशयः ॥
verses.rom:
aprithagdharmacharanaste tapyanta mahattapah |
dashavarshasahasrani samudrasalileshayah ||

verses.sa:
श्रीमैत्रेय उवाच
यदर्थं ते महात्मानस्तपस्तेपुर्महामुने ।
प्राचेतसः समुद्राम्भस्येतदाख्यातुमर्हसि ॥
verses.rom:
shrimaitreya uvacha
yadartham te mahatmanastapastepurmahamune |
prachetasah samudrambhasyetadakhyatumarhasi ||

verses.sa:
श्रीपराशर उवाच
पित्रा प्रचेतसः प्रोक्ताः प्रजार्थममितात्मना ।
प्रजापतिनियुक्तेन बहुमानपुरःसरम् ॥
verses.rom:
shriparashara uvacha
pitra prachetasah proktah prajarthamamitatmana |
prajapatiniyuktena bahumanapurahsaram ||

verses.sa:
प्राचीनबर्हिरुवाच
ब्रह्मणा देवदेवेन समादिष्टोस्म्यहं सुताः ।
प्रजाः संवर्धनीयास्ते मया चोक्तं तथेति तत् ॥
verses.rom:
prachinabarhiruvacha
brahmana devadevena samadishtosmyaham sutah |
prajah samvardhaniyaste maya choktam tatheti tat ||

verses.sa:
तन्मम प्रीतये पुत्राः प्रजावृद्धिमतन्द्रिताः ।
कुरुध्वं माननीया वः सम्यगाज्ञा प्रजापतेः ॥
verses.rom:
tanmama pritaye putrah prajavriddhimatandritah |
kurudhvam mananiya vah samyagajna prajapateh ||

verses.sa:
श्रीपराशर उवाच
ततस्ते तत्पितुः श्रुत्वा वचनं नृपनन्दनाः ।
तथेत्युक्त्वा च तं भूयः पप्रच्छुः पितरं मुने ॥
verses.rom:
shriparashara uvacha
tataste tatpituh shrutva vachanam nripanandanah |
tathetyuktva cha tam bhuyah paprachchhuh pitaram mune ||

verses.sa:
प्रचेतस ऊचुः
येन तात प्रजावृद्धौ समर्था कर्मणा वयम् ।
भवेम तत्समस्तं नः कर्म व्याख्यातुमर्हसि ॥
verses.rom:
prachetasa uchuh
yena tata prajavriddhau samartha karmana vayam |
bhavema tatsamastam nah karma vyakhyatumarhasi ||

verses.sa:
पितोवाच
आराध्य वरदं विष्णुमिष्टप्राप्तिमसंशयम् ।
समेति नान्यथा मर्त्यः किमन्यत्कथयामि वः ॥
verses.rom:
pitovacha
aradhya varadam vishnumishtapraptimasamshayam |
sameti nanyatha martyah kimanyatkathayami vah ||

verses.sa:
तस्मात्प्रजा विवृद्ध्यर्थं सर्वभूतप्रभुं हरिम् ।
आराधयत गोविन्दं यदि सिद्धिमभीप्सथः ॥
verses.rom:
tasmatpraja vivriddhyartham sarvabhutaprabhum harim |
aradhayata govindam yadi siddhimabhipsathah ||

verses.sa:
धर्ममर्थं च कामं च मोक्षं चान्विच्छतां सदा ।
आराधनीयो भगवाननादिपुरुषोत्तमः ॥
verses.rom:
dharmamartham cha kamam cha moksham chanvichchhatam sada |
aradhaniyo bhagavananadipurushottamah ||

verses.sa:
यस्मिन्नाराधिते सर्गं चकारादौ प्रजापतिः ।
तमाराध्याच्युतं वृद्धिः प्रजानां वो भविष्यति ॥
verses.rom:
yasminnaradhite sargam chakaradau prajapatih |
tamaradhyachyutam vriddhih prajanam vo bhavishyati ||

verses.sa:
श्रीपराशर उवाच
इत्येवमुक्तास्ते पित्रा पुत्राः प्राचेतसो दश ।
मग्नाः पयोधिसलिले तपस्तेषुः समाहिताः ॥
verses.rom:
shriparashara uvacha
ityevamuktaste pitra putrah prachetaso dasha |
magnah payodhisalile tapasteshuh samahitah ||

verses.sa:
दशवर्षसहस्राणि न्यस्तचित्ता जगत्पतौ ।
नारायणे मुनिश्रेष्ठ सर्वलोकपरायणे ॥
verses.rom:
dashavarshasahasrani nyastachitta jagatpatau |
narayane munishreshtha sarvalokaparayane ||

verses.sa:
तत्रैवावस्थिता देवमेकाग्रमनसो हरिम् ।
तुष्टुवुर्यःस्तुतः कामान् स्तोतुरिष्टान्प्रयच्छति ॥
verses.rom:
tatraivavasthita devamekagramanaso harim |
tushtuvuryahstutah kaman stoturishtanprayachchhati ||

verses.sa:
श्रीमैत्रेय उवाच
स्तवं प्रचेतसो विष्णोः समुद्राम्भसि संस्थिताः ।
चक्रुस्तन्मे मुनिश्रेष्ठ सुपुण्यं वक्तुमर्हसि ॥
verses.rom:
shrimaitreya uvacha
stavam prachetaso vishnoh samudrambhasi samsthitah |
chakrustanme munishreshtha supunyam vaktumarhasi ||

verses.sa:
श्रीपराशर उवाच
शृणु मैत्रेय गोविन्दं यथापूर्वं प्रचेतसः ।
तुष्टुवुस्तन्मयीभूताः समुद्रसलिलेशयाः ॥
verses.rom:
shriparashara uvacha
shrinu maitreya govindam yathapurvam prachetasah |
tushtuvustanmayibhutah samudrasalileshayah ||

verses.sa:
प्रचेतस ऊचुः
नताः स्म सर्ववचसां प्रतिष्ठा यत्र शाश्वती ।
तमाद्यन्तमशेषस्य जगतः परमं प्रभुम् ॥
verses.rom:
prachetasa uchuh
natah sma sarvavachasam pratishtha yatra shashvati |
tamadyantamasheshasya jagatah paramam prabhum ||

verses.sa:
ज्योतिराद्यमनौपम्यमण्वनन्तमपारवत् ।
योनिभूतमशेषस्य स्थावरस्य चरस्य च ॥
verses.rom:
jyotiradyamanaupamyamanvanantamaparavat |
yonibhutamasheshasya sthavarasya charasya cha ||

verses.sa:
यस्याहः प्रथमं रूपमरूपस्य तथा निशा ।
संध्या च परमेशस्य तस्मै कालात्मने नमः ॥
verses.rom:
yasyahah prathamam rupamarupasya tatha nisha |
samdhya cha parameshasya tasmai kalatmane namah ||

verses.sa:
भुज्यतेऽनुदिनं देवैः पितृभिश्च सुधात्मकः ।
बीजभूतं समस्तस्य तस्मै सोमात्मने नमः ॥
verses.rom:
bhujyate'nudinam devaih pitribhishcha sudhatmakah |
bijabhutam samastasya tasmai somatmane namah ||

verses.sa:
यस्तमास्यत्ति तीव्रात्मा प्रभाभिर्भासयन्नभः ।
घर्मशीताम्भसा योनिस्तस्मै सूर्यत्मने नमः ॥
verses.rom:
yastamasyatti tivratma prabhabhirbhasayannabhah |
gharmashitambhasa yonistasmai suryatmane namah ||

verses.sa:
काठिन्यवान् यो बिभर्ति जगदेतदशेषतः ।
शब्दादिसंश्रयो व्यापी तस्मै भूम्यात्मने नमः ॥
verses.rom:
kathinyavan yo bibharti jagadetadasheshatah |
shabdadisamshrayo vyapi tasmai bhumyatmane namah ||

verses.sa:
यद्योनिभूतं जगतो वीजं यत्सर्वदेहिनाम् ।
तत्तोयरूपमीशस्य नमामो हरिमेधसः ॥
verses.rom:
yadyonibhutam jagato vijam yatsarvadehinam |
tattoyarupamishasya namamo harimedhasah ||

verses.sa:
यो मुखं सर्वदेवानां हव्यभुक्कव्यभुक्तथा ।
पितॄणां च नमस्तस्मै विष्णवे पावकात्मने ॥
verses.rom:
yo mukham sarvadevanam havyabhukkavyabhuktatha |
pitrinam cha namastasmai vishnave pavakatmane ||

verses.sa:
पञ्चधावस्थितो देहे यश्चेष्टां कुरुतेऽनिशम् ।
