आकाशयोनिर्भगवांस्तस्मै वाय्वात्मने नमः ॥
verses.rom:
panchadhavasthito dehe yashcheshtam kurute'nisham |
akashayonirbhagavamstasmai vayvatmane namah ||

verses.sa:
अवकाशमशेषाणां भूतानां यः प्रयच्छति ।
अनन्तमूर्तिमाञ्छुद्धस्तस्मै व्योमात्मने नमः ॥
verses.rom:
avakashamasheshanam bhutanam yah prayachchhati |
anantamurtimanchhuddhastasmai vyomatmane namah ||

verses.sa:
समस्तेन्द्रियसर्गस्य यः सदा स्थानमुत्तमम् ।
तस्मै शब्दादिरूपाय नमः कृष्णाय वेधसे ॥
verses.rom:
samastendriyasargasya yah sada sthanamuttamam |
tasmai shabdadirupaya namah krishnaya vedhase ||

verses.sa:
गृह्णाति विषयान्नित्यमिन्द्रियात्माक्षराक्षरः ।
यस्तस्मै ज्ञानमूलाय नतास्म हरिमेधसे ॥
verses.rom:
grihnati vishayannityamindriyatmaksharaksharah |
yastasmai jnanamulaya natasma harimedhase ||

verses.sa:
गृहीतानिन्द्रियैरर्थानात्मने यः प्रयच्छति ।
अन्तःकरणरूपाय तस्मै विश्वात्मने नमः ॥
verses.rom:
grihitanindriyairarthanatmane yah prayachchhati |
antahkaranarupaya tasmai vishvatmane namah ||

verses.sa:
यस्मिन्ननन्ते सकलं विश्वं यस्मात्तथोद्गतम् ।
लयस्थानं च यस्तस्मै नमः प्रकृतिधर्मिणे ॥
verses.rom:
yasminnanante sakalam vishvam yasmattathodgatam |
layasthanam cha yastasmai namah prakritidharmine ||

verses.sa:
शुद्धः संल्लक्ष्यते भ्रान्त्या गुणवानिव योऽगुणः ।
तमात्मरूपिणं देव नतास्म पुरुषोत्तमम् ॥
verses.rom:
shuddhah samllakshyate bhrantya gunavaniva yo'gunah |
tamatmarupinam deva natasma purushottamam ||

verses.sa:
अविकारमजं शुद्धं निर्गुणं यन्निरजनम् ।
नताःस्मतत्परं ब्रह्म विष्णोर्यत्परमं पदम् ॥
verses.rom:
avikaramajam shuddham nirgunam yannirajanam |
natahsmatatparam brahma vishnoryatparamam padam ||

verses.sa:
अदीर्घह्रस्वमस्थूलण्वनमश्यामलोहितम् ।
अस्नेहच्छायमतनुमसक्तमशरीरीणम् ॥
verses.rom:
adirghahrasvamasthulanvanamashyamalohitam |
asnehachchhayamatanumasaktamasharirinam ||

verses.sa:
अनाकाशमसंस्पर्शमगन्धमरसं च यत् ।
अचक्षुश्रोत्रमचलमवाक्पाणिममानिसम् ॥
verses.rom:
anakashamasamsparshamagandhamarasam cha yat |
achakshushrotramachalamavakpanimamanisam ||

verses.sa:
अनामगोमत्रसुखमतेजस्कमहेतुकम् ।
अभयं भ्रान्तिरहितम निद्रमजरामरम् ॥
verses.rom:
anamagomatrasukhamatejaskamahetukam |
abhayam bhrantirahitama nidramajaramaram ||

verses.sa:
अरजोशब्दममृतमप्लुतं यदसंवृतम् ।
पूर्वापरेण वै यस्मिस्तद्विष्णोः परमं पदम् ॥
verses.rom:
arajoshabdamamritamaplutam yadasamvritam |
purvaparena vai yasmistadvishnoh paramam padam ||

verses.sa:
परमेशत्वगुणवत्सर्वभूतमसंशयम् ।
नतास्म तत्पदं विष्णोर्जिह्वादृग्गोचरं न यत् ॥
verses.rom:
parameshatvagunavatsarvabhutamasamshayam |
natasma tatpadam vishnorjihvadriggocharam na yat ||

verses.sa:
श्रीपराशर उवाच
एवं प्रचेतसो विष्णुं स्तुवन्तस्तत्समाधयः ।
दशवर्षसहस्राणि तपश्चेरुर्महार्णवे ॥
verses.rom:
shriparashara uvacha
evam prachetaso vishnum stuvantastatsamadhayah |
dashavarshasahasrani tapashcherurmaharnave ||

verses.sa:
ततः प्रसन्नो भगवांस्तेषामन्तर्जले हरिः ।
ददौ दर्शनमुन्निद्रनीलोत्पलदलच्छविः ॥
verses.rom:
tatah prasanno bhagavamsteshamantarjale harih |
dadau darshanamunnidranilotpaladalachchhavih ||

verses.sa:
पतत्रिराजमारूढमवलोक्य प्रचेतसः ।
प्रणिपेतुः शिरोभिस्तं भक्तिभारावनामितैः ॥
verses.rom:
patatrirajamarudhamavalokya prachetasah |
pranipetuh shirobhistam bhaktibharavanamitaih ||

verses.sa:
ततस्तानाह भगवान्व्रयतामीप्सतो वरः ।
प्रसादसुमुखोहं वो वरदः समुपस्थितः ॥
verses.rom:
tatastanaha bhagavanvrayatamipsato varah |
prasadasumukhoham vo varadah samupasthitah ||

verses.sa:
ततस्तमूचुर्वरदं प्रणिपत्य प्रचेतसः ।
यथा पित्रा समादिष्टं प्रजानां वृद्धिकारणम् ॥
verses.rom:
tatastamuchurvaradam pranipatya prachetasah |
yatha pitra samadishtam prajanam vriddhikaranam ||

verses.sa:
स चापि देवस्तं दत्त्वा यथभिलषितं वरम् ।
अन्तर्धानं जगामाशु ते च निश्चक्रमुर्जलात् ॥
verses.rom:
sa chapi devastam dattva yathabhilashitam varam |
antardhanam jagamashu te cha nishchakramurjalat ||

verses.sa: इति श्रीविष्णुपुराणे प्रथमेऽंशे प्रचेतास्तवो नाम चतुर्दशोऽध्यायः (१४)
verses.rom: iti shrivishnupurane prathame'mshe prachetastavo nama chaturdasho'dhyayah (14)

prose.en: From Prithu were born two highly powerful sons named Antardhāna and Pāli. And Antardhāna begot on Shiknandini a son named Habirdhāna. And Habirdhāna again begot on Dhishana six sons—named, Prāchinberhis, Sukra, Gaya, Krishna, Braja and Ajina. Prāchinverhis was a mighty prince and patriarch by whom mankind was multiplied after the death of Havirdhāna. He was called Prāchinverhis on account of his placing upon the earth (at the time of his prayer) the sacred grass pointing to the east. After a protracted devotion that lord of earth married the daughter of the Ocean named Savaranā. And Prāchinverhis, begot on Savaranā, the daughter of the Ocean ten sons, who were all called Prachetas and were all well-skilled in archery. They all practised the same religious austerities and remained immersed in the bed of the deep for ten thousand years. Maitreya said,—"Do thou, O great ascetic, tell me, why those high-souled Prachetas practised austerities being immersed in the deep". Parāçara said,—Welcoming the high-souled Prāchinverhis, the Patriarch requested him to multiply race. And he accordingly addressed his sons, saying,—"O my sons, I have been commanded by Bramhā, the god of gods to multiply mankind. And I too had promised obedience. Do ye therefore, my sons, diligently promote the increase of mankind. You shall all with reverence obey the commands of the Patriarch". Parāçara said,—Hearing the words of their father those princes said, "So be it" and repeatedly addressed him, O Muni, saying,—"By what, O father, we shall be able to multiply mankind? It behoveth thee to mention this unto me". The father said,—"There is no doubt that people shall meet with an accomplishment of all their desires, if they worship Vishnu, the conferrer of boons. There is no other alternative. What future can I tell you? If you wish to succeed, do you adore Govinda who is Hari, the lord of all beings, in order to bring about the increase of mankind. The excellent Purusha, without beginning, should be worshipped by him who wishes for virtue, wealth, enjoyment or liberation. Adore him, who is imperishable and propitiating whom the great Patriarch Brahmā succeeded in creating the universe". Parāçara said,—Being thus addressed by their father the ten Prachetas plunged into the deep and with concentrated minds, engaged in devotion. O foremost of ascetics, with their minds wholly devoted to Nārāyana, the refuge of all creatures and the lord of the universe, and withdrawing their thoughts from all other exterior objects, they remained (in the state of devotion) for ten thousand years. And remaining there they worshipped with concentrated minds that great God Hari, who, when propitiated, confers, on all those who praise him, whatever they desire. Maitreya said,—"O foremost of ascetics, the praises addressed to Vishnu, by those Prachatas, lying plunged in the depths of the ocean are sacred and it behoveth thee to relate them unto me". Parāçara said—Do thou hear—(I shall recount) the praises addressed, of old, to Govinda by the Prachetas as they stood in the waters of the deep. Prachetas said,—"We bow unto him who is the eternal theme of all speech, who is the beginning of the boundless universe and the lord of it; who is the primeval light—who has not the like of him; indivisible and infinite; who is the creator of all things, mobile and immobile—salutation unto him, who is one with time, who is without form—and whose first form is the day and the second and third form are the evening and night. Salutation unto him, who is the same with the moon who is the life of all living beings, and who is the receptacle of ambrosia, drunk daily by the celestials and progenitors. Salutation unto him, who is one with the sun, who with his fierce rays, dispels darkness from the sky and who is the creator of the seasons—the summer, the winter and the rains. Salutation unto him, who is one with the earth—who, being solid, is supporting the whole universe and is the asylum of smell and all other objects of sense. We bow to that form of Hari, which is water, which is the seed of all living beings and the womb of the world. Salutation unto Vishnu, who is one with Fire, who is the mouth of the celestials being the eater of the Havya and who is the mouth of the progenitors being the eater of the Kavya. Salutation unto him who is at one with the air, which exists as five vital airs in the body causing constant vital action and is the origin of ether. Salutation unto him, who is at one with the atmosphere, who is pure, whose form and end cannot be perceived, who is shapeless and limitless and who gives separate existence to all creatures. Salutation unto Krishna, who is the creator, is perceived in the form of sensible objects and is the direction of the faculties of sense. We bow unto Hari, who is one with senses both subtle and substantial, who receives the impression of the senses, and who is the source of all knowledge. Salutation unto that universal soul, who as intellect carries the impressions received by the senses to the soul—Salutation unto him who is Prakriti—who has created the Universe, who is maintaining it and in whom it shall perish. We bow unto that excellent Purusha, who albeit freed from all and devoid of all qualities, appears, to the creatures labouring under mistakes, as enveloped with all qualities. Salutation unto that Brahmā, who is the ultimate condition of Vishnu, who is unchangeable, without birth, pure, void of qualities and free from accidents; who is neither high nor low neither massive nor thin, has neither shape, nor colour, nor shadow, nor substance nor affection nor body; who is neither ethereal nor capable of being touched; who is neither smell nor taste; who has no eyes, cars, or motion or speech, breath mind; who is without name, gotra, countenance or lustre; who is without fear or mistake; without blame, disease or death; who is free from passion, without sins, imperceptible, inactive, independent of place and time, separated from all investing properties, but exercising irresistible might, and who is at one with all beings and dependant upon none. Salutation to that nature of Vishnu which tongue cannot describe nor eye hath seen". Parāçara said—Thus glorifying Vishnu the Prachetas performed austerities for ten thousand years in the depths of the sea. Thereupon Hari, having the complexion of the full-blown lotus leaf, being pleased, appeared before them even in the midst of waters. And beholding him mounted on Garuda, the Prachetas bending low their heads with reverence, saluted him. Thereupon Vishnu addressed them, saying,—"Do you ask of me a boon. Being pleased with you I have come here to confer boons on you". Bowing unto that giver of boons, the Prachetas asked of him the multiplication of mankind as ordered by their parents. And granting them the wished for boon Vishnu disappeared instantly and Prachetas too came out of the sea.

verses.sa:
श्रीपराशर उवाच
तपश्चरत्सु पृथिवीं प्रचेतःसु महीरुहाः ।
अरक्ष्यमाणामावव्रुर्बभूवाथ प्रजाक्षयः ॥
verses.rom:
shriparashara uvacha
tapashcharatsu prithivim prachetahsu mahiruhah |
arakshyamanamavavrurbabhuvatha prajakshayah ||

verses.sa:
नाशकन्मरुतो वातुं वृतं खमभवद्द्रुमैः ।
दशवर्षसहस्राणि न शकुश्चेष्टितुं प्रजाः ॥
verses.rom:
nashakanmaruto vatum vritam khamabhavaddrumaih |
dashavarshasahasrani na shakushcheshtitum prajah ||

verses.sa:
तान्दृष्ट्वा जलनिष्क्रान्ताः सर्वे क्रुद्धाः प्रचेतसः ।
मुखेभ्यो वायुमग्निं च तेऽसृजन् जातमन्यवः ॥
verses.rom:
tandrishtva jalanishkrantah sarve kruddhah prachetasah |
mukhebhyo vayumagnim cha te'srijan jatamanyavah ||

verses.sa:
उन्मूलानथ तान्वृक्षान्कृत्वा वायुरशोषयत् ।
तानग्निरदहद्घोरस्तत्राभूद्द्रुमसंक्षयः ॥
verses.rom:
unmulanatha tanvrikshankritva vayurashoshayat |
tanagniradahadghorastatrabhuddrumasamkshayah ||

verses.sa:
द्रुमक्षयमथो दृष्ट्वा किञ्चिच्छिष्टेषु शाखिषु ।
उपगम्याब्रवीदेतान्राजा सोमः प्रजापतीन् ॥
verses.rom:
drumakshayamatho drishtva kinchichchhishteshu shakhishu |
upagamyabravidetanraja somah prajapatin ||

verses.sa:
कोपं यच्छत राजानः शृणुध्वञ्च वचो मम ।
सन्धानं वः करिष्यामि सह क्षितिरुहैरहम् ॥
verses.rom:
kopam yachchhata rajanah shrinudhvancha vacho mama |
sandhanam vah karishyami saha kshitiruhairaham ||

verses.sa:
रत्नभूता च कन्येयं वार्क्षेयी वरवर्णिनी ।
भविष्यज्जानता पूर्वं मया गोभिर्विवर्धिता ॥
verses.rom:
ratnabhuta cha kanyeyam varksheyi varavarnini |
bhavishyajjanata purvam maya gobhirvivardhita ||

verses.sa:
मारिषा नाम नाम्नैषा वृक्षाणामिति निर्मिता ।
भार्या वोऽस्तु महाभागा ध्रुवं वंशविवर्धिनी ॥
verses.rom:
marisha nama namnaisha vrikshanamiti nirmita |
bharya vo'stu mahabhaga dhruvam vamshavivardhini ||

verses.sa:
युष्माकं तेज सोर्धेन मम चार्धेन तेजसः ।
अस्यामुत्पत्स्यते विद्वान्दक्षोनाम प्रजापतिः ॥
verses.rom:
yushmakam teja sordhena mama chardhena tejasah |
asyamutpatsyate vidvandakshonama prajapatih ||

verses.sa:
मम चांशेन संयुक्तो युष्मत्तेजोमयेन वै ।
तेजसाग्निसमो भूयः प्रजाः संवर्धयिष्यति ॥
verses.rom:
mama chamshena samyukto yushmattejomayena vai |
tejasagnisamo bhuyah prajah samvardhayishyati ||

verses.sa:
कण्डुर्नाम मुनिः पूर्वमासीद्वेदविदां वरः ।
मुरम्ये गोमतीतीरे म तेपे परमं तपः ॥
verses.rom:
kandurnama munih purvamasidvedavidam varah |
muramye gomatitire ma tepe paramam tapah ||

verses.sa:
तत्क्षोभाय सुरेन्द्रेण प्रम्लोचाख्या वराप्सराः ।
प्रयुक्ता क्षोभयामास तमृषिं सा शुचिस्मिता ॥
verses.rom:
tatkshobhaya surendrena pramlochakhya varapsarah |
prayukta kshobhayamasa tamrishim sa shuchismita ||

verses.sa:
क्षोभितः स तया सार्धं वर्षाणामधिकं शतम् ।
अतिष्ठन्मन्दरद्रोण्यां विषयासक्तमानसः ॥
verses.rom:
kshobhitah sa taya sardham varshanamadhikam shatam |
atishthanmandaradronyam vishayasaktamanasah ||

verses.sa:
तं सा प्राह महाभाग गन्तुमिच्छाम्यहं दिवम् ।
प्रसादसुमुखो ब्रह्मन्ननुज्ञां दातुमर्हसि ॥
verses.rom:
tam sa praha mahabhaga gantumichchhamyaham divam |
prasadasumukho brahmannanujnam datumarhasi ||

verses.sa:
तयैवमुक्तः स मुनिस्तस्यामासक्तमानसः ।
दिनानि कतिचिद्भद्रे स्थीयतामित्यभाषत ॥
verses.rom:
tayaivamuktah sa munistasyamasaktamanasah |
dinani katichidbhadre sthiyatamityabhashata ||

verses.sa:
एवमुक्ता ततस्तेन साग्रं वर्षशतं पुनः ।
बुभुजे विषयांस्तन्वी तेन साकं महात्मना ॥
verses.rom:
evamukta tatastena sagram varshashatam punah |
bubhuje vishayamstanvi tena sakam mahatmana ||

verses.sa:
अनुज्ञां देहि भगवन् व्रजामि त्रिदशालयम् ।
उक्तस्तथेति स पुनः स्थीयतामित्यभाषत ॥
verses.rom:
anujnam dehi bhagavan vrajami tridashalayam |
uktastatheti sa punah sthiyatamityabhashata ||

verses.sa:
पुनर्गते वर्षशते साधिक सा शुभानना ।
यामीत्याह दिवं ब्रह्मन्प्रणयस्मितशोभनम् ॥
verses.rom:
punargate varshashate sadhika sa shubhanana |
yamityaha divam brahmanpranayasmitashobhanam ||

verses.sa:
उक्तस्तयैवं स मुनिरुपगुह्यायते क्षणाम् ।
इहास्यतां क्षणं सुभु चिरकालं गमिष्यसि ॥
verses.rom:
uktastayaivam sa munirupaguhyayate kshanam |
ihasyatam kshanam subhu chirakalam gamishyasi ||

verses.sa:
सा क्रीडमाना सुश्रोणी सह तेनर्षिणा पुनः ।
शतद्वयं किञ्चिदूनं वर्षणामन्वतिष्ठत ॥
verses.rom:
sa kridamana sushroni saha tenarshina punah |
shatadvayam kinchidunam varshanamanvatishthata ||

verses.sa:
गमनाय महाभाग देवराजनिवेशनम् ।
प्रोक्तः प्रोक्तस्तया तन्व्या स्थीयतामित्यभाषत ॥
verses.rom:
gamanaya mahabhaga devarajaniveshanam |
proktah proktastaya tanvya sthiyatamityabhashata ||

verses.sa:
तस्य शापभयाद्भीता दाक्षिण्येन च दक्षिणा ।
प्रोक्ता प्रणयभङ्गर्तिवेदिनी न जहौ मुनिम् ॥
verses.rom:
tasya shapabhayadbhita dakshinyena cha dakshina |
prokta pranayabhangartivedini na jahau munim ||

verses.sa:
तया च रमतस्तस्य परमर्षेरहर्निशम् ।
नवंनवमभूत्प्रम मन्मथाविष्टचेतसः ॥
verses.rom:
taya cha ramatastasya paramarsheraharnisham |
navamnavamabhutprama manmathavishtachetasah ||

verses.sa:
एकदा तु त्वरायुक्तो निश्चक्रामोटजान्मुनिः ।
निष्क्रामन्तं च कुत्रेति गम्यते प्राह सा शुभा ॥
verses.rom:
ekada tu tvarayukto nishchakramotajanmunih |
nishkramantam cha kutreti gamyate praha sa shubha ||

verses.sa:
इत्युक्तः स तया प्राह परिवृत्तमहः शुभे ।
सन्ध्योपास्तिं करिष्यामि क्रियालोपोन्यथा भवेत् ॥
verses.rom:
ityuktah sa taya praha parivrittamahah shubhe |
sandhyopastim karishyami kriyaloponyatha bhavet ||

verses.sa:
ततः प्रहस्य सुददी तं सा प्राह महामुनिम् ।
किमद्य सर्वधर्मज्ञ परिवृत्तमहस्तव ॥
verses.rom:
tatah prahasya sudadi tam sa praha mahamunim |
kimadya sarvadharmajna parivrittamahastava ||

verses.sa:
बहूनां विप्र वर्षाणां परिवृत्तम हस्तव ।
गतमेतन्न कुरुते विस्मयं कस्य कथ्यताम् ॥
verses.rom:
bahunam vipra varshanam parivrittama hastava |
gatametanna kurute vismayam kasya kathyatam ||

verses.sa:
मुनिरुवाच
प्रातस्त्वमागता भद्रे नदीतीरमिदं शुभम् ।
मया दृष्टासि तन्वङ्गि प्रविष्टासि ममाश्रमम् ॥
verses.rom:
muniruvacha
pratastvamagata bhadre naditiramidam shubham |
maya drishtasi tanvangi pravishtasi mamashramam ||

verses.sa:
इयं च वर्तते सन्ध्या परिणाममहर्गतम् ।
उपहासः किमर्थोयं सद्भावः कथ्यतां मम ॥
verses.rom:
iyam cha vartate sandhya parinamamahargatam |
upahasah kimarthoyam sadbhavah kathyatam mama ||

verses.sa:
प्रम्लोचोवाच
प्रत्यूषस्यागता ब्रह्मन् सत्यमेतन्न तन्मृषा ।
नन्वस्य तस्य कालस्य गतान्यब्दशतानि ते ॥
verses.rom:
pramlochovacha
pratyushasyagata brahman satyametanna tanmrisha |
nanvasya tasya kalasya gatanyabdashatani te ||

verses.sa:
सोम उवाच
ततः स साध्वसो विप्रस्तां पप्रच्छायतेक्षणाम् ।
कथ्यतां भीरु कः कालस्त्वया मे रमतः सह ॥
verses.rom:
soma uvacha
tatah sa sadhvaso viprastam paprachchhayatekshanam |
kathyatam bhiru kah kalastvaya me ramatah saha ||

verses.sa:
प्रम्लोचोवाच
सप्तोत्तराम्यतीतानि नववर्षशतानि ते ।
मासाश्च षट्तथैवान्यत्समतीतं दिनत्रयम् ॥
verses.rom:
pramlochovacha
saptottaramyatitani navavarshashatani te |
masashcha shattathaivanyatsamatitam dinatrayam ||

verses.sa:
ऋषिरुवाच
सत्यं भीरु वदस्येतत्परिहासोऽथवा शुभे ।
दिनमेकमहं मन्येत्वया सार्धमिहासितम् ॥
verses.rom:
rishiruvacha
satyam bhiru vadasyetatparihaso'thava shubhe |
dinamekamaham manyetvaya sardhamihasitam ||

verses.sa:
प्रम्लोचोवाच
वदिष्याम्यनृतं ब्रह्मन्कथमत्र तवान्तिके ।
विशेषेणाद्य भवता पृष्टा मार्गानुवर्तिना ॥
verses.rom:
pramlochovacha
vadishyamyanritam brahmankathamatra tavantike |
visheshenadya bhavata prishta marganuvartina ||

verses.sa:
सोम उवाच
निशम्य तद्वचः सत्यं स मुनिर्नृपनन्दनाः ।
धिक्धिक्मामित्यतीवेत्थं निनिन्दात्मानमात्मना ॥
verses.rom:
soma uvacha
nishamya tadvachah satyam sa munirnripanandanah |
dhikdhikmamityativettham ninindatmanamatmana ||

verses.sa:
मुनिरुवाच
तपांसि मम नष्टनि हतं ब्रह्मविदां धनम् ।
हतो विवेकः केनापि योषिन्मोहाय निर्मिताः ॥
verses.rom:
muniruvacha
tapamsi mama nashtani hatam brahmavidam dhanam |
hato vivekah kenapi yoshinmohaya nirmitah ||

verses.sa:
ऊर्मिषट्कातिगं ब्रह्म ज्ञेयमात्मजयेन मे ।
मतिरेषा हृता येन धिक्तं कामं महाग्रहम् ॥
verses.rom:
urmishatkatigam brahma jneyamatmajayena me |
matiresha hrita yena dhiktam kamam mahagraham ||

verses.sa:
व्रतानि वेदवेद्याप्तिकाराणान्यखिलानि च ।
नरकग्राममर्गेण सङ्गेनापहृतानि मे ॥
verses.rom:
vratani vedavedyaptikarananyakhilani cha |
narakagramamargena sangenapahritani me ||

verses.sa:
विनिन्द्येत्थं स धर्मज्ञः स्वयमात्मानमात्मना ।
तामप्सरसमासीनामिदं वचनमब्रवीत् ॥
verses.rom:
vinindyettham sa dharmajnah svayamatmanamatmana |
tamapsarasamasinamidam vachanamabravit ||

verses.sa:
गच्छ पापे यथाकामं यत्कार्यं तत्कृतं त्वया ।
देवराजस्य मत्क्षोभं कुर्वन्त्या भावचेष्टितैः ॥
verses.rom:
gachchha pape yathakamam yatkaryam tatkritam tvaya |
devarajasya matkshobham kurvantya bhavacheshtitaih ||

verses.sa:
न त्वां करोण्यहं भस्म क्रोधतीव्रेण वह्निना ।
सतां सप्तपदं मैत्रुमुषि तोहं त्वया सह ॥
verses.rom:
na tvam karonyaham bhasma krodhativrena vahnina |
satam saptapadam maitrumushi toham tvaya saha ||

verses.sa:
अथ वा तव को दोषः किं वा कुप्याम्यहं तव ।
ममैव दोषो नितरां येनाहमजितेन्द्रियः ॥
verses.rom:
atha va tava ko doshah kim va kupyamyaham tava |
mamaiva dosho nitaram yenahamajitendriyah ||

verses.sa:
यया शक्रप्रियार्थिन्या कृतो मे तपसो व्ययः ।
त्वया धिक्तां महामोहमञ्जृषां सुजुगुप्सिताम् ॥
verses.rom:
yaya shakrapriyarthinya krito me tapaso vyayah |
tvaya dhiktam mahamohamanjrisham sujugupsitam ||

verses.sa:
सोम उवाच
यावदित्थं स विप्रर्षिस्तां ब्रवीति समुध्यमाम् ।
तावद्गलत्स्वेदजला साबभूवातिवेपथुः ॥
verses.rom:
soma uvacha
yavadittham sa viprarshistam braviti samudhyamam |
tavadgalatsvedajala sababhuvativepathuh ||

verses.sa:
प्रवेपमानां सततं खिन्नगात्रलतां सतीम् ।
गच्छ गच्छेति सक्रोधमुवाच मुनिसत्तमः ॥
verses.rom:
pravepamanam satatam khinnagatralatam satim |
gachchha gachchheti sakrodhamuvacha munisattamah ||

verses.sa:
सा तु निर्भर्त्सिता तेन विनाष्क्रम्य तदाश्रमात् ।
आकाशगामिनी स्वेदं ममार्ज तरुपल्लवैः ॥
verses.rom:
sa tu nirbhartsita tena vinashkramya tadashramat |
akashagamini svedam mamarja tarupallavaih ||

verses.sa:
निर्मार्जमाना गात्राणि गलत्स्वेदजलानि वै ।
वृक्षाद्धृक्षं ययौ बाला तदग्रारुणपल्लवैः ॥
verses.rom:
nirmarjamana gatrani galatsvedajalani vai |
vrikshaddhriksham yayau bala tadagrarunapallavaih ||

verses.sa:
ऋषिणा यस्तदा गर्भस्तस्या देहे समाहितः ।
निर्जगाम स रोमाञ्चस्वेदरूपी तदङ्गतः ॥
verses.rom:
rishina yastada garbhastasya dehe samahitah |
nirjagama sa romanchasvedarupi tadangatah ||

verses.sa:
तं वृक्षा जगृहुर्गर्भमेकं चक्रे तु मारुतः ।
मया चाप्यायितो गोभिः स तदा ववृधे शनैः ॥
verses.rom:
tam vriksha jagrihurgarbhamekam chakre tu marutah |
maya chapyayito gobhih sa tada vavridhe shanaih ||

verses.sa:
वृक्षाग्रगर्भसम्भूता मारिषाख्या वरानना ।
तां प्रदास्यन्ति वो वृक्षाः कोप एष प्रशाम्यताम् ॥
verses.rom:
vrikshagragarbhasambhuta marishakhya varanana |
tam pradasyanti vo vrikshah kopa esha prashamyatam ||

verses.sa:
कण्डोरपत्यमेवं सा वृक्षेभ्यश्च समुद्गता ।
ममापत्यं तथा वायोः प्रम्लोचातनया च सा ॥
verses.rom:
kandorapatyamevam sa vrikshebhyashcha samudgata |
mamapatyam tatha vayoh pramlochatanaya cha sa ||

verses.sa:
स चापि भगवान् कण्डुः क्षीणे तपसि सत्तमः ।
पुरुषोत्तमाख्यं मैत्रेय विष्णोरायतनं ययौ ॥
verses.rom:
sa chapi bhagavan kanduh kshine tapasi sattamah |
purushottamakhyam maitreya vishnorayatanam yayau ||

verses.sa:
तत्रैकाग्रमतिर्भूत्वा चकाराराधनं हरेः ।
ब्रह्मपारमयं कुर्वञ्जपमेकाग्रमानसः ।
ऊर्ध्वबाहुर्महायोगी स्थित्वासौ भूपनन्दनाः ॥
verses.rom:
tatraikagramatirbhutva chakararadhanam hareh |
brahmaparamayam kurvanjapamekagramanasah |
urdhvabahurmahayogi sthitvasau bhupanandanah ||

verses.sa:
प्रचेतस ऊचुः
ब्रह्मपारं मुने श्रोतुमिच्छामः परमं स्तवम् ।
जपता कण्डुना देवो येनाराध्यत केशवः ॥
verses.rom:
prachetasa uchuh
brahmaparam mune shrotumichchhamah paramam stavam |
japata kanduna devo yenaradhyata keshavah ||

verses.sa:
सोम उवाच
पारं परं विष्णुरपारपारः परः परेभ्यः पामारथरूपी ।
सब्रह्पारः परपारभूतः परः पराणामपि पारपारः ॥
verses.rom:
soma uvacha
param param vishnuraparaparah parah parebhyah pamaratharupi |
sabrahparah paraparabhutah parah paranamapi paraparah ||

verses.sa:
स कारणं कारणतस्ततोपि तस्यापि हेतुः ।
कार्येषु चैवं सह कर्मकर्तृरूपैरशेषैरवतीह सर्वम् ॥
verses.rom:
sa karanam karanatastatopi tasyapi hetuh |
karyeshu chaivam saha karmakartrirupairasheshairavatiha sarvam ||

verses.sa:
ब्रह्म प्रभुर्ब्रह्म स सर्वभूतो ब्रह्म प्रजानां पतिरच्युतोऽसौ ।
ब्रह्माव्ययं नित्यमजं स विष्णुरपक्षयाद्यैरखिलैरसङ्गि ॥
verses.rom:
brahma prabhurbrahma sa sarvabhuto brahma prajanam patirachyuto'sau |
brahmavyayam nityamajam sa vishnurapakshayadyairakhilairasangi ||

verses.sa:
ब्रह्माक्षरमजं नित्यं यथासौ पुरुषोत्तमः ।
तथा रागादयो दोषः प्रयान्तु प्रशमं मम ॥
verses.rom:
brahmaksharamajam nityam yathasau purushottamah |
tatha ragadayo doshah prayantu prashamam mama ||

verses.sa:
सोम उवाच
एतद्ब्रह्म पराख्यं वै संस्तवं परमं जपन् ।
अवाप परमां सिद्धिं स तमाराध्य केशवम् ।
इमं स्तवं यः पठति शृणुयाद्वापि नित्यशः ।
स कामदेषैरशिलैर्मुक्तः प्राप्रोति वाञ्छितम् ॥
verses.rom:
soma uvacha
etadbrahma parakhyam vai samstavam paramam japan |
avapa paramam siddhim sa tamaradhya keshavam |
imam stavam yah pathati shrinuyadvapi nityashah |
sa kamadeshairashilairmuktah praproti vanchhitam ||

verses.sa:
इयं च मारीषा पूर्वमासीद्य तां ब्रवीमि वः ।
कार्यगौरवमेतस्याः कथने फलदायि वः ॥
verses.rom:
iyam cha marisha purvamasidya tam bravimi vah |
karyagauravametasyah kathane phaladayi vah ||

verses.sa:
अपुत्रा प्रागियं विष्णुं मृते भर्तरि सत्तमाः ।
भीपपत्नी महाभागा तोषयामास भक्तितः ॥
verses.rom:
aputra pragiyam vishnum mrite bhartari sattamah |
bhipapatni mahabhaga toshayamasa bhaktitah ||

verses.sa:
आराधितस्तया विष्णुः प्राह प्रत्यक्षतां गतः ।
वरं वृणीष्वेति शुभे सा च प्राहात्मवाञ्छितम् ॥
verses.rom:
aradhitastaya vishnuh praha pratyakshatam gatah |
varam vrinishveti shubhe sa cha prahatmavanchhitam ||

verses.sa:
भगवन्बालवैधव्याद्वृथाजन्माहमीदृशी ।
मन्दभाग्या समुद्भुता विफला च जगत्पते ॥
verses.rom:
bhagavanbalavaidhavyadvrithajanmahamidrishi |
mandabhagya samudbhuta viphala cha jagatpate ||

verses.sa:
भवन्तु पतयः श्लाघ्या मम जन्मनि जन्मनि ।
त्वत्प्रसादात्तथा पुत्रः प्रजापतिसमोस्तु मे ॥
verses.rom:
bhavantu patayah shlaghya mama janmani janmani |
tvatprasadattatha putrah prajapatisamostu me ||

verses.sa:
कुलं शीलं वयः सत्यं दाक्षिण्यं क्षिप्रकारिता ।
अविसंवादिता सत्त्वं वृद्धसेवा कृतज्ञता ॥
verses.rom:
kulam shilam vayah satyam dakshinyam kshiprakarita |
avisamvadita sattvam vriddhaseva kritajnata ||

verses.sa:
रूपसम्पत्समायुक्ता सर्वस्य प्रियदर्शना ।
अयोनिजा च जायेयं त्वन्प्रसादादाधेक्षज ॥
verses.rom:
rupasampatsamayukta sarvasya priyadarshana |
ayonija cha jayeyam tvanprasadadadhekshaja ||

verses.sa:
सोम उवाच
तयैवमुक्तो देवेशो हृषीकेश उवाच ताम् ।
प्रणामनम्रामुत्थाप्य वरदः परमेश्वरः ॥
verses.rom:
soma uvacha
tayaivamukto devesho hrishikesha uvacha tam |
pranamanamramutthapya varadah parameshvarah ||

verses.sa:
देव उवाच
भविष्यन्ति महावीर्या एकस्मिन्नेव जन्मनि ।
प्रख्यातोदारकर्णाणो भवत्याः पतयो दश ॥
verses.rom:
deva uvacha
bhavishyanti mahavirya ekasminneva janmani |
prakhyatodarakarnano bhavatyah patayo dasha ||

verses.sa:
पुत्रञ्च सुमहावीर्यं महाबलपराक्रमम् ।
प्रजापतिगुणैर्युक्तं त्वमवाप्स्यसि शोभने ॥
verses.rom:
putrancha sumahaviryam mahabalaparakramam |
prajapatigunairyuktam tvamavapsyasi shobhane ||

verses.sa:
वंशानां तस्य कर्तृत्वं जगत्यस्मिन्भविष्यति ।
त्रैलोक्यमखिला सूतिस्तस्य चापूरयिष्यति ॥
verses.rom:
vamshanam tasya kartritvam jagatyasminbhavishyati |
trailokyamakhila sutistasya chapurayishyati ||

verses.sa:
त्वं चाप्ययोनिजा साध्वी रूपौदार्यगुणान्विता ।
मनः प्रीतिकरी नॄणां मत्प्रसादाद्भविष्यसि ॥
verses.rom:
tvam chapyayonija sadhvi rupaudaryagunanvita |
manah pritikari nrinam matprasadadbhavishyasi ||

verses.sa:
इत्युक्त्वान्तर्दधे देवस्तां विशालविलोचनाम् ।
सा चेयं मारिषा जाता युष्मत्पत्नी नृपात्मजाः ॥
verses.rom:
ityuktvantardadhe devastam vishalavilochanam |
sa cheyam marisha jata yushmatpatni nripatmajah ||

verses.sa:
श्रीपराशर उवाच
ततः सोमस्य वचनाज्जगृहुस्ते प्रचेतसः ।
संहृत्य कोपं वृक्षेभ्यः पत्नीधर्मोण मारीषाम् ॥
verses.rom:
shriparashara uvacha
tatah somasya vachanajjagrihuste prachetasah |
samhritya kopam vrikshebhyah patnidharmona marisham ||

verses.sa:
दशभ्यस्तु प्रचेतोभ्यो मारीषायां प्रजापतिः ।
जज्ञे दक्षो महाभागो यः पूर्वं ब्रह्मणोऽभवत् ॥
verses.rom:
dashabhyastu prachetobhyo marishayam prajapatih |
jajne daksho mahabhago yah purvam brahmano'bhavat ||

verses.sa:
स तु दक्षो महाभागःसृष्ट्यर्थं सुमहामते ।
पुत्रानुत्पादयामास प्रजासृष्ट्यर्थमात्मनः ॥
verses.rom:
sa tu daksho mahabhagahsrishtyartham sumahamate |
putranutpadayamasa prajasrishtyarthamatmanah ||

verses.sa:
अवरांश्च वरांश्चैव द्विपदोथ चतुष्पदान् ।
आदेशं ब्रह्मणः कुर्वन् सृष्ट्यर्थं समुपस्थितः ॥
verses.rom:
avaramshcha varamshchaiva dvipadotha chatushpadan |
adesham brahmanah kurvan srishtyartham samupasthitah ||

verses.sa:
स सृष्ट्वा मनसा दक्षः पश्चादसृजत स्त्रियः ।
ददौ स दश धर्माय कश्यपाय त्रयोदश ।
कालस्य नयने युक्ताः सप्तविंशतिमिन्दवे ॥
verses.rom:
sa srishtva manasa dakshah pashchadasrijata striyah |
dadau sa dasha dharmaya kashyapaya trayodasha |
kalasya nayane yuktah saptavimshatimindave ||

verses.sa:
तासु देवास्तथा दैत्या नागा गावस्तथा खगाः ।
गन्धर्वाप्सरसश्चैव दानवाद्याश्च जज्ञिरे ॥
verses.rom:
tasu devastatha daitya naga gavastatha khagah |
gandharvapsarasashchaiva danavadyashcha jajnire ||

verses.sa:
ततः प्रभृति मैत्रेय प्रजा मैथुनसम्भवाः ।
संकल्पाद्दर्शनात्स्पर्शात्पूर्वेषामभवन् प्रजाः ।
तपोविशेषैः सिद्धानां तदात्यन्ततपस्विनाम् ॥
verses.rom:
tatah prabhriti maitreya praja maithunasambhavah |
samkalpaddarshanatsparshatpurveshamabhavan prajah |
tapovisheshaih siddhanam tadatyantatapasvinam ||

verses.sa:
श्रीमैत्रेय उवाच
अङ्गुष्ठाद्दक्षिणाद्दक्षः पूर्वं जातो मया श्रुतः ।
कथं प्राचेतसो भूयः समुत्पन्नो महामुने ॥
verses.rom:
shrimaitreya uvacha
angushthaddakshinaddakshah purvam jato maya shrutah |
katham prachetaso bhuyah samutpanno mahamune ||

verses.sa:
एष मे संशयो ब्रह्मन्सुमहान्हृदि वर्तते ।
यद्दैहित्रश्च सोमस्य पुनः श्वशुरतां गतः ॥
verses.rom:
esha me samshayo brahmansumahanhridi vartate |
yaddaihitrashcha somasya punah shvashuratam gatah ||

verses.sa:
श्रीराशर उवाच
उत्पत्तिश्च निरोधश्च नित्यो भूतेषु सर्वाद ।
ऋषयोत्र न सुह्यन्ति ये चान्ये दिव्यचक्षुषः ॥
verses.rom:
shrirashara uvacha
utpattishcha nirodhashcha nityo bhuteshu sarvada |
rishayotra na suhyanti ye chanye divyachakshushah ||

verses.sa:
युगेयुगे भवन्त्येते दक्षाद्या मुनिसत्तम ।
पुनश्चैवं निरुद्ध्यन्ते विद्वांस्तत्र न मुह्यति ॥
verses.rom:
yugeyuge bhavantyete dakshadya munisattama |
punashchaivam niruddhyante vidvamstatra na muhyati ||

verses.sa:
कानिष्ठ्यं ज्यैष्ठ्यमप्येषां पूर्वं नाभूद्द्द्विजोत्तम ।
तप एव गरीयोभूत्प्रभा वश्चैव कारणम् ॥
verses.rom:
kanishthyam jyaishthyamapyesham purvam nabhudddvijottama |
tapa eva gariyobhutprabha vashchaiva karanam ||

verses.sa:
मैत्रेय उवाच
देवानां दानवानां च गन्धर्वोरगरक्षसाम् ।
उत्पत्तिं विस्तरेणेह मम ब्रह्मन्प्रकीर्तय ॥
verses.rom:
maitreya uvacha
devanam danavanam cha gandharvoragarakshasam |
utpattim vistareneha mama brahmanprakirtaya ||

verses.sa:
श्रीपराशर उवाच
प्रजाः सृजेति व्यादिष्टः पूर्वं दक्षः स्वयंभुवा ।
यथा ससर्ज भूतानि तथा शृणु महामुने ॥
verses.rom:
shriparashara uvacha
prajah srijeti vyadishtah purvam dakshah svayambhuva |
yatha sasarja bhutani tatha shrinu mahamune ||

verses.sa:
मानसान्येव भूतानि पूर्वं दक्षोऽसृजत्तदा ।
देवानृषीन्सगन्धर्वानसुरान्पन्नगांस्तथा ॥
verses.rom:
manasanyeva bhutani purvam daksho'srijattada |
devanrishinsagandharvanasuranpannagamstatha ||

verses.sa:
यदास्य सृजमानस्य न व्यवर्धन्त ताः प्रजाः ।
ततः संचिन्त्य स पुनः सृष्टिहेतोः प्रजापतिः ॥
verses.rom:
yadasya srijamanasya na vyavardhanta tah prajah |
tatah samchintya sa punah srishtihetoh prajapatih ||

verses.sa:
मैथुनेनैव धर्मेण सिसृक्षुर्विविधाः प्रजाः ।
असक्नीमावहत्कन्यां वीरणस्य प्रजापतेः ।
सुतां सुतपसा युक्तां महतीं लोकधारिणीम् ॥
verses.rom:
maithunenaiva dharmena sisrikshurvividhah prajah |
asaknimavahatkanyam viranasya prajapateh |
sutam sutapasa yuktam mahatim lokadharinim ||

verses.sa:
अथ पुत्रसहस्राणै वैरुण्यां पञ्च वीर्यवान् ।
असिक्न्यां जनयामास सर्गहेतोः प्रजापतिः ॥
verses.rom:
atha putrasahasranai vairunyam pancha viryavan |
asiknyam janayamasa sargahetoh prajapatih ||

verses.sa:
तान्दृष्ट्वा नारदो विप्र संविवर्धयिषून्प्रजाः ।
संगम्य प्रियसंवादो देवर्षिरिदमब्रवीत् ॥
verses.rom:
tandrishtva narado vipra samvivardhayishunprajah |
samgamya priyasamvado devarshiridamabravit ||

verses.sa:
हे हर्यश्वा महावीर्याः प्रजा यूयं करिष्यथ ।
ईदृशो दृश्यते यत्नो भवतां श्रूयतामीदम् ॥
verses.rom:
he haryashva mahaviryah praja yuyam karishyatha |
idrisho drishyate yatno bhavatam shruyatamidam ||

verses.sa:
बालिश बत यूयं वै नास्या जानीत वै भुवः ।
अन्तरूर्ध्वमधश्चैव कथं सृक्ष्यथ वै प्रजाः ॥
verses.rom:
balisha bata yuyam vai nasya janita vai bhuvah |
antarurdhvamadhashchaiva katham srikshyatha vai prajah ||

verses.sa:
ऊर्ध्वं तिर्यगधश्चैव यदाप्रतिहता गतिः ।
तदा कस्माद्भुवो नान्तं सर्वे द्रक्ष्यथ बालिशाः ॥
verses.rom:
urdhvam tiryagadhashchaiva yadapratihata gatih |
tada kasmadbhuvo nantam sarve drakshyatha balishah ||

verses.sa:
ते तु तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा प्रयाताः सर्वतो दिशम् ।
अद्यापि नो निवर्तन्ते समुद्रेभ्य इवापगाः ॥
verses.rom:
te tu tadvachanam shrutva prayatah sarvato disham |
adyapi no nivartante samudrebhya ivapagah ||

verses.sa:
हर्य श्वेष्वथ नष्टोषु दक्षः प्राचेतसः पुनः ।
वैरुण्यामथ पुत्राणां सहस्रमसृजत्प्रभुः ॥
verses.rom:
harya shveshvatha nashtoshu dakshah prachetasah punah |
vairunyamatha putranam sahasramasrijatprabhuh ||

verses.sa:
विवर्धयिषवस्ते तु शबलाश्वाः प्रजाः पुनः ।
पूर्वोक्तं वचनं ब्रह्मन्नारदेनैव नोदिताः ॥
verses.rom:
vivardhayishavaste tu shabalashvah prajah punah |
purvoktam vachanam brahmannaradenaiva noditah ||

verses.sa:
अन्योन्यमूचुस्ते सर्वे सम्यगाह महामुनिः ।
भ्रतॄणां पदवी चैव गन्तव्या नात्र संशयः ॥
verses.rom:
anyonyamuchuste sarve samyagaha mahamunih |
bhratrinam padavi chaiva gantavya natra samshayah ||

verses.sa: ज्ञात्वा प्रमाणं पृथ्व्याश्च प्रजाःसृज्यामहे ततः ॥
verses.rom: jnatva pramanam prithvyashcha prajahsrijyamahe tatah ||

verses.sa:
तेपि तेनैव मार्गेण प्रयाताः सर्वतोमुखम् ।
अद्यापि न निवर्तन्ते समुद्रेभ्य इवापगाः ।
ततः प्रभृति वै भ्राता भ्रातुरन्वेषणे द्विज ।
प्रयातो नश्यति तथा तन्न कार्यं विजानता ॥
verses.rom:
tepi tenaiva margena prayatah sarvatomukham |
adyapi na nivartante samudrebhya ivapagah |
tatah prabhriti vai bhrata bhraturanveshane dvija |
prayato nashyati tatha tanna karyam vijanata ||

verses.sa:
तां श्चापि नष्टान् विज्ञाय पुत्रान् दक्षः प्रजापतिः ।
क्रोधं चक्रे महाभागो नारदं स शशाप च ॥
verses.rom:
tam shchapi nashtan vijnaya putran dakshah prajapatih |
krodham chakre mahabhago naradam sa shashapa cha ||

verses.sa:
सर्गकामस्ततो विद्वान्स मैत्रेय प्रजापतिः ।
षष्टिं तक्षोऽसृजत्कन्या वैरुण्यामिति नः श्रुतम् ॥
verses.rom:
sargakamastato vidvansa maitreya prajapatih |
shashtim taksho'srijatkanya vairunyamiti nah shrutam ||

verses.sa:
ददौ स दश धर्माय कश्यपाय त्रयोदश ।
सप्तविंशति सोमाय चतस्त्रोऽरिष्टनेमिने ॥
verses.rom:
dadau sa dasha dharmaya kashyapaya trayodasha |
saptavimshati somaya chatastro'rishtanemine ||

verses.sa:
द्वे चैव बहुपुत्राय द्वे चैवाङ्गिरसे तथा ।
द्वे कृशाश्वाय विदुषे तासां नामानि मे शृणु ॥
verses.rom:
dve chaiva bahuputraya dve chaivangirase tatha |
dve krishashvaya vidushe tasam namani me shrinu ||

verses.sa:
अरुन्धती वसुर्जामिर्लङ्घा भानुमरुत्वती ।
संकल्पा च मुहूर्ता च साध्या विश्वा च तादृशी ।
धर्मपत्न्यो दशत्वेतास्तास्वपत्यानि मे शृणु ।
विश्वेदेवास्तु विश्वायाः साध्या साध्यानजायत ।
मरुत्वत्यां सरुत्वन्तो वसोश्च वसवः स्मृता ॥
verses.rom:
arundhati vasurjamirlangha bhanumarutvati |
samkalpa cha muhurta cha sadhya vishva cha tadrishi |
dharmapatnyo dashatvetastasvapatyani me shrinu |
vishvedevastu vishvayah sadhya sadhyanajayata |
marutvatyam sarutvanto vasoshcha vasavah smrita ||

verses.sa: भानोस्तु भानवः पुत्रा मुहूर्तायां मुहूर्तजाः ॥
verses.rom: bhanostu bhanavah putra muhurtayam muhurtajah ||

verses.sa: लङ्घायाश्चैव घोषोथ नागवीथी तु जामिता ॥
verses.rom: langhayashchaiva ghoshotha nagavithi tu jamita ||

verses.sa:
पृथिवीविषयं सर्वमरुन्धत्याम जायत ।
संकल्पायास्तु सर्वात्मा जज्ञे संकल्प एव हि ॥
verses.rom:
prithivivishayam sarvamarundhatyama jayata |
samkalpayastu sarvatma jajne samkalpa eva hi ||

verses.sa:
ये त्वनेकवसुप्राणदेवा ज्योतिः पुरोगमाः ।
वसवोष्टौ समाख्यातास्तेषां वक्ष्यामि विस्तरम् ॥
verses.rom:
ye tvanekavasupranadeva jyotih purogamah |
vasavoshtau samakhyatastesham vakshyami vistaram ||

verses.sa:
आपो ध्रुवश्च सोमश्च धर्मश्चैवानिलोऽनलः ।
प्रत्यूषश्च प्रभासश्च वसवो नामभिः स्मृताः ॥
verses.rom:
apo dhruvashcha somashcha dharmashchaivanilo'nalah |
pratyushashcha prabhasashcha vasavo namabhih smritah ||

verses.sa:
आपस्य पुत्रो वैतण्डः श्रमः शान्तोऽध्वनिस्तथा ।
ध्रुवस्य पुत्रो भगवान्कालो लोकप्रकालनः ॥
verses.rom:
apasya putro vaitandah shramah shanto'dhvanistatha |
dhruvasya putro bhagavankalo lokaprakalanah ||

verses.sa: सोमस्य भगवान्वर्चो वर्चस्वी येन जायते ॥
verses.rom: somasya bhagavanvarcho varchasvi yena jayate ||

verses.sa:
धर्मस्य पुत्रो द्रविणो हुतहव्यवहस्तथा ।
मनोहरायां शिशिरः प्राणोथ रवणस्तथा ॥
verses.rom:
dharmasya putro dravino hutahavyavahastatha |
manoharayam shishirah pranotha ravanastatha ||

verses.sa:
अनिलस्य शिवा भार्या तस्याः पुत्रो मनोजवः ।
अविज्ञातगतिश्चैव द्वौ पुत्रावनिलस्य तु ॥
verses.rom:
anilasya shiva bharya tasyah putro manojavah |
avijnatagatishchaiva dvau putravanilasya tu ||

verses.sa:
अग्निपुत्रः कुमारस्तु शरस्तम्बे व्यजायत ।
तस्य शाखो विशाखश्च नैगमेयश्च पृष्ठजाः ॥
verses.rom:
agniputrah kumarastu sharastambe vyajayata |
tasya shakho vishakhashcha naigameyashcha prishthajah ||

verses.sa: अपत्यं कृत्तिकानां तु कार्त्तिकेय इति स्मृतः ॥
verses.rom: apatyam krittikanam tu karttikeya iti smritah ||

verses.sa:
प्रत्यूषस्य विदुः पुत्रं ऋषि नाम्नाथ देवलम् ।
द्वौ पुत्रौ देवलस्यापि क्षमावन्तौ मनीषिणौ ॥
verses.rom:
pratyushasya viduh putram rishi namnatha devalam |
dvau putrau devalasyapi kshamavantau manishinau ||

verses.sa:
बृहस्पतेस्तु भगिनी वरस्त्री ब्रह्मचारिणी ।
योगसिद्धा जगत्कृत्स्नमसक्ता विचरत्युत ।
प्रभासस्य तु सा भार्या वसूनामष्टमस्य तु ॥
verses.rom:
brihaspatestu bhagini varastri brahmacharini |
yogasiddha jagatkritsnamasakta vicharatyuta |
prabhasasya tu sa bharya vasunamashtamasya tu ||

verses.sa:
विश्वकर्मा महाभागस्तस्यां जज्ञे प्रजापतिः ।
कर्ता शिल्पसहस्राणां त्रिदशानां च वार्धकिः ॥
verses.rom:
vishvakarma mahabhagastasyam jajne prajapatih |
karta shilpasahasranam tridashanam cha vardhakih ||

verses.sa:
भूषणानां च सर्वेषां कर्ताशिल्पवतां वरः ।
यः सर्वैषां विमानानि देवतानां चकार ह ।
मनुष्याश्चोपजीवन्ति यस्य शिल्पं महात्मनः ॥
verses.rom:
bhushananam cha sarvesham kartashilpavatam varah |
yah sarvaisham vimanani devatanam chakara ha |
manushyashchopajivanti yasya shilpam mahatmanah ||

verses.sa:
अजैकपादहिर्बुध्न्यस्त्वष्टा रुद्रश्च वीर्यवान् ।
त्वष्टुश्चाप्यात्मजः पुत्रो विश्वरूपो महातपाः ॥
verses.rom:
ajaikapadahirbudhnyastvashta rudrashcha viryavan |
tvashtushchapyatmajah putro vishvarupo mahatapah ||

verses.sa:
हरश्च बहुरूपश्च त्र्यम्बकश्चापराजितः ।
वृषाकपिश्च शम्भुश्च कपर्दीरैवतः स्मृतः ॥
verses.rom:
harashcha bahurupashcha tryambakashchaparajitah |
vrishakapishcha shambhushcha kapardiraivatah smritah ||

verses.sa:
मृगव्याधश्च शर्वश्च कपाली च महामुने ।
एकादशैते कथिता रुद्रास्त्रिभुवनेश्वराः ॥
verses.rom:
mrigavyadhashcha sharvashcha kapali cha mahamune |
ekadashaite kathita rudrastribhuvaneshvarah ||

verses.sa:
शतं त्वेकं समाख्यातं रुद्राणाममितौजसाम् ।
काश्यपस्य तु भार्या यास्तासां नामानि मे शृणु ।
अदितिर्दितिर्दनुश्चैवारिष्टा च सुरसा खसा ॥
verses.rom:
shatam tvekam samakhyatam rudranamamitaujasam |
kashyapasya tu bharya yastasam namani me shrinu |
aditirditirdanushchaivarishta cha surasa khasa ||

verses.sa:
सुरभिर्विनता चैव ताम्रा क्रोधवशा इरा ।
कद्रुर्मुनिश्च धर्मज्ञ तदपत्यानि मे शृणु ॥
verses.rom:
surabhirvinata chaiva tamra krodhavasha ira |
kadrurmunishcha dharmajna tadapatyani me shrinu ||

verses.sa:
पूर्वमन्वन्तरे श्रेष्ठा द्वादशासन्सुरोत्तमाः ।
तुषिता नाम तेऽन्योन्यमूचुर्वैवस्वतेन्तरे ॥
verses.rom:
purvamanvantare shreshtha dvadashasansurottamah |
tushita nama te'nyonyamuchurvaivasvatentare ||

verses.sa:
उपस्थितेऽतियशसश्चाक्षुषस्यान्तरे मनोः ।
समवायीकृताः सर्वे समागम्य परस्परम् ॥
verses.rom:
upasthite'tiyashasashchakshushasyantare manoh |
samavayikritah sarve samagamya parasparam ||

verses.sa:
आगच्छत द्रुतं देवा अदितिं संप्रविश्य वै ।
मन्वन्तरे प्रसूयामस्तन्नः श्रेयो भवेदिति ॥
verses.rom:
agachchhata drutam deva aditim sampravishya vai |
manvantare prasuyamastannah shreyo bhavediti ||

verses.sa:
एवमुक्त्वा तु ते सर्वे चाक्षुषस्यान्तरे मनोः ।
मारीचात्कश्यपाज्जाता अदित्या दक्षकन्यया ॥
verses.rom:
evamuktva tu te sarve chakshushasyantare manoh |
marichatkashyapajjata aditya dakshakanyaya ||

verses.sa:
तत्र विष्णुश्च शक्रश्च जज्ञाते पुनरेव हि ।
अर्यमा चैव धाता च त्वष्टा पूषा तथैव च ॥
verses.rom:
tatra vishnushcha shakrashcha jajnate punareva hi |
aryama chaiva dhata cha tvashta pusha tathaiva cha ||

verses.sa:
विवस्वान्सविता चैव मित्रो वरुण एव च ।
अंशुर्भगश्चातितेजा आदित्या द्वादश स्मृताः ॥
verses.rom:
vivasvansavita chaiva mitro varuna eva cha |
amshurbhagashchatiteja aditya dvadasha smritah ||

verses.sa:
चाक्षुषस्यान्तरे पूर्वमासन्ये तुषिताः सुराः ।
वैवस्वतेऽन्तरे ते वै आदित्या द्वादश स्मृताः ॥
verses.rom:
chakshushasyantare purvamasanye tushitah surah |
vaivasvate'ntare te vai aditya dvadasha smritah ||

verses.sa:
सप्तविंशति याः प्रोक्ताः सोमपत्न्योथ सुव्रताः ।
सर्वा नक्षत्रयोगिन्यस्तन्नाम्नश्चैव ताः स्मृताः ।
तासामपत्यान्यभवन्दीप्तान्यमिततेजसाम् ॥
verses.rom:
saptavimshati yah proktah somapatnyotha suvratah |
sarva nakshatrayoginyastannamnashchaiva tah smritah |
tasamapatyanyabhavandiptanyamitatejasam ||

verses.sa: अरिष्टनेमिपत्नीनामपत्यानीह षोडश ॥
verses.rom: arishtanemipatninamapatyaniha shodasha ||

verses.sa: बहुपुत्रस्य विदुषश्चतस्त्रोविद्युतः स्मृताः ॥
verses.rom: bahuputrasya vidushashchatastrovidyutah smritah ||

verses.sa: प्रत्यङ्गिरसजाः श्रेष्ठा ऋचो ब्रह्मर्षिसत्कृताः ॥
verses.rom: pratyangirasajah shreshtha richo brahmarshisatkritah ||

verses.sa: कृशाश्वस्य तु देवर्षेर्देवप्रहरणाः स्मृताः ॥
verses.rom: krishashvasya tu devarsherdevapraharanah smritah ||

verses.sa:
एते युगसहस्रान्ते जायन्ते पुनरेव हि ।
सर्वे देवगणास्तात त्रयस्त्रिंशत्तु छन्दजाः ।
तेषामपीह सततं निरोधोत्पत्तिरुच्यते ॥
verses.rom:
ete yugasahasrante jayante punareva hi |
sarve devaganastata trayastrimshattu chhandajah |
teshamapiha satatam nirodhotpattiruchyate ||

verses.sa:
यथा सूर्यस्य मैत्रेय उदयास्तमनाविह ।
एवं देवनिकायास्ते सम्भवन्ति युगेयुगे ॥
verses.rom:
yatha suryasya maitreya udayastamanaviha |
evam devanikayaste sambhavanti yugeyuge ||

verses.sa:
दित्या पुत्रद्वयं जज्ञे कश्यपादिति नः श्रुतम् ।
हिरण्यकशिपुश्चैव हिरण्याक्षश्च दुर्जयः ॥
verses.rom:
ditya putradvayam jajne kashyapaditi nah shrutam |
hiranyakashipushchaiva hiranyakshashcha durjayah ||

verses.sa: सिंहिका चाभवत्कन्या विप्रचित्तेः परिग्रहः ॥
verses.rom: simhika chabhavatkanya viprachitteh parigrahah ||

verses.sa:
हिरण्यकशिपोः पुत्राश्चात्वारः प्रथितौजसः ।
अनुह्लादश्च ह्लादश्च प्रह्लादश्चैव बुद्धिमान् ।
संह्लादश्च महावीर्या दैत्यवंशविवर्धनाः ॥
verses.rom:
hiranyakashipoh putrashchatvarah prathitaujasah |
anuhladashcha hladashcha prahladashchaiva buddhiman |
samhladashcha mahavirya daityavamshavivardhanah ||

verses.sa:
तेषां मध्ये महाभाग सर्वत्र समदृग्वाशी ।
प्रह्लादः परमां भक्तिं च उवाच जनार्दने ॥
verses.rom:
tesham madhye mahabhaga sarvatra samadrigvashi |
prahladah paramam bhaktim cha uvacha janardane ||

verses.sa:
दैत्येन्द्रदीपितो वह्निः सर्वाङ्गोपचितो द्विज ।
न ददाह च यं विप्र वासुदेव हृदि स्थिते ॥
verses.rom:
daityendradipito vahnih sarvangopachito dvija |
na dadaha cha yam vipra vasudeva hridi sthite ||

verses.sa:
महार्णवान्तः सलिले स्थितस्य चलतो मही ।
चचाल चलता यस्य पाशबद्धस्य धीमतः ॥
verses.rom:
maharnavantah salile sthitasya chalato mahi |
chachala chalata yasya pashabaddhasya dhimatah ||

verses.sa:
न भिन्नं विविधैः शस्त्रैर्यस्य दैत्येन्द्रपातितैः ।
शरीरमद्रिकठिनं सर्वत्राच्युतचेतसः ॥
verses.rom:
na bhinnam vividhaih shastrairyasya daityendrapatitaih |
shariramadrikathinam sarvatrachyutachetasah ||

verses.sa:
विषानलोज्ज्वलमुखा यस्य दैत्यप्रचोदिताः ।
नान्ताय सर्पपतयो बभूवुरुरुतेजसः ॥
verses.rom:
vishanalojjvalamukha yasya daityaprachoditah |
nantaya sarpapatayo babhuvururutejasah ||

verses.sa:
शैलैराक्रान्तदेहोपि यः स्मरन्पुरुषोत्तमम् ।
तत्याज नात्मनः प्राणान् विष्णुस्मरणदंशितः ॥
verses.rom:
shailairakrantadehopi yah smaranpurushottamam |
tatyaja natmanah pranan vishnusmaranadamshitah ||

verses.sa:
पतन्तमुच्चादवनिर्यमुपेत्य महामतिम् ।
दधार दैत्यपतिना क्षिप्तं स्वर्गनिवासिना ॥
verses.rom:
patantamuchchadavaniryamupetya mahamatim |
dadhara daityapatina kshiptam svarganivasina ||

verses.sa:
यस्य सशोषको वायुर्देहे दैत्येन्द्रयोजितः ।
अवाप संक्षयं सद्यश्चित्तस्थे मधुसूदने ॥
verses.rom:
yasya sashoshako vayurdehe daityendrayojitah |
avapa samkshayam sadyashchittasthe madhusudane ||

verses.sa:
विषाणभङ्गमुन्मत्ता मदहानिं च दिग्गजाः ।
यस्य वक्षःस्थले प्राप्ता दैत्येन्द्रपरिणामिताः ॥
verses.rom:
vishanabhangamunmatta madahanim cha diggajah |
yasya vakshahsthale prapta daityendraparinamitah ||

verses.sa:
यस्य चोत्पादिता कृत्या दैत्यराजपुरोहितैः ।
बभूव नान्ताय पुरा गोविन्दासक्तचेतसः ॥
verses.rom:
yasya chotpadita kritya daityarajapurohitaih |
babhuva nantaya pura govindasaktachetasah ||

verses.sa:
शम्बरस्य च मायानां सहस्रमतिमायिनः ।
यस्मिन्प्रयुक्तं चक्रेण कृष्णस्य वितथिकृतम् ॥
verses.rom:
shambarasya cha mayanam sahasramatimayinah |
yasminprayuktam chakrena krishnasya vitathikritam ||

verses.sa:
दैत्येन्द्रसूदोपहृतं यस्य हालाहलं विषम् ।
जरयामास मतिमानविकारममत्सरी ॥
verses.rom:
daityendrasudopahritam yasya halahalam visham |
jarayamasa matimanavikaramamatsari ||

verses.sa:
समचेता जगत्यस्मिन्यः सर्वेष्वेव जन्तुषु ।
यथात्मनि तथान्येषां परं मैत्रगुणान्वितः ॥
verses.rom:
samacheta jagatyasminyah sarveshveva jantushu |
yathatmani tathanyesham param maitragunanvitah ||

verses.sa:
धर्मात्मा सत्यशौर्यादिगुणानामाकरः परः ।
उपमानमशेषाणां साधूनां यः सदाभवत् ॥
verses.rom:
dharmatma satyashauryadigunanamakarah parah |
upamanamasheshanam sadhunam yah sadabhavat ||

verses.sa: इतिश्रीविष्णुपुराणे प्रथमेऽंशे पञ्चदशोऽध्यायः (१५)
verses.rom: itishrivishnupurane prathame'mshe panchadasho'dhyayah (15)

prose.en:
Parāçara said,—When the Prachetas were thus engaged in devout exercises the earth was covered with huge trees and the subjects suffered decease. The welkin being obstructed with the branches of trees, the wind did not blow for ten thousand years and the mankind did not labour. And when the Prachetas came out of the water they were greatly inflamed with ire beholding the earth, and wind and flame issued out of their mouths. The wind uprooted all the trees and left them sear and dry and the fierce fire consumed and thus the earth was cleared off the forests. Beholding all the trees thus destroyed and only few left, their king Soma approached those princes and said,—"Renounce your ire, O princes, and hear what I say; I shall bring about peace between you and the trees. This precious and beautiful maiden, sprung from the trees, has been nourished by me with my rays who am cognizant of futurity. Her name is Marishā and she has sprung from the trees. That lucky damsel shall be your wife and the multiplier of the family of Dhruva. From half of your lustre and half of mine, the learned and the great Patriarch Daksha shall be begotten on her; your lustre as well as mine being conjoined in him he shall be effulgent like fire and multiply the human race. There lived in the days of yore an ascetic named Kandu—the foremost of those conversant with the Vedas. He engaged in an austere devotion on the picturesque bank of the river Gomati. To obstruct his devotion a highly beautiful nymph named Pramlocha was despatched by the king of the celestials. And being thus engaged, the sweet-smiling nymph diverted the sage from the practice of his pious austerities. Being thus diverted he lived with her for a hundred and fifty years at the valley of the mount Mandāra, his mind being wholly given up to worldly enjoyment. Once on a time the damsel said to the high-souled Rishi,—'O Brahman, I desire to go to the abode of the celestials—do thou, with a delighted countenance, grant me the permission'. Being thus addressed by her, the ascetic, solely attached to her, replied,—'O fair lady, do thou stay a few days more with me'. Being thus requested by him that damsel of a slender person, enjoyed earthly pleasures in the company of that high-souled ascetic, for more than a hundred years. And being again accosted by her with 'O lord! allow me to return to the abode of the celestials' he again requested her to stay a few more with him. After the expiration of another hundred years the beautiful damsel, with a smile of love, again said,—'I shall now go to the abode of the celestials, O Brāhman'. Being thus addressed the ascetic, detaining the fair-eyed damsel, said,—'Stay a little more, thou shalt depart for a long time'. Afraid of incurring an imprecation the graceful nymph lived with the ascetic for nearly two hundred years more. The high-souled sage was repeatedly asked by the nymph to allow her to repair to the abode of the lord of the celestials and she was as often desired by him to remain. Afraid of his curse, excelling in amiable manners and knowing full well the pain consequent upon the separation from an object of love she did not quit the ascetic, who, enjoying in her company day and night and having his mind possessed by cupid, became fully attached unto her. Once while he was speedily issuing out of the cottage the nymph said to him. 'Where are you going?' Whereto he replied, 'O damsel, the day is fast approaching its close, I must perform my evening ablutions or else I shall neglect a duty'. Thereupon smiling, she, delightedly, said to the sage,—'O thou conversant with all religions, why dost thou talk of to-day approaching its close? Is thy day, O Brāhman, the aggregate of many hundred years? Shall it not create astonishment in other? Do thou tell me'. The ascetic said,—'O fair damsel, you came to the riverside this morning—I saw you there and brought you to my hermitage. The day has passed and the evening has well-nigh arrived. Tell me in sooth what the truth is'. The (nymph) Pramlocha said,—'True it is, O Brāhman, that I came here at dawn. It is not false—but after that hundreds of years have flown away'. Thereupon, the sage, stricken with fear, asked that nymph, having expansive eyes, saying,—'Tell me how many years I have spent in enjoyment with you'. Pramlocha said,—'You have spent nine hundred and seven years six months and three days'. The ascetic again said,—'No more of laughter, O fair nymph, tell me the truth; methinks I have spent one day in your company'. To which Pramlocha replied: 'O venerable sage why shall I speak untruth unto thee since I have been specially requested by thee to-day to speak the truth'. Soma said,—O Princes, when the sage had heard these words and thought them to be true he began to reproach himself exclaming, 'O fie, fie upon me; my penance has been obstructed—the wealth of those who are cognizant of Brahmā, has been stolen; my judgement has been blinded; by whom women have been created to beguile mankind? O fie upon that passion by which my self-control has been stolen whereby I, was about to attain the knowledge of Brahmā who is above the reach of those who are immersed in the six waves—namely, hunger, thirst, sorrow, stupification, decay and death. By this evil company, which is the road to hell all my austerities, leading to the acquisition of the wisdom of the Vedas, have been obstructed'. Having thus reviled himself the pious sage spoke to the nymph, who was near him, saying,—'Go where dost thou wish, O vile nymph—thou hast performed that for which thou hast been enjoyned by the lord of the celestials—thou hast obstructed my penances with thy fascinations. I do not reduce thee to ashes with the fierce fire of my rage. Seven paces together are quite sufficient for the friendship of the pious, and thou and I have lived together for a pretty long time. Or what for is thy folly—and why should I be offended with thee—verily this is an outcome of my own folly since I have not been able to control my passions. O fie on hated thee, the box of fascinations, who, to win favour with Sakra, has disturbed my devotion'. Soma said,—While the sage spoke thus to the nymph she perspired and stood trembling. Thereupon, the foremost of ascetics again said angrily to her, thus trembling and with drops of perspiration issuing from every pore—'Depart! Depart'. Being thus remonstrated with by that sage she issued out of the hermitage and began to wend her way by the welkin, rubbing the perspiration with the leaves of the trees. She went forth from tree to tree rubbing her limbs and the perspiration with the durky shoots. And the child, she had conceived by the sage, came out from the pores of her skin, in drops of perspiration. The trees received those drops and the wind collected them. I protected it with my rays till it increased in size gradually. Because she sprang from the drops on the tops of the trees that fair damsel was called Mārisha; the trees will give her to thee—let your anger be appeased. She is Kandu's child—she was sprung from the trees—she is my offspring as well as that of the wind—and she is also the daughter Pramlocha. And the great sage, Kandu, on the wane of his devotion, repaired to the region of Vishnu called Purushottama, O Maitreya. And there he, O princes, devoted himself, with his whole mind to the adoration of Vishnu and engaged in the Yoga, with uplifted hands and uttering the prayers comprehending the supreme truths of the Vedas". The Prachetasas said,—"We wish to hear of the excellent prayers of the sage, by which Kandu engaged in devotion and in the adoration of Keshava". On which Soma repeated them:—"'Vishnu is beyond the limit of all earthly things, he is the infinite; through him we may get at the other end of the limitless deep—the earth: he is above all that is above; he is the finite truth; he is worthy of being approached by those who are conversant with the Vedas; the limit of elemental being; above the perception of the senses and the protectors (the divinities who protect the creation). He is the cause of cause; the cause of the cause in cause; the cause of finite cause; and in effects he, both as every object and agent, preserves the creation. He is Brahmā the lord; Brahmā all beings; Brahmā the creator of the human race; the undecaying, imperishable and eternal; he is spread all over the earth, unborn, incapable of increase or diminution. Purushottama, is the eternal, unborn, immutable Brahmā. May he annihilate the infirmities of my nature'. Repeating those prayers, comprehending the essence of divine truth and propitiating Keshava the ascetic attained to the final emancipation. I shall now describe to you what Mārisha was in her previous birth—for a recital of her glorious acts will be of immense benefit to you. O princes, she was in her previous birth a queen, and was left childless at her husband's death; and she therefore propitiated Vishnu with zealous devotion. Thus pleased with her devotion Vishnu appeared to her in person and said,—'Do thou beg of me a boon'. Whereto she replied communicating her desire,—'O lord of earth—I am a widow from my childhood—unfortunate as I am, in vain is my birth on this earth. Do thou so favour me, that I may be blessed with a good husband in every birth and a son equal to a patriarch amongst men; I may be possessed of beauty and wealth and may be pleasing unto all—that I may be born out of the ordinary course'. Hrishikesha, the lord of the celestials, the giver of all boons thus prayed to, raised her from her prostrate attitude and said,—'In one birth you shall have ten husbands of great prowess whose fame shall spread far and wide. And O fair damsel, you shall have a great son gifted with mighty prowess and all the accomplishments that are to be seen in the great Patriarch. The supremacy of his family shall be established all over the universe and the three worlds shall be filled with his descendants. And you, by my favour, shall be of marvellous birth, chaste, endowed with grace and loveliness and delightful to men'. Having thus spoken to that fair damsel, having spacious eyes, the Deity disappeared and the princess, was accordingly born as Mārisha, who is given to you for a wife, Princes". Parāçara said:—Thereupon renouncing their ire against the trees at the words of Soma, the Prachetas took Mārisha righteously to wife. And the Ten Prachetas begot on Mārisha the eminent Patriarch, Daksha, who had (in a former birth) been born as the son of Brahmā. O thou of great mind, for the multiplication of creation and increase of his own race this eminent Daksha created progeny. Obeying the mandate of Brahmā for the furtherance of creation he made moveable and immoveable things, bipeds and quadrupeds. Having created (that) by his will he created females out of which ten were conferred on Dharma, thirteen on Kasyapa and twenty-seven who regulate the course of time on the Moon, And from them were produced the gods, the demons, the snake-gods, cows, birds, singers, the spirits of evil and others. Thenceforth creatures were produced by sexual intercourse. O Maitreya—before that they were generated, by the by sight, by touch and by the influence of austerities practised by the ascetics of accomplished piety. Maitreya said:—"O great ascetic, Daksha, as I am informed, was born from the right thumb of Brahmā: tell how he was born again as the son of Ten Prachetas. Another great doubt exists in my mind O Brahmā that how could he, who was the grandson of Soma, be also his father-in-law". Parisara said:—O thou of great piety, birth and death are constant in all creatures. Rishis having divine vision do not wonder at it. Daksha and other eminent ascetics take birth in every age and they again cease to be: the learned are not perplexed by it. O foremost of the twice-born ones, in the days of yore there was neither senior nor junior (by age); asceticism and spiritual power were the sole causes of being considered as senior. Maitreya said:—"O Brāhman, do thou relate at length, the origin of the gods, demons, Gandharvas, serpents and goblins". Parāçara said:—Do thou hear, O thou of a high-mind, how commanded by Brahmā, Daksha created living creatures. At first Daksha created his will-born progeny—the deities, the Rishis, the Gandharvas, the demons and the snake-gods. When he found, O twice-born one, that his mind-born progeny did not multiply he began to meditate upon some other means of increasing the living creatures, Then desirous of multiplying the race by means of sexual intercourse he married the daughter of the Patriarch Veerana by name Ashikni who was devotee! to austerities and the eminent supportress of the world. And the energetic Patriarch for the multiplication of the progeny begot on Ashikni the daughter of Veerana, five thousand sons. And beholding them desirous of multiplying the race, the divine ascetic Nārada approaching them addressed them with sweet words—Nārada said,—"O ye highly powerful Haryaswas, it is evident that you intend multiplying the progeny—do ye hear this: you like ignorant people, do know not the middle, the height and the depth of the world: how would you propagate progeny then? Your understanding is not hindered by interval, height or depth, why do ye not O fools, behold the end of the universe?" Parāçara said—Having heard these words they repaired to various quarters and have not returned as yet as the rivers lose themselves in the ocean (and do not come back).

The Haryaswas having gone away the Patriarch Daksha again begot a thousand sons upon the daughter of Beerana. And, they, who were named Savalaswas, were desirous of multiplying mankind and they were again addressed by Nārada, Brāhmana, with the words mentioned before. They said to one another,—"What the Muni had said is perfectly true. We must follow the path wended by our brothers: there is not the least doubt about it. And ascertaining the extent of the universe we will multiply our race". They also went to various quarters by the path (followed by their brothers) and have not returned like rivers flowing into the deep. Thenceforth, O twice-born one, a brother searching after a brother, is generally lost: the wise do not resort to such actions. Finding that all his sons had disappeared the eminent Patriarch Daksha was worked with ire and imprecated Nārada. We have heard, O Maitreya, that thereupon the learned Pratriarch Daksha, desirous to multiply the race begot upon the daughter of Veerana sixty daughters. Of whom he gave ten to Dharma, thirteen to Kasyapa, twenty-seven to Soma, four to Arishtanemi, two to Bahuputra, two to Angiras and two to the learned Krisaswa. Do thou hear their names from me. Arundnati, Vasu, Yami, Lamba, Bhami, Marutwati, Sankalpa, Muhurtta, Sadhya and Viswa were the ten wives of Dharma. I will mention their offspring. Viswadevas were the sons of Viswa and the Sadhyas were the sons of Sadhya. The Maruts or Winds were the offspring of Marutwati and the Vasus of Vasu. The Bhānus (or suns) were the sons of Bhānu and the deities governing the moments of Muhurtta, Ghosa was born of Lamba and Nāgabithi was born of Yāmi (night). And all the objects of the world were born of Arundhuti and Sankalpa (pious determination) was the son of Sankalpa. I shall mention at length the particulars of the eight Vasus who abound in effulgence and night. They are Apa, Dhruva, Soma, Dhara, Anila, Anala, Pratyusha and Prabhāsha. The sons of Apa were Vaitandya, Srama (weariness) Srānta (fatigue) and Dhur, and the son of Dhruva was the great Kāla (Time) the cherisher of the world. The son of Soma was Varchas (light) by whom was generated Varchaswi (radiance). And Dhara had, by his wife Monohora, Dravina, Hutaravyavaha, Sisira, Prāna and Ramana. Anila's wife was Siva; and he had by her two sons—Monojova (swift as thought) and Avijnātagati (unknowable motion), The son of Agni—Kumara, was born in a clump of Sara reeds, whose sons were Sākha, Visākha, Naigameya and Prishthaja. The son of Kritikas was named Kartikeya. The son of Pratyushwa was the great ascetic Duvala who had two intelligent and philosophic sons. The great ascetic Vrihaspati had a sister who was the foremost of the females, virtuous and of accomplished asceticism. Without beings attached to the world she travelled all over the world. She became the spouse of Pravasha the eighth Vasu. Of her was born the noble Patriarch Viswakarma the author of a thousand arts, the architect of the celestials, the inventor of all ornaments and the foremost of the artists. He constructed the chariots of all the deities; and by the skill of that high-souled one, people obtain subsistence. He had four sons whose names hear from me. They were Ayaikapad, Ahirvradhna, Twashtri and Rudra and they were all wise. And the self-born son of Twashtri was also the famous Viswarupa. There are eleven well-known Rudras, lords of the three worlds—Hara, Bahurupa, Tryambaka, Aparajitā, Vrishahapi, Sambhu, Kaparddi, Raivata, Mrigavyadha, Sarava and Kapāli; but there are a hundred names of the Rudras of unmitigated prowess.

Kashyapa married the thirteen daughters of Daksha namely Aditi, Diti, Danu, Arishta, Surasa, Surabhi, Vinatā, Tāmrā, Krodha, Vasa, Idā, Khasā, Kadru and Muni. I will describe their progeny to you. There were twelve well-known celestials in a former Manwantara, named Tushitas, who, on the approach of the present Manwantara and at the end of the reign of Manu Chakhusha assembled and said to one another,—"O deities, let us all speedily enter into the womb of Aditi that we may be born in the next Manwantara for we shall thereby be again crowned with blessings". Having said this they at the end of the reign of Manu Chakshusha were born the sons of Kashyapa, the son of Mārichi by Aditi the daughter of Daksha. Of them were born first Vishnu and Sakra and the Aryaman, Dhuti, Twashtri, Pushan, Vivaswat, Sāvitri, Mitra, Varunā, Ansa and Bhaga. These who, in the reign of Chākshusha Manu were Tushitas, were called the twelve Adityas in the Manwāntara of Vaivaswata. The twenty-seven virtuous daughters of the Patriarch who were married to the Moon were all well-known as the nymphs of the lunar constellations after their names; they had children of unmitigated effulgence. The wives of Arishthanemi bore sixteen children. The daughters of the learned Bahaputra were the four lightnings. The excellent Paratyangirasa Richas were born from the wives of Angiras and the celestial weapons were the children of the Rishi Krishaswa. These deities take their birth once after the expiry of a thousand yugas; they are thirty-three in number and their appearance and disappearance is here spoken of as birth and death and O Maitreya these divinities appear and disappear, age after age as the sun sets and rises again.

It is said that Kashyapa begat on Diti two sons—One was named Hiranyakashipu and the other was named Hiranyaksha and both of them were invincible. She had also a daughter named Sinhika who was married to Biprachitwa. Hiranyakashipu had four highly effulgent sons—named Anuhlāda Hlāda, Prahlāda and Sanhlāda;—they were all highly intelligent, powerful and the multiplier of the Daitya race. O noble sage, amongst these, Prahlāda, looking impartially on all things, devoted his whole faith to Janārddana. O twice-born one, the flames lighted by the king of Daityas did not consume him in whose heart Vasudeva was present. The whole earth shook, when bound with ropes, he moved in the midst of the water of the deep. Having his mind entirely engrossed by Achuta his body firm as the rock was not assailed by the diverse weapons hurled on him by the order of the king of Daityas. And the venomous snakes could not destroy him (even). And he remembering the excellent Purusha and protected by the recollection of Vishnu as his armour he did not renounce his life albeit overwhelmed with rocks. The earth received the high-minded (Prahlāda) when he was hurled from on high by the king of Daityas residing in Swerga. The slayer of Madhu being present in his mind, the wind sent into his body to wither him up was itself destroyed. Being ordered by the lord of Daityas the maddened elephants of the spheres broke their trunks and baffled their pride against his firm breast. The rites of the priests of the Daitya monarch were useless to bring about the destruction of one who was attached to Govinda. The thousand illusions of the illusive Samvara were baffled by the discus of Krishna. The poison offered by the cooks, at the command of the king of Daityas, could not produce any change upon the intelligent (Prahlāda) void of pride, who unhesitatingly partook that. He looked impartially upon the world and all creatures, was full of kindness and regarded all things equally and as identical with himself. He was pious and an inexhaustible mine of purity and truth and a model for all pious men.

verses.sa:
मैत्रेय उवाच ।
कथितो भवता वंशो मानवानां महामुने ।
काणञ्चास्य जगतो विष्णुरेव सनातनः ॥
verses.rom:
maitreya uvacha |
kathito bhavata vamsho manavanam mahamune |
kananchasya jagato vishnureva sanatanah ||

verses.sa:
यच्चैतदू भगवानाह प्रह्लादं दैत्यसत्तमम् ।
ददाह नाग्निर्नस्त्रैश्व क्षण्णस्तत्याज जीवितम् ॥
verses.rom:
yachchaitadu bhagavanaha prahladam daityasattamam |
dadaha nagnirnastraishva kshannastatyaja jivitam ||

verses.sa:
जगाम वसुधा क्षोभं प्रह्लादे सलिले स्थिते ।
बन्धबद्ध विचलति विक्षिप्ताङू गैः समाहता ॥
verses.rom:
jagama vasudha kshobham prahlade salile sthite |
bandhabaddha vichalati vikshiptanu gaih samahata ||

verses.sa:
शैलैराक्रान्तदेहोऽपि न ममार च यः पुरा ।
त्वयैवातीव माहात्म्यां कथितं यस्य धीमतः ॥
verses.rom:
shailairakrantadeho'pi na mamara cha yah pura |
tvayaivativa mahatmyam kathitam yasya dhimatah ||

verses.sa:
तस्य प्रभावमतुलं विष्णोर्भक्तिमतो मुने ।
श्वोतुमिच्छामि यस्योतच्चरितं दीप्ततेजसः ॥
verses.rom:
tasya prabhavamatulam vishnorbhaktimato mune |
shvotumichchhami yasyotachcharitam diptatejasah ||

verses.sa:
किं निमित्तमसौ शस्त्रैर्विक्षतो दितिजैर्मुने ।
किममर्थञ्चाब्धिसलिले निक्षिप्ते धर्म्मतत्परः ॥
verses.rom:
kim nimittamasau shastrairvikshato ditijairmune |
kimamarthanchabdhisalile nikshipte dharmmatatparah ||

verses.sa:
आक्रान्तः पर्व्वतैः कस्मात् कस्मादृष्टो महोरगैः ।
क्षिप्तः किमद्रिशिखरात् किं वा पावकसञ्चये ॥
verses.rom:
akrantah parvvataih kasmat kasmadrishto mahoragaih |
kshiptah kimadrishikharat kim va pavakasanchaye ||

verses.sa:
दिग्दन्तिनां दन्तबूमिं स च कस्मान्नरूपितः ।
संशोषकोऽनिलश्चास्य प्रयुक्तः किं मुहासुरैः ॥
verses.rom:
digdantinam dantabumim sa cha kasmannarupitah |
samshoshako'nilashchasya prayuktah kim muhasuraih ||

verses.sa:
कृत्याञ्च दैत्यगुरवो युयुजुस्तत्र किं मुने ।
शम्बरश्चापि मायानां सहस्त्रं कि प्रयुक्तवान् ॥
verses.rom:
krityancha daityaguravo yuyujustatra kim mune |
shambarashchapi mayanam sahastram ki prayuktavan ||

verses.sa:
हालाहलं विषमहो दैत्यसूदैर्महात्मनः ।
कस्माद् दत्त विनाशाय यद जीर्णा तेन धीमता ॥
verses.rom:
halahalam vishamaho daityasudairmahatmanah |
kasmad datta vinashaya yada jirna tena dhimata ||

verses.sa:
एतत् सर्व्वं महाभाग प्रह्लादस्य महात्मनः ।
चरितं श्वोतुमिच्छामि महामाहात्म्यसूचकम् ॥
verses.rom:
etat sarvvam mahabhaga prahladasya mahatmanah |
charitam shvotumichchhami mahamahatmyasuchakam ||

verses.sa:
न हि कौतूहलं तत्र यदू दैत्यैर्न हतो हि सः ।
अनन्यमनसो विष्णौ कः शक्नोति निपातने ॥
verses.rom:
na hi kautuhalam tatra yadu daityairna hato hi sah |
ananyamanaso vishnau kah shaknoti nipatane ||

verses.sa:
तस्मिन धर्म्मपरे नित्यं केशावरधानोद्य.ते ।
स्ववंशप्रभवैर्दैत्येः कर्त्तु द्रषोऽतिदुष्करः ॥
verses.rom:
tasmina dharmmapare nityam keshavaradhanodya.te |
svavamshaprabhavairdaityeh karttu drasho'tidushkarah ||

verses.sa:
दर्‌म्मात्मनि महाभागे विष्णुभक्ते विमत्सरे ।
दैतेयैः प्रह्टतं यस्मात् तन्ममाख्यातुमर्हसि ॥
verses.rom:
darmmatmani mahabhage vishnubhakte vimatsare |
daiteyaih prahtatam yasmat tanmamakhyatumarhasi ||

verses.sa:
प्रहरन्ति महात्मानो विपक्षा अपि नेदृशे ।
गुणौः समन्विते साचधौ किं पुनयः खपक्षजः ॥
verses.rom:
praharanti mahatmano vipaksha api nedrishe |
gunauh samanvite sachadhau kim punayah khapakshajah ||

verses.sa:
तदेतत् कथ्यतां सर्व्व विस्तरान्मुनिसत्तम ।
दैत्येश्वरस्य चरितं श्वोतुमिच्छाम्यशेषतः ॥
verses.rom:
tadetat kathyatam sarvva vistaranmunisattama |
daityeshvarasya charitam shvotumichchhamyasheshatah ||

prose.en: Maitreya said—"O great ascetic, you have described to me the human races and the ever-existing Vishnu, the cause of the world; but who was this Prahlāda the foremost of the Daityas of whom you spoke and whom fire could not burn, and who did not die even when assailed by weapons. And Prahlāda being present in the waters, in bonds, earth trembled, agitated by his movements. And he did not die before albeit overwhelmed with rocks. Thou hast related the unlimited glory of that intelligent Prahlāda. O muni, I am desirous to hear an account of the character and unequalled might of that effulgent worshipper of Vishnu. O Muni, Why was he assailed by the descendants of Diti with weapons? And why was he, ever engaged in pious observances, thrown into water? For what was he overwhelmed with rocks? And why bitten by venomous snakes? Why thrown down from the mountain-top? Why cast into fire? And why was he made a butt for the tusks of the elephants of spheres? And why was the wind sent by the mighty Asuras into his body to wither him up? O Muni, Why the spiritual guides of the Daityas were engaged in ceremonies for his destruction? And why did the Daitya Samvara spread thousands of illusions for his destruction? Why did the cooks of the Daitya-chief offer him poison for his destruction which was digested by that high-souled sage? O noble Manu—I wish to hear all this—an account of the high-souled Prahlāda, full of marvelous glories. I am not the least surprised for the Daityas not being able to destroy him: for who can slay him whose mind is solely devoted to Vishnu? Why did the Daityas, born in his race, cherish dreadful malice against him ever engaged in pious observances and in the worship of Kesava? Relate to me, Why the sons of Diti offer violence to one so pious,—high-souled and ever devoted to Vishnu and free from sin? The great cannot offer violence to a person gifted with such qualities even if he be an enemy; how could his own kin (behave thus towards him)? O foremost of the Muni, do thou relate all this—the character of the sovereign of Daityas. I wish to hear it at length".

verses.sa:
पाराशर उवाच ।
मैत्रेय श्वूयतां सम्यक् चरितं तस्य धीमतः ।
प्रह्लादस्य सदोदारचीरितस्य महात्मनः ॥
verses.rom:
parashara uvacha |
maitreya shvuyatam samyak charitam tasya dhimatah |
prahladasya sadodarachiritasya mahatmanah ||

verses.sa:
दितेः पुत्रो महावीर्य्यो हिरण्यकशिपुः पुरा ।
त्रैलोक्यं वशमानिन्ये ब्रह्मणो वरदर्पितः ॥
verses.rom:
diteh putro mahaviryyo hiranyakashipuh pura |
trailokyam vashamaninye brahmano varadarpitah ||

verses.sa:
इन्दत्वमकरोदू दैत्यः स चासीत् सविता स्वयम् ।
वायुरग्रिरपां नाथः सोमस्चाभूनूमहासुरः ॥
verses.rom:
indatvamakarodu daityah sa chasit savita svayam |
vayuragrirapam nathah somaschabhunumahasurah ||

verses.sa:
धनानामधिपः सोऽभूत् स एवासीत् खयं यमः ।
यज्ञभागानशेषांस्तु स स्वयं बुभुजेऽसुरः ॥
verses.rom:
dhananamadhipah so'bhut sa evasit khayam yamah |
yajnabhaganasheshamstu sa svayam bubhuje'surah ||

verses.sa:
देवाः सर्गं परित्यज्य ततूत्रासान्मुनिसत्तम ।
विचेरुरवनौ सर्वं बिब्राणा मानुषीं तनुम् ॥
verses.rom:
devah sargam parityajya tatutrasanmunisattama |
vicheruravanau sarvam bibrana manushim tanum ||

verses.sa:
जिताव त्रिभुव्रनं सर्व्वं त्रैलोक्यैश्वर्य्यदर्पितः ।
उपगीयामानो गन्धर्वैर्बुभुजे विषयान् प्रियान् ॥
verses.rom:
jitava tribhuvranam sarvvam trailokyaishvaryyadarpitah |
upagiyamano gandharvairbubhuje vishayan priyan ||

verses.sa:
पानासक्तं महात्मानं हिरणंयकशिपु तदा ।
उपासाञ्चकिरे सर्व्वै सिद्धगन्धर्वपन्नगाः ॥
verses.rom:
panasaktam mahatmanam hiranamyakashipu tada |
upasanchakire sarvvai siddhagandharvapannagah ||

verses.sa:
अवादयञ्जगुश्चान्ये जयशब्दानथापरे ।
दैत्यराजस्य पुरतश्चक्रुः सिद्धा मुदन्विताः ॥
verses.rom:
avadayanjagushchanye jayashabdanathapare |
daityarajasya puratashchakruh siddha mudanvitah ||

verses.sa:
तत्र प्रनृत्याप्सरसि स्फटिकाभ्रमयेऽमुरः ।
पपौ पानं मुदा युक्तः प्रासादे सुमनोहरे ॥
verses.rom:
tatra pranrityapsarasi sphatikabhramaye'murah |
papau panam muda yuktah prasade sumanohare ||

verses.sa:
तस्य पुत्रो महाभागः प्रह्लादो नाम नामतः ।
पपाठ बालपाठयानि गुरुगेहे गतोऽर्भकः ॥
verses.rom:
tasya putro mahabhagah prahlado nama namatah |
papatha balapathayani gurugehe gato'rbhakah ||

verses.sa:
एकदा तुस धर्म्मात्मा जगाम गुरुणा सह ।
पानासक्तस्य पुरतः पितुर्दैत्यपतेस्तदा ॥
verses.rom:
ekada tusa dharmmatma jagama guruna saha |
panasaktasya puratah piturdaityapatestada ||

verses.sa:
पादप्रणामावनतं तमुत्थाप्य पिता सुतम् ।
हिरण्यकशिपुः प्राह प्रह्लादममितोजसम् ॥
verses.rom:
padapranamavanatam tamutthapya pita sutam |
hiranyakashipuh praha prahladamamitojasam ||

verses.sa:
पठयतां भवता वत्स ! सारभूतं सुभाषितम् ।
कालेनैतावता यत् ते सदोद्यु क्तने शिक्षितम् ॥
verses.rom:
pathayatam bhavata vatsa ! sarabhutam subhashitam |
kalenaitavata yat te sadodyu ktane shikshitam ||

verses.sa:
श्वूयतां तात ! वक्ष्यामि सारभूतं तवाज्ञया ।
समाहितमना भूत्वा यन्मे चेतस्यवस्थितम् ॥
verses.rom:
shvuyatam tata ! vakshyami sarabhutam tavajnaya |
samahitamana bhutva yanme chetasyavasthitam ||

verses.sa:
अनादिमध्यान्तमजमवृद्धिक्षयमच्युतम् ।
प्रणातोऽस्मि महात्मानं सर्व्वकारणकारणम् ॥
verses.rom:
anadimadhyantamajamavriddhikshayamachyutam |
pranato'smi mahatmanam sarvvakaranakaranam ||

verses.sa:
एवं निशम्य दैन्येन्द्रः क्रोधसंरक्तलोचनः ।
विलोक्य तदूगुरुं प्राह स्फुरिताधरपल्लवः ॥
verses.rom:
evam nishamya dainyendrah krodhasamraktalochanah |
vilokya tadugurum praha sphuritadharapallavah ||

verses.sa:
ब्रह्मबन्धो ! किमेतत् ते विपक्षस्तुतिसहितम् ।
असारं ग्राहितो बालो मामवज्ञाय दुर्मते ! ॥
verses.rom:
brahmabandho ! kimetat te vipakshastutisahitam |
asaram grahito balo mamavajnaya durmate ! ||

verses.sa:
दैत्येश्वर ! न कोपस्य वशमागन्तुमर्हसि ।
ममोपदेशजनितं नायं वदति ते सुतः ॥
verses.rom:
daityeshvara ! na kopasya vashamagantumarhasi |
mamopadeshajanitam nayam vadati te sutah ||

verses.sa:
अनुशास्तोसि केनेदृगु वत्स ! प्रह्लाद कथ्यताम् ।
ममोपदिष्ट नेत्येष प्रब्रवीति गुरुस्तव ॥
verses.rom:
anushastosi kenedrigu vatsa ! prahlada kathyatam |
mamopadishta netyesha prabraviti gurustava ||

verses.sa:
शास्ता विष्णुरशेषस्य जगतो यो ह्टदि स्थितः ।
तमृते परमात्मानं तात ! कः केन शास्यते ॥
verses.rom:
shasta vishnurasheshasya jagato yo htadi sthitah |
tamrite paramatmanam tata ! kah kena shasyate ||

verses.sa:
कोऽय विष्णुः सुदुर्बुद्ध ! यं ब्रवीषि पुनः पुनः ।
जगतामीश्वरस्येह पुरतः प्रसभं मम ॥
verses.rom:
ko'ya vishnuh sudurbuddha ! yam bravishi punah punah |
jagatamishvarasyeha puratah prasabham mama ||

verses.sa:
न शह्दगोचरे यस्य योगिध्येयं परं पदम् ।
यतो यश्व स्वयं विश्वं स विष्णुः परमेश्वरः ॥
verses.rom:
na shahdagochare yasya yogidhyeyam param padam |
yato yashva svayam vishvam sa vishnuh parameshvarah ||

verses.sa:
परमेश्वरसंज्ञोऽज्ञ ! किमन्यो मययवस्थिते ।
तवास्ति मर्त्तुकामस्त्व प्रब्रवीषि पुनः पुनः ॥
verses.rom:
parameshvarasamjno'jna ! kimanyo mayayavasthite |
tavasti marttukamastva prabravishi punah punah ||

verses.sa:
न केवलं तात ! मम प्रजानां स ब्रह्मभूतो भवतश्व विष्णुः ।
धाता विधाता परमेश्वरश्च प्रसीद कोपं कुरुषे किमर्थम ॥
verses.rom:
na kevalam tata ! mama prajanam sa brahmabhuto bhavatashva vishnuh |
dhata vidhata parameshvarashcha prasida kopam kurushe kimarthama ||

verses.sa:
प्रविचष्टः कोऽस्य ह्टदये दुर्बुद्धेरतिपापकृत् ।
येनेदृशान्यसाधूनि वदत्याविष्टमानसः ॥
verses.rom:
pravichashtah ko'sya htadaye durbuddheratipapakrit |
yenedrishanyasadhuni vadatyavishtamanasah ||

verses.sa:
न केवलं मदूह्टदयं स विष्णु--राक्रम्य लोकान् सकलानवस्थितः ।
स मां त्वदादींश्च पितः ! समस्तान् समस्तचेष्टासु युनक्ति सर्वगः ॥
verses.rom:
na kevalam maduhtadayam sa vishnu--rakramya lokan sakalanavasthitah |
sa mam tvadadimshcha pitah ! samastan samastacheshtasu yunakti sarvagah ||

verses.sa:
निष्काम्यतामयं दुष्टः शास्यताञ्च गुरोगृ हे ।
योजितो दुर्म्मतिः केन विपक्षवितथस्तुतौ ॥
verses.rom:
nishkamyatamayam dushtah shasyatancha gurogri he |
yojito durmmatih kena vipakshavitathastutau ||

verses.sa:
इत्युक्तोऽसौ तदा दैत्यैर्नीतो गुरुगृहं पुनः ।
जग्राह विद्यामनिशं गुरुशुश्वू षणोद्यतः ॥
verses.rom:
ityukto'sau tada daityairnito gurugriham punah |
jagraha vidyamanisham gurushushvu shanodyatah ||

verses.sa:
कालेऽतीते च महति प्रह्लादमसुरेश्वरः ।
समाहूयाब्रवीत् पुत्र ! गाध काचित् प्रगीयताम् ॥
verses.rom:
kale'tite cha mahati prahladamasureshvarah |
samahuyabravit putra ! gadha kachit pragiyatam ||

verses.sa:
यतः प्रधानपुरुषौ यतश्चैतज्वराचरम् ।
कारणां सकलस्यास्य स नो विष्णुः प्रसीदतु ॥
verses.rom:
yatah pradhanapurushau yatashchaitajvaracharam |
karanam sakalasyasya sa no vishnuh prasidatu ||

verses.sa:
दुरात्मा वध्यतामेष ननिनार्थोऽस्ति जीवता ।
खपक्षहानिकर्त्तृ त्वाद यः कुलाङ्गारतां गतः ॥
verses.rom:
duratma vadhyatamesha naninartho'sti jivata |
khapakshahanikarttri tvada yah kulangaratam gatah ||

verses.sa:
इत्याज्ञप्तास्ततस्तेन प्रगृहीतमहायुधाः ।
उद्यतास्तस्य नाशाय दैत्याः शतसहस्त्रशः ॥
verses.rom:
ityajnaptastatastena pragrihitamahayudhah |
udyatastasya nashaya daityah shatasahastrashah ||

verses.sa:
विष्णूः शस्त्रेषु युष्माकं मयि चासौ यथा स्थितः ।
दैतेयास्तेन सत्येन मा क्रामन्त्वायुधानि मे ॥
verses.rom:
vishnuh shastreshu yushmakam mayi chasau yatha sthitah |
daiteyastena satyena ma kramantvayudhani me ||

verses.sa:
ततस्तैः शतशो धैत्यैः सस्त्रौघैराहतोऽपि सन् ।
नावाप वेदनामल्पामभूज्व वै पुनर्नवः ॥
verses.rom:
tatastaih shatasho dhaityaih sastraughairahato'pi san |
navapa vedanamalpamabhujva vai punarnavah ||

verses.sa:
दुर्बुद्ध ! विनिवर्त्तस्व वैरिपक्षस्तवादतः ।
अभयं ते प्रयच्छामि मातिमूढ़मतिर्भव ॥
verses.rom:
durbuddha ! vinivarttasva vairipakshastavadatah |
abhayam te prayachchhami matimurhamatirbhava ||

verses.sa:
भयं भयानामपहारिणि स्थिते मनस्यनन्ते मम कुत्र तिष्ठति ।
यस्मिन् स्मते जन्मजरान्तकादिभयानि सर्व्वाणयपयान्ति तात ॥
verses.rom:
bhayam bhayanamapaharini sthite manasyanante mama kutra tishthati |
yasmin smate janmajarantakadibhayani sarvvanayapayanti tata ||

verses.sa:
भोभोः सर्पा ! दुराचारमेनमत्यन्तदुर्मतिम् ।
विषज्वालाकुलैर्व्वक्तूः सद्यो नयत संक्षयम् ॥
verses.rom:
bhobhoh sarpa ! duracharamenamatyantadurmatim |
vishajvalakulairvvaktuh sadyo nayata samkshayam ||

verses.sa:
इत्युक्तास्तेन ते सर्पाः कुहकास्तक्षकान्धकाः ।
अदशन्त समस्तेषु गात्रेष्वतिविषोल्वणाः ॥
verses.rom:
ityuktastena te sarpah kuhakastakshakandhakah |
adashanta samasteshu gatreshvativisholvanah ||

verses.sa:
स त्वासक्तमतिः कृष्णो दश्यमानो महोरगैः ।
न विवेदात्मनो गात्रं तत्स्मृत्याह्लादसंस्थितः ॥
verses.rom:
sa tvasaktamatih krishno dashyamano mahoragaih |
na vivedatmano gatram tatsmrityahladasamsthitah ||

verses.sa:
दंष्ट्रा विशीर्णा मणयः स्फुटन्ति फणेषु तापो हृदयेषु कम्पः ।
नास्य त्वचः स्वल्पमपीह भिन्न प्रशाधि दैत्येश्वर कार्य्यमन्यत् ॥
verses.rom:
damshtra vishirna manayah sphutanti phaneshu tapo hridayeshu kampah |
nasya tvachah svalpamapiha bhinna prashadhi daityeshvara karyyamanyat ||

verses.sa:
हे दिग्गजाः ! सङ्कटदन्तमिशाव ! ध्नतैनमस्मद्रिपुपक्षभिन्नम् ।
तज्जा विनाशाय भवन्ति तस्य यथारणोः प्रज्वलितो हुताशाः ॥
verses.rom:
he diggajah ! sankatadantamishava ! dhnatainamasmadripupakshabhinnam |
tajja vinashaya bhavanti tasya yatharanoh prajvalito hutashah ||

verses.sa:
ततः स दिग्गजैर्बालो भूभृच्छिखरसन्निभैः ।
पातितो धरणीपृष्ठ विषाणैरवपीड़ितः ॥
verses.rom:
tatah sa diggajairbalo bhubhrichchhikharasannibhaih |
patito dharaniprishtha vishanairavapiritah ||

verses.sa:
स्मरतस्तस्य गोविन्दमिभदन्ताः सहस्त्रशः ।
शीर्णा वक्षःस्थलं प्राप्य स प्राह पितरं ततः ॥
