Do thou again purify me, O eternal god, with thy sight". The Deity replied,—"I am propitiated with thee for thy unshaken devotion unto me. Ask of me, Prahlāda, whatever thou wishest". Prahlāda said,—"My faith in thee may never suffer decrease in all the thousand births through which I may be doomed to pass. May my devotion unto thee be as firm as the attachment cherished by the ignorant people towards all worldly objects". The Deity replied,—"Thou hast already devotion unto me—and it shall ever be the same; but do thou beg of me a boon, O Prahlāda, whatever thou wishest". Prahlāda said,—"My father has treated me malignantly for proclaiming thy praises. O lord, do thou remove the sin he hath thus committed. He assailed me with weapons—he had me thrown into fire, bitten by the serpents, had poison mixed up with my viands, had me cast into the deep in bonds, and buried down with rocks and many other ills he had wrought against me out of malice for being devoted unto thee. May my father, O lord, by thy mercy, be speedily relieved of the sin he hath thus committed". The Deity replied,—"Prahlāda, all this shall be accomplished by my mercy. I wish to confer upon thee another boon, O son of Asura, do thou beg it". Prahlāda said,—"All my desires, O lord, have been fulfilled by the boon thou hast conferred upon me, that my faith in thee may never suffer decrease. What to speak of wealth, virtue or desire, even emancipation is in his hands who has firm devotion in thee, the root of the universal world". The Deity said,—"As unshaken is thy devotion unto me thou shalt by my mercy obtain final emancipation from existence". Parāçara said:—Having said this Vishnu disappeared from his sight, O Maitreya and Prahlāda again went to his father and bowed down before him. Having smelt his forehead, embraced him and shed tears, the father said, "Dost thou live my child?" The Great Asura treated him with kindness and repented for his past actions. And Prahlāda, conversant with piety, attended diligently upon his father and preceptor. After his father had been slain by Vishnu in the form of the man-lion, he became, O Maitreya, the sovereign of the Daityas. And obtaining the splendours of royalty on account of piety, he came by immense wealth and was blessed, with a numerous progeny. At the expiration of the regal power and freed from the consequences of moral merit or demerit, he obtained, by virtue of his meditation of the deity final emancipation from future births. So powerful was the wise Daitya Prahlāda devoted to Vishnu, O Maitreya, about whom you asked me. Whoever listens to the story of Prahlāda, is speedily freed from all sins. Forsooth a man is released from the iniquities he commits day and night by once hearing or reading the history of Prahlāda. The reading of this history, on the day of full-moon, of new-moon or in the eighth and twelfth days of the lunar half month, shall offer fruit tantamount to the gift of a cow, O twice born one. As Hari protected Prahlāda in all his calamities so he shall protect him who constantly listens to his history.

verses.sa:
प्रह्लादपुत्र आयुष्माञ्छिबिर्बाष्कल एव च
विरोचनस्तु प्राह्लादिर्बलिर्जज्ञे विरोचनात् ॥
verses.rom:
prahladaputra ayushmanchhibirbashkala eva cha
virochanastu prahladirbalirjajne virochanat ||

verses.sa:
बलेः पुत्रशतं त्वासीद्बाणज्येष्ठं महामुने
हिरण्याक्षसुताश्चासन्सर्व एव महा बलाः ॥
verses.rom:
baleh putrashatam tvasidbanajyeshtham mahamune
hiranyakshasutashchasansarva eva maha balah ||

verses.sa:
झर्झरः शकुनिश्चैव भूतसन्तापनस्तथा
महानाभो महाबाहुः कालनाभस्तथापरः ॥
verses.rom:
jharjharah shakunishchaiva bhutasantapanastatha
mahanabho mahabahuh kalanabhastathaparah ||

verses.sa:
अभवन्दनुपूत्राश्च द्विमूर्द्धा शंबरस्तथा
अयोमुखः शंकुशिराः कपिलः शंकरस्तथा ॥
verses.rom:
abhavandanuputrashcha dvimurddha shambarastatha
ayomukhah shamkushirah kapilah shamkarastatha ||

verses.sa:
एकचक्रो महाबाहुस्तारकश्च महाबलः
स्वर्भानुर्वृषपर्वा च पुलोम च महाबलः ॥
verses.rom:
ekachakro mahabahustarakashcha mahabalah
svarbhanurvrishaparva cha puloma cha mahabalah ||

verses.sa: एते दनोः सुताः ख्याता विप्रचित्तिश्च वीर्यवान् ॥
verses.rom: ete danoh sutah khyata viprachittishcha viryavan ||

verses.sa:
स्वर्भानोस्तु प्रभा कन्या शर्मिष्ठा वार्षपर्वणी
उपदानी हयशिराः प्रख्याता वरकन्यकाः ॥
verses.rom:
svarbhanostu prabha kanya sharmishtha varshaparvani
upadani hayashirah prakhyata varakanyakah ||

verses.sa:
वैश्वानरसुते चोभे पुलोमा कालका तथा
उभे सुते महाभागे मारीचेस्तु परिग्रहः ॥
verses.rom:
vaishvanarasute chobhe puloma kalaka tatha
ubhe sute mahabhage marichestu parigrahah ||

verses.sa:
ताभ्यां पुत्रसहस्राणि षष्टिर्दानवसत्तमाः
पौलोमाः कालकेयाश्च मारीचतनयाः स्मृताः ॥
verses.rom:
tabhyam putrasahasrani shashtirdanavasattamah
paulomah kalakeyashcha marichatanayah smritah ||

verses.sa:
ततोऽपरेमहावीर्या दारुणास्त्वतिनिर्घृणाः
सिंहिकायामथोत्पन्ना विप्रचित्तेः सुतास्तथा ॥
verses.rom:
tato'paremahavirya darunastvatinirghrinah
simhikayamathotpanna viprachitteh sutastatha ||

verses.sa:
त्र्! यंशः शल्यश्च बलवान् नभश्चैव महाबलः
वातापी नमुचिश्चैव इल्वलः खसृमस्तथा ॥
verses.rom:
tr! yamshah shalyashcha balavan nabhashchaiva mahabalah
vatapi namuchishchaiva ilvalah khasrimastatha ||

verses.sa:
आन्धको नरकश्चैव कालनाभस्तथैव च
स्वर्भानुश्च महावीर्यो वक्त्रयोधी महासुरः ॥
verses.rom:
andhako narakashchaiva kalanabhastathaiva cha
svarbhanushcha mahaviryo vaktrayodhi mahasurah ||

verses.sa:
एते वै दानवाः श्रेष्ठा दनुवंशविवर्द्धनाः
एतेषां पुत्रपौत्राश्च शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः ॥
verses.rom:
ete vai danavah shreshtha danuvamshavivarddhanah
etesham putrapautrashcha shatasho'tha sahasrashah ||

verses.sa:
प्रह्लादस्य तु दैत्यस्य निवातकवचाः कुले
समुत्पन्नाः सुमहता तपसा भावितात्मनः ॥
verses.rom:
prahladasya tu daityasya nivatakavachah kule
samutpannah sumahata tapasa bhavitatmanah ||

verses.sa:
षट् सुताः सुमहासत्त्वास्ताम्रायाः परिकीर्त्तिताः
शुकी श्येनी च भासी च सुग्रीवी शुचिगृद्ध्रका ॥
verses.rom:
shat sutah sumahasattvastamrayah parikirttitah
shuki shyeni cha bhasi cha sugrivi shuchigriddhraka ||

verses.sa:
शुकी शुकानजनयदुलूकप्रत्युलूकिकान्
श्येनी श्येनांस्तथा भासी भासान्गृद्धांश्च गृद्ध्र्यपि ॥
verses.rom:
shuki shukanajanayadulukapratyulukikan
shyeni shyenamstatha bhasi bhasangriddhamshcha griddhryapi ||

verses.sa:
शुच्यौदकान्पक्षिगणान्सुग्रीवी तु व्यजायत
अश्वानुष्ट्रान्गर्दभांश्च ताम्रावंशः प्रकीर्त्तितः ॥
verses.rom:
shuchyaudakanpakshiganansugrivi tu vyajayata
ashvanushtrangardabhamshcha tamravamshah prakirttitah ||

verses.sa:
विनतायास्तु द्वौ पुत्रौ विरतौ गरुडारुणौ
सुपर्णः पततां श्रेष्ठो दारुणः पन्नगाशनः ॥
verses.rom:
vinatayastu dvau putrau viratau garudarunau
suparnah patatam shreshtho darunah pannagashanah ||

verses.sa:
सुरसायां सहस्रं तु सर्पाणाममितौजसाम्
अनेकशिरसां ब्रह्मन् खेचराणां महात्मनाम् ॥
verses.rom:
surasayam sahasram tu sarpanamamitaujasam
anekashirasam brahman khecharanam mahatmanam ||

verses.sa:
काद्र वेयास्तु बलिनः सहस्रममितौजसः
सुपर्णवशगा ब्रह्मन् जज्ञिरे नैकमस्तकाः ॥
verses.rom:
kadra veyastu balinah sahasramamitaujasah
suparnavashaga brahman jajnire naikamastakah ||

verses.sa:
तेषां प्रधानभूतास्तु श्षोवासुकितक्षकाः
शंखश्वेतो महापद्मः कम्बलाश्वतरौ तथा ॥
verses.rom:
tesham pradhanabhutastu shshovasukitakshakah
shamkhashveto mahapadmah kambalashvatarau tatha ||

verses.sa:
एलापुत्रस्तथा नागः कर्कोटकधनञ्जयौ
एते चान्ये च बहवो दन्दशूका विषोल्बणाः ॥
verses.rom:
elaputrastatha nagah karkotakadhananjayau
ete chanye cha bahavo dandashuka visholbanah ||

verses.sa:
गणं क्रोधवशं विद्धि तस्याः सर्वे च दंष्ट्रिणः
स्थलजाः पक्षिणोब्जाश्च दारुणाः पिशिताशनाः ॥
verses.rom:
ganam krodhavasham viddhi tasyah sarve cha damshtrinah
sthalajah pakshinobjashcha darunah pishitashanah ||

verses.sa:
क्रोधात्तु पिशाचांश्च जनयामास महाबलान्
गास्तु वै जनयामास सुरभीर्महिषीस्तथा
इरावृक्षलतावल्लीस्तृणजातीश्च सर्वशः ॥
verses.rom:
krodhattu pishachamshcha janayamasa mahabalan
gastu vai janayamasa surabhirmahishistatha
iravrikshalatavallistrinajatishcha sarvashah ||

verses.sa:
स्वसा तु यक्षरक्षांसि मुनिरप्सरसस्तथा
अरिष्टा तु महासत्त्वान् गन्धर्वान्समजीजनत् ॥
verses.rom:
svasa tu yaksharakshamsi munirapsarasastatha
arishta tu mahasattvan gandharvansamajijanat ||

verses.sa:
एते कश्यपदायादाः कीर्त्तिताः स्थाणुजङ्गमाः
तेषां पुत्राश्च पौत्राश्च शतशोथ सहस्रशः ॥
verses.rom:
ete kashyapadayadah kirttitah sthanujangamah
tesham putrashcha pautrashcha shatashotha sahasrashah ||

verses.sa: एष मन्वन्तरे सर्गो ब्रह्मन्स्वारोचिषे स्मृतः ॥
verses.rom: esha manvantare sargo brahmansvarochishe smritah ||

verses.sa:
वैवस्वते च महति वारुणे वितते कृतौ
जुह्वानस्य ब्रह्मणो वै प्रजासर्ग इहोच्यते ॥
verses.rom:
vaivasvate cha mahati varune vitate kritau
juhvanasya brahmano vai prajasarga ihochyate ||

verses.sa:
पूर्वं यत्र तु सप्तर्षिनुत्पन्नान्सप्तमानसान्
पुत्रत्वे कल्पयामास स्वयमेव पितामहः
गन्धर्वभोगिदेवानां दानवानां च सत्तम ॥
verses.rom:
purvam yatra tu saptarshinutpannansaptamanasan
putratve kalpayamasa svayameva pitamahah
gandharvabhogidevanam danavanam cha sattama ||

verses.sa:
दितिर्विनष्टपुत्रा वै तोषयामास काश्यपम्
तया चाराधितः सम्यक्काश्यपस्तपतां वरः ॥
verses.rom:
ditirvinashtaputra vai toshayamasa kashyapam
taya charadhitah samyakkashyapastapatam varah ||

verses.sa:
वरेण च्छन्दयामास सा च वव्रे ततो वरम्
पुत्रमिन्द्र वधार्थाय समर्थममितौजसम् ॥
verses.rom:
varena chchhandayamasa sa cha vavre tato varam
putramindra vadharthaya samarthamamitaujasam ||

verses.sa:
स च तस्मै वरं प्रादाद्भार्यायै मुनिसत्तमः
दत्त्वा च वरमत्युग्रं कश्यपस्तामुवाच ह ॥
verses.rom:
sa cha tasmai varam pradadbharyayai munisattamah
dattva cha varamatyugram kashyapastamuvacha ha ||

verses.sa:
शक्रं पुत्रो निहन्ता ते यदि गर्भं शरच्छतम्
समाहितातिप्रयता शौचिनी धारयिष्यसि ॥
verses.rom:
shakram putro nihanta te yadi garbham sharachchhatam
samahitatiprayata shauchini dharayishyasi ||

verses.sa:
इत्येवमुक्त्वा तां देवीं संगतः कश्यपो मुनिः
दधार सा च तं गर्भं सम्यक्छोचसमन्विता ॥
verses.rom:
ityevamuktva tam devim samgatah kashyapo munih
dadhara sa cha tam garbham samyakchhochasamanvita ||

verses.sa:
गर्भमात्मवधार्थाय ज्ञात्वा तं मघवानपि
शुश्रूषुस्तामथागच्छद्विनयादमराधिपः ॥
verses.rom:
garbhamatmavadharthaya jnatva tam maghavanapi
shushrushustamathagachchhadvinayadamaradhipah ||

verses.sa:
तस्याश्चैवान्तरप्रेप्सुरतिष्ठत्पाकशासनः
ऊने वर्षशते चास्या ददर्शान्तरमात्मना ॥
verses.rom:
tasyashchaivantaraprepsuratishthatpakashasanah
une varshashate chasya dadarshantaramatmana ||

verses.sa:
अकृत्वा पादयोः शौचं दितिः शयनमाविशत्
निद्रा ं! चाहारयामास तस्याः कुक्षिं प्रविश्य सः ॥
verses.rom:
akritva padayoh shaucham ditih shayanamavishat
nidra m! chaharayamasa tasyah kukshim pravishya sah ||

verses.sa:
वज्रपाणिर्महागर्भं चिच्छेदाथ स सप्तधा
सम्पीड्यमानो वज्रेण स रुरोदातिदारुणम् ॥
verses.rom:
vajrapanirmahagarbham chichchhedatha sa saptadha
sampidyamano vajrena sa rurodatidarunam ||

verses.sa:
मा रोदीरिति तं शक्रः पुनःपुनरभाषत
सोऽभवत्सप्तधा गर्भस्तमिंद्र ः! कुपितः पुनः ॥
verses.rom:
ma rodiriti tam shakrah punahpunarabhashata
so'bhavatsaptadha garbhastamimdra h! kupitah punah ||

verses.sa:
एकैकं सप्तधा चक्रे वज्रेणारिविदारिणा
मरुतो नाम देवास्ते बभूवुरतिवेगिनः ॥
verses.rom:
ekaikam saptadha chakre vajrenarividarina
maruto nama devaste babhuvurativeginah ||

verses.sa:
यदुक्तं वै भगवता तेनैव मरुतोऽभवन्
देवा एकोनपञ्चाशत्सहाया वज्रपाणिनः ॥
verses.rom:
yaduktam vai bhagavata tenaiva maruto'bhavan
deva ekonapanchashatsahaya vajrapaninah ||

verses.sa: इति श्रीविष्णुपुराणे प्रथमेंशे एकविंशोऽध्यायः ॥
verses.rom: iti shrivishnupurane prathamemshe ekavimsho'dhyayah ||

verses.sa:
संह्लादपुत्र आयुष्मान् शिविर्वाष्कल एव च ।
विरोचनस्तु प्राह्लादिर्बलिर्ज्जज्ञच विरोचनात् ॥
verses.rom:
samhladaputra ayushman shivirvashkala eva cha |
virochanastu prahladirbalirjjajnacha virochanat ||

verses.sa:
बलेः पुत्रशतन्त्वासीदू बाणज्येष्ठं भहामुने ।
हिरणयाक्षसुताश्वासन् सर्व्व एव महाबलाः ॥
verses.rom:
baleh putrashatantvasidu banajyeshtham bhahamune |
hiranayakshasutashvasan sarvva eva mahabalah ||

verses.sa:
उत्कुरः शकुनिश्चैव भूतसन्तापनस्तथा
महानाभो महाबाबहु- कालनाभस्तथापरः ॥
verses.rom:
utkurah shakunishchaiva bhutasantapanastatha
mahanabho mahababahu- kalanabhastathaparah ||

verses.sa:
अभवन् दनुपुत्राश्च द्रिमूर्द्धा शङ्करस्तथा ।
अयोमुखः शङ्कु शिराः कपिलः शम्बरस्तथा ॥
verses.rom:
abhavan danuputrashcha drimurddha shankarastatha |
ayomukhah shanku shirah kapilah shambarastatha ||

verses.sa:
एकचक्रो महाबाहुस्तारकश्च महाबलः ।
स्वर्भानुर्वृ षपर्व्वा च पुलोमा च महावलः ॥
verses.rom:
ekachakro mahabahustarakashcha mahabalah |
svarbhanurvri shaparvva cha puloma cha mahavalah ||

verses.sa:
एते दनोः सुताः क्याता विप्रचित्तिश्च वीर्य्यवान ।
स्वर्भानोस्तु प्रभा कन्या शर्म्मिष्ठा वार्षपर्व्वाणी ॥
verses.rom:
ete danoh sutah kyata viprachittishcha viryyavana |
svarbhanostu prabha kanya sharmmishtha varshaparvvani ||

verses.sa:
उपदानवी-हयशिराः प्रख्याता वरकन्यकाः ।
वैश्वानरसुते चोभे पुलोमा कालका तथा ॥
verses.rom:
upadanavi-hayashirah prakhyata varakanyakah |
vaishvanarasute chobhe puloma kalaka tatha ||

verses.sa:
अबे सुते महाभागे मरीचेस्तु परिग्रहः ।
ताभ्यां पुत्रसहस्त्राणि षष्टिर्दानवसत्तमाः ॥
verses.rom:
abe sute mahabhage marichestu parigrahah |
tabhyam putrasahastrani shashtirdanavasattamah ||

verses.sa:
पौलोमा कालकेयाश्च मीरीचतनयाः स्मृताः ।
ततोऽपरो महावीर्य्या दारुणास्त्वतिनिर्घृणाः ॥
verses.rom:
pauloma kalakeyashcha mirichatanayah smritah |
tato'paro mahaviryya darunastvatinirghrinah ||

verses.sa:
सिंहिकायामथोत्पन्ना विप्रतचित्तेः सुतास्तथा ।
व्यंशः शल्यश्च बलवान् नभश्चैव महाबलः ॥
verses.rom:
simhikayamathotpanna vipratachitteh sutastatha |
vyamshah shalyashcha balavan nabhashchaiva mahabalah ||

verses.sa:
वातापिर्नमुचिश्चैव इल्वलः खसृमस्तथा ।
अञ्झको नरकश्चैव कालनाभस्तथवै च ॥
verses.rom:
vatapirnamuchishchaiva ilvalah khasrimastatha |
anjhako narakashchaiva kalanabhastathavai cha ||

verses.sa:
स्वर्भानुश्च महावीर्य्यश्चक्रयोधी महाबलः ।
एते ते दानवाः श्वे ष्ठो दनुवंशविवर्द्धनाः ॥
verses.rom:
svarbhanushcha mahaviryyashchakrayodhi mahabalah |
ete te danavah shve shtho danuvamshavivarddhanah ||

verses.sa:
एतेषां पुत्रपौत्राश्च शतशोऽथ सहस्त्रशः ।
प्रह्लादस्य तु दैत्यस्य निवातकवचाः कुले ॥
verses.rom:
etesham putrapautrashcha shatasho'tha sahastrashah |
prahladasya tu daityasya nivatakavachah kule ||

verses.sa:
समुत्पन्नाः सुमहता तपसा भावितात्मनः ।
ट् सुताः सुमहासत्त्वास्ताम्रायाः परिकीर्त्तिताः ॥
verses.rom:
samutpannah sumahata tapasa bhavitatmanah |
t sutah sumahasattvastamrayah parikirttitah ||

verses.sa:
शुकी श्येनी च भीसी च सुग्रीवी शुचिगृध्रिका ।
शुकी शुकानजनयदुलूकी प्रत्युलूककान् ॥
verses.rom:
shuki shyeni cha bhisi cha sugrivi shuchigridhrika |
shuki shukanajanayaduluki pratyulukakan ||

verses.sa:
श्येनी श्येनांस्तथा भासी भासान् गृध्रांश्च गृध्रयपि ।
शुच्यौदकान् पक्षिगणान् सुग्रीवी तु व्यजायत ॥
verses.rom:
shyeni shyenamstatha bhasi bhasan gridhramshcha gridhrayapi |
shuchyaudakan pakshiganan sugrivi tu vyajayata ||

verses.sa:
अश्वानुष्ट्रान् गर्द्द भांश्च ताम्रावंशः प्रकीर्त्तितः ।
विनतायास्तु पुत्रौ द्रौ विख्यातौ गरुड़ारुणौ ॥
verses.rom:
ashvanushtran gardda bhamshcha tamravamshah prakirttitah |
vinatayastu putrau drau vikhyatau garurarunau ||

verses.sa:
सुपर्णः पततां श्वष्ठो दारुणः पन्नागाशनः ।
सुरसायां सहस्त्रन्तु सर्पाणाममितौजसाम् ॥
verses.rom:
suparnah patatam shvashtho darunah pannagashanah |
surasayam sahastrantu sarpanamamitaujasam ||

verses.sa:
अनेकखिरसां ब्रह्मन् शेचराणां महात्मनाम् ।
काद्रवेयास्तु बलिनः सहस्त्रममितौजसः ॥
verses.rom:
anekakhirasam brahman shecharanam mahatmanam |
kadraveyastu balinah sahastramamitaujasah ||

verses.sa:
सुपर्णावशागा ब्रह्मन् जज्ञिरे नैकमस्तकाः ।
तेषां प्रधानभूतास्तु शेषवासुकितक्षकाः ॥
verses.rom:
suparnavashaga brahman jajnire naikamastakah |
tesham pradhanabhutastu sheshavasukitakshakah ||

verses.sa:
शङ्खः श्वेतो महापह्मः कम्बलाख्वतरौ तथा ।
एलापत्रस्तथा नागः कर्कोटक-दनञ्जयौ ॥
verses.rom:
shankhah shveto mahapahmah kambalakhvatarau tatha |
elapatrastatha nagah karkotaka-dananjayau ||

verses.sa:
एते चान्ये च बहवो दन्दशूका विषोल्वणाः ।
गणां क्रोधवशं विद्धि तस्याः सर्व्वो च दंष्टिणः ॥
verses.rom:
ete chanye cha bahavo dandashuka visholvanah |
ganam krodhavasham viddhi tasyah sarvvo cha damshtinah ||

verses.sa:
स्थलजाः पक्षिणोऽब्जाश्च दारुणाः पिशिताशनाः ।
क्रोधा तु जनयामास पिशाचांश्यच महाबलान् ॥
verses.rom:
sthalajah pakshino'bjashcha darunah pishitashanah |
krodha tu janayamasa pishachamshyacha mahabalan ||

verses.sa:
गास्तु वै जनयामास सुरभिर्म्महिषांस्तथा ।
इरा वृक्ष-लता-वल्लीस्तृणजातीश्च सर्व्वशः ।
खसा तु यक्षरक्षांसि मुनिरप्सरसस्तथा ॥
verses.rom:
gastu vai janayamasa surabhirmmahishamstatha |
ira vriksha-lata-vallistrinajatishcha sarvvashah |
khasa tu yaksharakshamsi munirapsarasastatha ||

verses.sa:
अरिष्टा तु महासत्त्वान् गन्धर्व्वान् समजीजनत् ।
एते कश्यपदायादाः कीर्त्तिताः स्थाणु-जङ्गमाः ॥
verses.rom:
arishta tu mahasattvan gandharvvan samajijanat |
ete kashyapadayadah kirttitah sthanu-jangamah ||

verses.sa:
तेषां पुत्राश्च पौत्राश्च शतशोऽथ सहस्त्रशः ।
एष मन्वन्तरे मर्गो ब्रह्मन् स्वारोचिषे स्मृतः ॥
verses.rom:
tesham putrashcha pautrashcha shatasho'tha sahastrashah |
esha manvantare margo brahman svarochishe smritah ||

verses.sa:
वैवस्वते च महति वारुणे वितते क्रतौ ।
जुह्वानस्य ब्रह्मणो वै प्रजासर्ग इहोच्यते ॥
verses.rom:
vaivasvate cha mahati varune vitate kratau |
juhvanasya brahmano vai prajasarga ihochyate ||

verses.sa:
पूर्व्वं यत्र तु सप्तर्षीनुत्पन्नान् सप्त मानसान् ।
पुत्रत्वे कल्पयामास स्वयमेव पितामहः ॥
verses.rom:
purvvam yatra tu saptarshinutpannan sapta manasan |
putratve kalpayamasa svayameva pitamahah ||

verses.sa:
गन्धर्व्वभोगिदेवानां दानवानाञ्च सत्तम ।
दितिर्व्विनष्टपुत्रा वै तोषयामास कश्यपम् ॥
verses.rom:
gandharvvabhogidevanam danavanancha sattama |
ditirvvinashtaputra vai toshayamasa kashyapam ||

verses.sa:
तया चाराधितः सम्यक् कश्यपस्तपतां वरः ।
वरेण च्छन्दयामास सा च वव्र ततो वरम् ॥
verses.rom:
taya charadhitah samyak kashyapastapatam varah |
varena chchhandayamasa sa cha vavra tato varam ||

verses.sa:
पुत्रमिन्द्रवधार्थाय समर्थममितौजसम् ।
स च तस्मै वरं प्रादादू भार्य्यायै मुनिसत्तम ॥
verses.rom:
putramindravadharthaya samarthamamitaujasam |
sa cha tasmai varam pradadu bharyyayai munisattama ||

verses.sa:
दत्ता च वरमत्युय्र कश्यपस्तामुवाच ह ।
शक्रं पुत्रो निहन्ता ते यदि गर्भं शरच्छतम् ॥
verses.rom:
datta cha varamatyuyra kashyapastamuvacha ha |
shakram putro nihanta te yadi garbham sharachchhatam ||

verses.sa:
समाहितातिप्रयता शुचिनी धारयिष्यसि ।
इत्येवमुत्तवा तां देवीं सङ्गतः कश्यपो मुनिः ॥
verses.rom:
samahitatiprayata shuchini dharayishyasi |
ityevamuttava tam devim sangatah kashyapo munih ||

verses.sa:
दधार मा च तं गर्भं सम्यक् शौचसमन्विता ।
गर्भमात्मवधार्थाय ज्ञात्वा तं मघवानपि ॥
verses.rom:
dadhara ma cha tam garbham samyak shauchasamanvita |
garbhamatmavadharthaya jnatva tam maghavanapi ||

verses.sa:
सुश्रूषु स्तामथागच्छदू विनयादमराधिपः ।
तस्याश्चैवान्तरं प्रेप्सुरतिष्ठते पाकशासनः ॥
verses.rom:
sushrushu stamathagachchhadu vinayadamaradhipah |
tasyashchaivantaram prepsuratishthate pakashasanah ||

verses.sa:
ऊने वर्ष शते चास्या ददर्शान्तरमात्मना ।
अकृत्वा पादयोः शौचं दितिः शयनमाविशत् ॥
verses.rom:
une varsha shate chasya dadarshantaramatmana |
akritva padayoh shaucham ditih shayanamavishat ||

verses.sa:
नि द्राञ्चाहारायामास तस्याः कुक्षिं प्रविश्य सः ।
वज्रपाणिर्म्महागर्भं चिच्छदाथ स सप्तधा ॥
verses.rom:
ni dranchaharayamasa tasyah kukshim pravishya sah |
vajrapanirmmahagarbham chichchhadatha sa saptadha ||

verses.sa:
स पीड़यमानो वज्रेणा प्ररुरोदातिदारुणम् ।
मा रोदीरिति तं शक्रः पुनः पूनरभाषत ॥
verses.rom:
sa pirayamano vajrena prarurodatidarunam |
ma rodiriti tam shakrah punah punarabhashata ||

verses.sa:
सोऽभवत् सप्तधा गर्भस्तमिन्द्रः कुपितः पुनः ।
एकैक सप्तधा चक्र वज्रणारिविदारिणा ॥
verses.rom:
so'bhavat saptadha garbhastamindrah kupitah punah |
ekaika saptadha chakra vajranarividarina ||

verses.sa:
मरुतो नाम देवास्ते बभूवुरतिवेगिनः ।
यदुक्तं वै मघवता तेनैव मरुतोऽभवन् ।
देवा एकोनपञ्चासत् सहाया वज्रपाणिनः ॥
verses.rom:
maruto nama devaste babhuvurativeginah |
yaduktam vai maghavata tenaiva maruto'bhavan |
deva ekonapanchasat sahaya vajrapaninah ||

prose.en:
Parāçara said:—The sons of Sanglhada were Ayushman Sivi and Vashkala. The son of Prahlāda was named Virochana, whose son was Vali who had a hundred sons of whom Vāna was the eldest, O great Muni.

All the sons of Hiranyaksha were also gifted with great prowess—Jharjhara, Sakuni, Bhutasantāpana, Mahānābha, Mahābāhu and Kālanābhan.

Dahu had many sons—Dwimurddha, Sankara, Ayomukha, Sankusiras, Kapila, Samvara, Ekachakra, Mahābāhu, the mighty Tāraka, Swarbhānu, Vrishaparvan, Pulomon and the mighty Viprachiti: these were the powerful and renowned sons Danu.

Swarbhanu had a daughter named Prabhā and Sarmisthā was the daughter of Vrishaparvan who had two other daughters named Upadānavi and Hayasirā.

The two daughters of Vaiswanara were named Pulomā and Kālikā who were both married to Kasyapa and bore him sixty thousand celebrated Dānavas called Paulomas and Kālakanjas, who were mighty, dreadful and cruel.

Viprachiti begot on Sinhikā several sons named—Vyansa, Salya the strong, Nabha the powerful, Vātāpi, Namuchi, Hwala, Khasrima, Anjaka, Naraka, Kālanābha, the Valiant, Swarbhānu and the mighty Vaktrayodhi. These were the most eminent Dānavas who multiplied the race of Danu. Their children and grand children were by hundreds and thousands.

In the family of the Daitya Prahlāda, the Nivāta Kavachas were born, who were greatly purified by rigid austerities.

Six daughters, gifted with great energy, were born to Tāmra—named Suki, Syeni, Bhāsi, Sugrivi, Suchi, and Gridhrikā. Suki gave birth to parrots, owls, and crows, Syeni to hawks, Bhāsi to kites; Gridhrika to vultures, Suchi to water-fowl; Sugrivi to horses, camels and asses. These were the offsprings of Tāmra.

Vānati had two well-known sons, named Garuda and Varuna; the former also called Superna was the lord of the feathered tribes and the dreadful enemy of the serpents.

The offsprings of Surasā were a thousand powerful many-headed serpents coursing the welkin.

Kadru had also a thousand powerful sons of unmitigated prowess—all subject to Garuda and many-headed. The most celebrated amongst them were, Sesha, Vāsuki, Takshaka, Sankha, Sweta, Mahāpadma, Kumbala, Aswatara, Elapatra, Nāga, Karkkota, Dhananyaya, and many other deadly and poisonous serpents.

Krodas gave birth to highly powerful monsters and Suravi gave birth to cows and buffaloes. Irā was the mother of trees and creeping plants and shrubs and every kind of grass: Khāsa of the Rākshasas and Yakshas: Muni of Apsaras and Aristha of the celebrated Gandharvas.

These were the offsprings of Kasyapa whether moveable or stationary; their children and grand children multiplied by hundreds and thousands. Such was the creation, O Brahmana, in the Swarochisa (or the second) Manwantara. In the present or Viavaswata Manwantara Brahmā being engaged in sacrifices undertaken by Varuna I shall describe to you the manner in which the progeny multiplied. The great Patriarch begot as his sons the seven Rishis, who were in the days of yore, engendered by his mind.

O best of ascetics, when there was a quarrel amongst the Gandharvas, serpents, Dānavas and gods, Diti, having lost all her children, propitiated Kasyapa, Being perfectly adored by her, Kasyapa, the foremost of the ascetics, promised her a boon and Diti prayed for it in the shape of a valiant son capable of destroying Indra, O excellent Muni, he granted his spouse that boon. And having granted her that boon Kasyapa said—"You shall give birth to a son who shall destroy Sakra, if with pious thoughts and a pure body, you carry the babe in your womb for a hundred years". Having said this the ascetic Kasyapa remained with her and she conceived being perfectly pure. Knowing that this conception was for his own destruction, Indra the lord of immortals, came to her and attended upon her with humility. And the slayer of Pāka wanted there to thwart her intention. At last in the last year of the century he found out an opportunity. Diti, without washing her feet, went to bed. And when she was asleep the wielder of the thunder-bolt entered into her womb and severed the embryo into seven pieces.

The child, thus severed, cried out bitterly in the womb but Sakra again and again said "Do not cry". The embryo was thus cut into seven portions, and Indra, wroth again, cut each portion into seven pieces with his thunder-bolt. From these originated the swift-coursing deities called Maruts (winds.) They got this name from the words with which Indra had addressed the embryo (Ma—rooda—do not cry) and became forty-nine divinities, the assistants of the wielder of the thunder bolt.

verses.sa:
श्रीपराशर उवाच
यदाभिषिक्तः स पृथुः पूर्वं राज्ये महर्षिभिः ।
ततः क्रमेण राज्यानि ददौ लोकपितामहः ॥
verses.rom:
shriparashara uvacha
yadabhishiktah sa prithuh purvam rajye maharshibhih |
tatah kramena rajyani dadau lokapitamahah ||

verses.sa:
नक्षत्रग्रहविप्राणां वीरुधां चाप्यशेषतः ।
सोमं राज्ये दधद्ब्रह्मा यज्ञानां तपसामपि ॥
verses.rom:
nakshatragrahavipranam virudham chapyasheshatah |
somam rajye dadhadbrahma yajnanam tapasamapi ||

verses.sa:
राज्ञां वैश्रवणं राज्ये जलानां वरुणं तथा ।
आदित्यानां पतिं विष्णुं वसूनामथ पावकम् ॥
verses.rom:
rajnam vaishravanam rajye jalanam varunam tatha |
adityanam patim vishnum vasunamatha pavakam ||

verses.sa:
प्रजापतीनां दक्षं तु वासवं मरुतामपि ।
दैत्यानां दानवानां च प्रह्लादमधिपं ददौ ॥
verses.rom:
prajapatinam daksham tu vasavam marutamapi |
daityanam danavanam cha prahladamadhipam dadau ||

verses.sa:
पितॄणां धर्मराजानं यमं राज्येऽभ्यषेचयत् ।
ऐरावतं गर्जेद्राणामशेषाणां पतिं ददौ ॥
verses.rom:
pitrinam dharmarajanam yamam rajye'bhyashechayat |
airavatam garjedranamasheshanam patim dadau ||

verses.sa:
पतत्रिणां तु गरुडं देवानामपि वासवम् ।
उच्चैःश्रवसमश्वानां वृषभं तु गवामपि ॥
verses.rom:
patatrinam tu garudam devanamapi vasavam |
uchchaihshravasamashvanam vrishabham tu gavamapi ||

verses.sa:
मृगाणां चैव सर्वेषां राज्ये सिंहं ददौ प्रभुः ।
शेषं तु दन्दशूकानामकरोत्पतिमव्ययः ॥
verses.rom:
mriganam chaiva sarvesham rajye simham dadau prabhuh |
shesham tu dandashukanamakarotpatimavyayah ||

verses.sa:
हिमालयं स्थावराणां मुनीनां कपिलं मुनिम् ।
नखिनां दंष्ट्रिणां चैव मृगाणां व्याघ्रमीश्वरम् ॥
verses.rom:
himalayam sthavaranam muninam kapilam munim |
nakhinam damshtrinam chaiva mriganam vyaghramishvaram ||

verses.sa:
वनस्पतीनां राजानां प्लक्षमैवाभ्यषेचयत् ।
एवमेवान्यजातीनां प्राधान्येनाकरोत्प्रभून् ॥
verses.rom:
vanaspatinam rajanam plakshamaivabhyashechayat |
evamevanyajatinam pradhanyenakarotprabhun ||

verses.sa:
एवं विभज्य राज्यानि दिशां पालाननन्तरम् ।
प्रजापतिपतिर्ब्रह्मा स्थापयामास सर्वतः ॥
verses.rom:
evam vibhajya rajyani disham palananantaram |
prajapatipatirbrahma sthapayamasa sarvatah ||

verses.sa:
पूर्वस्यां दिशि राजानं वैराजस्य प्रजापतेः ।
दिशापालं सुधन्वानं सुतं वै सोऽभ्यषेचयत् ॥
verses.rom:
purvasyam dishi rajanam vairajasya prajapateh |
dishapalam sudhanvanam sutam vai so'bhyashechayat ||

verses.sa:
दक्षिणस्यां दिशि तथा कर्दमस्य प्रजापतेः ।
पुत्रं शङ्खपदं नाम राजानं सोऽभ्यषेचयत् ॥
verses.rom:
dakshinasyam dishi tatha kardamasya prajapateh |
putram shankhapadam nama rajanam so'bhyashechayat ||

verses.sa:
पश्चिमस्यां दिशि तथा रजसः पुत्रमच्युतम् ।
केतुमन्तं महात्मानं राजानं सोऽभ्यषेचयत् ॥
verses.rom:
pashchimasyam dishi tatha rajasah putramachyutam |
ketumantam mahatmanam rajanam so'bhyashechayat ||

verses.sa:
तथा हिरण्यरोमाणं पर्जन्यस्य प्रजापतेः ।
उदीच्यां दिशि दुर्धर्षं राजानमभ्यषेचयत् ॥
verses.rom:
tatha hiranyaromanam parjanyasya prajapateh |
udichyam dishi durdharsham rajanamabhyashechayat ||

verses.sa:
तैरियं पृथिवी सर्वा सप्तद्वीपा सपत्तना ।
यथाप्रदेशमद्यापि धर्मतः परिपाल्यते ॥
verses.rom:
tairiyam prithivi sarva saptadvipa sapattana |
yathapradeshamadyapi dharmatah paripalyate ||

verses.sa:
एते सर्वे प्रवृत्तस्य स्थितौ विष्णोर्महात्मनः ।
विभूतिभूता राजानो ये चान्ये मुनिसत्तम ॥
verses.rom:
ete sarve pravrittasya sthitau vishnormahatmanah |
vibhutibhuta rajano ye chanye munisattama ||

verses.sa:
ये भविष्यन्ति ये भूताः सर्वे भूतेश्वरा द्विज ।
ते सर्वे सर्वभूतस्य विष्णोरंशा द्विजोत्तम ॥
verses.rom:
ye bhavishyanti ye bhutah sarve bhuteshvara dvija |
te sarve sarvabhutasya vishnoramsha dvijottama ||

verses.sa:
ये तु देवाधिपतयो ये च दैत्याधिपास्तथा ।
दानवानां च ये नाथा ये नाथाः पिशिताशिनाम् ॥
verses.rom:
ye tu devadhipatayo ye cha daityadhipastatha |
danavanam cha ye natha ye nathah pishitashinam ||

verses.sa:
पशूनां ये च पतयः पतयो ये च पक्षिणाम् ।
मनुष्याणां च सर्पाणां नागानामधिपाश्च ये ॥
verses.rom:
pashunam ye cha patayah patayo ye cha pakshinam |
manushyanam cha sarpanam naganamadhipashcha ye ||

verses.sa:
वृक्षाणां पर्वतानां च ग्रहाणां चापि येऽधिपाः ।
अतीता वर्तमानाश्च ये भविष्यन्ति चापरे ।
ते सर्वे सर्वभूतस्य विष्णोरंशसमुद्भवाः ॥
verses.rom:
vrikshanam parvatanam cha grahanam chapi ye'dhipah |
atita vartamanashcha ye bhavishyanti chapare |
te sarve sarvabhutasya vishnoramshasamudbhavah ||

verses.sa:
न हि पालनसामर्थ्यमृते सर्वेश्वरं हरिम् ।
स्थितं स्थितौ महाप्राज्ञ भवत्यन्यस्य कस्यचित् ॥
verses.rom:
na hi palanasamarthyamrite sarveshvaram harim |
sthitam sthitau mahaprajna bhavatyanyasya kasyachit ||

verses.sa:
सृजत्येष जगत्सृष्टौ स्थितौ पाति सनातनः ।
हन्ति चैवान्तकत्वेन रजःसत्त्वादिसंश्रयः ॥
verses.rom:
srijatyesha jagatsrishtau sthitau pati sanatanah |
hanti chaivantakatvena rajahsattvadisamshrayah ||

verses.sa:
चतुर्विभागः संसृष्टौ चतुर्धा संस्थितः स्थितौ ।
प्रलयं च करोत्यन्ते चतुर्भेदो जनार्दनः ॥
verses.rom:
chaturvibhagah samsrishtau chaturdha samsthitah sthitau |
pralayam cha karotyante chaturbhedo janardanah ||

verses.sa:
एकेनांशेन ब्रह्मसौ भवत्यव्यक्तमूर्तिमान् ।
मरीचिमिश्राः पतयः प्रजानाञ्चान्यभागशः ॥
verses.rom:
ekenamshena brahmasau bhavatyavyaktamurtiman |
marichimishrah patayah prajananchanyabhagashah ||

verses.sa:
कालस्तृतीयस्तस्यांशः सर्वभूतानि चापरः ।
इत्थं चतुर्धा संसृष्टौ वर्ततेसौ रजोगुणः ॥
verses.rom:
kalastritiyastasyamshah sarvabhutani chaparah |
ittham chaturdha samsrishtau vartatesau rajogunah ||

verses.sa:
एकांशेनास्थितो विष्णुः करोति प्रतिपालनम् ।
मन्वादिरूपश्चान्येन कालरूपोऽपरोण च ॥
verses.rom:
ekamshenasthito vishnuh karoti pratipalanam |
manvadirupashchanyena kalarupo'parona cha ||

verses.sa:
सर्वभूतेषु चान्येन संश्थितः कुरुते स्थितिम् ।
सत्त्वं गुणं समाश्रित्य जगतः पुरुषोत्तमः ॥
verses.rom:
sarvabhuteshu chanyena samshthitah kurute sthitim |
sattvam gunam samashritya jagatah purushottamah ||

verses.sa:
आश्रित्य तमसो वृत्तिमन्तकाले तथा पुनः ।
रुद्रस्वरूपो भगवानेकांशेन भवत्यजः ॥
verses.rom:
ashritya tamaso vrittimantakale tatha punah |
rudrasvarupo bhagavanekamshena bhavatyajah ||

verses.sa:
अग्न्यन्तकादिरूपेण भागेनान्येन वर्तते ।
कालस्वरूपो भागो यःसर्वभूतानि चापरः ॥
verses.rom:
agnyantakadirupena bhagenanyena vartate |
kalasvarupo bhago yahsarvabhutani chaparah ||

verses.sa:
विनाशं कुर्वतस्तस्य चतुर्धैवं महात्मनः ।
विभागकल्पना ब्रह्मन् कथ्यते सार्वकालिकी ॥
verses.rom:
vinasham kurvatastasya chaturdhaivam mahatmanah |
vibhagakalpana brahman kathyate sarvakaliki ||

verses.sa:
ब्रह्म दक्षादयः कालस्तथै वाखिलजन्तवः ।
विभूतयो हरेरेता जगतः सृष्टिहेतवः ॥
verses.rom:
brahma dakshadayah kalastathai vakhilajantavah |
vibhutayo harereta jagatah srishtihetavah ||

verses.sa:
विष्णुर्मन्वादयः कालः सर्वभूतानि च द्विज ।
स्थितेर्निमित्तभूतस्य विष्णोरेता विभूतयः ॥
verses.rom:
vishnurmanvadayah kalah sarvabhutani cha dvija |
sthiternimittabhutasya vishnoreta vibhutayah ||

verses.sa:
रुद्रः कालान्तकाद्याश्च समस्ताश्चैव जन्तवः ।
चतुर्धा प्रलायायैता जनार्दनविभूतयः ॥
verses.rom:
rudrah kalantakadyashcha samastashchaiva jantavah |
chaturdha pralayayaita janardanavibhutayah ||

verses.sa:
जगदादौ तथा मध्ये सृष्टिराप्रलया द्विज ।
धात्रा मरीचिमिश्रैश्च क्रियते जन्तुभिस्तथा ॥
verses.rom:
jagadadau tatha madhye srishtirapralaya dvija |
dhatra marichimishraishcha kriyate jantubhistatha ||

verses.sa:
ब्रह्म सृजत्यादिकाले मरीचिप्रमुखास्ततः ।
उत्पादयन्त्यपत्यानि जन्तवश्च प्रतिक्षणम् ॥
verses.rom:
brahma srijatyadikale marichipramukhastatah |
utpadayantyapatyani jantavashcha pratikshanam ||

verses.sa:
कालेन न विना ब्रह्म सृष्टिनिष्पादको द्विज ।
न प्रजापतयः सर्वे न चैवाखिलजन्तवः ॥
verses.rom:
kalena na vina brahma srishtinishpadako dvija |
na prajapatayah sarve na chaivakhilajantavah ||

verses.sa:
एवमेव विभागोयं स्तितावप्युपदिश्यति ।
चतुर्दा तस्य देवस्य मैत्रेय प्रलये तथा ॥
verses.rom:
evameva vibhagoyam stitavapyupadishyati |
chaturda tasya devasya maitreya pralaye tatha ||

verses.sa:
यत्किञ्चित्सृज्यते येन सत्त्वजातेन वै द्विज ।
तस्य सृज्यस्य सम्भूतो तत्सर्वं वै हरेस्तनुः ॥
verses.rom:
yatkinchitsrijyate yena sattvajatena vai dvija |
tasya srijyasya sambhuto tatsarvam vai harestanuh ||

verses.sa:
हन्ति यावच्च यत्किञ्चित्सत्त्वं स्थावरजङ्गमम् ।
जनार्दनस्य तद्रौद्रं मैत्रेयान्तकरं वपुः ॥
verses.rom:
hanti yavachcha yatkinchitsattvam sthavarajangamam |
janardanasya tadraudram maitreyantakaram vapuh ||

verses.sa:
एवमेष जगत्स्त्रष्टा जगत्पाता तथा जगत् ।
जगद्भक्षयिता देवः समस्तस्य जनार्दनः ॥
verses.rom:
evamesha jagatstrashta jagatpata tatha jagat |
jagadbhakshayita devah samastasya janardanah ||

verses.sa:
सृष्टिस्थित्यन्तकालेषु त्रिधैवं संप्रवर्तते ।
गुणप्रवृत्या परमं पदं तस्यागुणं महत् ॥
verses.rom:
srishtisthityantakaleshu tridhaivam sampravartate |
gunapravritya paramam padam tasyagunam mahat ||

verses.sa:
तच्च ज्ञानमयं व्यापि स्वसंवेद्यमनौपमम् ।
चतुष्प्रकारं तदपि स्वरूपं परमात्मनः ॥
verses.rom:
tachcha jnanamayam vyapi svasamvedyamanaupamam |
chatushprakaram tadapi svarupam paramatmanah ||

verses.sa:
श्रीमैत्रेय उवाच
चतुःप्रकारतां तस्य ब्रह्मभूतस्य हे मुने ।
ममाचक्ष्व यथान्यायं यदुक्तं परमं पदम् ॥
verses.rom:
shrimaitreya uvacha
chatuhprakaratam tasya brahmabhutasya he mune |
mamachakshva yathanyayam yaduktam paramam padam ||

verses.sa:
श्रीपराशर उवाच
मैत्रेय कारणं प्रोक्तं साधनं सर्ववस्तुषु ।
साध्यं च वस्त्वभिमतं यत्साधयितुमात्मनः ॥
verses.rom:
shriparashara uvacha
maitreya karanam proktam sadhanam sarvavastushu |
sadhyam cha vastvabhimatam yatsadhayitumatmanah ||

verses.sa:
योगिनो मुक्तिकामस्य प्राणायामादिसाधनम् ।
साध्यं च परमं ब्रह्म पुनर्नावर्तते यतः ॥
verses.rom:
yogino muktikamasya pranayamadisadhanam |
sadhyam cha paramam brahma punarnavartate yatah ||

verses.sa:
साधनालम्बनं ज्ञानं मुक्तये योगिनां हि यत् ।
स भेदः प्रथमस्तस्य ब्रह्मभूतस्य वै मुने ॥
verses.rom:
sadhanalambanam jnanam muktaye yoginam hi yat |
sa bhedah prathamastasya brahmabhutasya vai mune ||

verses.sa:
युञ्जतः क्लेशमुक्त्यर्थं साध्यं यद्ब्रह्म योगिनः ।
तदालम्बनविज्ञानं द्वितीयोऽंशो महामुने ॥
verses.rom:
yunjatah kleshamuktyartham sadhyam yadbrahma yoginah |
tadalambanavijnanam dvitiyo'msho mahamune ||

verses.sa:
उभयोस्त्वविभागेन साध्यसाधनयोर्हि यत् ।
विज्ञानमद्वैतमयं तद्भागोन्यो मयोदितः ॥
verses.rom:
ubhayostvavibhagena sadhyasadhanayorhi yat |
vijnanamadvaitamayam tadbhagonyo mayoditah ||

verses.sa:
ज्ञानत्रयस्य वै तस्य विशेषो यो महामुने ।
तन्निराकरणद्वारा दर्शितात्मस्वरूपवत् ॥
verses.rom:
jnanatrayasya vai tasya vishesho yo mahamune |
tannirakaranadvara darshitatmasvarupavat ||

verses.sa:
निर्व्यापारमनाख्येयं व्याप्तिमात्रमनूपमम् ।
आत्मसम्बोधविषयं सत्तामात्रमलक्षणम् ॥
verses.rom:
nirvyaparamanakhyeyam vyaptimatramanupamam |
atmasambodhavishayam sattamatramalakshanam ||

verses.sa:
प्रशान्तमभयं शुद्धं दुर्विभाव्यमसंश्रयम् ।
विष्णोर्ज्ञानमयस्योक्तं तज्ज्ञानं ब्रह्मसंज्ञितम् ॥
verses.rom:
prashantamabhayam shuddham durvibhavyamasamshrayam |
vishnorjnanamayasyoktam tajjnanam brahmasamjnitam ||

verses.sa:
तत्र ज्ञाननिरोधेन योगिनो यान्ति ये लयम् ।
संसारकर्षणोप्तौ ते यान्ति निर्बीजतां द्विजा ॥
verses.rom:
tatra jnananirodhena yogino yanti ye layam |
samsarakarshanoptau te yanti nirbijatam dvija ||

verses.sa:
एवंप्रकारममलं नित्यं व्यापकमक्षयम् ।
समस्तहेयरहितं विष्ण्वाख्यं परमं पदम् ॥
verses.rom:
evamprakaramamalam nityam vyapakamakshayam |
samastaheyarahitam vishnvakhyam paramam padam ||

verses.sa:
तद्ब्रह्म परमं योगी यतो नावर्तते पुनः ।
श्रयत्यपुण्योपरमे क्षीणक्लेशेऽतिनिर्मले ॥
verses.rom:
tadbrahma paramam yogi yato navartate punah |
shrayatyapunyoparame kshinakleshe'tinirmale ||

verses.sa:
द्वे रूपे ब्रह्मणस्तस्य मूर्तं चामूर्तमेव च ।
क्षराक्षरास्वरूपे ते सर्वभूतेष्ववस्थिते ॥
verses.rom:
dve rupe brahmanastasya murtam chamurtameva cha |
ksharaksharasvarupe te sarvabhuteshvavasthite ||

verses.sa:
अक्षरं तत्परं ब्रह्म क्षरं सर्वमिदं जगत् ।
एकदेशस्थितस्याग्नेर्ज्योत्स्त्रा विस्तारिणि यथा ।
परस्य ब्रह्मणः शक्तिस्तथोदमखिलं जगत् ॥
verses.rom:
aksharam tatparam brahma ksharam sarvamidam jagat |
ekadeshasthitasyagnerjyotstra vistarini yatha |
parasya brahmanah shaktistathodamakhilam jagat ||

verses.sa:
तत्राप्यासन्नदूरत्वाद्बहुत्वस्वल्पतामयः ।
ज्योत्स्नाभेदोस्ति तच्छक्तेस्तद्वन्मैत्रेय विद्यते ॥
verses.rom:
tatrapyasannaduratvadbahutvasvalpatamayah |
jyotsnabhedosti tachchhaktestadvanmaitreya vidyate ||

verses.sa:
ब्रह्मविष्णुशिवा ब्रह्मन्प्रधाना ब्रह्मशक्तयः ।
ततश्च देवा मैत्रेय न्यूना दक्षादयस्ततः ॥
verses.rom:
brahmavishnushiva brahmanpradhana brahmashaktayah |
tatashcha deva maitreya nyuna dakshadayastatah ||

verses.sa:
ततो मनुष्याः पशवौ मृगपक्षिसरीसृपाः ।
न्यूनान्यूनतराश्चैव वृक्षगुल्मादयस्तथा ॥
verses.rom:
tato manushyah pashavau mrigapakshisarisripah |
nyunanyunatarashchaiva vrikshagulmadayastatha ||

verses.sa:
तदेतदक्षरं नित्यं जगन्मुनिवराखितम् ।
आविर्भावतिरोभावजन्मनाशविकल्पवत् ॥
verses.rom:
tadetadaksharam nityam jaganmunivarakhitam |
avirbhavatirobhavajanmanashavikalpavat ||

verses.sa:
सर्वशक्ति मयो विष्णुः स्वरूपं ब्रह्मणः परम् ।
मूर्तं यद्योगिभिः पूर्वं योगारम्भेषु चिन्त्यते ॥
verses.rom:
sarvashakti mayo vishnuh svarupam brahmanah param |
murtam yadyogibhih purvam yogarambheshu chintyate ||

verses.sa:
सालम्बनो महायोगः सबीजो यत्रसंस्थितः ।
मनस्यव्याहते सम्यग्युञ्जतां जायते मुने ॥
verses.rom:
salambano mahayogah sabijo yatrasamsthitah |
manasyavyahate samyagyunjatam jayate mune ||

verses.sa:
स परः परशक्तीनां ब्रह्मणः समनन्तरम् ।
मूर्तं ब्रह्म महाभाग सर्वब्रह्ममयो हरिः ॥
verses.rom:
sa parah parashaktinam brahmanah samanantaram |
murtam brahma mahabhaga sarvabrahmamayo harih ||

verses.sa:
यत्र सर्वमिदं प्रोतमोतं चैवाखितं जगत् ।
ततो जगज्जगत्यस्मिन्स जगच्चखिलं मुने ॥
verses.rom:
yatra sarvamidam protamotam chaivakhitam jagat |
tato jagajjagatyasminsa jagachchakhilam mune ||

verses.sa:
क्षराक्षरमयो विष्णुर्बिभर्त्यखिलमीश्वरः ।
पुरुषाव्याकृतमयं भूषणास्त्रस्वरूपवत् ॥
verses.rom:
ksharaksharamayo vishnurbibhartyakhilamishvarah |
purushavyakritamayam bhushanastrasvarupavat ||

verses.sa:
श्रीमैत्रेय उवाच
भूषणास्त्रस्वरूपस्थं यच्चैतदखिलं जगत् ।
बिभर्ति भगवान्विष्णुस्तन्ममाख्यातुमर्हसि ॥
verses.rom:
shrimaitreya uvacha
bhushanastrasvarupastham yachchaitadakhilam jagat |
bibharti bhagavanvishnustanmamakhyatumarhasi ||

verses.sa:
श्रीपराशर उवाच
नमस्कृत्वाप्रमेयाय विष्णवे प्रभविष्णवे ।
कथयामि यथाख्यातं वसिष्ठेन ममा भवत् ॥
verses.rom:
shriparashara uvacha
namaskritvaprameyaya vishnave prabhavishnave |
kathayami yathakhyatam vasishthena mama bhavat ||

verses.sa:
आत्मानमस्य जगतो निर्लेपमगुणामलम् ।
बिभर्ति कौस्तुभमणिस्वरूपं भगवान्हरिः ॥
verses.rom:
atmanamasya jagato nirlepamagunamalam |
bibharti kaustubhamanisvarupam bhagavanharih ||

verses.sa:
श्रीवत्ससंस्थानधरमनन्तेन समाश्रितम् ।
प्रधानं बुद्धिरप्यास्ते गदारूपेण माधवे ॥
verses.rom:
shrivatsasamsthanadharamanantena samashritam |
pradhanam buddhirapyaste gadarupena madhave ||

verses.sa:
भूतादिमिन्द्रियादिं च द्विधाहङ्कारमीश्वरः ।
बिभर्ति शंखरूपेण शार्ङ्गरूपेण च स्थितम् ॥
verses.rom:
bhutadimindriyadim cha dvidhahankaramishvarah |
bibharti shamkharupena sharngarupena cha sthitam ||

verses.sa:
चलत्स्वरूपमत्यन्तं जवेनान्तारितानिलम् ।
चक्रस्वरूपं च मनो धत्ते विष्णुकरे स्थितम् ॥
verses.rom:
chalatsvarupamatyantam javenantaritanilam |
chakrasvarupam cha mano dhatte vishnukare sthitam ||

verses.sa:
पञ्चरूपा तु या माला वैजयन्ती गदाभृतः ।
सा भूतहेतुसंघाता भूतमाला च वै द्विज ॥
verses.rom:
pancharupa tu ya mala vaijayanti gadabhritah |
sa bhutahetusamghata bhutamala cha vai dvija ||

verses.sa:
यानीन्द्रियाण्यशेषाणि बुद्धिकर्मात्मकानि वै ।
शररूपाण्यशेषाणि तानि धत्ते जनार्दनः ॥
verses.rom:
yanindriyanyasheshani buddhikarmatmakani vai |
shararupanyasheshani tani dhatte janardanah ||

verses.sa:
बिभर्ति यच्चासिरत्नमच्युतोत्यन्तनिर्मलम् ।
विद्यामय तु तज्ज्ञानमविद्याकोशसंस्थितम् ॥
verses.rom:
bibharti yachchasiratnamachyutotyantanirmalam |
vidyamaya tu tajjnanamavidyakoshasamsthitam ||

verses.sa:
इत्थं पुमान्प्रधानं च बुद्ध्यहङ्कारमेव च ।
भूतानि च हृषीकेशे मनः सर्वेन्द्रियाणि च ।
विद्याविद्ये च मैत्रेय सर्वमेतत्समाश्रितम् ॥
verses.rom:
ittham pumanpradhanam cha buddhyahankarameva cha |
bhutani cha hrishikeshe manah sarvendriyani cha |
vidyavidye cha maitreya sarvametatsamashritam ||

verses.sa:
अस्त्रभूषणसंस्थानस्वरूपं रूपवर्जितः ।
बिभार्ति मायारूपोसौ श्रेयसे प्राणिनां हरिः ॥
verses.rom:
astrabhushanasamsthanasvarupam rupavarjitah |
bibharti mayaruposau shreyase praninam harih ||

verses.sa:
सविकारं प्रधानं च पुमांश्चैवाखिलं जगत् ।
बिभर्ति पुण्डहीकाक्षस्तदेवं परमेश्वरः ॥
verses.rom:
savikaram pradhanam cha pumamshchaivakhilam jagat |
bibharti pundahikakshastadevam parameshvarah ||

verses.sa:
या विद्या या तथाविद्या यत्सद्यच्चासदव्ययम् ।
तत्सर्वं सर्वभूतेशे मैत्रेय मधुसूदने ॥
verses.rom:
ya vidya ya tathavidya yatsadyachchasadavyayam |
tatsarvam sarvabhuteshe maitreya madhusudane ||

verses.sa:
कलाकाष्ठानिमेषादिदिनर्त्वयनहायनैः ।
कालस्वरूपो भगवानपापो हरिरव्ययः ॥
verses.rom:
kalakashthanimeshadidinartvayanahayanaih |
kalasvarupo bhagavanapapo hariravyayah ||

verses.sa:
भूर्लोकोथ भुवर्लोकः स्वर्लोको मुनिसत्तम ।
महर्जनस्तपः सत्यं सप्त लोका इमे विभुः ॥
verses.rom:
bhurlokotha bhuvarlokah svarloko munisattama |
maharjanastapah satyam sapta loka ime vibhuh ||

verses.sa:
लोकात्ममूर्तिः सर्वेषां पूर्वेषामपि पूर्वजः ।
आधारः सर्वविद्यानां स्वयमेव हरिः स्थितः ॥
verses.rom:
lokatmamurtih sarvesham purveshamapi purvajah |
adharah sarvavidyanam svayameva harih sthitah ||

verses.sa:
देवमानुषपश्वादिश्वरूपैर्बहुभिः स्थितः ।
ततः सर्वेश्वरोऽनन्तो भूतमूर्तिरमूर्तिमान् ॥
verses.rom:
devamanushapashvadishvarupairbahubhih sthitah |
tatah sarveshvaro'nanto bhutamurtiramurtiman ||

verses.sa:
ऋचो यजूंषि सामानि तथैवाथर्वाणानि वै ।
इतिहासोपवेदाश्च वेदान्तेषु तथोक्तयः ॥
verses.rom:
richo yajumshi samani tathaivatharvanani vai |
itihasopavedashcha vedanteshu tathoktayah ||

verses.sa:
वेदाङ्गानि समस्तानि मन्वादिगदितानि च ।
शास्त्राण्यशेषाण्याख्यानान्यनुवाकाश्च ये क्वचित् ॥
verses.rom:
vedangani samastani manvadigaditani cha |
shastranyasheshanyakhyananyanuvakashcha ye kvachit ||

verses.sa:
काव्यालापाश्च ये केचिद्रीतकान्यखिलानि च ।
शब्दमूर्तिधरस्यैतद्वपुर्विष्णोर्महात्मनः ॥
verses.rom:
kavyalapashcha ye kechidritakanyakhilani cha |
shabdamurtidharasyaitadvapurvishnormahatmanah ||

verses.sa:
यानि मूर्तान्यमूर्तानि यान्यत्रान्यत्र वा क्वचित् ।
सन्ति वै वस्तुजातानि तानि सर्वाणि तद्वपुः ॥
verses.rom:
yani murtanyamurtani yanyatranyatra va kvachit |
santi vai vastujatani tani sarvani tadvapuh ||

verses.sa:
अहं हरिः सर्वमिदं जनार्दनो नान्यत्ततः कारणकार्यजातम् ।
ईदृङ्मनो यस्य न तस्यट भूयो भवोद्भावा द्वन्द्वगदा भवन्ति ॥
verses.rom:
aham harih sarvamidam janardano nanyattatah karanakaryajatam |
idrinmano yasya na tasyata bhuyo bhavodbhava dvandvagada bhavanti ||

verses.sa:
इत्यैष तेंशः प्रथमः पुराणस्यास्य वै द्विज ।
यथावत्कथितो यस्मिन्धृते पापैः प्रमुच्यते ॥
verses.rom:
ityaisha temshah prathamah puranasyasya vai dvija |
yathavatkathito yasmindhrite papaih pramuchyate ||

verses.sa:
कार्त्तिक्यां पुष्करस्नाने द्वादशाब्देन यत्फलम् ।
तदस्य श्रवणात्सव मैत्रेयाप्नोति मानवः ॥
verses.rom:
karttikyam pushkarasnane dvadashabdena yatphalam |
tadasya shravanatsava maitreyapnoti manavah ||

verses.sa:
देवर्षिपितृगन्धर्वयक्षादिनां च सम्भवम् ।
भवन्ति शृण्वतः पुंसो देवाद्य वरदा मुने ॥
verses.rom:
devarshipitrigandharvayakshadinam cha sambhavam |
bhavanti shrinvatah pumso devadya varada mune ||

verses.sa:
इति श्रिविष्णुमहापुराणे प्रथमेऽंशे द्वाविंशोऽध्यायः
इति श्रीपराशरमुनिविरचिते श्रीविष्णुपरत्वनिर्णायके श्रीमति विष्णुमहापुराणे प्रथमांशः समाप्तः ।
verses.rom:
iti shrivishnumahapurane prathame'mshe dvavimsho'dhyayah
iti shriparasharamunivirachite shrivishnuparatvanirnayake shrimati vishnumahapurane prathamamshah samaptah |

prose.en:
Parāçara said:—When Pritha was installed on the throne by the great Rishis the great Patriarch by and by conferred kingdoms upon other kings. He bestowed upon the moon the sovereignty of stars, planets, twice-born ones, grass, creeping plants sacrifices and penances. Vaisravana was made king over kings, and Varuna was made lord of waters. Vishnu was made the king of Adityas and Pāvaka of Vasus. Daksha was made the lord of Patriarchs and Vāsava of Maruts. And he conferred the sovereignty ®f Daityas and Dānavas upon Prāhlada. And Yama, the king of justice, was made the king of the manes (Pitris). Airāvata was made the king of many elephants, Garuda of birds, Vāsava of the celestials. Uchaisravas was made the king of horses and Vrishabba of kine. Shesha became the king of serpents, the lion, the monarch of the beasts and the holy fig-tree the king of the trees. Having thus divided the kingdom the great Patriarch Brahmā appointed divinities to protect the different quarters: he made Sudhanwan, the son of the patriarch Viraja, the protector of the east; Sankhapada the son of the patriarch Kardama, of the south; the immortal Ketumat, the son of Rajas, protector of the west and Hiranyaroman the son of the patriarch Parjanya, protector of the north. By these the whole earth, with its even islands and cities, was righteously governed, each confining himself to his own limit.

All these and others appointed to govern the creation are but persons of the Great Vishnu, O foremost of Munis, All the kings who have been and who shall be, O foremost of twice-born ones, are the portions of Vishnu. The lords of celestials, the kings of the Daityas, the sovereigns of the Dānavas, the rulers of the demons, the kings of the beasts, birds, men, serpents, Nagas, the best of trees, of mountains, of planets—those that were, those that are, and those that shall be, are but portions of Vishnu who is identical with the universe. None else is capable of protecting the world, but Hari, the lord of all. O greatly wise ascetic, the essence of the universal creation exists in him and none else. The eternal Vishnu invested respectively with the qualities of foulness, goodness, and darkness, creates the universe, preserves it and destroys it. By a four-fold manifestation of himself he creates the world and in the same way preserves and destroys it. In one manifestation as Brahmā, the invisible (Vishnu) assumes a visible shape; in his second manifestation, he appears as the patriarch Marichi and others; Kāla is the third manifestation and all other beings constitute his fourth manifestation. Thus he becomes four-fold in his creation invested with the quality of goodness. The Deity in one portion as Vishnu, preserves the creation; in his second portion he assumes the shape of Manu and others; in his third portion he assumes the shape of time, and in his fourth portion he assumes the shape of all beings. And thus invested with the quality of goodness, the excellent Purusha preserves the universe. And invested with the quality of darkness at the end of creation the un-born Deity, in one portion, assumes the form of Rudra. In another portion he assumes the shape of fire—in another he assumes the shape of time, and in his fourth portion he assumes the shape of all beings. And thus in his four-fold form he is the destroyer of the universe. This is the four-fold division of the Deity, O Brahman, at all seasons.

Brahmā, Daksha, time and all beings, are the energies of the Great Hari, which are the causes of creation. Vishnu, Manu, time and all beings are energies, O twice-born one, of Vishnu, which are the causes of preservation. Rudra, Antaka, time and all other creatures are the energies of Janārddana that are intended for universal dissolution. In the beginning of the creation, till the hour of dissolution, Brahmā, the patriarchs and all other animals, are engaged with the work of creation. At first Brahmā created the universe, then Marichi and others were engaged in multiplying the race and then the other animals multiply it every moment. O twice born one, Brahmā cannot create the universe unless the proper time comes, and Marichi and other patriarchs as well as other animals, independent of time, cannot help the creation. Thus at the time of creation as well as that of dissolution the four-fold divisions of the Great Deity are equally essential, O Maitreya. Whatever is generated by any living being, O twice-born one—the agent is considered as a portion of Hari. And whatever destroys any living being, moveable or immoveable, is considered as the destroying portion of Janārddana as Rudra. In this wise Janārddana is the creator, preserver and destroyer of the universe. And assuming three qualities he is three-fold—in creation, preservation and destruction—but his true form is void of these qualities. And the four-fold manifestation of the Deity comprises true wisdom, pervades the universe, and does not admit of any similitude. Maitreya said:—"Describe to me, in sooth, O Muni, how could the supreme condition of the Deity admit of four varieties?" Parāçara said:—O Maitreya, that which is called the cause of a thing is the means of accomplishing it; and what is the desire of the soul to accomplish is the thing accomplished. The suspension of breath and the like operations, of the Yogi who is intent upon obtaining final emancipation, are his means and the end is the supreme Brahma from whom he does not return to the world. O Muni, the means, adopted for liberation by the ascetic, is the discriminative knowledge and this is the first variety of the condition of Brahma, O great Muni, the second portion is the knowledge that is to be obtained by the ascetics for liberation from suffering. By the third sort, they arrive at the knowledge of the identity of the end and the means and the rejection of the idea of duality. The last sort is the removal of whatever differences may have been formed regarding the three first varieties of knowledge and the necessary contemplation of the true essence of soul. The highest condition of Vishnu, who is identical with wisdom, is the knowledge of the truth. This knowledge requires no exercise, is not to be taught, is spread all over, admits of no comparison with anything, which does not require any other thing to explain it, which is itself existent and docs not require any explanation, which is calm, fearless and pure, which is not the subject of reasoning and does not require any support. And this knowledge is the excellent condition of Vishnu. O twice-born one, these ascetics, who, by the destruction of ignorance, emerge themselves in this knowledge of Brahma, lose the semenial property and do not germinate in the field of worldly existence. That which is the excellent condition of Vishnu is pure, eternal, universal, undecaying and uniform. And the ascetic who obtains this supreme condition of Brahma is not required to be born again, for he is freed from the distinction of virtue and vice and suffering.

There are two states of Brahma—one with shape and the other without it—one perishable and the other imperishable. These two states are manifest everywhere. As the blaze of fire, at one place, spreads light and heat all around so this vast universe is nothing but the manifestation of the energy of the undecaying and eternal Brahma. And as the light and heat are stronger or feebler proportionate to the distance of the spot, so the energy of Brahma is more or less manifest in beings as they are more or less remote from him. O Brāhman, Brahma, Vishnu and Siva are the most powerful energies of Brahma: next to them, O Maitreya, are the inferior celestials—next to them are the patriarch Daksha and others—next to them, men, beasts, birds and serpents and then the trees and plants each growing feebler proportionate to their distance from the Supreme God. In this way, the world, although eternal and indestructable, appears and disappears as if being subject to birth and death.

The all-powerful Vishnu is but the manifestation of Brahma. He being invested with form, the Yogis worship him at the very commencement. And the great ascetics, with their minds unagitated, in whose minds exists great spirit of devotion with the object to be meditated upon and along with the means for effecting it, endeavour to bring about mystic union with him. O great Muni, Hari is the most powerful of all the energies of Brahma, because he is the most immediate. And he is an embodiment of Brahma because he is composed entirely of his essence. In him the whole universe is interwoven—from him and in him is the universe, O Muni. Vishnu, the lord of the universe containing all that is destructable and indestructable, holds the creation material and spiritual with his ornaments and weapons.

Maitreya said:—"Do thou relate to me how does the great God Vishnu hold the universe with his ornaments and weapons".

Parāçara said:—Having bowed down unto the mighty and indescribable Vishnu I shall relate to you what was formerly described by Vasishtha, The Great Hari holds the pure soul of the world uncontaminated and divested of qualities like the Kaustava gem. The undecaying holds Pakriti as Srivatsa mark and intellect exists in Mādhava in the shape of his mace. The lord holds the two-folded divisions of egotism namely into elements and organs of sense in the shape of his conch-shell and bow. He holds in his hand, in the shape of discus, mind which is the strength of all and excels wind in its flight. The necklace, of the holder of mace, namely Vaijayenti, contains five precious gems (pearl, ruby, emerald, sapphire and diamond) being the emblems of the five elemental rudiments. Janārddana holds the faculties of action and perception in the shape of numerous shafts. The holy wisdom is the bright sword of Achyuta concealed sometimes in the scabbard of ignorance. In this wise, O Maitreya, Hrishikesha is the refuge of soul, nature, intellect, egotism, the elements, the senses, mind, ignorance and wisdom. And although Hari is without any shape, yet, he, for the behoof of mankind, in his dillusive form, embodies the elements of the world as his weapons and ornaments. Then the lotus-eyed deity, the lord of the universe, holds the nature and the universes. O Maitreya, true wisdom, ignorance, all that is transient, all that is everlasting, exist in the slayer of Madhu, the lord of all creatures. The time with its division of seconds, minutes, days, months, seasons, and years, is but the manifestation of the Great Hari. O Great Muni, the seven worlds, the earth the sky, the heaven, the world of Patriarchs, of sages, of saints, of truth are but diverse manifestations of his. His form is the whole universe; he is first born before all the first-born. He is the refuge of ail being; he is himself self-sustained; his various forms are celestials, men and animals. Therefore he is the supreme lord of all; eternal; he has a visible shape and is without it He is known in the Vedanta as the Rich, Yajush, Sāma and Atharva Vedas, history and sacred science. The Vedas with their manifold divisions, the institutes of Manu and the writings of other law-givers, sacred lores and their translations, poems and all that is said or sung are bodily forms of that Great Vishnu in the shape of sound. All kinds of things with or without form—here or elsewhere are the body of Vishnu. I am Hari; all this is Janārddana, cause and effect proceed from none else but him. He, who is cognizant of these truths, shall never be subject to the afflictions of worldly existence.

Thus, O twice-born one, the first portion of the Purāna, has been related to you, hearing which one may be freed from sins. The man, who hears this, obtains the fruit of bathing in the Pushkara lake for twelve years in the month of Kartik. O Muni, the celestials confer upon him, who hears this Purāna, the dignity of a divine sage, of a patriarch, or of a spirit of a heaven.

THE END OF PART I.
